```python
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V44_END\n"
HELPER_SIZE = 60428
HELPER_SHA256 = "dbca295b37576ada70096481055fb3dbc9e67f269d15b76ff8203ad55e87a119"


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or path.is_symlink() or before.st_size > maximum:
        raise RuntimeError("unsafe V44 source input")
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V44 source input identity mismatch")
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(descriptor, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V44 source input changed")
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    if len(payload) != before.st_size:
        raise RuntimeError("V44 source input short read")
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 16 * 1024 * 1024)
if plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) != 1 or plan_bytes.count(END) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("V44 source marker mismatch")
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:plan_bytes.index(END, start)]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 1024 * 1024)
if len(helper_bytes) != HELPER_SIZE or hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() != HELPER_SHA256:
    raise RuntimeError("V44 helper identity mismatch")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v44_source_freeze", HELPER)
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("V44 helper import failed")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(module.main(sys.argv[1:], source_bytes=source_bytes, helper_bytes=helper_bytes))
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V44_END
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v43_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V43_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V43_END\n"
HELPER_SIZE = 48825
HELPER_SHA256 = "482f3266f0d4775114dd4c496733470b3bf9839bda61a635b96ab810a4f60750"


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or path.is_symlink() or before.st_size > maximum:
        raise RuntimeError("unsafe V43 source input")
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V43 source input identity mismatch")
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(descriptor, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V43 source input changed")
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    if len(payload) != before.st_size:
        raise RuntimeError("V43 source input short read")
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 16 * 1024 * 1024)
if plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) != 1 or plan_bytes.count(END) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("V43 source marker mismatch")
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:plan_bytes.index(END, start)]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 1024 * 1024)
if len(helper_bytes) != HELPER_SIZE or hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() != HELPER_SHA256:
    raise RuntimeError("V43 helper identity mismatch")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v43_source_freeze", HELPER)
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("V43 helper import failed")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(module.main(sys.argv[1:], source_bytes=source_bytes, helper_bytes=helper_bytes))
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V43_END
```

### Unique embedded root-only preparation source

The following source is the sole V41 root-only source. It loads only the
exact Trusted-Main helper after verifying its bytes; the helper independently
derives and audits the V41 driver before any fixed-root creation.

```python
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V41_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v41_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V41_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V41_END\n"
HELPER_SIZE = 57374
HELPER_SHA256 = "24d6487bf9b6d1e427ba1fcc90a07cc1ec03336e453eabb62fe2f72f0f44ad98"


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or path.is_symlink() or before.st_size > maximum:
        raise RuntimeError("unsafe V41 source input")
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V41 source input identity mismatch")
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(descriptor, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size):
            raise RuntimeError("V41 source input changed")
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    if len(payload) != before.st_size:
        raise RuntimeError("V41 source input short read")
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 16 * 1024 * 1024)
if plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) != 1 or plan_bytes.count(END) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("V41 source marker mismatch")
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:plan_bytes.index(END, start)]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 1024 * 1024)
if len(helper_bytes) != HELPER_SIZE or hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() != HELPER_SHA256:
    raise RuntimeError("V41 helper identity mismatch")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v41_source_freeze", HELPER)
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("V41 helper import failed")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(module.main(sys.argv[1:], source_bytes=source_bytes, helper_bytes=helper_bytes))
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V41_END
```

# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V40_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v40_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V40_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V40_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 52494
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "227a27e6adc77357e829caaa0ed617c941c7aa39e70cd96dbd0d1dfa93cb1dfe"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v40_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V40_END

The finding is compatible with the accepted architecture. Current
`src/liveclip/media/secure_files.py` is 65,066 bytes / SHA-256
`8bf78b587f96b82cd2c2669c2d1b32b10431217ef9bf51f6bed6b171af7f29b6`;

atomic no-replace publication, and rollback. Letting a fresh isolated Coder
modify that adapter preserves dependency direction. Duplicating its traversal
inside `agent_clipping_validation` would violate the application-to-adapter
boundary and is forbidden.

The exact defect is at private
`_scan_regular_directory_tree`: it snapshots `tuple(iterator)` and recurses
into every directory before `_validate_pinned_directory_files` compares the
observed sets with the expected pinned-file tree. Therefore a hostile or
accidental unexpected subtree can consume unbounded entries, memory, depth,
descriptors, and time before rejection. This is a real T2 acceptance gap; it
does not justify broader product, schema, dependency, or control-plane scope.

consume `os.scandir` incrementally, bound seen-state by the exact expected

recursion. It must never materialize an unbounded iterator or enumerate an
unexpected subtree. Existing fd/path identity checks, pinned rehash,

# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V39_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v39_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V39_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V39_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 36839
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "0eb140d96c2ec000e737c5ba50d85b66296a33f6a55a438c160b80881aa3bdfe"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v39_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V39_END

# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V38_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v38_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V38_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V38_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 41978
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "e6ec4f0400ee4a4477d82e5a75b4294900477834a8a5430d024d0fc18d9f4501"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v38_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V38_END

# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V37_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v37_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V37_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V37_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 37310
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "293041d4ef2cbc336ffcb9e77d4b333bd165a00c1e642960f8b40a2d3b142ceb"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v37_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V37_END

```python
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V36_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v36_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V36_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V36_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 34717
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "af81d42d4fe9840b9b71c050a65e8302dd461f0a6d9d587f80e317f588968eab"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v36_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V36_END
```

```python
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V35_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v35_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V35_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V35_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 35092
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "86a376a73130fea509582b9ad5da0a9ceef90ec9327adf206163bd9a2307d8af"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v35_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V35_END
```

```python
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 48066
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "1a105b430a1c42357f817d86cd7ab077866605ec20244023621eb4577642ca89"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v34_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V34_END
```

```python
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V32_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v32_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V32_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V32_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 38831
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "9d5ad6c51ffb33782b1e61f84614a7315c2baa51e0f63a9412ad1c6706c967c2"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(
    plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1,
    "source marker mismatch",
)
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(
    hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256,
    "helper hash mismatch",
)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v32_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(
    module.main(
        sys.argv[1:],
        source_bytes=source_bytes,
        helper_bytes=helper_bytes,
    )
)
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V32_END
```

engineering acceptance.

```python
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V31_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


PLAN = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md")
HELPER = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/autoclip/tools/loop_engineering/m3s_v31_source_freeze.py")
BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V31_BEGIN\n"
END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V31_END\n"
EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE = 47433
EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256 = "ccf537707fdca1d0aeaee9ba4eaf7e894ac82e1cd5956b18b8bf3ed164e44548"


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int) -> bytes:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe preparation input",
    )
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "preparation input exceeds bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            "opened preparation identity mismatch",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            "preparation input changed during read",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short preparation read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        "preparation path identity changed",
    )
    return payload


plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
require(plan_bytes.count(BEGIN) == 1 and plan_bytes.count(END) == 1, "source marker mismatch")
start = plan_bytes.index(BEGIN) + len(BEGIN)
finish = plan_bytes.index(END, start)
source_bytes = plan_bytes[start:finish]
helper_bytes = read_regular(HELPER, 128 * 1024)
require(len(helper_bytes) == EXPECTED_HELPER_SIZE, "helper size mismatch")
require(hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_HELPER_SHA256, "helper hash mismatch")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("liveclip_m3s_v31_source_freeze", HELPER)
require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "helper loader unavailable")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
raise SystemExit(module.main(sys.argv[1:], source_bytes=source_bytes, helper_bytes=helper_bytes))
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V31_END
```

### Decision Log

- Use a standalone, credential-purpose-limited driver rather than adding auth
  capability to the immutable V30 driver. The root-only prerequisite and the
  later handoff each have one independent use. Root success grants no handoff
  or formal authority; handoff success grants no formal authority.
- Root-only validates current documents, the accepted V30 root and result,
  the exact candidate/run receipts, branch/HEAD/inventories, candidate set,
  pinned Codex executable, source/driver/contract equality, and root absence
  before `mkdir`. It parses and compiles the future driver but never imports or
  executes it and never reaches either authentication location.
- The completed handoff validated the sealed M3A-v1 root, current documents, all
  V30/candidate/run bindings, pristine state, private HOME/TMPDIR, inventory,
  result absence, and pinned Codex executable before opening the authorized
  source. The destination is created with `O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW`, mode
  `0600`; source and destination descriptors are identity-correlated and
  fsynced in the same process. No destructive cleanup exists.
- The handoff receipt has exactly eight sanitized non-secret fields:
  `copy_success`, `destination_mode`, `destination_owner_uid`,
  `format_version`, `login_status`, `phase`, `result`, and
  `sanitized_error`. Errors are fixed uppercase codes. The receipt has no
  credential path/name/content/size/hash/timestamp/account/channel/argv field.
- The pinned login-status child receives the exact candidate-private HOME and
  TMPDIR in an eight-name clean environment, `shell=False`, a fresh process
  group, 30-second timeout, and stdin/stdout/stderr `DEVNULL`. No environment
  credential is forwarded.
- The accepted sanitized receipt proves only that the bounded handoff reached
  its supported authenticated status. It does not certify Planner output,
  Coder work, Runner evidence, review, tests, Gateway acceptance, candidate
  publication, delivery publication, or any product behavior.

```python
    "v30": {"driver_sha256": "520f6a6ccb243ae970d1160c3c94935eed348dde4453368abd2355c8d6d5038f", "final_index_sha256": "1b3e06d653d93ef52615bf9369a33927c0cbf186e3b00b89d78a9055237a850b", "result_sha256": "509bbec65b5cb07bc19bf0d9c740c945322209201dc23d322f06e0a7c856de2a"},
}
ROOT_FILES = {
    "controller-acceptance-v1.json", "final-index.json", "self-check-result.json",
    "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json",
}
SHAPE = (
    "auth-handoff", "--expected-self-sha", None,
    "--plan", None, "--expected-plan-sha256", None,
    "--status", None, "--expected-status-sha256", None,
    "--expected-root-final-index-sha256", None,
    "--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", None,
)


class AuthStop(RuntimeError):
    pass


def stop(code: str) -> None:
    if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_]+", code) is None:
        raise AuthStop("UNEXPECTED_STOP")
    raise AuthStop(code)


def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        stop(code)


def sha(payload: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 8 * 1024 * 1024) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "NONSECRET_FILE_UNSAFE")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "NONSECRET_FILE_CHANGED")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "NONSECRET_FILE_CHANGED")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "NONSECRET_FILE_CHANGED")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path, max(size, 1))
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "NONSECRET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "NONSECRET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": CURRENT_UID, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_MISMATCH")


def git_capture(repo: Path, args: list[str]) -> bytes:
    process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - fixed git path and literal read-only argv
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), *args], cwd=repo,
        env={"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": str(TARGET / "home"), "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": str(TARGET / "tmp"), "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING},
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True, shell=False,
    )
    try:
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=30)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        stop("GIT_TIMEOUT")
    require(process.returncode == 0 and len(stdout) <= 65536 and len(stderr) <= 65536, "GIT_FAILED")
    require(stderr == b"" or (len(stderr) == 106 and sha(stderr) == "54dc9366cf6d804bdf5ae1ffa172dab10fc68a63170232134cbe6981ee4634fb"), "GIT_FAILED")
    return stdout


def inventory(repo: Path, expected: tuple[int, int, int]) -> None:
    branch = git_capture(repo, ["branch", "--show-current"])
    head = git_capture(repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    status_payload = git_capture(repo, ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"])
    require(branch == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode() and head == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "GIT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    lines = status_payload.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    observed = (
        sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}),
        sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}),
        sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")),
    )
    require(observed == expected, "GIT_INVENTORY_MISMATCH")


def parse_values() -> dict[str, str]:
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(len(tokens) == len(SHAPE), "ARGV_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    index = 0
    while index < len(SHAPE):
        expected = SHAPE[index]
        require(expected == tokens[index], "ARGV_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")
        if index + 1 < len(SHAPE) and SHAPE[index + 1] is None:
            require(index + 1 < len(tokens) and bool(tokens[index + 1]), "ARGV_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")
            values[expected.removeprefix("--").replace("-", "_")] = tokens[index + 1]
            index += 2
        else:
            index += 1
    return values


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "RESULT_WRITE_FAILED")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_size == len(payload), "RESULT_WRITE_FAILED")
    directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": str(TARGET / "home"), "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": str(TARGET / "tmp"),
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and Path.cwd() == TARGET / "repo" and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID, "ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH")


def validate_root(values: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    private_directory(ROOT)
    private_directory(RECEIPTS)
    private_directory(ROOT / "home")
    private_directory(ROOT / "tmp")
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"handoff-driver.py", "home", "receipts", "tmp"}, "ROOT_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == ROOT_FILES, "ROOT_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
    require(not os.path.lexists(RESULT), "RESULT_ALREADY_EXISTS")
    self_payload, self_info = read_regular(DRIVER)
    require(sha(self_payload) == values["expected_self_sha"] and self_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(self_info.st_mode) == 0o600, "SELF_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    final_payload, _ = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json")
    acceptance_payload, _ = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "controller-acceptance-v1.json")
    require(sha(final_payload) == values["expected_root_final_index_sha256"], "ROOT_INDEX_MISMATCH")
    require(sha(acceptance_payload) == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_MISMATCH")
    final_value = json.loads(final_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    acceptance_value = json.loads(acceptance_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(final_value["phase"] == "M3A_V1_FINAL_INDEX" and final_value["verdict"] == "M3A_V1_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW", "ROOT_INDEX_MISMATCH")
    require(final_value["contract_sha256"] == sha(compact(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)), "CONTRACT_MISMATCH")
    require(acceptance_value["contract"] == HANDOFF_CONTRACT and acceptance_value["contract_sha256"] == sha(compact(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)), "CONTRACT_MISMATCH")


def validate_documents(values: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    require(Path(values["plan"]) == PLAN and Path(values["status"]) == STATUS, "DOCUMENT_PATH_MISMATCH")
    plan_payload, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_payload, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require(sha(plan_payload) == values["expected_plan_sha256"] and sha(status_payload) == values["expected_status_sha256"], "DOCUMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")


def validate_v30_and_target() -> None:
    private_directory(V30_ROOT)
    require(set(os.listdir(V30_ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "receipts", "tmp"}, "V30_ROOT_MISMATCH")
    require(set(os.listdir(V30_ROOT / "receipts")) == {"controller-acceptance-v30.json", "final-index.json", "self-check-result.json", "source-receipt.json", "successor-preparation-v30-result.json", "writer-self-test.json"}, "V30_ROOT_MISMATCH")
    for relative, (size, digest) in V30_FILES.items():
        identity(V30_ROOT / relative, size, digest)
    result_value = json.loads(read_regular(V30_ROOT / "receipts/successor-preparation-v30-result.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(result_value["returncode"] == 0 and result_value["timed_out"] is False and result_value["output_truncated"] is False and result_value["wrapper_error"] is None and result_value["session_id"] is None and result_value["credential_variables"] == [], "V30_RESULT_MISMATCH")
    private_directory(TARGET)
    require(set(os.listdir(TARGET)) == {"home", "repo", "successor-receipts", "tmp"}, "TARGET_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
    for relative, (size, digest) in TARGET_FILES.items():
        mode = 0o644 if relative.endswith("state.json") or relative.endswith("events.jsonl") else 0o600
        identity(TARGET / relative, size, digest, mode)
    state_value = json.loads(read_regular(RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        state_value["run_id"] == RUN_ID
        and state_value["state"] == "received"
        and state_value["cycle"] == 0
        and state_value["code_cycle"] == 0
        and state_value["coder_session_id"] is None
        and state_value["artifacts"] == {}
        and state_value["command_results"] == []
        and state_value["last_error"] is None,
        "RUN_NOT_PRISTINE",
    )
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "CANDIDATE_SET_MISMATCH")
    inventory(DELIVERY, EXPECTED_DELIVERY)
    inventory(TARGET / "repo", EXPECTED_TARGET)


def validate_private_runtime() -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
    home = TARGET / "home"
    tmp = TARGET / "tmp"
    private_directory(home)
    private_directory(tmp)
    private_directory(home / ".codex")
    require(CODEX.is_symlink() and Path(os.readlink(CODEX)) == CODEX_TARGET, "CODEX_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    identity(CODEX_TARGET, CODEX_SIZE, CODEX_SHA, 0o755)
    return TARGET / "repo", home, tmp


def opaque_copy_state() -> tuple[str, int]:
    try:
        before = AUTH_SOURCE.lstat()
        if not (stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not AUTH_SOURCE.is_symlink() and before.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) == 0o600 and 0 < before.st_size <= 4 * 1024 * 1024):
            stop("SOURCE_UNSAFE")
        source_fd = os.open(AUTH_SOURCE, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    except AuthStop:
        raise
    except BaseException:
        stop("SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE")
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(source_fd)
        source_guard = (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode), opened.st_size, opened.st_mtime_ns, opened.st_ctime_ns)
        path_guard = (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode), before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns)
        if source_guard != path_guard:
            stop("SOURCE_CHANGED")
        try:
            destination_fd = os.open(AUTH_DESTINATION, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        except BaseException:
            stop("DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE")
        try:
            while True:
                block = os.read(source_fd, 65536)
                if not block:
                    break
                view = memoryview(block)
                while view:
                    written = os.write(destination_fd, view)
                    if written <= 0:
                        stop("DESTINATION_WRITE_FAILED")
                    view = view[written:]
            os.fsync(destination_fd)
            destination_info = os.fstat(destination_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(destination_fd)
        final_source = os.fstat(source_fd)
        after = AUTH_SOURCE.lstat()
        final_guard = (final_source.st_dev, final_source.st_ino, final_source.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(final_source.st_mode), final_source.st_size, final_source.st_mtime_ns, final_source.st_ctime_ns)
        after_guard = (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode), after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns)
        if final_guard != source_guard or after_guard != source_guard:
            stop("SOURCE_CHANGED")
    finally:
        os.close(source_fd)
    destination_path_info = AUTH_DESTINATION.lstat()
    if not (stat.S_ISREG(destination_info.st_mode) and stat.S_ISREG(destination_path_info.st_mode) and not AUTH_DESTINATION.is_symlink() and destination_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and destination_path_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(destination_info.st_mode) == 0o600 and stat.S_IMODE(destination_path_info.st_mode) == 0o600 and (destination_info.st_dev, destination_info.st_ino, destination_info.st_size) == (destination_path_info.st_dev, destination_path_info.st_ino, destination_path_info.st_size)):
        stop("DESTINATION_UNSAFE")
    directory_fd = os.open(AUTH_DESTINATION.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)
    return "0600", CURRENT_UID


def terminate_group(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
    try:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        process.wait(timeout=5)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.wait(timeout=5)
        except BaseException:
            stop("LOGIN_STATUS_TERMINATION_FAILED")


def login_status(repo: Path, home: Path, tmp: Path) -> str:
    env = {
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": str(home), "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": str(tmp),
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    try:
        process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - exact pinned non-secret status argv
            [str(CODEX), "login", "status"], cwd=repo, env=env,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True, shell=False,
        )
        try:
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            terminate_group(process)
            stop("LOGIN_STATUS_TIMEOUT")
        if returncode != 0:
            stop("LOGIN_STATUS_NOT_AUTHENTICATED")
    except AuthStop:
        raise
    except BaseException:
        stop("LOGIN_STATUS_FAILED")
    return "SUPPORTED_AUTHENTICATED"


def receipt(copy_success: bool, destination_mode: str | None, destination_owner_uid: int | None, status_value: str, result: str, sanitized_error: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "copy_success": copy_success,
        "destination_mode": destination_mode,
        "destination_owner_uid": destination_owner_uid,
        "format_version": 1,
        "login_status": status_value,
        "phase": "M3A_V1_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "result": result,
        "sanitized_error": sanitized_error,
    }


def main() -> int:
    copy_success = False
    destination_mode: str | None = None
    destination_owner_uid: int | None = None
    status_value = "NOT_RUN"
    result_gate = False
    try:
        values = parse_values()
        validate_environment()
        validate_root(values)
        result_gate = True
        validate_documents(values)
        validate_v30_and_target()
        repo, home, tmp = validate_private_runtime()
        destination_mode, destination_owner_uid = opaque_copy_state()
        copy_success = True
        status_value = login_status(repo, home, tmp)
        value = receipt(True, destination_mode, destination_owner_uid, status_value, "READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW", None)
        write_exclusive(RESULT, pretty(value))
        os.write(1, compact(value) + b"\n")
        return 0
    except AuthStop as exc:
        value = receipt(copy_success, destination_mode, destination_owner_uid, status_value, "STOPPED", str(exc))
    except BaseException:
        value = receipt(copy_success, destination_mode, destination_owner_uid, status_value, "STOPPED", "UNEXPECTED_STOP")
    if result_gate:
        try:
            write_exclusive(RESULT, pretty(value))
        except BaseException:
            return 1
        os.write(1, compact(value) + b"\n")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3A_DRIVER_V1_END
'''


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(payload: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 8 * 1024 * 1024) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path, max(size, 1))
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "identity mismatch")
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "mode or owner mismatch")
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": CURRENT_UID, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": CURRENT_UID}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def git_capture(repo: Path, args: list[str]) -> bytes:
    process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - fixed git path and read-only literal argv
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), *args], cwd=repo,
        env={"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": str(SEED.parent / "home"), "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": PRE_ROOT_TMP, "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING},
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True, shell=False,
    )
    try:
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=30)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        raise RuntimeError("git probe timeout") from None
    require(process.returncode == 0 and len(stdout) <= 65536 and len(stderr) <= 65536, "git probe failed")
    require(stderr == b"" or (len(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SIZE and sha(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SHA), "git stderr mismatch")
    return stdout


def inventory(repo: Path, expected: tuple[int, int, int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    branch = git_capture(repo, ["branch", "--show-current"])
    head = git_capture(repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    status_payload = git_capture(repo, ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"])
    require(branch == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode() and head == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "git identity mismatch")
    lines = status_payload.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    observed = (
        sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}),
        sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}),
        sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")),
    )
    require(observed == expected, "git inventory mismatch")
    return {"branch": EXPECTED_BRANCH, "head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "staged": observed[0], "modified": observed[1], "untracked": observed[2]}


def validate_driver(driver: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(driver, filename="<m3a-v1-driver>")
    compile(driver, "<m3a-v1-driver>", "exec")
    assignments = {node.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(node.value) for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id in {"HANDOFF_CONTRACT", "SHAPE", "ROOT_FILES"}}
    require(assignments["HANDOFF_CONTRACT"] == HANDOFF_CONTRACT, "driver contract mismatch")
    require(len(assignments["SHAPE"]) == 15 and assignments["SHAPE"][0] == "auth-handoff", "driver argv schema mismatch")
    require(set(assignments["ROOT_FILES"]) == {"controller-acceptance-v1.json", "final-index.json", "self-check-result.json", "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json"}, "driver root domain mismatch")
    functions = {node.name: node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
    require({"opaque_copy_state", "login_status", "receipt", "main"}.issubset(functions), "driver function missing")
    opaque = functions["opaque_copy_state"]
    forbidden_calls = {"digest", "hexdigest", "loads", "dumps", "print", "read_text", "read_bytes", "write_text", "unlink", "remove", "replace", "rename"}
    calls = [node for node in ast.walk(opaque) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)]
    observed_forbidden = [node.func.attr for node in calls if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr in forbidden_calls]
    observed_forbidden += [node.func.id for node in calls if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id in forbidden_calls]
    require(observed_forbidden == [], "opaque-copy forbidden call")
    login = functions["login_status"]
    popen = [node for node in ast.walk(login) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name) and node.func.value.id == "subprocess" and node.func.attr == "Popen"]
    require(len(popen) == 1, "login Popen count mismatch")
    call = popen[0]
    keywords = {item.arg: item.value for item in call.keywords}
    require(isinstance(keywords.get("shell"), ast.Constant) and keywords["shell"].value is False, "login shell mismatch")
    for name in ("stdin", "stdout", "stderr"):
        value = keywords.get(name)
        require(isinstance(value, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(value.value, ast.Name) and value.value.id == "subprocess" and value.attr == "DEVNULL", "login channel mismatch")
    receipt_node = functions["receipt"]
    returns = [node.value for node in ast.walk(receipt_node) if isinstance(node, ast.Return) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Dict)]
    require(len(returns) == 1, "receipt schema mismatch")
    fields = [ast.literal_eval(key) for key in returns[0].keys]
    require(fields == HANDOFF_CONTRACT["privacy"]["receipt_fields"], "receipt fields mismatch")
    require(b"logging" not in driver and b"sys.stderr" not in driver and b"--last" not in driver and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in driver and b"loop-run" not in driver, "forbidden driver capability")
    require(driver.count(b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json") == 1 and driver.count(b"home/.codex/auth.json") == 1, "fixed opaque endpoint count mismatch")
    negative = dict(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)
    negative["phase"] = "MUTATED"
    require(negative != assignments["HANDOFF_CONTRACT"] and sha(compact(negative)) != sha(compact(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)), "contract negative fixture failed")
    return {"argv_strings": len(assignments["SHAPE"]), "contract_sha256": sha(compact(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)), "opaque_forbidden_calls": observed_forbidden, "receipt_fields": fields, "result": "PASS"}


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "root-only argv prefix mismatch")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-contract-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def expected_acceptance(args: argparse.Namespace, plan_size: int, status_size: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "authority": "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER",
        "candidate": {"name": TARGET.name, "run_id": RUN_ID},
        "contract": HANDOFF_CONTRACT,
        "contract_sha256": args.expected_contract_sha256,
        "documents": {
            "execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": plan_size},
            "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": status_size},
        },
        "driver": {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size},
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3A_V1_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE",
        "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size},
        "result": "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION",
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "v30": {"final_index_sha256": V30_FILES["receipts/final-index.json"][1], "result_sha256": V30_FILES["receipts/successor-preparation-v30-result.json"][1]},
    }


def preflight(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected_env = {
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": PRE_ROOT_TMP,
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected_env and Path.cwd() == SEED and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID, "root-only environment mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "fixed root already exists")
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    plan_payload, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_payload, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require(sha(plan_payload) == args.expected_plan_sha256 and sha(status_payload) == args.expected_status_sha256, "document identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_payload, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    driver = extract_once(source, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256), "source identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    compile(source, "<m3a-v1-preparation>", "exec")
    static = validate_driver(driver)
    require(static["contract_sha256"] == args.expected_contract_sha256 == sha(compact(HANDOFF_CONTRACT)), "contract identity mismatch")
    acceptance_line = args.controller_acceptance_json.encode("utf-8")
    acceptance_payload = acceptance_line + b"\n"
    require(len(acceptance_payload) == args.expected_acceptance_size and sha(acceptance_payload) == args.expected_acceptance_sha256, "acceptance identity mismatch")
    acceptance_value = json.loads(acceptance_line.decode("utf-8"))
    expected_value = expected_acceptance(args, len(plan_payload), len(status_payload))
    require(acceptance_value == expected_value and acceptance_line == compact(expected_value), "acceptance semantics mismatch")
    require(CODEX.is_symlink() and Path(os.readlink(CODEX)) == CODEX_TARGET, "Codex link mismatch")
    codex = identity(CODEX_TARGET, CODEX_SIZE, CODEX_SHA, 0o755)
    python = identity(PYTHON.resolve(strict=True), PYTHON.resolve(strict=True).stat().st_size, PYTHON_SHA, 0o755)
    private_directory(V30_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "receipts", "tmp"})
    require(set(os.listdir(V30_ROOT / "receipts")) == {"controller-acceptance-v30.json", "final-index.json", "self-check-result.json", "source-receipt.json", "successor-preparation-v30-result.json", "writer-self-test.json"}, "V30 receipt domain mismatch")
    v30 = {relative: identity(V30_ROOT / relative, size, digest) for relative, (size, digest) in V30_FILES.items()}
    private_directory(TARGET, {"home", "repo", "successor-receipts", "tmp"})
    target = {relative: identity(TARGET / relative, size, digest, 0o644 if relative.endswith("state.json") or relative.endswith("events.jsonl") else 0o600) for relative, (size, digest) in TARGET_FILES.items()}
    state_value = json.loads(read_regular(RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state_value["run_id"] == RUN_ID and state_value["state"] == "received" and state_value["cycle"] == 0 and state_value["code_cycle"] == 0 and state_value["coder_session_id"] is None and state_value["artifacts"] == {} and state_value["command_results"] == [] and state_value["last_error"] is None, "run is not pristine")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    return {"acceptance": acceptance_payload, "codex": codex, "delivery": inventory(DELIVERY, EXPECTED_DELIVERY), "driver": driver, "python": python, "source": source, "static": static, "target": target, "v30": v30}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "short write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    fsync_directory(path.parent)
    return identity(path, len(payload), sha(payload), 0o600)


def create_root(pre: dict[str, Any], args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver = write_exclusive(DRIVER, pre["driver"])
    acceptance = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "controller-acceptance-v1.json", pre["acceptance"])
    source_value = {
        "acceptance": acceptance,
        "contract_sha256": args.expected_contract_sha256,
        "documents": {"execplan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256},
        "driver": driver,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3A_V1_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size},
        "result": "PASS",
    }
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty(source_value))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3A_V1_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contract": HANDOFF_CONTRACT, "contract_sha256": args.expected_contract_sha256, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3A_V1_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": pre["static"]}))
    final_value = {
        "acceptance": acceptance,
        "candidate": {"name": TARGET.name, "run_id": RUN_ID},
        "contract_sha256": args.expected_contract_sha256,
        "documents": {"execplan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256},
        "driver": driver,
        "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test},
        "format_version": 1,
        "inventory": pre["delivery"],
        "phase": "M3A_V1_FINAL_INDEX",
        "reserved_result_absent": "auth-handoff-v1-result.json",
        "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": sha(json.dumps([str(PYTHON), "-c", pre["source"].decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]], ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")),
        "v30": {"final_index_sha256": V30_FILES["receipts/final-index.json"][1], "result_sha256": V30_FILES["receipts/successor-preparation-v30-result.json"][1]},
        "verdict": "M3A_V1_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
    }
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty(final_value))
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"handoff-driver.py", "home", "receipts", "tmp"}, "final root domain mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {"controller-acceptance-v1.json", "final-index.json", "self-check-result.json", "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json"}, "final receipt domain mismatch")
    return {"acceptance": acceptance, "driver": driver, "final_index": final_index}


def main() -> int:
    root_created = False
    try:
        args = parse_args()
        pre = preflight(args)
        result = create_root(pre, args)
        root_created = True
        os.write(1, compact({"phase": "M3A_V1_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3A_V1_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW", **result}) + b"\n")
        return 0
    except BaseException:
        os.write(2, compact({"phase": "M3A_V1_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "STOPPED", "root_created": root_created or ROOT.exists() or ROOT.is_symlink(), "sanitized_error": "PRECONDITION_OR_WRITE_FAILED"}) + b"\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3A_PREPARATION_V1_END
```

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(payload: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 8_000_000) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file: " + str(path))
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch: " + str(path))
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1_048_576)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed: " + str(path))
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed: " + str(path))
    return payload, {"device": before.st_dev, "inode": before.st_ino, "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": before.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload), "type": "regular"}


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require((len(payload), sha(payload), info["owner_uid"], info["mode"]) == (size, digest, CURRENT_UID, f"{mode:04o}"), "identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    return info


def private_directory(path: Path, entries: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch: " + str(path))
    actual = set(os.listdir(path))
    if entries is not None:
        require(actual == entries, "directory entries mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"device": info.st_dev, "entries": sorted(actual), "inode": info.st_ino, "mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path)}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "source marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_definition(payload: bytes, name: str, replacement: bytes) -> bytes:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<v30-transform>")
    matches: list[ast.AST] = []
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name:
            matches.append(node)
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
            targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
            if any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name for target in targets):
                matches.append(node)
    require(len(matches) == 1, "definition count mismatch: " + name)
    node = matches[0]
    lines = payload.splitlines(keepends=True)
    require(node.end_lineno is not None, "definition end unavailable: " + name)
    start = sum(len(line) for line in lines[: node.lineno - 1])
    finish = sum(len(line) for line in lines[: node.end_lineno])
    return payload[:start] + replacement + payload[finish:]


def insert_before_once(payload: bytes, anchor: bytes, addition: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(anchor) == 1, "insertion anchor mismatch")
    return payload.replace(anchor, addition + anchor, 1)


def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(["M3S_" + version + "_" + suffix for suffix in PHASE_SUFFIXES] + ["M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + suffix for suffix in SUCCESSOR_SUFFIXES] + ["M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_" + suffix for suffix in DRY_RUN_SUFFIXES])


def exact_python_string_tokens(payload: bytes) -> frozenset[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<phase-policy>")
    return frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))


def phase_source_violations_model(payload: bytes, require_active: bool) -> list[str]:
    exact = exact_python_string_tokens(payload)
    active = ACTIVE_PHASES
    active_set = set(active)
    full_set = set(versioned_phase_tokens("V30"))
    require(len(active) == 14 and len(active_set) == 14 and active_set < full_set, "active model mismatch")
    violations: list[str] = []
    if require_active:
        for phase in active:
            if phase not in exact:
                violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(full_set - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    for phase in tuple(item for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for item in versioned_phase_tokens(version)):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V31"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v31:" + phase)
    for version in range(31, 55):
        name = f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json"
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    for token in (b"candidate.dygENR4n/repo", b"--last", b"resume_liveclip.sh"):
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations

def derive_driver(previous: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(previous), sha(previous)) == (V29_DRIVER_SIZE, V29_DRIVER_SHA), "sealed V29 driver mismatch")
