def validate_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v30-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v30-driver>", "exec")
    assignments: dict[str, ast.AST] = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
            targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
            for target in targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
                    assignments[target.id] = node.value

    def tuple_values(name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        value = assignments[name]
        require(isinstance(value, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)), "tuple assignment shape mismatch: " + name)
        items: list[str] = []
        for item in value.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Starred) and isinstance(item.value, ast.Name):
                items.extend(tuple_values(item.value.id))
            else:
                require(isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str), "tuple item mismatch: " + name)
                items.append(item.value)
        return tuple(items)

    shapes = ast.literal_eval(assignments["SHAPES"])
    successor_receipts = tuple_values("SUCCESSOR_V30_RECEIPTS")
    successor_only_node = assignments["SUCCESSOR_ONLY_RECEIPTS"]
    require(isinstance(successor_only_node, ast.Call) and len(successor_only_node.args) == 1 and isinstance(successor_only_node.args[0], ast.Set), "successor-only receipt shape mismatch")
    successor_only = {item.value for item in successor_only_node.args[0].elts if isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str)}
    require(len(shapes["execute"]) == 25 and len(successor_receipts) == 38 and len(successor_only) == 11, "schema/receipt domain mismatch")
    outcomes = fixture_outcomes()
    violations = phase_source_violations_model(payload, True)
    require(violations == [], "runtime-equivalent phase mismatch: " + ",".join(violations))
    require(payload.count(b"/usr/bin/mktemp") == 2, "mktemp contract/site count mismatch")
    mktemp_sites = sum(
        1
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
        and node.func.id == "bounded"
        and node.args
        and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.List)
        and any(isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and item.value == "/usr/bin/mktemp" for item in node.args[0].elts)
    )
    loop_init_sites = sum(
        1
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
        and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "argv" for target in node.targets)
        and isinstance(node.value, ast.List)
        and any(isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and item.value == "loop-init" for item in node.value.elts)
    )
    require(mktemp_sites == 1 and loop_init_sites == 1, "allocation/init call-site count mismatch")
    require(b"M3S_V30_AUTH_HANDOFF" not in payload, "exact V30 auth phase appeared")
    require(b"auth-handoff-v30-result.json" not in payload, "V30 auth result capability appeared")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "forbidden resume capability appeared")
    protected_count = payload.count(b"home/.codex/auth.json")
    require(protected_count == 3, "protected credential omission fixture count mismatch")
    return {"ast": "PASS", "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_omission_fixture_count": protected_count, "execute_schema_tokens": len(shapes["execute"]), "full_byte_phase_violations": violations, "loop_init_sites": loop_init_sites, "mktemp_sites": mktemp_sites, "phase_fixtures": outcomes, "receipt_count": len(successor_receipts), "receipt_delta": len(successor_only), "result": "PASS"}

    private_directory(V29_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V29_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    expected = {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V29_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")}
    private_directory(V29_ROOT / "receipts", expected)

    value = json.loads(read_regular(V29_ROOT / "receipts/successor-preparation-v29-result.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    stopped = V29_CLOSURE["candidate_recovery"]
    require(value["phase"] == stopped["phase"] and value["returncode"] == 1 and value["elapsed_seconds"] == stopped["elapsed_seconds"], "V29 result fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["timed_out"] is False and value["output_truncated"] is False and value["session_id"] is None and value["credential_variables"] == [] and value["wrapper_error"] is None, "V29 wrapper fields mismatch")

def git_output(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=DELIVERY, env={"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": "0x1F5:0x0:0x0"}, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)  # noqa: S108,S603
    stderr_ok = result.stderr == b"" or (len(result.stderr) == 106 and sha(result.stderr) == "54dc9366cf6d804bdf5ae1ffa172dab10fc68a63170232134cbe6981ee4634fb")
    require(result.returncode == 0 and stderr_ok, "git inventory command failed")
    return result.stdout


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"]) == b"main\n", "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode("ascii"), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    counts = (sum(line[:1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(line.startswith("??") for line in lines))
    require(counts == (0, 15, 156), "inventory mismatch")
    candidates = frozenset(path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink())
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    return {"branch": "main", "candidates": len(candidates), "head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "modified": 15, "staged": 0, "untracked": 156}


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": "0x1F5:0x0:0x0"}  # noqa: S108
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info["owner_uid"] == CURRENT_UID and info["mode"] == "0600", "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": CURRENT_UID, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    for name in ("plan", "status"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-size", required=True, type=int)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_acceptance(value: object, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contract_objects", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V30_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contract_objects"] == CONTRACTS and value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES, "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require({name: sha(compact(contract)) for name, contract in CONTRACTS.items()} == CONTRACT_HASHES, "contract hash recomputation mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size} and value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance source/driver mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == json.loads(compact(V29_CLOSURE).decode("utf-8")) and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING and value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance provenance mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source/driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V30 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    previous, _ = read_regular(V29_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(previous)
    static = validate_driver(derived)
    acceptance = validate_acceptance(json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json), args, source, derived)
    v29 = validate_v29()
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    require(derive_driver(previous) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V30 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "controller-acceptance-v30.json", acceptance)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V30_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": json.loads(compact(V29_CLOSURE).decode("utf-8")), "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V30_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V30_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v29": v29}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V30_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": json.loads(compact(V29_CLOSURE).decode("utf-8")), "reserved_results_absent": ["auth-handoff-v30-result.json", "successor-preparation-v30-result.json"], "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V30_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {"controller-acceptance-v30.json", "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V30_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V30_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file owner or mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

def manifest_included_paths(root: Path) -> tuple[list[tuple[Path, str]], int]:
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), f"unsafe tree root: {root}")
    included: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    omitted = 0
    def visit(directory: Path, prefix: str) -> None:
        nonlocal omitted
        with os.scandir(directory) as iterator:
            entries = sorted(list(iterator), key=lambda entry: os.fsencode(entry.name))
        for entry in entries:
            relative_path = entry.name if not prefix else prefix + "/" + entry.name
            if is_protected_credential_manifest_path(relative_path):
                omitted += 1
                continue
            path = Path(entry.path); included.append((path, relative_path))
            if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                visit(path, relative_path)
    visit(root, ""); included.sort(key=lambda item: os.fsencode(item[1]))
    return included, omitted


def tree_manifest(root: Path, expected_protected_credential_omissions: int | None = None) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, int]]:
    included, omitted = manifest_included_paths(root)
    if expected_protected_credential_omissions is not None:
        require(omitted == expected_protected_credential_omissions, "protected credential omission count mismatch")
    payload_parts: list[bytes] = []; regular_bytes = 0
    for _path, relative_path in included:
        record = file_record(root, os.fsencode(relative_path), None)
        if record["type"] == "regular":
            regular_bytes += int(record["size"])
        payload_parts.append(compact(record) + b"\\n")
    return b"".join(payload_parts), {"path_count": len(included), "regular_file_bytes": regular_bytes}
"""
    return source.replace("__OMISSIONS__", repr(omissions)).encode("utf-8")

    require(set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V25_CANDIDATE / "successor-receipts")) == set(index["files"]) | {"final-receipt-index.json"} and len(index["files"]) == 36, "V25 candidate receipt domain mismatch")

    run = PREVIOUS_M3S_V25_CANDIDATE / "repo/.loop/runs" / PREVIOUS_M3S_V25_RUN_ID

V26_PREDECESSOR_DRIVER_FUNCTIONS = b'''def canonical_json_model(value: object) -> object:
    return json.loads(compact(value).decode("utf-8"))


def acceptance_provenance_model_self_test() -> dict[str, Any]:
    tuple_model = {"candidate_files": {"receipt.json": (7, "a" * 64)}}
    parsed_model = json.loads(compact(tuple_model).decode("utf-8"))
    require(tuple_model != parsed_model, "tuple/list defect fixture did not differ")
    require(canonical_json_model(tuple_model) == canonical_json_model(parsed_model), "canonical provenance positive fixture mismatch")
    negative = canonical_json_model(parsed_model)
    negative["candidate_files"]["receipt.json"][0] = 8
    require(canonical_json_model(tuple_model) != negative, "canonical provenance negative fixture accepted")
    return {"normalized_tuple_fields": 1, "negative_mutations_rejected": 1, "result": "PASS"}


def validate_m3s_v26_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(not PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_ROOT.exists() and not PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V26 stopped root appeared")
    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE["before_root_mkdir"] is True and PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE["root_exists"] is False, "V26 stop boundary mismatch")
    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE["error"] == "RuntimeError: acceptance provenance mismatch" and PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE["provenance_mismatch"]["field_count"] == 13, "V26 stop evidence mismatch")
    require(canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE) == PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE, "V26 closure is not canonical JSON-shaped")
    return PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE


'''


def derive_v26_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V25_DRIVER_SIZE, V25_DRIVER_SHA), "V25 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V26"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v26:" + phase)\n', b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V27"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v27:" + phase)\n', "future phase policy")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V26")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V26 fixture mismatch")\n', b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V27")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V27 fixture mismatch")\n', "future phase fixture")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(26, 55)", b"range(27, 55)", "future receipt range")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V25", b"V26").replace(b"v25", b"v26")
    predecessor_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_domain) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_domain, predecessor_domain[:-1] + b', "V25"}')
    bad_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V26", "V26"}'
    good_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27"}'
    payload = replace_once(payload, bad_domain, good_domain, "phase version domain")
    start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = ")
    hash_start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start)
    finish = payload.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    payload = payload[:start] + ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(V26_CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(V26_CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode() + payload[finish:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", predecessor_v25_driver_block() + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V25 predecessor constants")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + V25_PREDECESSOR_DRIVER_FUNCTIONS + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v24_stopped": validate_m3s_v24_stopped(),\n', b'        "m3s_v24_stopped": validate_m3s_v24_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v25_stopped": validate_m3s_v25_stopped(),\n', "V25 predecessor gate")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V24_CLOSURE', b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V25_CLOSURE', "V25 acceptance closure")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    "candidate.o99gfxup": ', b'    "candidate.VoU5SVVl": (44319, 947850511, "50d0d63aa147df6ff9bf5595bfe4bdc6e55c6ceb3bf9bf9a7b449bd980e17665", "2a6eeb6ddb9b85c3574df51ddaddbb56c922456f6d755c9eb881a03b299a22b1"),\n    "candidate.o99gfxup": ', "V25 candidate predecessor")
    omission_start = payload.index(b"PREDECESSOR_PROTECTED_CREDENTIAL_OMISSIONS = ")
    omission_end = payload.index(b"\n", omission_start)
    omissions = {name: (1 if name == "candidate.KWbe2iGW" else 0) for name in sorted(EXPECTED_CANDIDATES)}
    payload = payload[:omission_start] + ("PREDECESSOR_PROTECTED_CREDENTIAL_OMISSIONS = " + repr(omissions)).encode() + payload[omission_end:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        expected_paths.update({context_path, acceptance_path})\n', b'        expected_paths.add(context_path)\n', "ignored acceptance path-set repair")
    old_acceptance = b'''        acceptance_row = rows[acceptance_path]
        require(acceptance_row["class"] == "ordinary-untracked" and acceptance_row["type"] == "regular" and acceptance_row["mode"] == "0600", "controller acceptance record identity mismatch")
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 74,
            "records": 2325,
        }
'''
    new_acceptance = b'''        require(acceptance_path not in rows, "ignored controller acceptance entered Git manifest")
        source_acceptance, source_info = read_regular(M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME)
        candidate_acceptance, candidate_info = read_regular(repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL)
        source_owner = correlate_read_identity_owner(M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME, source_info, "0600")
        candidate_owner = correlate_read_identity_owner(repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL, candidate_info, "0600")
        require(candidate_acceptance == source_acceptance and candidate_owner == source_owner == CURRENT_UID, "ignored controller acceptance byte/owner mismatch")
        acceptance_identity = {"mode": candidate_info["mode"], "owner_uid": candidate_owner, "path": str(repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL), "sha256": sha(candidate_acceptance), "size": len(candidate_acceptance)}
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 73,
            "records": 2324,
        }
'''
    payload = replace_once(payload, old_acceptance, new_acceptance, "ignored acceptance identity gate")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    return {\n        "counts": counts,\n        "manifest_sha256": sha(payload),\n        "status": current_status,\n    }\n', b'    return {\n        "controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity if context_expected else None,\n        "counts": counts,\n        "manifest_sha256": sha(payload),\n        "status": current_status,\n    }\n', "source validation return")
    return payload

def derive_v28_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V27_DRIVER_SIZE, V27_DRIVER_SHA), "V27 driver identity mismatch")

    payload = payload.replace(b"future_v28", b"future_v29").replace(b"future V28", b"future V29")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V28", b"V29").replace(b"V27", b"V28")
    for old, new in ((b"m3-successor-preparation-v27", b"m3-successor-preparation-v28"), (b"successor-preparation-v27-result.json", b"successor-preparation-v28-result.json"), (b"controller-acceptance-v27.json", b"controller-acceptance-v28.json"), (b"successor-v27-", b"successor-v28-"), (b"active_v27_phases", b"active_v28_phases"), (b"m3s-v27", b"m3s-v28")):
        payload = payload.replace(old, new)

    good_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27", "V28", "V29"}'
    payload = replace_once(payload, bad_domain, good_domain, "phase version domain")

    start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = "); hash_start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start); finish = payload.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    payload = payload[:start] + ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(V28_CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(V28_CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode() + payload[finish:]
    previous = ("PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_ROOT = Path(" + repr(str(V27_ROOT)) + ")\nPREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE = " + repr(V27_CLOSURE) + "\n\n").encode()
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", previous + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V27 predecessor constants")
    helpers = b'def validate_m3s_v27_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    require(not PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_ROOT.exists() and not PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V27 stopped root appeared")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE["before_root_mkdir"] is True and PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE["root_exists"] is False, "V27 stop boundary mismatch")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE["error"] == "RuntimeError: runtime-equivalent phase mismatch", "V27 stop error mismatch")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE["runtime_equivalent_phase_violations"] == ["forbidden_receipt:successor-preparation-v27-result.json"], "V27 phase violation mismatch")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE["precheck"] == {"error": "ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined", "filesystem_mutation": False, "v27_process_launched": False}, "V27 precheck evidence mismatch")\n    require(canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE) == PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE, "V27 closure is not canonical JSON-shaped")\n    return PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE\n\n\n'
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")

    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v26_stopped": validate_m3s_v26_stopped(),\n', b'        "m3s_v26_stopped": validate_m3s_v26_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v27_stopped": validate_m3s_v27_stopped(),\n', "V27 predecessor gate")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'canonical_json_model(value["predecessor_closure"]) == canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V26_CLOSURE)', b'canonical_json_model(value["predecessor_closure"]) == canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE)', "V27 acceptance closure")
    anchor = b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V29")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V29 fixture mismatch")\n'
    extra = anchor + b'    current_result_fixture = b\'"successor-preparation-v28-result.json"\\n\'\n    require(phase_source_violations(current_result_fixture, False) == [], "current V28 result fixture mismatch")\n    future_result_name = "successor-preparation-v" + "29-result.json"\n    future_result_fixture = (repr(future_result_name) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(phase_source_violations(future_result_fixture, False) == ["forbidden_receipt:" + future_result_name], "future V29 result fixture mismatch")\n'
    payload = replace_once(payload, anchor, extra, "driver result phase fixtures")
    return payload


def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V28_DRIVER_SIZE, V28_DRIVER_SHA), "V28 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = payload.replace(b"successor-preparation-v29-result.json", b"successor-preparation-v30-result.json")
    payload = payload.replace(b"future_v29", b"future_v30").replace(b"future V29", b"future V30")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V29", b"V30").replace(b"V28", b"V29")
    for old, new in ((b"m3-successor-preparation-v28", b"m3-successor-preparation-v29"), (b"successor-preparation-v28-result.json", b"successor-preparation-v29-result.json"), (b"controller-acceptance-v28.json", b"controller-acceptance-v29.json"), (b"successor-v28-", b"successor-v29-"), (b"active_v28_phases", b"active_v29_phases"), (b"m3s-v28", b"m3s-v29")):
        payload = payload.replace(old, new)
    predecessor_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_domain) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_domain, predecessor_domain[:-1] + b', "V28"}')
    bad_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27", "V29", "V30"}'
    good_domain = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27", "V28", "V29", "V30"}'
    payload = replace_once(payload, bad_domain, good_domain, "phase version domain")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(29, 55)", b"range(30, 55)", "future receipt range")
    start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = "); hash_start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start); finish = payload.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    payload = payload[:start] + ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode() + payload[finish:]
    previous = ("PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_ROOT = Path(" + repr(str(V28_ROOT)) + ")\nPREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE = " + repr(V28_CLOSURE) + "\n\n").encode()
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", previous + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V28 predecessor constants")
    helpers = b'def validate_m3s_v28_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    require(not PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_ROOT.exists() and not PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V28 stopped root appeared")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE["before_root_mkdir"] is True and PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE["root_exists"] is False, "V28 stop boundary mismatch")\n    require(PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE["error"] == "RuntimeError: V27 intermediate driver mismatch", "V28 stop error mismatch")\n    mismatch = PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE["intermediate_mismatch"]\n    require(mismatch["accepted"] == {"sha256": "891dabdbb9c7e7243852e5f8d61afe3068d22496e8356a5faa7adb7df544383a", "size": 368663}, "V28 accepted intermediate mismatch")\n    require(mismatch["actual"] == {"sha256": "c6aac2b171c8608927b037246f644c2b84e6c52e0a7b2bd48ccec4090a0d59e6", "size": 368723}, "V28 actual intermediate mismatch")\n    require(canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE) == PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE, "V28 closure is not canonical JSON-shaped")\n    return PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE\n\n\n'
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + helpers + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v27_stopped": validate_m3s_v27_stopped(),\n', b'        "m3s_v27_stopped": validate_m3s_v27_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v28_stopped": validate_m3s_v28_stopped(),\n', "V28 predecessor gate")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'canonical_json_model(value["predecessor_closure"]) == canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V27_CLOSURE)', b'canonical_json_model(value["predecessor_closure"]) == canonical_json_model(PREVIOUS_M3S_V28_CLOSURE)', "V28 acceptance closure")
    return payload


def historical_transform_binding_fixtures(v26_driver: bytes, v27_driver: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require((len(v27_driver), sha(v27_driver)) == (V27_DRIVER_SIZE, V27_DRIVER_SHA), "V27 positive transform fixture mismatch")
    start = v27_driver.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = ")
    hash_start = v27_driver.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start)
    finish = v27_driver.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    mutated = v27_driver[:start] + ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(V28_CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(V28_CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode() + v27_driver[finish:]
    require((len(mutated), sha(mutated)) == (BAD_V27_DRIVER_SIZE, BAD_V27_DRIVER_SHA), "captured-global mutation fixture mismatch")
    first = next(index for index, pair in enumerate(zip(v27_driver, mutated, strict=False)) if pair[0] != pair[1])
    require(first == BAD_V27_FIRST_DIFFERENCE and mutated != v27_driver and derive_v27_driver(v26_driver) == v27_driver, "historical transform binding fixture mismatch")
    return {"captured_global_mutation": {"first_difference_offset": first, "sha256": sha(mutated), "size": len(mutated)}, "positive": {"sha256": sha(v27_driver), "size": len(v27_driver)}, "result": "PASS"}


def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v29-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str)); active_set = set(active); violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact: violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(set(versioned_phase_tokens("V29")) - active_set):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    for phase in tuple(item for version in ("V1","V2","V3","V4","V5","V6","V7","V8","V9","V10","V11","V12") for item in versioned_phase_tokens(version)):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V30"):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("future_v30:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(30,55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload: violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    for token in (b"candidate.dygENR4n"+b"/repo",b"--"+b"last",b"resume_liveclip"+b".sh"):
        if token in payload: violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations

    active=versioned_phase_tokens("V29")[0]
    cases={"missing_active":(b"x = 1\n",(active,),["missing_active:"+active]),"inactive_current":(b'x = "M3S_V29_WRITER_SELF_TEST"\n',(),["inactive_active_version:M3S_V29_WRITER_SELF_TEST"]),"stale_predecessor":(b'x = "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"\n',(),["stale_predecessor:M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"]),"future":(b'x = "M3S_V30_SOURCE_WRITE"\n',(),["future_v30:M3S_V30_SOURCE_WRITE"]),"forbidden_receipt":(b'x = "successor-preparation-v30-result.json"\n',(),["forbidden_receipt:successor-preparation-v30-result.json"]),"forbidden_candidate":(b'x = "candidate.dygENR4n/repo"\n',(),["forbidden:candidate.dygENR4n/repo"]),"forbidden_last":(b'x = "--last"\n',(),["forbidden:--last"]),"forbidden_resume":(b'x = "resume_liveclip.sh"\n',(),["forbidden:resume_liveclip.sh"])}
    for name,(payload,phases,expected) in cases.items(): require(runtime_phase_violations(payload,phases)==expected,name+" phase fixture mismatch")
    current_result = b'x = "successor-preparation-v29-result.json"\n'
    require(runtime_phase_violations(current_result, ()) == [], "current V29 result fixture mismatch")
    return {"current_result_fixture":"PASS","negative_fixtures":list(cases),"positive_derived_fixture":"PASS"}

def assignment_map(tree: ast.Module) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    return {node.targets[0].id: node.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)}


def static_value(node: ast.AST) -> Any:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple, ast.Set)):
        values = [static_value(item) for item in node.elts]
        return values if isinstance(node, ast.List) else tuple(values) if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) else set(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
        return {static_value(key): static_value(value) for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values, strict=True)}
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return frozenset(static_value(node.args[0]))
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported static value: " + ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False))


def static_collection(node: ast.AST, assignments: dict[str, ast.expr]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return static_collection(assignments[node.id], assignments)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return static_collection(node.args[0], assignments)
    require(isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)), "unsupported static collection")
    values: list[str] = []
    for item in node.elts:
        if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
            values.extend(static_collection(item.value, assignments))
        else:
            value = static_value(item)
            require(isinstance(value, str), "non-string static collection item")
            values.append(value)
    return tuple(values)


def contract_violations(objects: object, hashes: object) -> list[str]:
    keys = set(CONTRACTS)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(objects, dict) or set(objects) != keys:
        return ["object_keys"]
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != keys:
        return ["hash_keys"]
    if objects != CONTRACTS:
        errors.append("objects")
    if hashes != CONTRACT_HASHES:
        errors.append("accepted_hashes")
    if {name: sha(compact(value)) for name, value in objects.items()} != hashes:
        errors.append("derived_hashes")
    return errors


def contract_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, CONTRACT_HASHES) == [], "contract positive fixture mismatch")
    changed = json.loads(compact(CONTRACTS).decode("utf-8"))
    changed["policy_toolchain"]["policy_contract"] += "-changed"
    require(contract_violations(changed, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["objects", "derived_hashes"], "contract object negative mismatch")
    changed_hashes = dict(CONTRACT_HASHES)
    changed_hashes["trusted_context"] = "0" * 64
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, changed_hashes) == ["accepted_hashes", "derived_hashes"], "contract hash negative mismatch")
    missing = dict(CONTRACTS)
    missing.pop("initial_run")
    require(contract_violations(missing, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["object_keys"], "contract key negative mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": 3, "positive_fixture": "PASS"}


def read_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> list[str]:
    violations: list[str] = []
    for function in (node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        dictionary_names: set[str] = set()
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign) or not isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) or node.value.func.id != "read_regular":
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    dictionary_names.add(target.elts[1].id)
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in dictionary_names:
                violations.append(function.name + ":" + node.value.id + "." + node.attr)
    return violations

def validate_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v29-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v29-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    assignments = assignment_map(tree)
    contracts = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS"])
    hashes = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES"])
    require(contract_violations(contracts, hashes) == [], "derived contract mismatch")
    active = tuple(static_value(assignments["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"]))
    require(len(active) == 14 and runtime_phase_violations(payload, active) == [], "runtime-equivalent phase mismatch")
    fixtures = phase_fixtures()
    shapes = static_value(assignments["SHAPES"])

def git_output(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=DELIVERY, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"]) == b"main\n", "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode("ascii"), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    counts = (sum(line[:1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(line.startswith("??") for line in lines))
    require(counts == (0, 15, 156), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"branch": "main", "candidates": len(candidates), "head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "modified": 15, "staged": 0, "untracked": 156}

def validate_acceptance(value: object, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    acceptance_provenance_model_self_test()
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contract_objects", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V29_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(contract_violations(value["contract_objects"], value["contracts"]) == [], "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(canonical_json_model(value["predecessor_closure"]) == canonical_json_model(V28_CLOSURE) and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING and value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance provenance mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    for name in ("plan", "status"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-size", required=True, type=int)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])

    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V29 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v25_driver, _ = read_regular(V25_DRIVER)
    intermediate_v26 = derive_v26_driver(v25_driver)
    require((len(intermediate_v26), sha(intermediate_v26)) == (V26_DRIVER_SIZE, V26_DRIVER_SHA), "V26 intermediate driver mismatch")
    intermediate_v27 = derive_v27_driver(intermediate_v26)
    require((len(intermediate_v27), sha(intermediate_v27)) == (V27_DRIVER_SIZE, V27_DRIVER_SHA), "V27 intermediate driver mismatch")
    transform_fixtures = historical_transform_binding_fixtures(intermediate_v26, intermediate_v27)
    intermediate_v28 = derive_v28_driver(intermediate_v27)
    require((len(intermediate_v28), sha(intermediate_v28)) == (V28_DRIVER_SIZE, V28_DRIVER_SHA), "V28 intermediate driver mismatch")
    derived = derive_driver(intermediate_v28)
    static = validate_driver(derived)
    static["historical_transform_binding_fixtures"] = transform_fixtures
    acceptance = validate_acceptance(json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json), args, source, derived)
    require(derive_v26_driver(v25_driver) == intermediate_v26 and derive_v27_driver(intermediate_v26) == intermediate_v27 and derive_v28_driver(intermediate_v27) == intermediate_v28 and derive_driver(intermediate_v28) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v19 = validate_v19()
    v20 = validate_v20()
    v23 = validate_v23()
    v24 = validate_v24()
    v25 = validate_v25()
    v26 = validate_v26(plan_bytes)
    v27 = validate_v27(plan_bytes)
    v28 = validate_v28(plan_bytes)
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V29 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V29_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v28, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V29_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V29_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v19": v19, "v20": v20, "v23": v23, "v24": v24, "v25": v25, "v26": v26, "v27": v27, "v28": v28}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V29_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v28, "reserved_results_absent": ["auth-handoff-v29-result.json", "successor-preparation-v29-result.json"], "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V29_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V29_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V29_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:

def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:

def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file owner or mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

def manifest_included_paths(root: Path) -> tuple[list[tuple[Path, str]], int]:
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), f"unsafe tree root: {root}")
    included: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    omitted = 0
    def visit(directory: Path, prefix: str) -> None:
        nonlocal omitted
        with os.scandir(directory) as iterator:
            entries = sorted(list(iterator), key=lambda entry: os.fsencode(entry.name))
        for entry in entries:
            relative_path = entry.name if not prefix else prefix + "/" + entry.name
            if is_protected_credential_manifest_path(relative_path):
                omitted += 1
                continue
            path = Path(entry.path); included.append((path, relative_path))
            if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                visit(path, relative_path)
    visit(root, ""); included.sort(key=lambda item: os.fsencode(item[1]))
    return included, omitted


def tree_manifest(root: Path, expected_protected_credential_omissions: int | None = None) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, int]]:
    included, omitted = manifest_included_paths(root)
    if expected_protected_credential_omissions is not None:
        require(omitted == expected_protected_credential_omissions, "protected credential omission count mismatch")
    payload_parts: list[bytes] = []; regular_bytes = 0
    for _path, relative_path in included:
        record = file_record(root, os.fsencode(relative_path), None)
        if record["type"] == "regular":
            regular_bytes += int(record["size"])
        payload_parts.append(compact(record) + b"\\n")
    return b"".join(payload_parts), {"path_count": len(included), "regular_file_bytes": regular_bytes}

def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v28-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str)); active_set = set(active); violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact: violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(set(versioned_phase_tokens("V28")) - active_set):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    for phase in tuple(item for version in ("V1","V2","V3","V4","V5","V6","V7","V8","V9","V10","V11","V12") for item in versioned_phase_tokens(version)):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V29"):
        if phase in exact: violations.append("future_v29:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(29,55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload: violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    for token in (b"candidate.dygENR4n"+b"/repo",b"--"+b"last",b"resume_liveclip"+b".sh"):
        if token in payload: violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations

    active=versioned_phase_tokens("V28")[0]
    cases={"missing_active":(b"x = 1\n",(active,),["missing_active:"+active]),"inactive_current":(b'x = "M3S_V28_WRITER_SELF_TEST"\n',(),["inactive_active_version:M3S_V28_WRITER_SELF_TEST"]),"stale_predecessor":(b'x = "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"\n',(),["stale_predecessor:M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"]),"future":(b'x = "M3S_V29_SOURCE_WRITE"\n',(),["future_v29:M3S_V29_SOURCE_WRITE"]),"forbidden_receipt":(b'x = "successor-preparation-v29-result.json"\n',(),["forbidden_receipt:successor-preparation-v29-result.json"]),"forbidden_candidate":(b'x = "candidate.dygENR4n/repo"\n',(),["forbidden:candidate.dygENR4n/repo"]),"forbidden_last":(b'x = "--last"\n',(),["forbidden:--last"]),"forbidden_resume":(b'x = "resume_liveclip.sh"\n',(),["forbidden:resume_liveclip.sh"])}
    for name,(payload,phases,expected) in cases.items(): require(runtime_phase_violations(payload,phases)==expected,name+" phase fixture mismatch")
    current_result = b'x = "successor-preparation-v28-result.json"\n'
    require(runtime_phase_violations(current_result, ()) == [], "current V28 result fixture mismatch")
    return {"current_result_fixture":"PASS","negative_fixtures":list(cases),"positive_derived_fixture":"PASS"}

def assignment_map(tree: ast.Module) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    return {node.targets[0].id: node.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)}


def static_value(node: ast.AST) -> Any:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple, ast.Set)):
        values = [static_value(item) for item in node.elts]
        return values if isinstance(node, ast.List) else tuple(values) if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) else set(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
        return {static_value(key): static_value(value) for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values, strict=True)}
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return frozenset(static_value(node.args[0]))
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported static value: " + ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False))


def static_collection(node: ast.AST, assignments: dict[str, ast.expr]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return static_collection(assignments[node.id], assignments)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return static_collection(node.args[0], assignments)
    require(isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)), "unsupported static collection")
    values: list[str] = []
    for item in node.elts:
        if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
            values.extend(static_collection(item.value, assignments))
        else:
            value = static_value(item)
            require(isinstance(value, str), "non-string static collection item")
            values.append(value)
    return tuple(values)


def contract_violations(objects: object, hashes: object) -> list[str]:
    keys = set(CONTRACTS)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(objects, dict) or set(objects) != keys:
        return ["object_keys"]
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != keys:
        return ["hash_keys"]
    if objects != CONTRACTS:
        errors.append("objects")
    if hashes != CONTRACT_HASHES:
        errors.append("accepted_hashes")
    if {name: sha(compact(value)) for name, value in objects.items()} != hashes:
        errors.append("derived_hashes")
    return errors


def contract_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, CONTRACT_HASHES) == [], "contract positive fixture mismatch")
    changed = json.loads(compact(CONTRACTS).decode("utf-8"))
    changed["policy_toolchain"]["policy_contract"] += "-changed"
    require(contract_violations(changed, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["objects", "derived_hashes"], "contract object negative mismatch")
    changed_hashes = dict(CONTRACT_HASHES)
    changed_hashes["trusted_context"] = "0" * 64
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, changed_hashes) == ["accepted_hashes", "derived_hashes"], "contract hash negative mismatch")
    missing = dict(CONTRACTS)
    missing.pop("initial_run")
    require(contract_violations(missing, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["object_keys"], "contract key negative mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": 3, "positive_fixture": "PASS"}


def read_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> list[str]:
    violations: list[str] = []
    for function in (node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        dictionary_names: set[str] = set()
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign) or not isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) or node.value.func.id != "read_regular":
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    dictionary_names.add(target.elts[1].id)
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in dictionary_names:
                violations.append(function.name + ":" + node.value.id + "." + node.attr)
    return violations
