```python
def validate_acceptance(value: object, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contract_objects", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V23_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(contract_violations(value["contract_objects"], value["contracts"]) == [], "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == V22_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING and value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance provenance mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    for name in ("plan", "status"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-size", required=True, type=int)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V23 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v22_driver, _ = read_regular(V22_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v22_driver)
    static = validate_driver(derived)
    acceptance = validate_acceptance(json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json), args, source, derived)
    require(derive_driver(v22_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v19 = validate_v19()
    v20 = validate_v20()
    v22 = validate_v22()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V23 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V23_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v22, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V23_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V23_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v19": v19, "v20": v20, "v22": v22}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V23_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v22, "reserved_results_absent": ["auth-handoff-v23-result.json", "successor-preparation-v23-result.json"], "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V23_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V23_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V23_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V23_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:

def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file owner or mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

    tree_start = payload.index(b"def tree_manifest(")

def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v22-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))
    active_set = set(active)
    violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact:
            violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(set(versioned_phase_tokens("V22")) - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    for phase in tuple(item for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for item in versioned_phase_tokens(version)):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V23"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v23:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(23, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    for token in (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh"):
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations


def phase_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    active = versioned_phase_tokens("V22")[0]
    cases = {
        "missing_active": (b"x = 1\n", (active,), ["missing_active:" + active]),
        "inactive_current": (b'x = "M3S_V22_WRITER_SELF_TEST"\n', (), ["inactive_active_version:M3S_V22_WRITER_SELF_TEST"]),
        "stale_predecessor": (b'x = "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"\n', (), ["stale_predecessor:M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"]),
        "future": (b'x = "M3S_V23_SOURCE_WRITE"\n', (), ["future_v23:M3S_V23_SOURCE_WRITE"]),
        "forbidden_receipt": (b'x = "successor-preparation-v23-result.json"\n', (), ["forbidden_receipt:successor-preparation-v23-result.json"]),
        "forbidden_candidate": (b'x = "candidate.dygENR4n/repo"\n', (), ["forbidden:candidate.dygENR4n/repo"]),
        "forbidden_last": (b'x = "--last"\n', (), ["forbidden:--last"]),
        "forbidden_resume": (b'x = "resume_liveclip.sh"\n', (), ["forbidden:resume_liveclip.sh"]),
    }
    for name, (payload, phases, expected) in cases.items():
        require(runtime_phase_violations(payload, phases) == expected, name + " phase fixture mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": list(cases), "positive_derived_fixture": "PASS"}


def assignment_map(tree: ast.Module) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    return {node.targets[0].id: node.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)}


def static_value(node: ast.AST) -> Any:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple, ast.Set)):
        values = [static_value(item) for item in node.elts]
        return values if isinstance(node, ast.List) else tuple(values) if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) else set(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
        return {static_value(key): static_value(value) for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values, strict=True)}
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return frozenset(static_value(node.args[0]))
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported static value: " + ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False))


def static_collection(node: ast.AST, assignments: dict[str, ast.expr]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return static_collection(assignments[node.id], assignments)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return static_collection(node.args[0], assignments)
    require(isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)), "unsupported static collection")
    values: list[str] = []
    for item in node.elts:
        if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
            values.extend(static_collection(item.value, assignments))
        else:
            value = static_value(item)
            require(isinstance(value, str), "non-string static collection item")
            values.append(value)
    return tuple(values)


def contract_violations(objects: object, hashes: object) -> list[str]:
    keys = set(CONTRACTS)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(objects, dict) or set(objects) != keys:
        return ["object_keys"]
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != keys:
        return ["hash_keys"]
    if objects != CONTRACTS:
        errors.append("objects")
    if hashes != CONTRACT_HASHES:
        errors.append("accepted_hashes")
    if {name: sha(compact(value)) for name, value in objects.items()} != hashes:
        errors.append("derived_hashes")
    return errors


def contract_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, CONTRACT_HASHES) == [], "contract positive fixture mismatch")
    changed = json.loads(compact(CONTRACTS).decode("utf-8"))
    changed["policy_toolchain"]["policy_contract"] += "-changed"
    require(contract_violations(changed, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["objects", "derived_hashes"], "contract object negative mismatch")
    changed_hashes = dict(CONTRACT_HASHES)
    changed_hashes["trusted_context"] = "0" * 64
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, changed_hashes) == ["accepted_hashes", "derived_hashes"], "contract hash negative mismatch")
    missing = dict(CONTRACTS)
    missing.pop("initial_run")
    require(contract_violations(missing, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["object_keys"], "contract key negative mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": 3, "positive_fixture": "PASS"}


def read_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> list[str]:
    violations: list[str] = []
    for function in (node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        dictionary_names: set[str] = set()
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign) or not isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) or node.value.func.id != "read_regular":
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    dictionary_names.add(target.elts[1].id)
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in dictionary_names:
                violations.append(function.name + ":" + node.value.id + "." + node.attr)
    return violations


def validate_manifest_credential_policy(tree: ast.Module, decoded: str, assignments: dict[str, ast.expr]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    protected = static_value(assignments["PROTECTED_CREDENTIAL_MANIFEST_PATHS"])
    omissions = static_value(assignments["PREDECESSOR_PROTECTED_CREDENTIAL_OMISSIONS"])
    require(protected == frozenset({"home/.codex/auth.json"}), "protected credential path set mismatch")
    require(set(omissions) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES and sum(omissions.values()) == 1 and omissions["candidate.KWbe2iGW"] == 1, "protected credential omission map mismatch")
    negatives = {".codex/auth.json", "home/.codex/auth.json.bak", "home/.codex/Auth.json", "home/auth.json"}
    require(protected.isdisjoint(negatives), "protected credential negative fixture mismatch")
    function = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "tree_manifest")
    source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function)
    require(isinstance(source, str) and "credential path excluded from manifests" not in source, "fatal credential manifest policy retained")
    require(source.index("is_protected_credential_manifest_path(relative_path)") < source.index("file_record("), "credential omission occurs after file access")
    policy_if = next((node for node in ast.walk(function) if isinstance(node, ast.If) and isinstance(node.test, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.test.func, ast.Name) and node.test.func.id == "is_protected_credential_manifest_path"), None)
    require(policy_if is not None and any(isinstance(node, ast.Continue) for node in ast.walk(policy_if)), "credential omission branch mismatch")
    forbidden_calls = {"file_record", "hash_regular", "open", "read_regular", "require_identity", "write_exclusive"}
    require(not any(isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id in forbidden_calls for node in ast.walk(policy_if)), "credential omission branch accesses content")
    predecessor = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "validate_predecessors")
    predecessor_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, predecessor)
    require(isinstance(predecessor_source, str) and "PREDECESSOR_PROTECTED_CREDENTIAL_OMISSIONS[name]" in predecessor_source and "tree_manifest(BASE / name, protected_omissions)" in predecessor_source, "predecessor omission binding mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixture_count": len(negatives), "omitted_predecessor_count": sum(omissions.values()), "ordering": "BEFORE_FILE_RECORD", "result": "PASS"}


def validate_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v22-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v22-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    assignments = assignment_map(tree)
    contracts = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS"])
    hashes = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES"])
    require(contract_violations(contracts, hashes) == [], "derived contract mismatch")
    active = tuple(static_value(assignments["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"]))
    require(len(active) == 14 and runtime_phase_violations(payload, active) == [], "runtime-equivalent phase mismatch")
    fixtures = phase_fixtures()
    shapes = static_value(assignments["SHAPES"])
    require(shapes["execute"] == ["execute", "--expected-self-sha", None, "--base", None, "--seed", None, "--wrapper", None, "--expected-wrapper-sha", None, "--plan", None, "--expected-plan-sha256", None, "--status", None, "--expected-status-sha256", None, "--expected-bootstrap-final-index-sha256", None, "--expected-root-prepare-argv-json-sha256", None, "--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", None], "execute schema mismatch")
    predecessors = static_value(assignments["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(predecessors) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES and len(predecessors) == 18, "predecessor mismatch")
    successor = static_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_V22_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    delta = static_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_ONLY_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    require(len(successor) == 38 and len(set(successor)) == 38 and len(delta) == 11 and len(set(delta)) == 11, "receipt domain or delta mismatch")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "validate_controller_acceptance")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, acceptance)
    execute = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "execute")
    execute_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, execute)
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and 'value["contract_objects"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS' in acceptance_source and 'value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES' in acceptance_source and 'sha(compact(contract))' in acceptance_source, "acceptance contract proof mismatch")
    require(isinstance(execute_source, str) and execute_source.index("validate_active_phase_names()") < execute_source.index("validate_controller_acceptance(") < execute_source.index("read_only_gates(") < execute_source.index('"/usr/bin/mktemp"'), "phase/acceptance/current/allocation order mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1 and payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "allocation/init count mismatch")
    require(b"M3S_V22_AUTH_HANDOFF" not in payload and b"auth_handoff" not in payload and b"opaque_copy_auth_state" not in payload, "credential capability retained")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "resume capability retained")
    require(read_identity_attribute_violations(tree) == [], "dictionary identity attribute access retained")
    manifest_policy = validate_manifest_credential_policy(tree, decoded, assignments)
    return {"active_phase_count": len(active), "compile_only": "PASS", "contract_fixtures": contract_fixtures(), "dictionary_identity_dataflow": "PASS", "manifest_credential_policy": manifest_policy, "phase_fixtures": fixtures, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "receipt_domain_count": len(successor), "result": "PASS", "successor_delta_count": len(delta)}


def git_output(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=DELIVERY, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"]) == b"main\n", "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode("ascii"), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    counts = (sum(line[:1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(line.startswith("??") for line in lines))
    require(counts == (0, 15, 156), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"branch": "main", "candidates": len(candidates), "head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "modified": 15, "staged": 0, "untracked": 156}

def validate_acceptance(value: object, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contract_objects", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V22_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(contract_violations(value["contract_objects"], value["contracts"]) == [], "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == V21_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING and value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance provenance mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    for name in ("plan", "status"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-size", required=True, type=int)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V22 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v21_driver, _ = read_regular(V21_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v21_driver)
    static = validate_driver(derived)
    acceptance = validate_acceptance(json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json), args, source, derived)
    require(derive_driver(v21_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v19 = validate_v19()
    v20 = validate_v20()
    v21 = validate_v21()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V22 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V22_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v21, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V22_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V22_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v19": v19, "v20": v20, "v21": v21}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V22_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v21, "reserved_results_absent": ["auth-handoff-v22-result.json", "successor-preparation-v22-result.json"], "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V22_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V22_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V22_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V22_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and before.st_size <= maximum, "unsafe regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int = 0o600) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file owner or mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{mode:04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)


def predecessor_driver_block() -> bytes:
    values = (
        "PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_ROOT = Path(" + repr(str(V19_ROOT)) + ")\n"
        "PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_ROOT_FILES = " + repr(V19_ROOT_FILES) + "\n"
        "PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_CLOSURE = " + repr(V19_CLOSURE) + "\n"
        "PREVIOUS_M3S_V20_ROOT = Path(" + repr(str(V20_ROOT)) + ")\n"
        "PREVIOUS_M3S_V20_CLOSURE = " + repr(V20_CLOSURE) + "\n\n"
    )
    return values.encode("utf-8")


PREDECESSOR_DRIVER_FUNCTIONS = b'''def validate_m3s_v19_blocked() -> dict[str, Any]:

def validate_m3s_v20_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:

    ], "V20 ordered violation mismatch")

'''


def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V19_DRIVER_SIZE, V19_DRIVER_SHA), "V19 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V20"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v20:" + phase)\n', b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V22"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v22:" + phase)\n', "future phase policy")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V20")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V20 fixture mismatch")\n', b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V22")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V22 fixture mismatch")\n', "future phase fixture")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(20, 55)", b"range(22, 55)", "future receipt range")
    require(payload.count(b"V19") == 62 and payload.count(b"v19") == 61, "V19 token count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V19", b"V21").replace(b"v19", b"v21")
    predecessors = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessors) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessors, predecessors[:-1] + b', "V19", "V20"}')
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V21", "V20"}', b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22"}', "phase version domain")
    start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = ")
    hash_start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start)
    finish = payload.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    contract_block = ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    payload = payload[:start] + contract_block + payload[finish:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", predecessor_driver_block() + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "predecessor constants")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + PREDECESSOR_DRIVER_FUNCTIONS + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v18_stopped": validate_m3s_v18_stopped(),\n', b'        "m3s_v18_stopped": validate_m3s_v18_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v19_blocked": validate_m3s_v19_blocked(),\n        "m3s_v20_stopped": validate_m3s_v20_stopped(),\n', "predecessor gates")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V18_CLOSURE', b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V20_CLOSURE', "acceptance closure")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"})', b'frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "contract_objects", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"})', "acceptance schema")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V20_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")\n', b'    require(value["contract_objects"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS, "controller acceptance contract object mismatch")\n    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES, "controller acceptance contract hash mismatch")\n    require({name: sha(compact(contract)) for name, contract in value["contract_objects"].items()} == value["contracts"], "controller acceptance recomputed hash mismatch")\n    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V20_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")\n', "acceptance object/hash equality")
    return payload


def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v21-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))
    active_set = set(active)
    violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact:
            violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(set(versioned_phase_tokens("V21")) - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    for phase in tuple(item for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for item in versioned_phase_tokens(version)):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V22"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v22:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(22, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    for token in (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh"):
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations


def phase_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    active = versioned_phase_tokens("V21")[0]
    cases = {
        "missing_active": (b"x = 1\n", (active,), ["missing_active:" + active]),
        "inactive_current": (b'x = "M3S_V21_WRITER_SELF_TEST"\n', (), ["inactive_active_version:M3S_V21_WRITER_SELF_TEST"]),
        "stale_predecessor": (b'x = "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"\n', (), ["stale_predecessor:M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE"]),
        "future": (b'x = "M3S_V22_SOURCE_WRITE"\n', (), ["future_v22:M3S_V22_SOURCE_WRITE"]),
        "forbidden_receipt": (b'x = "successor-preparation-v22-result.json"\n', (), ["forbidden_receipt:successor-preparation-v22-result.json"]),
        "forbidden_candidate": (b'x = "candidate.dygENR4n/repo"\n', (), ["forbidden:candidate.dygENR4n/repo"]),
        "forbidden_last": (b'x = "--last"\n', (), ["forbidden:--last"]),
        "forbidden_resume": (b'x = "resume_liveclip.sh"\n', (), ["forbidden:resume_liveclip.sh"]),
    }
    for name, (payload, phases, expected) in cases.items():
        require(runtime_phase_violations(payload, phases) == expected, name + " phase fixture mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": list(cases), "positive_derived_fixture": "PASS"}


def assignment_map(tree: ast.Module) -> dict[str, ast.expr]:
    return {node.targets[0].id: node.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)}


def static_value(node: ast.AST) -> Any:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple, ast.Set)):
        values = [static_value(item) for item in node.elts]
        return values if isinstance(node, ast.List) else tuple(values) if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) else set(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
        return {static_value(key): static_value(value) for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values, strict=True)}
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return frozenset(static_value(node.args[0]))
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported static value: " + ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False))


def static_collection(node: ast.AST, assignments: dict[str, ast.expr]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return static_collection(assignments[node.id], assignments)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "frozenset" and len(node.args) == 1:
        return static_collection(node.args[0], assignments)
    require(isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)), "unsupported static collection")
    values: list[str] = []
    for item in node.elts:
        if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
            values.extend(static_collection(item.value, assignments))
        else:
            value = static_value(item)
            require(isinstance(value, str), "non-string static collection item")
            values.append(value)
    return tuple(values)


def contract_violations(objects: object, hashes: object) -> list[str]:
    keys = set(CONTRACTS)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(objects, dict) or set(objects) != keys:
        return ["object_keys"]
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != keys:
        return ["hash_keys"]
    if objects != CONTRACTS:
        errors.append("objects")
    if hashes != CONTRACT_HASHES:
        errors.append("accepted_hashes")
    if {name: sha(compact(value)) for name, value in objects.items()} != hashes:
        errors.append("derived_hashes")
    return errors


def contract_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, CONTRACT_HASHES) == [], "contract positive fixture mismatch")
    changed = json.loads(compact(CONTRACTS).decode("utf-8"))
    changed["policy_toolchain"]["policy_contract"] += "-changed"
    require(contract_violations(changed, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["objects", "derived_hashes"], "contract object negative mismatch")
    changed_hashes = dict(CONTRACT_HASHES)
    changed_hashes["trusted_context"] = "0" * 64
    require(contract_violations(CONTRACTS, changed_hashes) == ["accepted_hashes", "derived_hashes"], "contract hash negative mismatch")
    missing = dict(CONTRACTS)
    missing.pop("initial_run")
    require(contract_violations(missing, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["object_keys"], "contract key negative mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": 3, "positive_fixture": "PASS"}


def read_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> list[str]:
    violations: list[str] = []
    for function in (node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        dictionary_names: set[str] = set()
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign) or not isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) or not isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) or node.value.func.id != "read_regular":
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    dictionary_names.add(target.elts[1].id)
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in dictionary_names:
                violations.append(function.name + ":" + node.value.id + "." + node.attr)
    return violations


def validate_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v21-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v21-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    assignments = assignment_map(tree)
    contracts = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS"])
    hashes = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES"])
    require(contract_violations(contracts, hashes) == [], "derived contract mismatch")
    active = tuple(static_value(assignments["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"]))
    require(len(active) == 14 and runtime_phase_violations(payload, active) == [], "runtime-equivalent phase mismatch")
    fixtures = phase_fixtures()
    shapes = static_value(assignments["SHAPES"])
    require(shapes["execute"] == ["execute", "--expected-self-sha", None, "--base", None, "--seed", None, "--wrapper", None, "--expected-wrapper-sha", None, "--plan", None, "--expected-plan-sha256", None, "--status", None, "--expected-status-sha256", None, "--expected-bootstrap-final-index-sha256", None, "--expected-root-prepare-argv-json-sha256", None, "--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", None], "execute schema mismatch")
    predecessors = static_value(assignments["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(predecessors) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES and len(predecessors) == 18, "predecessor mismatch")
    successor = static_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_V21_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    delta = static_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_ONLY_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    require(len(successor) == 38 and len(set(successor)) == 38 and len(delta) == 11 and len(set(delta)) == 11, "receipt domain or delta mismatch")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "validate_controller_acceptance")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, acceptance)
    execute = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "execute")
    execute_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, execute)
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and 'value["contract_objects"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS' in acceptance_source and 'value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES' in acceptance_source and 'sha(compact(contract))' in acceptance_source, "acceptance contract proof mismatch")
    require(isinstance(execute_source, str) and execute_source.index("validate_active_phase_names()") < execute_source.index("validate_controller_acceptance(") < execute_source.index("read_only_gates(") < execute_source.index('"/usr/bin/mktemp"'), "phase/acceptance/current/allocation order mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1 and payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "allocation/init count mismatch")
    require(b"M3S_V21_AUTH_HANDOFF" not in payload and b"auth_handoff" not in payload and b"opaque_copy_auth_state" not in payload, "credential capability retained")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "resume capability retained")
    require(read_identity_attribute_violations(tree) == [], "dictionary identity attribute access retained")
    return {"active_phase_count": len(active), "compile_only": "PASS", "contract_fixtures": contract_fixtures(), "dictionary_identity_dataflow": "PASS", "phase_fixtures": fixtures, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "receipt_domain_count": len(successor), "result": "PASS", "successor_delta_count": len(delta)}


def git_output(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=DELIVERY, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"]) == b"main\n", "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode("ascii"), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]).decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    counts = (sum(line[:1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"} for line in lines), sum(line.startswith("??") for line in lines))
    require(counts == (0, 15, 156), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"branch": "main", "candidates": len(candidates), "head": EXPECTED_HEAD, "modified": 15, "staged": 0, "untracked": 156}


def validate_v19() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V19_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V19_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V19_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    receipt_names = {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V19_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")}
    private_directory(V19_ROOT / "receipts", receipt_names)
    files = {name: identity(V19_ROOT / name, size, digest) for name, (size, digest) in V19_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    for name in ("successor-preparation-v19-result.json", "auth-handoff-v19-result.json"):
        path = V19_ROOT / "receipts" / name
        require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "V19 reserved result appeared")
    return {"closure": V19_CLOSURE, "files": files}


def validate_v20() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(not V20_ROOT.exists() and not V20_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V20 root appeared")
    require(V20_CLOSURE["before_root_mkdir"] is True and V20_CLOSURE["ordered_violations"] == V20_ORDERED_VIOLATIONS, "V20 closure mismatch")
    return V20_CLOSURE


def validate_acceptance(value: object, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contract_objects", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V21_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(contract_violations(value["contract_objects"], value["contracts"]) == [], "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == V20_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING and value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance provenance mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    for name in ("plan", "status"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-size", required=True, type=int)
        parser.add_argument("--expected-" + name + "-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V21 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v19_driver, _ = read_regular(V19_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v19_driver)
    static = validate_driver(derived)
    acceptance = validate_acceptance(json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json), args, source, derived)
    require(derive_driver(v19_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v19 = validate_v19()
    v20 = validate_v20()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V21 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V21_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v20, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V21_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V21_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v19": v19, "v20": v20}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"self-check-result.json": self_check, "source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V21_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v20, "reserved_results_absent": ["auth-handoff-v21-result.json", "successor-preparation-v21-result.json"], "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V21_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V21_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V21_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V21_END
```

### Outcomes and retrospective

V20 fixes drift without weakening external authority: the driver cannot
self-assert acceptance. The controller first accepts exact receipt bytes, while
source and driver independently recompute identical hashes from identical
objects. Any object/hash/key/path/policy drift stops before root creation and,
in a future execute path, before current documents and allocation.

### Precise Next Action

Stop before root creation. Controller may reconstruct the final documents,
source, driver, contracts, canonical receipt, 31-string Python argv, 41-string
clean env vector, and literal envelope. Only later exact accepted-hash authority
may create only the fixed V20 root and sealed root evidence, stopping before
candidate recovery. No allocation, auth, setup, readiness, doctor, loop-init,
role, test, render, evaluation, inference, publication, cleanup, commit, push,
`--last`, or `resume_liveclip.sh` is authorized.

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)
```
