```python
def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (312527, "a192f3346f3ef386edaebbad8e2b0c7361e47c2567583d8a2669600b3594842f"), "V19 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V20"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v20:" + phase)\n', b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V21"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v21:" + phase)\n', "future phase policy")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V20")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V20 fixture mismatch")\n', b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V21")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V21 fixture mismatch")\n', "future phase fixture")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(20, 55)", b"range(21, 55)", "future receipt range")
    require(payload.count(b"V19") == 62 and payload.count(b"v19") == 61, "V19 token count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V19", b"V20").replace(b"v19", b"v20")
    predecessor_versions = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_versions) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, predecessor_versions[:-1] + b', "V19"}')
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V20", "V20"}', b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21"}', "phase version domain")
    start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = ")
    hash_start = payload.index(b"CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = ", start)
    finish = payload.index(b"\n", hash_start) + 1
    contract_block = ("CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS = " + repr(CONTRACTS) + "\nCONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES = " + repr(CONTRACT_HASHES) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    payload = payload[:start] + contract_block + payload[finish:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", DRIVER_V19_CONSTANTS + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V19 constants")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + DRIVER_V19_FUNCTION + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v18_stopped": validate_m3s_v18_stopped(),\n', b'        "m3s_v18_stopped": validate_m3s_v18_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v19_blocked": validate_m3s_v19_blocked(),\n', "V19 read-only gate")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V18_CLOSURE', b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_CLOSURE', "V19 acceptance closure")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"})', b'frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "contract_objects", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"})', "acceptance schema")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")\n', b'    require(value["contract_objects"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS, "controller acceptance contract object mismatch")\n    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES, "controller acceptance contract hash mismatch")\n    require({name: sha(compact(contract)) for name, contract in value["contract_objects"].items()} == value["contracts"], "controller acceptance recomputed hash mismatch")\n    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V19_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")\n', "acceptance object/hash equality")
    return payload


def static_versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v20-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))
    active_set = set(active)
    full_set = set(static_versioned_phase_tokens("V20"))
    violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact:
            violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(full_set - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    stale = tuple(phase for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens(version))
    for phase in stale:
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens("V20"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v20:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(20, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    forbidden = (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh")
    for token in forbidden:
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations

def static_string_collection(
    node: ast.AST,
    constants: dict[str, ast.AST],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
        return (node.value,)
    if isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)):
        values: list[str] = []
        for item in node.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
                require(isinstance(item.value, ast.Name), "unsupported starred receipt expression")
                values.extend(static_string_collection(constants[item.value.id], constants))
            else:
                values.extend(static_string_collection(item, constants))
        return tuple(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        require(
            isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
            and node.func.id == "frozenset"
            and len(node.args) == 1
            and not node.keywords,
            "unsupported receipt collection call",
        )
        return static_string_collection(node.args[0], constants)
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported receipt collection expression")


def read_regular_identity_bindings(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...]:
    bindings: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for function in (node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
                continue
            call = node.value
            if not (isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name) and call.func.id == "read_regular"):
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    bindings.append((function.name, target.elts[1].id, node.lineno))
    return tuple(sorted(bindings))


def read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, str, int], ...]:
    violations: list[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = []
    for function in (node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        identity_names = {
            target.elts[1].id
            for node in ast.walk(function)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
            and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call)
            and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name)
            and node.value.func.id == "read_regular"
            for target in node.targets
            if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List))
            and len(target.elts) == 2
            and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name)
        }
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in identity_names:
                violations.append((function.name, node.value.id, node.attr, node.lineno))
    return tuple(sorted(violations))


def validate_read_regular_identity_dataflow(tree: ast.Module, decoded: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    violations = read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(tree)
    require(violations == (), "read_regular identity attribute access retained")
    bindings = read_regular_identity_bindings(tree)
    require(
        ("validate_controller_acceptance", "info") in {(function, name) for function, name, _ in bindings}
        and ("transport_controller_acceptance", "reread_info") in {(function, name) for function, name, _ in bindings},
        "controller acceptance read identity bindings missing",
    )
    safe_fixture = ast.parse(
        "def source_acceptance():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(path, info, '0600')\n"
        "    return payload, {'mode': info['mode'], 'owner_uid': owner_uid}\n"
        "def returned_identity():\n"
        "    payload, identity = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return identity['sha256']\n"
        "def transported_reread():\n"
        "    payload, reread_info = read_regular(destination)\n"
        "    return correlate_read_identity_owner(destination, reread_info, '0600')\n"
    )
    require(read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(safe_fixture) == (), "dictionary identity positive fixtures failed")
    unsafe_fixture = ast.parse(
        "def source_acceptance():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return info.st_mode\n"
        "def returned_identity():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return {'owner_uid': info.st_uid}\n"
        "def transported_reread():\n"
        "    payload, reread_info = read_regular(destination)\n"
        "    return reread_info.st_uid\n"
    )
    unsafe = read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(unsafe_fixture)
    require(
        {(function, name, attribute) for function, name, attribute, _ in unsafe}
        == {
            ("source_acceptance", "info", "st_mode"),
            ("returned_identity", "info", "st_uid"),
            ("transported_reread", "reread_info", "st_uid"),
        },
        "dictionary identity negative fixtures failed",
    )
    source_gate = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    transport_gate = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "transport_controller_acceptance"))
    helper = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "correlate_read_identity_owner"))
    require(
        isinstance(source_gate, str)
        and 'owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(path, info, "0600")' in source_gate
        and '"mode": info["mode"]' in source_gate
        and '"owner_uid": owner_uid' in source_gate,
        "source acceptance or returned identity fixture mismatch",
    )
    require(
        isinstance(transport_gate, str)
        and 'reread_owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(destination, reread_info, "0600")' in transport_gate,
        "transported reread fixture mismatch",
    )
    require(
        isinstance(helper, str)
        and "open_identity(path)" in helper
        and "path.lstat()" in helper
        and 'frozenset({"device", "inode", "mode", "path", "sha256", "size", "type"})' in helper,
        "owner correlation helper mismatch",
    )
    return {"binding_count": len(bindings), "negative_fixture_count": 3, "result": "PASS"}

def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def static_value(node: ast.AST) -> Any:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, ast.List):
        return [static_value(item) for item in node.elts]
    if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple):
        return tuple(static_value(item) for item in node.elts)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Set):
        return set(static_value(item) for item in node.elts)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
        return {static_value(key): static_value(value) for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values, strict=True)}
    raise RuntimeError("non-static contract value")


def contract_pair_violations(objects: Any, accepted_hashes: Any) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    expected_keys = set(CONTRACTS)
    if not isinstance(objects, dict) or set(objects) != expected_keys:
        errors.append("object_keys")
    if not isinstance(accepted_hashes, dict) or set(accepted_hashes) != expected_keys:
        errors.append("hash_keys")
    if errors:
        return errors
    if objects != CONTRACTS:
        errors.append("objects")
    derived = {name: sha(compact(value)) for name, value in objects.items()}
    if accepted_hashes != CONTRACT_HASHES:
        errors.append("accepted_hashes")
    if derived != accepted_hashes:
        errors.append("derived_hashes")
    return errors


def contract_alignment_fixtures() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(contract_pair_violations(CONTRACTS, CONTRACT_HASHES) == [], "positive contract fixture mismatch")
    altered = json.loads(compact(CONTRACTS).decode("utf-8"))
    altered["policy_toolchain"]["policy_contract"] += "-altered"
    require(contract_pair_violations(altered, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["objects", "derived_hashes"], "object negative fixture mismatch")
    altered_hashes = dict(CONTRACT_HASHES)
    altered_hashes["trusted_context"] = "0" * 64
    require(contract_pair_violations(CONTRACTS, altered_hashes) == ["accepted_hashes", "derived_hashes"], "hash negative fixture mismatch")
    missing = dict(CONTRACTS)
    missing.pop("initial_run")
    require(contract_pair_violations(missing, CONTRACT_HASHES) == ["object_keys"], "key negative fixture mismatch")
    return {"negative_fixtures": 3, "positive_fixture": "PASS"}

def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v20-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v20-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v19_blocked", "read_only_gates", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    require(not ({"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"} & functions), "credential capability retained")
    assignments = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    driver_contracts = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS"])
    driver_hashes = static_value(assignments["CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES"])
    require(contract_pair_violations(driver_contracts, driver_hashes) == [], "derived contract alignment mismatch")
    fixtures = contract_alignment_fixtures()
    shapes = static_value(assignments["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = static_value(assignments["PREDECESSORS"])
    successor = static_string_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_V20_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    delta = static_string_collection(assignments["SUCCESSOR_ONLY_RECEIPTS"], assignments)
    active = static_string_collection(assignments["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"], assignments)
    require(shapes == {"execute": ["execute", "--expected-self-sha", None, "--base", None, "--seed", None, "--wrapper", None, "--expected-wrapper-sha", None, "--plan", None, "--expected-plan-sha256", None, "--status", None, "--expected-status-sha256", None, "--expected-bootstrap-final-index-sha256", None, "--expected-root-prepare-argv-json-sha256", None, "--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", None]}, "execute schema mismatch")
    require(set(predecessors) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES and len(predecessors) == 18, "predecessor domain mismatch")
    require(len(successor) == 38 and len(delta) == 11 and len(active) == 14, "receipt or phase domain mismatch")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and 'value["contract_objects"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS' in acceptance_source and 'value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES' in acceptance_source and 'sha(compact(contract))' in acceptance_source, "execute acceptance contract proof mismatch")
    execute_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "execute"))
    require(isinstance(execute_source, str), "execute source unavailable")
    require(execute_source.index("validate_controller_acceptance(") < execute_source.index("read_only_gates(") < execute_source.index('"/usr/bin/mktemp"'), "contract/current/allocation order mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1 and payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "allocation/init site mismatch")
    require(runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload, tuple(active)) == [], "runtime-equivalent phase mismatch")
    require(("M3S_" + "V20_AUTH_HANDOFF").encode("ascii") not in payload, "auth phase retained")
    require(b"auth_handoff" not in payload and b"opaque_copy_auth_state" not in payload, "auth capability retained")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "resume capability retained")
    dataflow = validate_read_regular_identity_dataflow(tree, decoded)
    return {"active_phase_count": len(active), "compile_only": "PASS", "contract_alignment": "PASS", "contract_fixtures": fixtures, "credential_capability_absent": True, "document_generation_separation": "PASS", "identity_dataflow": dataflow, "mktemp_sites": 1, "loop_init_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "receipt_domain_count": len(successor), "successor_delta_count": len(delta), "result": "PASS"}


def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}

def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "contract_objects", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V20_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(contract_pair_violations(value["contract_objects"], value["contracts"]) == [], "acceptance contract alignment mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_closure"] == V19_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload



def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V20 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v19_driver, _ = read_regular(V19_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v19_driver)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    require(derive_driver(v19_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    v15 = validate_v15_blocked()
    v16 = validate_v16_stopped()
    v17 = validate_v17_stopped()
    v18 = validate_v18_stopped()
    v19 = validate_v19_blocked()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V20 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V20_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v19, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V20_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V20_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14, "v15_blocked_closure": v15, "v16_stopped_closure": v16, "v17_stopped_closure": v17, "v18_stopped_closure": v18, "v19_blocked_closure": v19}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V20_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v19, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v20-result.json", "auth-handoff-v20-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V20_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V20_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_closure": v19, "result": "M3S_V20_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V20_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

DRIVER_IDENTITY_HELPER = b'''def correlate_read_identity_owner(path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any], expected_mode: str) -> int:
    require(isinstance(identity, dict), "read identity is not a dictionary")
    require_exact_keys(identity, frozenset({"device", "inode", "mode", "path", "sha256", "size", "type"}), "read identity")
    require(identity["path"] == str(path) and identity["type"] == "regular" and identity["mode"] == expected_mode, "read identity schema mismatch")
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "read identity path is unsafe")
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    try:
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (identity["device"], identity["inode"], identity["size"])
            and opened.st_uid == CURRENT_UID
            and f"{stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode):04o}" == expected_mode,
            "opened read identity owner/mode mismatch",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode))
        == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size, opened.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode)),
        "read identity changed during owner correlation",
    )
    return opened.st_uid

def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (305862, "5a5f958050a281a836da0507f295c0ecc5e7dec3399fea28331ecb7aad9dcda5"), "V18 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V19"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v19:" + phase)\n',
        b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V20"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v20:" + phase)\n',
        "future phase policy",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V19")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V19 fixture mismatch")\n',
        b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V20")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V20 fixture mismatch")\n',
        "future phase fixture",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(19, 55)", b"range(20, 55)", "future receipt range")
    require(payload.count(b"V18") == 62 and payload.count(b"v18") == 61, "V18 token count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V18", b"V19").replace(b"v18", b"v19")
    predecessor_versions = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_versions) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18"}')
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V19", "V19"}',
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20"}',
        "phase version domain",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", DRIVER_V18_CONSTANTS + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V18 constants")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + DRIVER_V18_FUNCTION + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'        "m3s_v17_stopped": validate_m3s_v17_stopped(),\n',
        b'        "m3s_v17_stopped": validate_m3s_v17_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v18_stopped": validate_m3s_v18_stopped(),\n',
        "V18 read-only gate",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V17_CLOSURE',
        b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V18_CLOSURE',
        "V18 acceptance closure",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"def validate_controller_acceptance(", DRIVER_IDENTITY_HELPER + b"def validate_controller_acceptance(", "identity helper")
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance file mode/owner mismatch")\n',
        b'    owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(path, info, "0600")\n',
        "source acceptance identity",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    identity = {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}\n',
        b'    identity = {"mode": info["mode"], "owner_uid": owner_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}\n',
        "returned acceptance identity",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    require(reread == payload and reread_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")\n',
        b'    reread_owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(destination, reread_info, "0600")\n    require(reread == payload and reread_owner_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")\n',
        "transported acceptance reread",
    )
    return payload

def static_versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v19-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))
    active_set = set(active)
    full_set = set(static_versioned_phase_tokens("V19"))
    violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact:
            violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(full_set - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    stale = tuple(phase for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens(version))
    for phase in stale:
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens("V20"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v20:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(20, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    forbidden = (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh")
    for token in forbidden:
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations

def static_string_collection(
    node: ast.AST,
    constants: dict[str, ast.AST],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
        return (node.value,)
    if isinstance(node, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)):
        values: list[str] = []
        for item in node.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Starred):
                require(isinstance(item.value, ast.Name), "unsupported starred receipt expression")
                values.extend(static_string_collection(constants[item.value.id], constants))
            else:
                values.extend(static_string_collection(item, constants))
        return tuple(values)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        require(
            isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
            and node.func.id == "frozenset"
            and len(node.args) == 1
            and not node.keywords,
            "unsupported receipt collection call",
        )
        return static_string_collection(node.args[0], constants)
    raise RuntimeError("unsupported receipt collection expression")


def read_regular_identity_bindings(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...]:
    bindings: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for function in (node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
                continue
            call = node.value
            if not (isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name) and call.func.id == "read_regular"):
                continue
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)) and len(target.elts) == 2 and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name):
                    bindings.append((function.name, target.elts[1].id, node.lineno))
    return tuple(sorted(bindings))


def read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, str, int], ...]:
    violations: list[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = []
    for function in (node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)):
        identity_names = {
            target.elts[1].id
            for node in ast.walk(function)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
            and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call)
            and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name)
            and node.value.func.id == "read_regular"
            for target in node.targets
            if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List))
            and len(target.elts) == 2
            and isinstance(target.elts[1], ast.Name)
        }
        for node in ast.walk(function):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in identity_names:
                violations.append((function.name, node.value.id, node.attr, node.lineno))
    return tuple(sorted(violations))


def validate_read_regular_identity_dataflow(tree: ast.Module, decoded: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    violations = read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(tree)
    require(violations == (), "read_regular identity attribute access retained")
    bindings = read_regular_identity_bindings(tree)
    require(
        ("validate_controller_acceptance", "info") in {(function, name) for function, name, _ in bindings}
        and ("transport_controller_acceptance", "reread_info") in {(function, name) for function, name, _ in bindings},
        "controller acceptance read identity bindings missing",
    )
    safe_fixture = ast.parse(
        "def source_acceptance():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(path, info, '0600')\n"
        "    return payload, {'mode': info['mode'], 'owner_uid': owner_uid}\n"
        "def returned_identity():\n"
        "    payload, identity = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return identity['sha256']\n"
        "def transported_reread():\n"
        "    payload, reread_info = read_regular(destination)\n"
        "    return correlate_read_identity_owner(destination, reread_info, '0600')\n"
    )
    require(read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(safe_fixture) == (), "dictionary identity positive fixtures failed")
    unsafe_fixture = ast.parse(
        "def source_acceptance():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return info.st_mode\n"
        "def returned_identity():\n"
        "    payload, info = read_regular(path)\n"
        "    return {'owner_uid': info.st_uid}\n"
        "def transported_reread():\n"
        "    payload, reread_info = read_regular(destination)\n"
        "    return reread_info.st_uid\n"
    )
    unsafe = read_regular_identity_attribute_violations(unsafe_fixture)
    require(
        {(function, name, attribute) for function, name, attribute, _ in unsafe}
        == {
            ("source_acceptance", "info", "st_mode"),
            ("returned_identity", "info", "st_uid"),
            ("transported_reread", "reread_info", "st_uid"),
        },
        "dictionary identity negative fixtures failed",
    )
    source_gate = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    transport_gate = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "transport_controller_acceptance"))
    helper = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "correlate_read_identity_owner"))
    require(
        isinstance(source_gate, str)
        and 'owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(path, info, "0600")' in source_gate
        and '"mode": info["mode"]' in source_gate
        and '"owner_uid": owner_uid' in source_gate,
        "source acceptance or returned identity fixture mismatch",
    )
    require(
        isinstance(transport_gate, str)
        and 'reread_owner_uid = correlate_read_identity_owner(destination, reread_info, "0600")' in transport_gate,
        "transported reread fixture mismatch",
    )
    require(
        isinstance(helper, str)
        and "open_identity(path)" in helper
        and "path.lstat()" in helper
        and 'frozenset({"device", "inode", "mode", "path", "sha256", "size", "type"})' in helper,
        "owner correlation helper mismatch",
    )
    return {"binding_count": len(bindings), "negative_fixture_count": 3, "result": "PASS"}

def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v19-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v19-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "correlate_read_identity_owner", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "validate_m3s_v14_stopped", "validate_m3s_v15_blocked", "validate_m3s_v16_stopped", "validate_m3s_v17_stopped", "validate_m3s_v18_stopped", "validate_active_phase_names", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    forbidden = {"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"}
    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = ast.literal_eval(constants["PREDECESSORS"])
    successor_receipts = static_string_collection(constants["SUCCESSOR_V19_RECEIPTS"], constants)
    successor_only_receipts = static_string_collection(constants["SUCCESSOR_ONLY_RECEIPTS"], constants)
    require(set(shapes) == {"execute"} and len(shapes["execute"]) == 25, "derived command schema mismatch")
    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(len(successor_receipts) == 38 and len(set(successor_receipts)) == 38, "successor receipt domain mismatch")
    require(len(successor_only_receipts) == 11 and len(set(successor_only_receipts)) == 11, "successor-only receipt delta mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v19-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v19.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    active_values = ast.literal_eval(constants["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"])
    auth_phase = b"M3S_" + b"V19_AUTH_HANDOFF"
    require(len(active_values) == 14 and auth_phase not in payload, "credential-free active phase set mismatch")
    active_source = ast.get_source_segment(payload.decode("utf-8"), function_node(tree, "active_v19_phases"))
    require(isinstance(active_source, str) and "return ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES" in active_source, "active phase implementation mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json") == 1 and payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json") == 1, "exact V13 artifact lineage fixture mismatch")
    auth_path = b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/" + b"auth.json"
    require(auth_path not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require((b"--" + b"last") not in payload and (b"resume_" + b"liveclip.sh") not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")
    called = {node.func.id for node in ast.walk(execute) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)}
    require({"validate_controller_acceptance", "initialize_and_bind_successor"} <= called, "acceptance gate not on execute path")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and "expected_plan_sha256" not in acceptance_source and "expected_status_sha256" not in acceptance_source, "historical acceptance coupled to current documents")
    gates_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "read_only_gates"))
    require(isinstance(gates_source, str) and "validate_documents" in gates_source, "current document validation missing")
    require(b'"historical root document binding mismatch"' in payload, "root historical document binding missing")
    dataflow = validate_read_regular_identity_dataflow(tree, decoded)
    observed_phase_violations = runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload, tuple(active_values))
    require(observed_phase_violations == [], "runtime-equivalent active phase mismatch: " + ",".join(observed_phase_violations))
    writer_phase = "M3S_" + "V19_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
    auth_phase_text = "M3S_" + "V19_AUTH_HANDOFF"
    writer_fixture = payload + ("\n" + repr(writer_phase) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    auth_fixture = payload + ("\n" + repr(auth_phase_text) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    require(runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(writer_fixture, tuple(active_values)) == ["inactive_active_version:" + writer_phase], "inactive writer negative fixture mismatch")
    require(runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(auth_fixture, tuple(active_values)) == ["inactive_active_version:" + auth_phase_text], "inactive auth negative fixture mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'require(len(successor) == 38, "successor receipt fixture count mismatch")') == 1, "38-receipt fixture missing")
    return {"command_set": sorted(shapes), "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_capability_absent": True, "document_generation_separation": "PASS", "identity_dataflow": dataflow, "phase_runtime_equivalent": "PASS", "receipt_count_fixture": 38, "receipt_domain_count": len(successor_receipts), "successor_delta_count": len(successor_only_receipts), "function_count": len(functions), "mktemp_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "result": "PASS"}

def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}

def validate_v17_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V17_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V17_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V17_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V17_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V17_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})

    result = json.loads(read_regular(V17_ROOT / "receipts/successor-preparation-v17-result.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(index["verdict"] == V17_CLOSURE["root_verdict"] and index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == V17_ROOT_PREPARE_ARGV_SHA, "V17 final index mismatch")
    require(result["phase"] == "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V17" and result["returncode"] == 1 and result["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.151416 and result["timed_out"] is False and result["output_truncated"] is False and result["session_id"] is None and result["credential_variables"] == [] and result["wrapper_error"] is None and result["output"].endswith(V17_FAILURE + "\n"), "V17 execution stop mismatch")
    require(sha(argv_json(result["argv"])) == V17_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA, "V17 execute argv mismatch")
    auth_result = V17_ROOT / "receipts/auth-handoff-v17-result.json"
    require(not auth_result.exists() and not auth_result.is_symlink(), "V17 auth result appeared")
    return {"closure": V17_CLOSURE, "files": files}


def validate_v18_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V18_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V18_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V18_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V18_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V18_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    files = {name: identity(V18_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V18_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    index = json.loads(read_regular(V18_ROOT / "receipts/final-index.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    result = json.loads(read_regular(V18_ROOT / "receipts/successor-preparation-v18-result.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(index["verdict"] == V18_CLOSURE["root_verdict"] and index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == V18_ROOT_PREPARE_ARGV_SHA, "V18 final index mismatch")
    require(result["phase"] == "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V18" and result["returncode"] == 1 and result["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.149305 and result["timed_out"] is False and result["output_truncated"] is False and result["session_id"] is None and result["credential_variables"] == [] and result["wrapper_error"] is None and result["output"].endswith(V18_FAILURE + "\n"), "V18 execution stop mismatch")
    require(sha(argv_json(result["argv"])) == V18_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA, "V18 execute argv mismatch")
    auth_result = V18_ROOT / "receipts/auth-handoff-v18-result.json"
    require(not auth_result.exists() and not auth_result.is_symlink(), "V18 auth result appeared")
    return {"closure": V18_CLOSURE, "files": files}


def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V19_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == V18_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V19 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v18_driver, _ = read_regular(V18_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v18_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v18_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    v15 = validate_v15_blocked()
    v16 = validate_v16_stopped()
    v17 = validate_v17_stopped()
    v18 = validate_v18_stopped()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V19 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V19_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v18, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V19_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V19_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14, "v15_blocked_closure": v15, "v16_stopped_closure": v16, "v17_stopped_closure": v17, "v18_stopped_closure": v18}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V19_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v18, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v19-result.json", "auth-handoff-v19-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V19_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V19_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_closure": v18, "result": "M3S_V19_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0

def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V19_END
```

## M3S-v18 executable active-policy successor design (2026-10-12)

### Progress and objective

The single accepted V17 candidate-recovery invocation is consumed immutable
preallocation-stop evidence. The wrapper returned 1 after 0.151416 seconds
with no timeout, truncation, wrapper error, session id, or credential
variables. Its mode-`0600`, uid-501 result is
`trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v17/receipts/successor-preparation-v17-result.json`,
3,709 bytes, SHA-256
`d65064d99735c89bedddcc396040389293c7bb40213157cb63bd45f758e4a102`.
The exact terminal error is
`RuntimeError: successor phase policy violation:
inactive_active_version:M3S_V17_WRITER_SELF_TEST`. No suffix or run budget was
crossed; candidate count remains 18 and delivery remains 0 staged / 15
modified / 156 untracked. The V17 root, result, and accepted
execute/vector/envelope hashes are consumed and never retryable.

V18 is a fresh fixed no-replace root design. It preserves the exact V17
execute-only 14-phase active set, broad 16-token classification vocabulary,
historical/current document-generation separation, external controller
acceptance, exact 18 predecessors, one-result/one-suffix/one-run budgets,
one-writer path, private `HOME`/`TMPDIR`, fail-closed gates, preservation,
and sealing. It corrects only the proven active-source defect and the dormant
receipt-count fixture.

### Surprises and discoveries

V17 excluded auth correctly but left two exact
`M3S_V17_WRITER_SELF_TEST` string constants in dormant transported
`self_check`/`finalize` code. The execute-time validator scans all Python
string constants in its own bytes, so dormant command inaccessibility did not
make those exact constants inactive-policy-safe. The root-only writer
self-test remains legitimate evidence, but its exact phase token must live in
the root-only preparation source/receipt rather than as one exact constant in
the execute driver.

The actual successor domain is 38 names: the 28-name historical domain minus
`m2-stop-receipt.json`, plus 11 successor-only names. V17 sealing already
used that 38-name tuple; only a dormant self-test asserted 37.

### Decision log and frozen contracts

- Derive V18 deterministically from the immutable 300,521-byte V17 driver.
  Before versioning, move its future-V18 policy to future V19; then version the
  active driver to V18, extend predecessor/version domains, bind the immutable
  V17 stop, and add one V17 read-only gate.
- Rewrite exactly the two current-version writer phase constants as
  `"M3S_" + "V18_WRITER_SELF_TEST"`. Runtime semantics remain identical,
  while AST exact-token inspection sees no inactive writer literal. Auth
  remains absent and there is no auth command, path, result, login probe, or
  copy capability.
- Change the dormant successor fixture from 37 to 38. The executable tuple,
  historical delta, 11-name successor delta, and sealing behavior remain
  unchanged.
- Add a preparation-time runtime-equivalent AST check over the full derived
  bytes. It requires all 14 active exact tokens, forbids both inactive current
  tokens, stale V1-V12 active tokens, future V19 tokens, future receipt names,
  and forbidden resume paths. Negative fixtures append exact writer/auth
  constants and must reproduce the precise inactive-policy violation. This
  pure parser check would have rejected V17 before root creation.
- The immutable V17 root-acceptance document hashes remain historical
  evidence. V18's later execute-time documents will be validated independently
  against their own argv; no gate equates those generations.

The fixed root is
`/Users/junhuaxu/Library/Application Support/LiveClip/engineering-candidates/agent-runtime-v2/a822890ace12/trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v18`.
Its root/controller-receipt budget is one; result/suffix/init each remain a
separate future one-shot budget. Auth and formal dispatch are unauthorized.
The root-only command is the 31-string pinned-Python argv defined by the source
below. It runs only through non-login `/bin/zsh` in immutable
`candidate.OlsWg1/repo`, with `/dev/null` stdin, exact eight-name
credential-free `env -i`, a 120-second outer allowance, and a 65,536-byte
aggregate diagnostic bound. All argv/environment/envelope identities are
derived from final closed documents and the externally accepted canonical
receipt, never written back into those self-referential bytes.

The canonical controller receipt is compact sorted JSON plus exactly one LF.
It binds final closed ExecPlan/STATUS identities, exclusive V18 source,
derived driver, five contract hashes, fixed root, immutable seed, and complete
V17 closure. It must be externally accepted before root creation. Driver
output cannot create controller authority.

### Validation and acceptance

Closure permits only raw marker extraction, independent deterministic byte
transforms, AST parse/compile-only checks, structural inspection, Ruff F/B/S,
canonical in-memory JSON/argv/envelope construction, read-only V17/root/
inventory correlation, and root-absence proof. The embedded source and derived
driver are never imported or executed during this design cycle.

A separately authorized root-only invocation may create only the absent
mode-`0700` V18 root, mode-`0600` derived driver, empty private
`home`/`tmp`, the exact accepted receipt, and four mode-`0600` root
receipts. Any mismatch retains and stops. Candidate recovery, reserved
results, allocation, setup, readiness, doctor, loop-init, auth, formal roles,
tests, rendering, evaluation, inference, publication, cleanup, commit, push,
`--last`, and `resume_liveclip.sh` remain outside this boundary.

### Artifacts and notes

The V18 source is the unique raw payload between the markers below. Source,
driver, contract, controller-receipt, root argv, env vector, and literal shell
envelope byte counts and SHA-256 identities are computed only after both
documents are final and are reported as the closure identities.

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)
```
