def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (300521, "85668e6c17ed929e9b4f7c4eae431fd3cf25f8174377eacfc5f2a153e0743f99"), "V17 driver identity mismatch")
    payload = source
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V18"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v18:" + phase)\n',
        b'    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V19"):\n        if phase in exact:\n            violations.append("future_v19:" + phase)\n',
        "future phase policy",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V18")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V18 fixture mismatch")\n',
        b'    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V19")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")\n    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V19 fixture mismatch")\n',
        "future phase fixture",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"range(18, 55)", b"range(19, 55)", "future receipt range")
    require(payload.count(b"V17") == 62 and payload.count(b"v17") == 61, "V17 token count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(b"V17", b"V18").replace(b"v17", b"v18")
    predecessor_versions = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_versions) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17"}')
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V18", "V18"}',
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19"}',
        "phase version domain",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", DRIVER_V17_CONSTANTS + b"CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING = ", "V17 constants")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:")
    payload = payload[:execute_start] + DRIVER_V17_FUNCTION + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'        "m3s_v16_stopped": validate_m3s_v16_stopped(),\n',
        b'        "m3s_v16_stopped": validate_m3s_v16_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v17_stopped": validate_m3s_v17_stopped(),\n',
        "V17 read-only gate",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V16_CLOSURE',
        b'value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V17_CLOSURE',
        "V17 acceptance closure",
    )
    writer_literal = b'"M3S_V18_WRITER_SELF_TEST"'
    require(payload.count(writer_literal) == 2, "inactive writer literal count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(writer_literal, b'"M3S_" + "V18_WRITER_SELF_TEST"')
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'require(len(successor) == 37, "successor receipt fixture count mismatch")',
        b'require(len(successor) == 38, "successor receipt fixture count mismatch")',
        "successor receipt fixture",
    )
    return payload


def static_versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE", "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3S_" + version + "_AUTH_HANDOFF",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload: bytes, active: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v18-phase-runtime-equivalent>")
    exact = frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))
    active_set = set(active)
    full_set = set(static_versioned_phase_tokens("V18"))
    violations: list[str] = []
    for phase in active:
        if phase not in exact:
            violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(full_set - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    stale = tuple(phase for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens(version))
    for phase in stale:
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in static_versioned_phase_tokens("V19"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v19:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(19, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    forbidden = (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh")
    for token in forbidden:
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations


def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v18-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v18-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "validate_m3s_v14_stopped", "validate_m3s_v15_blocked", "validate_m3s_v16_stopped", "validate_m3s_v17_stopped", "validate_active_phase_names", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    forbidden = {"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"}
    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = ast.literal_eval(constants["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(shapes) == {"execute"} and len(shapes["execute"]) == 25, "derived command schema mismatch")
    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v18-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v18.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    active_values = ast.literal_eval(constants["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"])
    auth_phase = b"M3S_" + b"V18_AUTH_HANDOFF"
    require(len(active_values) == 14 and auth_phase not in payload, "credential-free active phase set mismatch")
    active_source = ast.get_source_segment(payload.decode("utf-8"), function_node(tree, "active_v18_phases"))
    require(isinstance(active_source, str) and "return ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES" in active_source, "active phase implementation mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json") == 1 and payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json") == 1, "exact V13 artifact lineage fixture mismatch")
    auth_path = b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/" + b"auth.json"
    require(auth_path not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require((b"--" + b"last") not in payload and (b"resume_" + b"liveclip.sh") not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")
    called = {node.func.id for node in ast.walk(execute) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)}
    require({"validate_controller_acceptance", "initialize_and_bind_successor"} <= called, "acceptance gate not on execute path")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and "expected_plan_sha256" not in acceptance_source and "expected_status_sha256" not in acceptance_source, "historical acceptance coupled to current documents")
    gates_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "read_only_gates"))
    require(isinstance(gates_source, str) and "validate_documents" in gates_source, "current document validation missing")
    require(b'"historical root document binding mismatch"' in payload, "root historical document binding missing")
    observed_phase_violations = runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(payload, tuple(active_values))
    require(observed_phase_violations == [], "runtime-equivalent active phase mismatch: " + ",".join(observed_phase_violations))
    writer_phase = "M3S_" + "V18_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
    auth_phase_text = "M3S_" + "V18_AUTH_HANDOFF"
    writer_fixture = payload + ("\n" + repr(writer_phase) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    auth_fixture = payload + ("\n" + repr(auth_phase_text) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    require(runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(writer_fixture, tuple(active_values)) == ["inactive_active_version:" + writer_phase], "inactive writer negative fixture mismatch")
    require(runtime_equivalent_phase_violations(auth_fixture, tuple(active_values)) == ["inactive_active_version:" + auth_phase_text], "inactive auth negative fixture mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'require(len(successor) == 38, "successor receipt fixture count mismatch")') == 1, "38-receipt fixture missing")
    return {"command_set": sorted(shapes), "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_capability_absent": True, "document_generation_separation": "PASS", "phase_runtime_equivalent": "PASS", "receipt_count_fixture": 38, "function_count": len(functions), "mktemp_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "result": "PASS"}


def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}

def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V18_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == V17_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V18 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v17_driver, _ = read_regular(V17_ROOT / "candidate-driver.py")
    derived = derive_driver(v17_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v17_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    v15 = validate_v15_blocked()
    v16 = validate_v16_stopped()
    v17 = validate_v17_stopped()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V18 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V18_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v17, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V18_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V18_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14, "v15_blocked_closure": v15, "v16_stopped_closure": v16, "v17_stopped_closure": v17}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V18_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v17, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v18-result.json", "auth-handoff-v18-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V18_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V18_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_closure": v17, "result": "M3S_V18_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V18_END

contains an obsolete `len(successor) == 37` fixture. That helper is not a
command: `SHAPES` contains only the 25-token `execute` schema, `main()` accepts
only `execute`, and neither `execute()`, `read_only_gates()`, materialization,
initialization, preservation, nor `seal_attempt()` calls the helper or its
receipt-count self-test. The executable sealing path consumes the 38-name
tuple itself. This non-command discrepancy is retained visibly; it is not
treated as an executed preallocation gate or silently relabeled as 37.

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

DRIVER_FUNCTIONS = b'''def validate_m3s_v13_consumed() -> dict[str, Any]:

    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 planner artifact lineage mismatch")
    return {"budget": "CONSUMED_NO_REUSE", "files": files, "terminal": terminal}

    receipt_names = {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in PREVIOUS_M3S_V15_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")}

        path = PREVIOUS_M3S_V15_ROOT / "receipts" / name

def validate_controller_acceptance(values: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    path = M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance file mode/owner mismatch")
    require(sha(payload) == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "controller acceptance hash mismatch")
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(payload == compact(value) + b"\\n", "controller acceptance is not canonical")
    require_exact_keys(value, frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}), "controller acceptance")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V17_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "controller acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V16_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require_exact_keys(value["documents"], frozenset({"execplan", "status"}), "accepted documents")
    for label, expected_path in (("execplan", str(PLAN)), ("status", str(STATUS))):
        record = value["documents"][label]
        require_exact_keys(record, frozenset({"path", "sha256", "size"}), "accepted document " + label)
        require(record["path"] == expected_path and isinstance(record["size"], int) and record["size"] > 0 and isinstance(record["sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record["sha256"]) is not None, "accepted document schema mismatch: " + label)
    require(value["driver"]["path"] == str(DRIVER) and value["driver"]["sha256"] == values["expected_self_sha"], "accepted driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == {"head": HEAD, "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA, "patch_sha256": PATCH_SHA, "path_list_sha256": LIST_SHA}, "accepted seed mismatch")
    identity = {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}
    return payload, identity, value


def transport_controller_acceptance(repo: Path, receipts: Path, payload: bytes, source_identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trusted = repo / ".loop/trusted"
    require(not trusted.exists() and not trusted.is_symlink(), "controller acceptance directory collision")
    trusted.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    fsync_directory(trusted.parent)
    info = trusted.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not trusted.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "controller acceptance directory mismatch")
    destination = repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL
    destination_identity = write_exclusive(destination, payload)
    require(destination_identity["mode"] == "0600" and destination_identity["sha256"] == source_identity["sha256"] and destination_identity["size"] == source_identity["size"], "controller acceptance transport mismatch")
    reread, reread_info = read_regular(destination)
    require(reread == payload and reread_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")
    fsync_directory(trusted)
    receipt = {
        "byte_equal": True,
        "destination": destination_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V17_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_TRANSPORT",
        "source": source_identity,
        "result": "PASS",
    }
    receipt_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v17-controller-acceptance.json", pretty(receipt))
    return {"file": destination_identity, "receipt": receipt_identity}

DRIVER_PHASE_POLICY = b'''def phase_source_violations(payload: bytes, require_active: bool) -> list[str]:
    exact = exact_python_string_tokens(payload)
    active = tuple(active_v17_phases())
    active_set = set(active)
    full_set = set(versioned_phase_tokens("V17"))
    require(active == ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES and len(active_set) == len(active), "active V17 phase set mismatch")
    require(active_set < full_set, "active/full V17 phase separation mismatch")
    violations: list[str] = []
    if require_active:
        for phase in active:
            if phase not in exact:
                violations.append("missing_active:" + phase)
    for phase in sorted(full_set - active_set):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("inactive_active_version:" + phase)
    stale = tuple(phase for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12") for phase in predecessor_active_phases(version))
    for phase in stale:
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("stale_predecessor:" + phase)
    for phase in versioned_phase_tokens("V18"):
        if phase in exact:
            violations.append("future_v18:" + phase)
    for name in tuple(f"successor-preparation-v{version}-result.json" for version in range(18, 55)):
        if name.encode("ascii") in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden_receipt:" + name)
    forbidden = (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh")
    for token in forbidden:
        if token in payload:
            violations.append("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii"))
    return violations


def validate_active_phase_names() -> dict[str, Any]:
    active = tuple(active_v17_phases())
    full = tuple(versioned_phase_tokens("V17"))
    auth_phase = "M3S_" + "V17_AUTH_HANDOFF"
    writer_phase = "M3S_" + "V17_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
    require(active == ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES and len(active) == 14 and len(set(active)) == 14, "active V17 phase fixture mismatch")
    require(len(full) == 16 and len(set(full)) == 16 and set(active) == set(full) - {auth_phase, writer_phase}, "full V17 vocabulary fixture mismatch")
    self_bytes = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    require(auth_phase.encode("ascii") not in self_bytes, "inactive V17 auth phase literal present")
    observed = phase_source_violations(self_bytes, True)
    require(observed == [], "successor phase policy violation: " + ",".join(observed))
    active_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in active) + "\\n").encode("ascii")
    require(phase_source_violations(active_fixture, True) == [], "active V17 positive fixture mismatch")
    auth_fixture = active_fixture + (repr(auth_phase) + "\\n").encode("ascii")
    require(phase_source_violations(auth_fixture, True) == ["inactive_active_version:" + auth_phase], "inactive auth negative fixture mismatch")
    collision_fixture = b"'M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V1'\\n'M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V10'\\n'M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V11'\\n'M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V12'\\n"
    collision = phase_source_violations(collision_fixture, False)
    require(collision == ["stale_predecessor:M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V1", "stale_predecessor:M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V10", "stale_predecessor:M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V11", "stale_predecessor:M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V12"], "exact collision fixture mismatch")
    future_fixture = ("\\n".join(repr(item) for item in versioned_phase_tokens("V18")) + "\\n").encode("ascii")
    require(len(phase_source_violations(future_fixture, False)) == 16, "future V18 fixture mismatch")
    return {"active_count": len(active), "active_phases": list(active), "auth_phase_present": False, "full_vocabulary_count": len(full), "full_vocabulary_only": sorted(set(full) - set(active)), "result": "PASS"}


'''


def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V13_DRIVER_SIZE, V13_DRIVER_SHA), "V13 driver identity mismatch")
    require(source.count(b"V13") == 52 and source.count(b"v13") == 52, "V13 token count mismatch")
    payload = source.replace(b"V13", b"V17").replace(b"v13", b"v17")
    predecessor_versions = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_versions) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16"}')
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V17", "V14"}',
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18"}',
        "phase version domain",
    )
    shape_start = payload.index(b"SHAPES = {")
    shape_end = payload.index(b"\n}\n\nPREDECESSORS = {", shape_start) + 2
    payload = payload[:shape_start] + DRIVER_SHAPES + payload[shape_end:]
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b"\n}\n\nPROFILES = {",
        b'    "candidate.KWbe2iGW": (44316, 946755162, "e0aa33a9231aa88ec1a809be4f2bf7413973d16320146cd0c42cde051a6bca38", "8beef3afae1a83e370dde5495af8420c2b097225f99cf1bfa560c3a79b3bb624"),\n}\n\nPROFILES = {',
        "predecessor",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'AUTH_SOURCE = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json")\nAUTH_RESULT_NAME = "auth-handoff-v17-result.json"\nAUTH_MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024\n', b"", "remove auth constants")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n', b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n' + DRIVER_ACCEPTANCE, "acceptance constants")
    auth_start = payload.index(b"class AuthHandoffStop(RuntimeError):")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:", auth_start)
    payload = payload[:auth_start] + DRIVER_FUNCTIONS + DRIVER_V16_FUNCTION + payload[execute_start:]
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'def active_v17_phases() -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    return versioned_phase_tokens("V17")\n', b'def active_v17_phases() -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    return ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES\n', "active phase set")
    policy_start = payload.index(b"def phase_source_violations(payload: bytes, require_active: bool) -> list[str]:")
    policy_end = payload.index(b"def validate_stopped_root(", policy_start)
    payload = payload[:policy_start] + DRIVER_PHASE_POLICY + payload[policy_end:]
    old_main = b'''def main() -> int:
    command, values = parse_shape(sys.argv[1:])
    if command == "auth-handoff":
        return auth_handoff(values)
    return execute(values)
'''
    new_main = b'''def main() -> int:
    command, values = parse_shape(sys.argv[1:])
    require(command == "execute", "credential-free V17 command mismatch")
    return execute(values)
'''
    payload = replace_once(payload, old_main, new_main, "main dispatch")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'            "final-index.json",\n        },\n', b'            "final-index.json",\n            "controller-acceptance-v17.json",\n        },\n', "root acceptance receipt")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v12_consumed": validate_m3s_v12_consumed(),\n', b'        "m3s_v12_consumed": validate_m3s_v12_consumed(),\n        "m3s_v13_consumed": validate_m3s_v13_consumed(),\n        "m3s_v14_stopped": validate_m3s_v14_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v15_blocked": validate_m3s_v15_blocked(),\n        "m3s_v16_stopped": validate_m3s_v16_stopped(),\n', "V13/V14/V15/V16 gates")
    acceptance_receipt_anchor = b'    "successor-v17-trusted-context.json",\n'
    require(payload.count(acceptance_receipt_anchor) == 3, "acceptance receipt domain anchor mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(acceptance_receipt_anchor, acceptance_receipt_anchor + b'    "successor-v17-controller-acceptance.json",\n')
    payload = payload.replace(b'"CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL"', b'"EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED"')
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.add(context_path)\n', b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    acceptance_path = CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.update({context_path, acceptance_path})\n', "acceptance manifest path")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        expected_counts = {\n            "tracked": 2251,\n            "ordinary_untracked": 73,\n            "records": 2324,\n        }\n', b'        acceptance_row = rows[acceptance_path]\n        require(acceptance_row["class"] == "ordinary-untracked" and acceptance_row["type"] == "regular" and acceptance_row["mode"] == "0600", "controller acceptance record identity mismatch")\n        expected_counts = {\n            "tracked": 2251,\n            "ordinary_untracked": 74,\n            "records": 2325,\n        }\n', "acceptance manifest counts")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    status_sha: str,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    loop_root = repo / ".loop"\n', b'    status_sha: str,\n    acceptance_payload: bytes,\n    acceptance_identity: dict[str, Any],\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    loop_root = repo / ".loop"\n', "initializer acceptance arguments")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)\n', b'    acceptance_transport = transport_controller_acceptance(repo, receipts, acceptance_payload, acceptance_identity)\n    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)\n', "acceptance transport")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "candidate_root": str(repo),\n', b'        "candidate_root": str(repo),\n        "controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity,\n        "controller_acceptance_transport": acceptance_transport,\n', "final binding acceptance")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    started = time.monotonic()\n    initial_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])\n', b'    started = time.monotonic()\n    initial_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])\n', "execute anchor")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])\n', b'    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])\n    acceptance_payload, acceptance_identity, acceptance_value = validate_controller_acceptance(values)\n', "execute acceptance validation")
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    require(index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == values["expected_root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"], "root prepare argv hash mismatch")\n',
        b'    require(index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == values["expected_root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"], "root prepare argv hash mismatch")\n    require(index["controller_acceptance"]["sha256"] == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "root controller acceptance binding mismatch")\n    require(index["documents"] == {"plan_sha256": acceptance_value["documents"]["execplan"]["sha256"], "status_sha256": acceptance_value["documents"]["status"]["sha256"]}, "historical root document binding mismatch")\n',
        "historical root document generation binding",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n', b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n    gates["controller_acceptance"] = {"identity": acceptance_identity, "semantic": acceptance_value}\n', "acceptance gate")
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(\n',
        b'    require(toolchain["source_fingerprint"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS["policy_toolchain"]["toolchain_source_fingerprint"] and toolchain["snapshot_fingerprint"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS["policy_toolchain"]["toolchain_snapshot_fingerprint"], "controller-accepted toolchain fingerprint mismatch")\n    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(\n',
        "accepted toolchain binding",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(\n            repo,\n            parent,\n            receipts,\n            dry_env,\n            values["expected_plan_sha256"],\n            values["expected_status_sha256"],\n        )\n',
        b'        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(\n            repo,\n            parent,\n            receipts,\n            dry_env,\n            values["expected_plan_sha256"],\n            values["expected_status_sha256"],\n            acceptance_payload,\n            acceptance_identity,\n        )\n',
        "initializer acceptance call",
    )
    return payload


def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v17-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v17-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "validate_m3s_v14_stopped", "validate_m3s_v15_blocked", "validate_m3s_v16_stopped", "validate_active_phase_names", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}

    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])

    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v17-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v17.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    active_values = ast.literal_eval(constants["ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES"])
    auth_phase = b"M3S_" + b"V17_AUTH_HANDOFF"

    active_source = ast.get_source_segment(payload.decode("utf-8"), function_node(tree, "active_v17_phases"))
    require(isinstance(active_source, str) and "return ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES" in active_source, "active phase implementation mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json") == 1 and payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json") == 1, "exact V13 artifact lineage fixture mismatch")
    auth_path = b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/" + b"auth.json"
    require(auth_path not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require((b"--" + b"last") not in payload and (b"resume_" + b"liveclip.sh") not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")

    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")

def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}

def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V17_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == V16_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V17 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v13_driver, _ = read_regular(V13_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v13_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v13_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    v15 = validate_v15_blocked()
    v16 = validate_v16_stopped()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V17 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V17_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v16, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V17_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V17_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14, "v15_blocked_closure": v15, "v16_stopped_closure": v16}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V17_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v16, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v17-result.json", "auth-handoff-v17-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V17_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V17_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_closure": v16, "result": "M3S_V17_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V17_END

## M3S-v16 independent-document-generation successor design (2026-10-12)

### Purpose / Big Picture

M3S-v16 is the fresh no-replace successor to the sealed but
`BLOCKED_NO_SAFE_DISPATCH` M3S-v15 chain. V15 root-only preparation succeeded,
but its immutable candidate driver conflated two legitimate document
generations: the ExecPlan/STATUS identities accepted by the external controller
before root creation and the later current ExecPlan/STATUS identities supplied
to candidate recovery. Because the sealed V15 acceptance validator required the
historical receipt hashes to equal the execute arguments, while its independent
document validator also required those same arguments to equal the changed
current files, no candidate-recovery dispatch could pass.

V16 preserves the external-controller authority model and corrects only that
generation error. Its root-only prerequisite has since completed and is
sealed. The accepted root receipt remains immutable historical acceptance
evidence. A later execute invocation must independently validate its current
documents against its own exact argv. No comparison, equality predicate,
alias, or shared digest field may require the two generations to match. The
future candidate receives the exact historical receipt bytes plus the current
overlaid documents as separately labeled evidence.

### Controller acceptance and document generations

After these documents, the raw preparation source, deterministic driver, and
five contracts are closed, the external controller constructs and accepts one
canonical receipt before any root creation. Canonical bytes are sorted compact
UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one terminal LF. The root-only process receives the
compact JSON as one argv item, reconstructs the LF, validates every identity
before `mkdir`, and writes the accepted bytes no-replace. Driver output never
creates controller authority.

The receipt has exactly `authority`, `contracts`, `documents`, `driver`,
`format_version`, `phase`, `predecessor_closure`, `preparation_source`,
`result`, `root`, and `seed`. Fixed fields are
`EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER`, version 1, phase
`M3S_V16_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE`, and
`ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION`. `predecessor_closure` exactly binds the
sealed V15 files, root verdict/root argv, historical and post-root document
identities, rejected V15 dispatch hashes, and budget closure. `root` binds
the fixed no-replace mode-`0700` V16 path. `documents` binds the eventual
closed V16 pre-root documents and is historical after root creation.

The V16 driver validates the exact receipt hash and canonical schema, its fixed
paths, the sealed final-index receipt binding, source/driver/root/seed/contracts,
and historical document records. That validator deliberately has no reference
to `expected_plan_sha256` or `expected_status_sha256`. Separately,
`read_only_gates()` calls `validate_documents()` with the execute argv's
current plan/status hashes before allocation. The final root index binds the
historical receipt documents; the future execute receipt binds the current
documents. Equality across those generations is forbidden.

### Contracts, phases, schemas, and budgets

The five contracts preserve V15 except for versioned paths and the explicit
generation rule:

1. `candidate_allocation`: exact sorted 18-name predecessor set, one
   `/usr/bin/mktemp -d .../candidate.XXXXXXXX`, one suffix, no reuse/retry.
2. `trusted_context`: exact-byte no-replace/no-follow/fsync/reread transport
   of the historical receipt to
   `.loop/trusted/controller-acceptance-v16.json`, and explicit
   `historical-root-acceptance-and-current-execute-validated-independently`.
3. `initial_run`: one fixed `loop-init`, one fresh run, received
   cycle/code-cycle zero, null Coder session, empty artifacts/results, no error.
4. `formal_dispatch`: no role authority during preparation; later roles
   retain fresh read-only Planner/Reviewer/Tester/Gateway, one fresh isolated
   durable Coder with exact session lineage, and fixed deterministic Runner.
5. `policy_toolchain`: V16 closed-document policy and immutable toolchain
   source/snapshot fingerprints
   `d6a7f3f77d2b5edebab0792182a4bbacf0e8e6bd6201f8c5c851881efd889922` /
   `cecd553240606ac99485a822364db6662ac68c5a027a2d425049db2b00c0099a`.

Root phases are `M3S_V16_SOURCE_WRITE`,
`M3S_V16_WRITER_SELF_TEST`, `M3S_V16_SELF_CHECK`,
`M3S_V16_FINAL_INDEX`, and `M3S_V16_ROOT_ONLY`; verdict is
`M3S_V16_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW`. Receipt transport is
`M3S_V16_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_TRANSPORT`. Reserved results are
`successor-preparation-v16-result.json` and
`auth-handoff-v16-result.json`, both absent at root closure. The root receipt
domain is the accepted receipt plus exactly four root receipts.

The derived credential-free driver exposes only the 25-token `execute`
schema, has exact V1-V15 predecessor/V16 active/V17 future phase domains, the
38-item V16 candidate receipt domain and 11-item successor-only delta, exactly
one `mktemp`, and exactly one `loop-init`. It has no auth command, source,
destination, login probe, credential-copy path, `--last`, or resume surface.

The external receipt decision and root creation were distinct one-shot budgets
and are now consumed without reuse. Candidate result, suffix, and init are
further distinct one-shot budgets and remain unconsumed. Exclusive creation of
`successor-preparation-v16-result.json` consumes execute authority; the sole
`mktemp` consumes suffix; the sole `loop-init` consumes run. Every stop retains
all crossed evidence. No repair, replay, alternate root, second
result/suffix/run, or predecessor reuse exists. Authentication remains
unauthorized and requires new explicit credential authority after a separately
accepted candidate/run.

### Surprises and Discoveries

- External acceptance remains sound when its document identities are treated
  as historical evidence. The defect was not the receipt or transport; it was
  reusing its hashes as current-document arguments after authorized docs
  changed.
- A strict provenance chain needs both bindings: immutable pre-root controller
  bytes in the root/final index, and independently validated execute-time
  documents in the future result. Requiring equality loses valid chronology.
- V15's unused lower budgets cannot be reclaimed. A fresh version is required
  even though no candidate allocation occurred.
- The first V16 closure report used the inclusive fenced block rather than the
  runtime `extract_once()` boundary. The two marker lines total exactly 72
  bytes, so that report's 48,952-byte source identity was not the transported
  payload identity. Independent controller extraction stopped dispatch before
  any budget was consumed; the exclusive payload is 48,880 bytes and is the
  only source identity accepted below.

### Decision Log

- **Fresh V16, never repair V15.** V15 source, driver, root, and receipts are
  immutable; all rejected dispatch identities remain forbidden.
- **Two explicit generations.** Historical receipt records and current execute
  arguments have separate validators and evidence fields; cross-generation
  equality is a static policy violation.
- **Exact V15 closure in the new receipt.** The external controller accepts the
  complete retained closure before V16 root creation. Root output transports
  but never authors that authority.
- **Credential-free chain.** V16 preparation/recovery cannot access or reuse
  authentication state. Any future authentication requires new authority.
- **Root immutable before execute.** Driver, controller receipt, root receipts,
  final index, root argv, and root layout are sealed predecessor inputs; the
  execute design cannot update or regenerate them.

### Validation and Acceptance

Static closure never evaluates the embedded source or derived driver. It uses
raw single-marker extraction, independent byte transforms, `ast.parse`,
compile-only code-object construction, structural AST inspection, and Ruff
stdin F/B/S. Required checks are:

- unique source markers; deterministic driver equality; exact source/driver
  identities; exclusive marker-boundary fixture proving the two marker lines
  are exactly 72 bytes; source and driver parse/compile;
- acceptance schema and contract hashes; historical receipt validator contains
  neither current-document argument name; execute preallocation retains
  `validate_documents`; final index binds the historical receipt;
- exact V1-V17 phase domain, V16 path/schema/receipt domains, one execute
  command, 25 schema tokens, 38/11 receipt domains, one `mktemp`, one
  `loop-init`, exact 18 predecessors, one-writer and no-retry semantics;
- exact V13 artifact lineage, V14 absent stop, sealed V15 layout/files/final
  index, V15 reserved results absent, sealed V16 root layout/files/final index,
  and both V16 reserved results absent;
- branch/HEAD, 0/15/156 delivery inventory, exact 18-name candidate set;
- no raw authentication path/capability, no credential environment, no
  forbidden resume token, and no credential file access.

Candidate recovery, setup, readiness, doctor, init, formal roles, tests,
render, evaluation, inference, publication, commit, push, cleanup, and
authentication are not part of this design cycle.

def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:

def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

def validate_controller_acceptance(values: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    path = M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance file mode/owner mismatch")
    require(sha(payload) == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "controller acceptance hash mismatch")
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(payload == compact(value) + b"\\n", "controller acceptance is not canonical")
    require_exact_keys(value, frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}), "controller acceptance")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V16_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "controller acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V15_CLOSURE and value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "controller acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require_exact_keys(value["documents"], frozenset({"execplan", "status"}), "accepted documents")
    for label, expected_path in (("execplan", str(PLAN)), ("status", str(STATUS))):
        record = value["documents"][label]
        require_exact_keys(record, frozenset({"path", "sha256", "size"}), "accepted document " + label)
        require(record["path"] == expected_path and isinstance(record["size"], int) and record["size"] > 0 and isinstance(record["sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record["sha256"]) is not None, "accepted document schema mismatch: " + label)
    require(value["driver"]["path"] == str(DRIVER) and value["driver"]["sha256"] == values["expected_self_sha"], "accepted driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == {"head": HEAD, "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA, "patch_sha256": PATCH_SHA, "path_list_sha256": LIST_SHA}, "accepted seed mismatch")
    identity = {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}
    return payload, identity, value


def transport_controller_acceptance(repo: Path, receipts: Path, payload: bytes, source_identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trusted = repo / ".loop/trusted"
    require(not trusted.exists() and not trusted.is_symlink(), "controller acceptance directory collision")
    trusted.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    fsync_directory(trusted.parent)
    info = trusted.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not trusted.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "controller acceptance directory mismatch")
    destination = repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL
    destination_identity = write_exclusive(destination, payload)
    require(destination_identity["mode"] == "0600" and destination_identity["sha256"] == source_identity["sha256"] and destination_identity["size"] == source_identity["size"], "controller acceptance transport mismatch")
    reread, reread_info = read_regular(destination)
    require(reread == payload and reread_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")
    fsync_directory(trusted)
    receipt = {
        "byte_equal": True,
        "destination": destination_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V16_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_TRANSPORT",
        "source": source_identity,
        "result": "PASS",
    }
    receipt_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v16-controller-acceptance.json", pretty(receipt))
    return {"file": destination_identity, "receipt": receipt_identity}

def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (V13_DRIVER_SIZE, V13_DRIVER_SHA), "V13 driver identity mismatch")

    payload = source.replace(b"V13", b"V16").replace(b"v13", b"v16")
    predecessor_versions = b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12"}'
    require(payload.count(predecessor_versions) == 4, "predecessor version-set count mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15"}')
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V16", "V14"}',
        b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16", "V17"}',
        "phase version domain",
    )
    shape_start = payload.index(b"SHAPES = {")
    shape_end = payload.index(b"\n}\n\nPREDECESSORS = {", shape_start) + 2
    payload = payload[:shape_start] + DRIVER_SHAPES + payload[shape_end:]
