```python
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'AUTH_SOURCE = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json")\nAUTH_RESULT_NAME = "auth-handoff-v16-result.json"\nAUTH_MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024\n', b"", "remove auth constants")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n', b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n' + DRIVER_ACCEPTANCE, "acceptance constants")
    auth_start = payload.index(b"class AuthHandoffStop(RuntimeError):")
    execute_start = payload.index(b"def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:", auth_start)
    payload = payload[:auth_start] + DRIVER_FUNCTIONS + payload[execute_start:]
    old_main = b'''def main() -> int:
    command, values = parse_shape(sys.argv[1:])
    if command == "auth-handoff":
        return auth_handoff(values)
    return execute(values)
'''
    new_main = b'''def main() -> int:
    command, values = parse_shape(sys.argv[1:])
    require(command == "execute", "credential-free V16 command mismatch")
    return execute(values)
'''
    payload = replace_once(payload, old_main, new_main, "main dispatch")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'            "final-index.json",\n        },\n', b'            "final-index.json",\n            "controller-acceptance-v16.json",\n        },\n', "root acceptance receipt")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "m3s_v12_consumed": validate_m3s_v12_consumed(),\n', b'        "m3s_v12_consumed": validate_m3s_v12_consumed(),\n        "m3s_v13_consumed": validate_m3s_v13_consumed(),\n        "m3s_v14_stopped": validate_m3s_v14_stopped(),\n        "m3s_v15_blocked": validate_m3s_v15_blocked(),\n', "V13/V14/V15 gates")
    acceptance_receipt_anchor = b'    "successor-v16-trusted-context.json",\n'
    require(payload.count(acceptance_receipt_anchor) == 3, "acceptance receipt domain anchor mismatch")
    payload = payload.replace(acceptance_receipt_anchor, acceptance_receipt_anchor + b'    "successor-v16-controller-acceptance.json",\n')
    payload = payload.replace(b'"CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL"', b'"EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED"')
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.add(context_path)\n', b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    acceptance_path = CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.update({context_path, acceptance_path})\n', "acceptance manifest path")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        expected_counts = {\n            "tracked": 2251,\n            "ordinary_untracked": 73,\n            "records": 2324,\n        }\n', b'        acceptance_row = rows[acceptance_path]\n        require(acceptance_row["class"] == "ordinary-untracked" and acceptance_row["type"] == "regular" and acceptance_row["mode"] == "0600", "controller acceptance record identity mismatch")\n        expected_counts = {\n            "tracked": 2251,\n            "ordinary_untracked": 74,\n            "records": 2325,\n        }\n', "acceptance manifest counts")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    status_sha: str,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    loop_root = repo / ".loop"\n', b'    status_sha: str,\n    acceptance_payload: bytes,\n    acceptance_identity: dict[str, Any],\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    loop_root = repo / ".loop"\n', "initializer acceptance arguments")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)\n', b'    acceptance_transport = transport_controller_acceptance(repo, receipts, acceptance_payload, acceptance_identity)\n    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)\n', "acceptance transport")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'        "candidate_root": str(repo),\n', b'        "candidate_root": str(repo),\n        "controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity,\n        "controller_acceptance_transport": acceptance_transport,\n', "final binding acceptance")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    started = time.monotonic()\n    initial_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])\n', b'    started = time.monotonic()\n    initial_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])\n', "execute anchor")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])\n', b'    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])\n    acceptance_payload, acceptance_identity, acceptance_value = validate_controller_acceptance(values)\n', "execute acceptance validation")
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    require(index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == values["expected_root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"], "root prepare argv hash mismatch")\n',
        b'    require(index["root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"] == values["expected_root_prepare_argv_json_sha256"], "root prepare argv hash mismatch")\n    require(index["controller_acceptance"]["sha256"] == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "root controller acceptance binding mismatch")\n    require(index["documents"] == {"plan_sha256": acceptance_value["documents"]["execplan"]["sha256"], "status_sha256": acceptance_value["documents"]["status"]["sha256"]}, "historical root document binding mismatch")\n',
        "historical root document generation binding",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n', b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n    gates["controller_acceptance"] = {"identity": acceptance_identity, "semantic": acceptance_value}\n', "acceptance gate")
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(\n',
        b'    require(toolchain["source_fingerprint"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS["policy_toolchain"]["toolchain_source_fingerprint"] and toolchain["snapshot_fingerprint"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS["policy_toolchain"]["toolchain_snapshot_fingerprint"], "controller-accepted toolchain fingerprint mismatch")\n    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(\n',
        "accepted toolchain binding",
    )
    payload = replace_once(
        payload,
        b'        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(\n            repo,\n            parent,\n            receipts,\n            dry_env,\n            values["expected_plan_sha256"],\n            values["expected_status_sha256"],\n        )\n',
        b'        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(\n            repo,\n            parent,\n            receipts,\n            dry_env,\n            values["expected_plan_sha256"],\n            values["expected_status_sha256"],\n            acceptance_payload,\n            acceptance_identity,\n        )\n',
        "initializer acceptance call",
    )
    return payload


def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v16-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v16-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "validate_m3s_v14_stopped", "validate_m3s_v15_blocked", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    forbidden = {"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"}
    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = ast.literal_eval(constants["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(shapes) == {"execute"} and len(shapes["execute"]) == 25, "derived command schema mismatch")
    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v16-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v16.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    require(payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json") == 1 and payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json") == 1, "exact V13 artifact lineage fixture mismatch")
    auth_path = b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/" + b"auth.json"
    require(auth_path not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require((b"--" + b"last") not in payload and (b"resume_" + b"liveclip.sh") not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")
    called = {node.func.id for node in ast.walk(execute) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)}
    require({"validate_controller_acceptance", "initialize_and_bind_successor"} <= called, "acceptance gate not on execute path")
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8")
    acceptance_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "validate_controller_acceptance"))
    require(isinstance(acceptance_source, str) and "expected_plan_sha256" not in acceptance_source and "expected_status_sha256" not in acceptance_source, "historical acceptance coupled to current documents")
    gates_source = ast.get_source_segment(decoded, function_node(tree, "read_only_gates"))
    require(isinstance(gates_source, str) and "validate_documents" in gates_source, "current document validation missing")
    require(b'"historical root document binding mismatch"' in payload, "root historical document binding missing")
    return {"command_set": sorted(shapes), "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_capability_absent": True, "document_generation_separation": "PASS", "function_count": len(functions), "mktemp_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "result": "PASS"}


def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}

def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_closure", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V16_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES and value["predecessor_closure"] == V15_CLOSURE and value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance semantic mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256) and (len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "source or driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V16 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v13_driver, _ = read_regular(V13_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v13_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v13_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    v15 = validate_v15_blocked()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V16 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V16_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_closure": v15, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V16_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V16_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14, "v15_blocked_closure": v15}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V16_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_closure": v15, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v16-result.json", "auth-handoff-v16-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V16_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V16_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_closure": v15, "result": "M3S_V16_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V16_END
```

## M3S-v15 controller-acceptance successor design (2026-10-12)

### Purpose / Big Picture

M3S-v15 is the fresh no-replace successor to the consumed V14 root-only
invocation. It preserves V14's non-circular external-controller acceptance
architecture and corrects only the exact immutable V13 Planner-artifact lineage
predicate that stopped V14 before root creation. The observable end of this
design cycle is a closed pair of documents, one unique embedded preparation
source, one independently reproducible credential-free driver, five canonical
contract digests, and one externally constructible canonical controller receipt.
The separately authorized root-only invocation has since sealed that design;
this cycle records its immutable result and freezes candidate recovery without
executing it.

### Context and Orientation

The accepted V14 root-only Python argv, full env vector, and literal shell
envelope are consumed and non-retryable. Their one invocation exited 1 after
0.147307 seconds in preflight `validate_v13_evidence` with exact terminal
`RuntimeError: V13 artifact lineage mismatch`. The stop preceded the fixed-root
`mkdir`; therefore
`trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v14`, its derived driver, accepted
receipt, four root receipts, both reserved results, suffix, init, auth, and
formal phases never existed or crossed a budget boundary.

The root cause is exact and non-secret. Immutable V13 `state.json` contains:

```json
{"planner":[".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json",".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json"]}
```

under its `artifacts` member. V14 incorrectly converted that ordered list to a
set and compared it with the labels `{"001","002"}`. V15 requires the list to
equal exactly those two full relative paths in that order. The check therefore
rejects missing or extra members, duplicates, reordering, short labels, absolute
paths, and alternate run or role paths. The same exact representation is used
by root preflight, the independently derived driver, and the static fixture
against the immutable V13 state.

The fixed root, now sealed and immutable, is
`/Users/junhuaxu/Library/Application Support/LiveClip/engineering-candidates/agent-runtime-v2/a822890ace12/trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v15`.
The immutable seed remains `candidate.OlsWg1/repo`; the exact predecessor set
remains the 18 existing candidate names. Delivery remains branch `main`, HEAD
`2f361fcddc0e63ae62ee62826e27b54bb8204c53`, with 0 staged / 15 modified
tracked / 156 untracked. V13 candidate `candidate.KWbe2iGW`, its terminal run,
all prior roots/results/candidates/runs, and the dirty delivery worktree remain

### Scope and non-goals

The completed root-only authority was allowed only to validate
closed non-secret evidence, create the fixed no-replace V15 root mode `0700`,
derive and write its mode-`0600` driver, create empty private `home` and
`tmp`, create private `receipts`, write the exact externally accepted

`self-check-result.json`, and `final-index.json`. It stopped with
`M3S_V15_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW` before candidate recovery.

Candidate recovery, suffix allocation, setup, readiness, doctor, loop-init,
loop-run, formal roles, Runner, tests, rendering, evaluation, inference,
services, publication, cleanup, commit, push, source-media mutation,
`resume_liveclip.sh`, and `--last` are non-goals. V15 preparation and

### Controller acceptance and contracts

After the final ExecPlan, STATUS, preparation source, and independently derived
driver are closed, the controller reconstructs and accepts one canonical JSON
receipt before root creation. The root-only process receives its compact JSON
as a literal argv item, reconstructs exactly one terminal LF, validates its
separately supplied byte count and SHA-256 plus every semantic field before
`mkdir`, and later writes those exact bytes no-replace. Driver output can
transport the receipt but can never create or substitute controller authority.

The receipt has exactly these top-level keys: `authority`, `contracts`,
`documents`, `driver`, `format_version`, `phase`,
`predecessor_stop`, `preparation_source`, `result`, `root`, and
`seed`. Canonical serialization is

### Surprises and Discoveries

- V13 `state.artifacts.planner` stores candidate-relative artifact paths,
  not ordinal labels. The paths are already immutable and stronger than the
  attempted label comparison; preserving their list order closes the defect
  without weakening provenance.
- V14 did not consume its root budget because the failing predicate ran before
  `mkdir`, but its accepted invocation/argv/vector/envelope authority is
  consumed. An absent root therefore does not authorize replay.
- The controller receipt can bind the consumed predecessor stop and fixed new
  root as ordinary canonical fields without introducing circularity: neither
  field depends on future root output.

### Decision Log

- **2026-10-12 — Fresh V15 rather than V14 repair.** V14's single dispatch is
  consumed and non-retryable. A new version keeps historical evidence
  immutable and makes every active path/phase/schema independently reviewable.
- **2026-10-12 — Ordered full-path equality.** Both pre-root and candidate
  driver require the exact two-element list. Set or basename comparison is
  rejected because it loses order and path provenance.
- **2026-10-12 — External receipt remains sole authority.** The driver may
  validate and transport exact accepted bytes; no receipt or driver-produced
  label can stand in for the controller's pre-root acceptance.
- **2026-10-12 — Credential-free preparation.** V15 removes the V13 auth
  command from the derived schema and requires new explicit authority for any
  later handoff.

Static closure must not evaluate embedded source or driver. It uses raw
single-marker extraction, `ast.parse`, compile-only code-object construction,
structural AST inspection, an independently implemented deterministic
transformation of immutable V13 driver bytes, and Ruff stdin F/B/S. It must
prove:

- exact V13 state identity and exact ordered `artifacts.planner` fixture;
- V14 root absent, V15 root absent, exact 18-name candidate set, delivery

- one command (`execute`), 25 schema strings, one `mktemp`, one
  `loop-init`, no auth capability/path in the derived driver, no retry/

- exact V1-V14 predecessor, V15 active, and V16 future token domains with no

- root receipt domain of accepted receipt plus four root receipts, both
  reserved results absent, and exact V15 candidate receipt/manifest additions;
- controller receipt schema, five contract hashes, deterministic driver
  equality, 31-string root Python argv, 41-string full env vector, and literal

Root-only acceptance requires return code zero, empty stderr, bounded output,

no candidate-recovery, credential, or formal-role authority.

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

    receipt_names = {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")}
    require(set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ROOT / "receipts")) == receipt_names, "V13 receipt set mismatch")
    files = {name: require_identity(PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ROOT / name, digest, 0o600, size) for name, (size, digest) in PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: require_identity(PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_RUN / name, digest, 0o644, size) for name, (size, digest) in PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state, _ = load_json(PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_RUN / "state.json")
    require(state["run_id"] == "20261012T225001Z-e23eba62" and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 planner artifact lineage mismatch")
    return {"budget": "CONSUMED_NO_REUSE", "files": files, "terminal": terminal}


def validate_m3s_v14_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(not PREVIOUS_M3S_V14_ROOT.exists() and not PREVIOUS_M3S_V14_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V14 stopped root appeared")
    return PREVIOUS_M3S_V14_STOP


def validate_controller_acceptance(values: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    path = M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance file mode/owner mismatch")
    require(sha(payload) == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "controller acceptance hash mismatch")
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(payload == compact(value) + b"\\n", "controller acceptance is not canonical")
    require_exact_keys(value, frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_stop", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}), "controller acceptance")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V15_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "controller acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES, "controller acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_stop"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V14_STOP, "accepted predecessor stop mismatch")
    require(value["root"] == CONTROLLER_ROOT_BINDING, "accepted root binding mismatch")
    require(value["documents"]["execplan"]["path"] == str(PLAN) and value["documents"]["execplan"]["sha256"] == values["expected_plan_sha256"], "accepted ExecPlan mismatch")
    require(value["documents"]["status"]["path"] == str(STATUS) and value["documents"]["status"]["sha256"] == values["expected_status_sha256"], "accepted STATUS mismatch")
    require(value["driver"]["path"] == str(DRIVER) and value["driver"]["sha256"] == values["expected_self_sha"], "accepted driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == {"head": HEAD, "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA, "patch_sha256": PATCH_SHA, "path_list_sha256": LIST_SHA}, "accepted seed mismatch")
    identity = {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}
    return payload, identity, value


def transport_controller_acceptance(repo: Path, receipts: Path, payload: bytes, source_identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trusted = repo / ".loop/trusted"
    require(not trusted.exists() and not trusted.is_symlink(), "controller acceptance directory collision")
    trusted.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    fsync_directory(trusted.parent)
    info = trusted.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not trusted.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "controller acceptance directory mismatch")
    destination = repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL
    destination_identity = write_exclusive(destination, payload)
    require(destination_identity["mode"] == "0600" and destination_identity["sha256"] == source_identity["sha256"] and destination_identity["size"] == source_identity["size"], "controller acceptance transport mismatch")
    reread, reread_info = read_regular(destination)
    require(reread == payload and reread_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")
    fsync_directory(trusted)
    receipt = {
        "byte_equal": True,
        "destination": destination_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V15_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_TRANSPORT",
        "source": source_identity,
        "result": "PASS",
    }
    receipt_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v15-controller-acceptance.json", pretty(receipt))
    return {"file": destination_identity, "receipt": receipt_identity}

def derive_driver(source: bytes) -> bytes:

    payload = payload.replace(predecessor_versions, b'{"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13"}')

        "phase version domain",

        "predecessor",
    )
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'AUTH_SOURCE = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json")\nAUTH_RESULT_NAME = "auth-handoff-v15-result.json"\nAUTH_MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024\n', b"", "remove auth constants")
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n', b'CODEX_SHA = "12ac11d2c7eee27cfae34393986d7b7c9ed0dea537cb749831cdd7033893e6de"\n\n' + DRIVER_ACCEPTANCE, "acceptance constants")
    auth_start = payload.index(b"class AuthHandoffStop(RuntimeError):")

'''
    new_main = b'''def main() -> int:

'''
    payload = replace_once(payload, old_main, new_main, "main dispatch")

    acceptance_receipt_anchor = b'    "successor-v15-trusted-context.json",\n'

    payload = payload.replace(b'"CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL"', b'"EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED"')
    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.add(context_path)\n', b'    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()\n    acceptance_path = CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL.as_posix()\n    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}\n    if context_expected:\n        expected_paths.update({context_path, acceptance_path})\n', "acceptance manifest path")

    payload = replace_once(payload, b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n', b'    gates["operator_config"] = operator_config\n    gates["controller_acceptance"] = {"identity": acceptance_identity, "semantic": acceptance_value}\n', "acceptance gate")

        b'        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(\n            repo,\n            parent,\n            receipts,\n            dry_env,\n            values["expected_plan_sha256"],\n            values["expected_status_sha256"],\n            acceptance_payload,\n            acceptance_identity,\n        )\n',

def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v15-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v15-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "validate_m3s_v14_stopped", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    forbidden = {"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"}
    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = ast.literal_eval(constants["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(shapes) == {"execute"} and len(shapes["execute"]) == 25, "derived command schema mismatch")
    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v15-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v15.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    require(payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/001.json") == 1 and payload.count(b".loop/runs/20261012T225001Z-e23eba62/artifacts/planner/002.json") == 1, "exact V13 artifact lineage fixture mismatch")
    require(b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json" not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")
    called = {node.func.id for node in ast.walk(execute) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)}
    require({"validate_controller_acceptance", "initialize_and_bind_successor"} <= called, "acceptance gate not on execute path")
    return {"command_set": sorted(shapes), "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_capability_absent": True, "function_count": len(functions), "mktemp_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "result": "PASS"}


def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and state["artifacts"]["planner"] == V13_ARTIFACT_LINEAGE, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}


def validate_v14_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(not V14_ROOT.exists() and not V14_ROOT.is_symlink(), "V14 stopped root appeared")
    return V14_STOP


def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "predecessor_stop", "preparation_source", "result", "root", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V15_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES, "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["predecessor_stop"] == V14_STOP, "acceptance predecessor stop mismatch")
    require(value["root"] == ROOT_BINDING, "acceptance root binding mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256), "source identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V15 root already exists")

    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v13_driver, _ = read_regular(V13_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v13_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v13_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    v14 = validate_v14_stopped()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V15 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V15_SOURCE_WRITE", "predecessor_stop": v14, "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V15_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V15_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"], "v14_pre_mkdir_stop": v14}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V15_FINAL_INDEX", "predecessor_stop": v14, "root_binding": ROOT_BINDING, "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v15-result.json", "auth-handoff-v15-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V15_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V15_ROOT_ONLY", "predecessor_stop": v14, "result": "M3S_V15_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V15_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = GENERIC_MAX_BYTES) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), "unsafe regular file")
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, "file exceeds read bound")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require((opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "opened identity mismatch")
        while True:
            block = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require((final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size), "read identity changed")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, "short read")
    after = path.lstat()
    require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size), "path identity changed")
    return payload, before


def identity(path: Path, size: int, digest: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(len(payload) == size and sha(payload) == digest, "file identity mismatch: " + str(path))
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, "file mode mismatch: " + str(path))
    require(info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "file owner mismatch: " + str(path))
    return {"mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": digest, "size": size}


def private_directory(path: Path, names: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "private directory mismatch")
    observed = set(os.listdir(path))
    if names is not None:
        require(observed == names, "private directory entries mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0700", "owner_uid": info.st_uid}


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def replace_once(payload: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes, label: str) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(old) == 1, label + " replacement count mismatch")
    return payload.replace(old, new, 1)

def validate_controller_acceptance(values: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    path = M2B / "receipts" / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_NAME
    payload, info = read_regular(path)
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance file mode/owner mismatch")
    require(sha(payload) == values["expected_controller_acceptance_sha256"], "controller acceptance hash mismatch")
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(payload == compact(value) + b"\\n", "controller acceptance is not canonical")
    require_exact_keys(value, frozenset({"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "preparation_source", "result", "seed"}), "controller acceptance")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V14_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "controller acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTROLLER_CONTRACT_HASHES, "controller acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"]["execplan"]["path"] == str(PLAN) and value["documents"]["execplan"]["sha256"] == values["expected_plan_sha256"], "accepted ExecPlan mismatch")
    require(value["documents"]["status"]["path"] == str(STATUS) and value["documents"]["status"]["sha256"] == values["expected_status_sha256"], "accepted STATUS mismatch")
    require(value["driver"]["path"] == str(DRIVER) and value["driver"]["sha256"] == values["expected_self_sha"], "accepted driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == {"head": HEAD, "manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA, "patch_sha256": PATCH_SHA, "path_list_sha256": LIST_SHA}, "accepted seed mismatch")
    identity = {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}
    return payload, identity, value


def transport_controller_acceptance(repo: Path, receipts: Path, payload: bytes, source_identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trusted = repo / ".loop/trusted"
    require(not trusted.exists() and not trusted.is_symlink(), "controller acceptance directory collision")
    trusted.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    fsync_directory(trusted.parent)
    info = trusted.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not trusted.is_symlink() and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, "controller acceptance directory mismatch")
    destination = repo / CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_REL
    destination_identity = write_exclusive(destination, payload)
    require(destination_identity["mode"] == "0600" and destination_identity["sha256"] == source_identity["sha256"] and destination_identity["size"] == source_identity["size"], "controller acceptance transport mismatch")
    reread, reread_info = read_regular(destination)
    require(reread == payload and reread_info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID, "controller acceptance reread mismatch")
    fsync_directory(trusted)
    receipt = {
        "byte_equal": True,
        "destination": destination_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V14_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE_TRANSPORT",
        "source": source_identity,
        "result": "PASS",
    }
    receipt_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v14-controller-acceptance.json", pretty(receipt))
    return {"file": destination_identity, "receipt": receipt_identity}

def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == name), None)
    require(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef), "missing function: " + name)
    return node


def validate_derived_driver(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<m3s-v14-derived-driver>")
    compile(tree, "<m3s-v14-derived-driver>", "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    functions = {item.name for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef)}
    required = {"execute", "validate_controller_acceptance", "transport_controller_acceptance", "validate_m3s_v13_consumed", "seal_attempt", "initialize_and_bind_successor"}
    require(required <= functions, "derived driver function set mismatch")
    forbidden = {"auth_handoff", "opaque_copy_auth_state", "codex_login_status"}
    require(not (forbidden & functions), "credential capability retained")
    constants = {item.targets[0].id: item.value for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.Assign) and len(item.targets) == 1 and isinstance(item.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    shapes = ast.literal_eval(constants["SHAPES"])
    predecessors = ast.literal_eval(constants["PREDECESSORS"])
    require(set(shapes) == {"execute"} and len(shapes["execute"]) == 25, "derived command schema mismatch")
    require(len(predecessors) == 18 and "candidate.KWbe2iGW" in predecessors, "derived predecessor set mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")]') == 1, "mktemp site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b'        "loop-init",\n') == 1, "loop-init site mismatch")
    require(payload.count(b"successor-v14-controller-acceptance.json") >= 2, "acceptance transport receipt missing")
    require(payload.count(b"controller-acceptance-v14.json") >= 4, "acceptance binding missing")
    require(b"/Users/junhuaxu/.codex/auth.json" not in payload and b"def auth_handoff" not in payload and b"AUTH_SOURCE" not in payload, "credential path or capability retained")
    require(b"--last" not in payload and b"resume_liveclip.sh" not in payload, "forbidden resume token")
    execute = function_node(tree, "execute")
    called = {node.func.id for node in ast.walk(execute) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)}
    require({"validate_controller_acceptance", "initialize_and_bind_successor"} <= called, "acceptance gate not on execute path")
    return {"command_set": sorted(shapes), "compile_only": "PASS", "credential_capability_absent": True, "function_count": len(functions), "mktemp_sites": 1, "predecessor_count": len(predecessors), "result": "PASS"}


def git_output(argv: list[str], cwd: Path) -> bytes:
    env = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=30)  # noqa: S603 - exact read-only Git argv
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 65536, "git preflight failed")
    return result.stdout


def status_counts(cwd: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    lines = git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd).decode().splitlines()
    return (sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"}), sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??")))


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    require(status_counts(DELIVERY) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "delivery inventory mismatch")
    candidates = {path.name for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()}
    require(candidates == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate set mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "branch", "--show-current"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == b"main\n", "V13 candidate branch mismatch")
    require(git_output(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "V13 candidate head mismatch")
    require(status_counts(V13_CANDIDATE / "repo") == (0, 15, 73), "V13 candidate inventory mismatch")
    return {"candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_status": [0, 15, 73], "delivery_status": [0, 15, 156], "head": EXPECTED_HEAD}


def validate_v13_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V13_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V13_ROOT / "receipts", {name.split("/", 1)[1] for name in V13_ROOT_FILES if name.startswith("receipts/")})
    root_files = {name: identity(V13_ROOT / name, size, digest, 0o600) for name, (size, digest) in V13_ROOT_FILES.items()}
    terminal = {name: identity(V13_RUN / name, size, digest, 0o644) for name, (size, digest) in V13_TERMINAL_FILES.items()}
    state = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / "state.json")[0].decode("utf-8"))
    require(state["run_id"] == V13_RUN_ID and state["state"] == "blocked" and state["cycle"] == 2 and state["code_cycle"] == 0 and state["coder_session_id"] is None and state["command_results"] == [] and state["last_error"] == "plan repair budget exhausted", "V13 terminal state mismatch")
    require(set(state["artifacts"]) == {"planner"} and set(state["artifacts"]["planner"]) == {"001", "002"}, "V13 artifact lineage mismatch")
    for number in ("001", "002"):
        planner = json.loads(read_regular(V13_RUN / ("artifacts/planner/" + number + ".json"))[0].decode("utf-8"))
        require(planner["verdict"] == "NEEDS_INPUT", "V13 Planner verdict mismatch")
    return {"root_files": root_files, "terminal": terminal}


def validate_acceptance(value: Any, args: argparse.Namespace, source: bytes, driver: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"authority", "contracts", "documents", "driver", "format_version", "phase", "preparation_source", "result", "seed"}, "acceptance schema mismatch")
    require(value["authority"] == "EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER" and value["format_version"] == 1 and value["phase"] == "M3S_V14_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE" and value["result"] == "ACCEPTED_BEFORE_ROOT_CREATION", "acceptance fixed fields mismatch")
    require(value["contracts"] == CONTRACT_HASHES, "acceptance contract mismatch")
    require(value["documents"] == {"execplan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": args.expected_plan_size}, "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": args.expected_status_size}}, "acceptance document mismatch")
    require(value["preparation_source"] == {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "acceptance source mismatch")
    require(value["driver"] == {"path": str(DRIVER), "sha256": args.expected_driver_sha256, "size": args.expected_driver_size}, "acceptance driver mismatch")
    require(value["seed"] == SEED_BINDING, "acceptance seed mismatch")
    payload = compact(value) + b"\n"
    require((len(payload), sha(payload)) == (args.expected_controller_acceptance_size, args.expected_controller_acceptance_sha256), "acceptance identity mismatch")
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (args.expected_source_size, args.expected_source_sha256), "source identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    return payload


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    observed, info = read_regular(path)
    require(observed == payload and info.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600, "exclusive write mismatch")
    return {"mode": "0600", "owner_uid": info.st_uid, "sha256": sha(payload), "size": len(payload)}


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c" and sys.argv[1:2] == ["--"], "literal -c source required")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("root-only",))
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--controller-acceptance-json", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-controller-acceptance-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(sys.argv[2:])


def validate_environment() -> None:
    expected = {"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0", "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": PATH_VALUE, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "TMPDIR": "/tmp", "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING}  # noqa: S108 - frozen pre-root environment
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected and os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID and Path.cwd() == SEED, "root environment mismatch")


def root_only(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    validate_environment()
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V14 root already exists")
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN, LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    require((len(plan_bytes), sha(plan_bytes)) == (args.expected_plan_size, args.expected_plan_sha256), "ExecPlan identity mismatch")
    require((len(status_bytes), sha(status_bytes)) == (args.expected_status_size, args.expected_status_sha256), "STATUS identity mismatch")
    source = extract_once(plan_bytes, SOURCE_BEGIN, SOURCE_END)
    v13_driver, _ = read_regular(V13_DRIVER)
    derived = derive_driver(v13_driver)
    acceptance_value = json.loads(args.controller_acceptance_json)
    acceptance_payload = validate_acceptance(acceptance_value, args, source, derived)
    static = validate_derived_driver(derived)
    require(derive_driver(v13_driver) == derived, "driver derivation is not deterministic")
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    v13 = validate_v13_evidence()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V14 root appeared during preflight")
    root_argv_sha = sha(argv_json([str(PYTHON), "-c", source.decode("utf-8"), *sys.argv[1:]]))
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    driver_identity = write_exclusive(DRIVER, derived)
    acceptance_identity = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / ACCEPTANCE_NAME, acceptance_payload)
    source_receipt = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V14_SOURCE_WRITE", "preparation_source": {"sha256": args.expected_source_sha256, "size": args.expected_source_size}, "result": "PASS", "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha}))
    writer_test = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json", pretty({"deterministic_derivation": True, "format_version": 1, "no_replace_driver_write": True, "phase": "M3S_V14_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "result": "PASS"}))
    self_check = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json", pretty({"contracts": CONTRACT_HASHES, "format_version": 1, "phase": "M3S_V14_SELF_CHECK", "result": "PASS", "static": static, "v13_terminal_evidence": v13["terminal"]}))
    final_index = write_exclusive(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json", pretty({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "documents": {"plan_sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "status_sha256": args.expected_status_sha256}, "driver": driver_identity, "files": {"source-receipt.json": source_receipt, "writer-self-test.json": writer_test, "self-check-result.json": self_check}, "format_version": 1, "inventory": inventory, "phase": "M3S_V14_FINAL_INDEX", "reserved_results_absent": ["successor-preparation-v14-result.json", "auth-handoff-v14-result.json"], "root_prepare_argv_json_sha256": root_argv_sha, "verdict": "M3S_V14_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}))
    fsync_directory(RECEIPTS)
    require(set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}, "final root entries mismatch")
    require(set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS)) == {ACCEPTANCE_NAME, "source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"}, "final receipt set mismatch")
    os.write(1, compact({"controller_acceptance": acceptance_identity, "driver": driver_identity, "final_index": final_index, "phase": "M3S_V14_ROOT_ONLY", "result": "M3S_V14_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    return root_only(parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREPARATION_V14_END
```
