```python
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]
    )
    status, status_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]
    )
    require(branch == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(head == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = status.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    staged = sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"})
    modified = sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"})
    untracked = sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??"))
    require((staged, modified, untracked) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "inventory mismatch")
    candidates = sorted(
        path.name
        for path in BASE.iterdir()
        if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()
    )
    require(len(candidates) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate count mismatch")
    return {
        "branch": EXPECTED_BRANCH,
        "candidates": len(candidates),
        "head": EXPECTED_HEAD,
        "modified": modified,
        "staged": staged,
        "untracked": untracked,
        "stderr_contracts": {
            "branch": branch_stderr,
            "head": head_stderr,
            "status": status_stderr,
        },
    }


def validate_retained_roots() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for version, identities in (("v1", V1_IDENTITIES), ("v2", V2_IDENTITIES), ("v3", V3_IDENTITIES)):
        root = BASE / ("trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-" + version)
        private_directory(root, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
        private_directory(root / "home", set())
        private_directory(root / "tmp", set())
        private_directory(root / "receipts", {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"})
        result[version] = {
            name: identity(root / name, size, digest, 0o600)
            for name, (size, digest) in identities.items()
        }
    private_directory(V4_ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "receipts", set())
    for relative in V4_ABSENT:
        path = V4_ROOT / relative
        require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "V4 absent artifact appeared")
    result["v4"] = {
        "absent": list(V4_ABSENT),
        "failure": "ReferenceError: " + "Text" + "Encoder is not defined",
        "root_budget": "CONSUMED",
        "wrapper_or_subprocess_ran": False,
    }
    return result


def validate_protected() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = {
        "protected": identity(PROTECTED, PROTECTED_SIZE, PROTECTED_SHA, 0o600),
        "completed": identity(COMPLETED, COMPLETED_SIZE, COMPLETED_SHA),
        "m2_result": identity(M2_RESULT, M2_RESULT_SIZE, M2_RESULT_SHA, 0o600),
        "m2_index": identity(M2_INDEX, M2_INDEX_SIZE, M2_INDEX_SHA, 0o600),
    }
    result["blocked"] = {
        name: identity(BLOCKED / name, size, digest)
        for name, (size, digest) in BLOCKED_IDENTITIES.items()
    }
    return result


def validate_source_policy(source: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename="<m3s-v5-orchestration-v2>")
    imports: set[str] = set()
    popen_count = 0
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            continue
        name = ""
        owner = ""
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            name = node.func.id
        elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
            name = node.func.attr
            if isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name):
                owner = node.func.value.id
        require(name not in {"eval", "exec", "compile", "input"}, "forbidden dynamic call")
        require(not (owner == "os" and name in {"system", "popen"}), "forbidden os command call")
        require(
            not (owner == "subprocess" and name in {"run", "call", "check_call", "check_output"}),
            "forbidden subprocess helper",
        )
        if owner == "subprocess" and name == "Popen":
            popen_count += 1
            keywords = {item.arg: item.value for item in node.keywords}
            require(
                isinstance(keywords.get("shell"), ast.Constant)
                and keywords["shell"].value is False,
                "Popen shell policy mismatch",
            )
    require(not imports.intersection({"socket", "urllib", "http", "requests", "aiohttp"}), "network import forbidden")
    require(popen_count == 1, "unexpected Popen surface")
    forbidden = (
        b"Text" + b"Encoder",
        b"Java" + b"Script",
        b"$" + b"(",
        b"<" + b"<",
        b"sys." + b"stdin",
    )
    require(all(token not in source for token in forbidden), "prohibited orchestration token")
    require(b"/usr/bin/" + b"python3" not in source, "host python forbidden")
    require(b"python" + b" -" not in source, "python dash forbidden")
    return {
        "canonical_json": "json.dumps ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False separators comma-colon",
        "direct_argv_only": True,
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "negative_fixtures": {
            "command_substitution_absent": True,
            "heredoc_absent": True,
            "host_python_absent": True,
            "js_runtime_absent": True,
            "python_dash_absent": True,
            "shell_true_absent": True,
            "stdin_source_absent": True,
            "text_encoder_absent": True,
            "unfrozen_source_absent": True,
        },
        "popen_shell_false_count": popen_count,
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c", "orchestrator must use literal -c source")
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "orchestrator argv separator missing")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-wrapper-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-finalize-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(tokens[1:])


def construct_commands(args: argparse.Namespace, plan_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    writer = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    driver = extract_once(plan_bytes, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    orchestrator = extract_once(plan_bytes, ORCHESTRATOR_BEGIN, ORCHESTRATOR_END)
    require((len(writer), sha(writer)) == (args.expected_writer_size, args.expected_writer_sha256), "writer identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    require(
        (len(orchestrator), sha(orchestrator))
        == (args.expected_orchestrator_size, args.expected_orchestrator_sha256),
        "orchestrator identity mismatch",
    )
    source_policy = validate_source_policy(orchestrator)
    transport = [
        str(PYTHON),
        "-c",
        writer.decode("utf-8"),
        "--",
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--begin-marker",
        DRIVER_BEGIN[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--end-marker",
        DRIVER_END[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--destination",
        str(DRIVER),
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-driver-size",
        str(args.expected_driver_size),
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
    ]
    transport_json = canonical_argv(transport)
    require(sha(transport_json) == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256, "transport argv hash mismatch")
    self_check = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "self-check",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--wrapper",
        str(WRAPPER),
        "--expected-wrapper-sha",
        args.expected_wrapper_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
    ]
    self_check_json = canonical_argv(self_check)
    require(sha(self_check_json) == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256, "self-check argv hash mismatch")
    finalize = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "finalize",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
        "--writer-self-test",
        str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
        "--self-check-result",
        str(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json"),
    ]
    finalize_json = canonical_argv(finalize)
    require(sha(finalize_json) == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256, "finalize argv hash mismatch")
    require((len(transport), len(self_check), len(finalize)) == (26, 25, 23), "root argv count mismatch")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "finalize": finalize,
        "finalize_json": finalize_json,
        "orchestrator": orchestrator,
        "self_check": self_check,
        "self_check_json": self_check_json,
        "source_policy": source_policy,
        "transport": transport,
        "transport_json": transport_json,
        "writer": writer,
    }


def preflight(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    environment = preflight_environment()
    require(str(PYTHON) == "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12", "pinned Python path mismatch")
    resolved_python = PYTHON.resolve(strict=True)
    require(resolved_python.is_file() and not resolved_python.is_symlink(), "resolved pinned Python unsafe")
    python_identity = identity(resolved_python, None, PYTHON_SHA)
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V5 root already exists")
    require(ROOT.parent.is_dir() and not ROOT.parent.is_symlink(), "trusted-tools parent unsafe")
    plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_bytes = read_regular(STATUS)
    require(sha(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(sha(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")
    commands = construct_commands(args, plan_bytes)
    wrapper = identity(WRAPPER, WRAPPER_SIZE, args.expected_wrapper_sha256, 0o600)
    require(args.expected_wrapper_sha256 == WRAPPER_SHA, "wrapper authority mismatch")
    retained = validate_retained_roots()
    protected = validate_protected()
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V5 root appeared during preflight")
    return {
        "commands": commands,
        "documents": {
            "plan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": len(plan_bytes)},
            "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": len(status_bytes)},
        },
        "environment": environment,
        "inventory": inventory,
        "protected": protected,
        "retained": retained,
        "python": python_identity,
        "wrapper": wrapper,
    }


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def create_root() -> dict[str, Any]:
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    created = ["root"]
    try:
        for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
            os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
            fsync_directory(ROOT)
            created.append(name)
    finally:
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    return {
        "created": created,
        "home": private_directory(ROOT / "home", set()),
        "receipts": private_directory(ROOT / "receipts", set()),
        "root": private_directory(ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"}),
        "tmp": private_directory(ROOT / "tmp", set()),
    }


def receipt_result(path: Path, phase: str, argv_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = read_regular(path)
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "wrapper receipt is not object")
    require(
        value["phase"] == phase
        and value["returncode"] == 0
        and value["timed_out"] is False
        and value["output_truncated"] is False
        and value["session_id"] is None
        and value["credential_variables"] == []
        and value["wrapper_error"] is None,
        phase + " wrapper result mismatch",
    )
    require(sha(canonical_argv(value["argv"])) == argv_hash, phase + " receipt argv mismatch")
    st = lstat_regular(path, 0o600)
    return {
        "elapsed_seconds": value["elapsed_seconds"],
        "mode": "0600",
        "path": str(path),
        "phase": phase,
        "sha256": sha(payload),
        "size": len(payload),
        "stdout_summary": value["output"],
        "inode": st.st_ino,
    }


def invoke_root_phases(pre: dict[str, Any], args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    commands = pre["commands"]
    transport_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE",
            commands["transport_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(transport_outer, "transport outer")
    transport_summary = json.loads(transport_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        transport_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE"
        and transport_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and transport_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and transport_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and transport_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "transport outer summary mismatch",
    )
    driver = identity(DRIVER, args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256, 0o600)
    source_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK",
            commands["self_check_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(self_outer, "self-check outer")
    self_summary = json.loads(self_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        self_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK"
        and self_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and self_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and self_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and self_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "self-check outer summary mismatch",
    )
    self_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_output = json.loads(self_receipt["stdout_summary"])
    require(self_output["result"] == "PASS", "self-check did not PASS")
    writer_test_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json")
    writer_test = json.loads(writer_test_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        writer_test["phase"] == "M3S_V5_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
        and writer_test["error"] is None
        and writer_test["no_replace_existing_source_receipt"] is True,
        "writer self-test mismatch",
    )
    finalize_outer = capture(
        commands["finalize"],
        SEED,
        phase_environment("M3S_V5_FINALIZE", commands["finalize_json"], None),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(finalize_outer, "finalize outer")
    finalize_summary = json.loads(finalize_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        finalize_summary
        == {
            "phase": "M3S_V5_FINAL_INDEX",
            "result": "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        },
        "finalize summary mismatch",
    )
    final_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json")
    final_index = json.loads(final_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        final_index["phase"] == "M3S_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and final_index["verdict"] == "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"
        and final_index["transport_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["self_check_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["finalize_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
        "final index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "final root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS))
        == {"source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"},
        "final receipt set mismatch",
    )
    require(not (RECEIPTS / "successor-preparation-v5-result.json").exists(), "reserved result appeared")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "final_index": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'final-index.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json"),
            "sha256": sha(final_payload),
            "size": len(final_payload),
            "verdict": final_index["verdict"],
        },
        "finalize_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": finalize_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": self_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(self_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(self_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_receipt": self_receipt,
        "source_receipt": source_receipt,
        "transport_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": transport_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "writer_self_test": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'writer-self-test.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
            "sha256": sha(writer_test_payload),
            "size": len(writer_test_payload),
        },
    }


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    started_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.monotonic()
    root_created = False
    try:
        pre = preflight(args)
        root_state = create_root()
        root_created = True
        phases = invoke_root_phases(pre, args)
        output = {
            "argv_hashes": {
                "finalize": args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
                "self_check": args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
                "transport": args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
            },
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "orchestration": {
                "sha256": args.expected_orchestrator_sha256,
                "size": args.expected_orchestrator_size,
                "source_policy": pre["commands"]["source_policy"],
            },
            "phases": phases,
            "root": root_state,
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        }
        os.write(1, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 0
    except BaseException as exc:
        output = {
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "error": type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "root_created": root_created or ROOT.exists() or ROOT.is_symlink(),
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V5_ORCHESTRATION_V2_STOPPED",
        }
        os.write(2, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREROOT_ORCHESTRATOR_V5_2_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def canonical_argv(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(
        argv,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def lstat_regular(path: Path, expected_mode: int | None = None) -> os.stat_result:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"not regular: {path}")
    if expected_mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) == expected_mode, f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    return before


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 4_000_000) -> bytes:
    before = lstat_regular(path)
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, f"file too large: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            f"opened identity mismatch: {path}",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1_048_576)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"read identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        f"path identity changed: {path}",
    )
    return payload


def identity(path: Path, size: int | None, expected_sha: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = read_regular(path)
    if size is not None:
        require(len(payload) == size, f"size mismatch: {path}")
    require(sha(payload) == expected_sha, f"hash mismatch: {path}")
    st = path.lstat()
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) == mode, f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    return {
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": expected_sha,
        "size": len(payload),
    }


def private_directory(path: Path, entries: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    st = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"not directory: {path}")
    require(st.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) == 0o700, f"private directory mismatch: {path}")
    actual = set(os.listdir(path))
    if entries is not None:
        require(actual == entries, f"directory entries mismatch: {path}")
    return {
        "device": st.st_dev,
        "entries": sorted(actual),
        "inode": st.st_ino,
        "mode": "0700",
        "owner_uid": st.st_uid,
        "path": str(path),
    }


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]

def drain(pipe: Any, target: bytearray, state: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> None:
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = pipe.read(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            with state["lock"]:
                state[name + "_observed"] += len(chunk)
                state["aggregate_observed"] += len(chunk)
                channel_remaining = CHANNEL_LIMIT - len(target)
                aggregate_remaining = AGGREGATE_LIMIT - state["retained_total"]
                retained = max(0, min(len(chunk), channel_remaining, aggregate_remaining))
                if retained:
                    target.extend(chunk[:retained])
                    state["retained_total"] += retained
                if retained < len(chunk):
                    state[name + "_truncated"] = True
                if state["aggregate_observed"] > AGGREGATE_LIMIT:
                    state["aggregate_truncated"] = True
    except BaseException as exc:
        with state["lock"]:
            state["capture_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    finally:
        try:
            pipe.close()
        except BaseException as exc:
            with state["lock"]:
                state["capture_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))


def terminate_group(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes], errors: list[str]) -> None:
    try:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("TERM " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        return
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        pass
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("TERM wait " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    try:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("KILL " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))


def capture(argv: list[str], cwd: Path, env: dict[str, str], timeout: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "capture argv invalid")
    require(cwd.is_dir() and not cwd.is_symlink(), "capture cwd unsafe")
    stdout = bytearray()
    stderr = bytearray()
    state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "aggregate_observed": 0,
        "aggregate_truncated": False,
        "capture_errors": [],
        "lock": threading.Lock(),
        "retained_total": 0,
        "stderr_observed": 0,
        "stderr_truncated": False,
        "stdout_observed": 0,
        "stdout_truncated": False,
        "termination_errors": [],
    }
    started_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - argv and environment are fixed and validated
        argv,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=env,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True,
        shell=False,
    )
    require(process.stdout is not None and process.stderr is not None, "capture pipe unavailable")
    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=(process.stdout, stdout, state, "stdout"), daemon=True),
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=(process.stderr, stderr, state, "stderr"), daemon=True),
    ]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    timed_out = False
    try:
        returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        terminate_group(process, state["termination_errors"])
        try:
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=5)
        except BaseException as exc:
            state["termination_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
            returncode = None
    finally:
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join(timeout=5)
        if any(thread.is_alive() for thread in threads):
            state["capture_errors"].append("drain thread still alive")
            terminate_group(process, state["termination_errors"])
    finished_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return {
        "aggregate_limit": AGGREGATE_LIMIT,
        "aggregate_observed": state["aggregate_observed"],
        "aggregate_truncated": state["aggregate_truncated"],
        "argv": argv,
        "capture_errors": state["capture_errors"],
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "finished_at_utc": finished_at_utc,
        "returncode": returncode,
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
        "stderr": bytes(stderr),
        "stderr_limit": CHANNEL_LIMIT,
        "stderr_observed": state["stderr_observed"],
        "stderr_truncated": state["stderr_truncated"],
        "stdout": bytes(stdout),
        "stdout_limit": CHANNEL_LIMIT,
        "stdout_observed": state["stdout_observed"],
        "stdout_truncated": state["stdout_truncated"],
        "termination_errors": state["termination_errors"],
        "timed_out": timed_out,
    }


def require_capture_pass(result: dict[str, Any], label: str) -> None:
    require(result["returncode"] == 0, label + " return code")
    require(result["timed_out"] is False, label + " timeout")
    require(result["stdout_truncated"] is False, label + " stdout truncation")
    require(result["stderr_truncated"] is False, label + " stderr truncation")
    require(result["aggregate_truncated"] is False, label + " aggregate truncation")
    require(result["capture_errors"] == [], label + " capture error")
    require(result["termination_errors"] == [], label + " termination error")
    require(result["stderr"] == b"", label + " stderr nonempty")


def require_git_capture_pass(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    require(result["returncode"] == 0, "git preflight return code")
    require(result["timed_out"] is False, "git preflight timeout")
    require(result["stdout_truncated"] is False, "git preflight stdout truncation")
    require(result["stderr_truncated"] is False, "git preflight stderr truncation")
    require(result["aggregate_truncated"] is False, "git preflight aggregate truncation")
    require(result["capture_errors"] == [], "git preflight capture error")
    require(result["termination_errors"] == [], "git preflight termination error")
    stderr = result["stderr"]
    if stderr == b"":
        return "EMPTY"
    require(
        len(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SIZE and sha(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SHA,
        "git preflight stderr mismatch",
    )
    return "DARWIN_CONFSTR_WARNING"

            "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
        },
        30,
    )
    variant = require_git_capture_pass(result)
    return result["stdout"], variant


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    branch, branch_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "branch", "--show-current"]
    )
    head, head_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]
    )
    status, status_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]
    )
    require(branch == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(head == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = status.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    staged = sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"})
    modified = sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"})
    untracked = sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??"))
    require((staged, modified, untracked) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "inventory mismatch")
    candidates = sorted(
        path.name
        for path in BASE.iterdir()
        if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()
    )
    require(len(candidates) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate count mismatch")
    return {
        "branch": EXPECTED_BRANCH,
        "candidates": len(candidates),
        "head": EXPECTED_HEAD,
        "modified": modified,
        "staged": staged,
        "untracked": untracked,
        "stderr_contracts": {
            "branch": branch_stderr,
            "head": head_stderr,
            "status": status_stderr,
        },
    }


def validate_retained_roots() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for version, identities in (("v1", V1_IDENTITIES), ("v2", V2_IDENTITIES), ("v3", V3_IDENTITIES)):
        root = BASE / ("trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-" + version)
        private_directory(root, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
        private_directory(root / "home", set())
        private_directory(root / "tmp", set())
        private_directory(root / "receipts", {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"})
        result[version] = {
            name: identity(root / name, size, digest, 0o600)
            for name, (size, digest) in identities.items()
        }
    private_directory(V4_ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "receipts", set())
    for relative in V4_ABSENT:
        path = V4_ROOT / relative
        require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "V4 absent artifact appeared")
    result["v4"] = {
        "absent": list(V4_ABSENT),
        "failure": "ReferenceError: " + "Text" + "Encoder is not defined",
        "root_budget": "CONSUMED",
        "wrapper_or_subprocess_ran": False,
    }
    return result


def validate_protected() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = {
        "protected": identity(PROTECTED, PROTECTED_SIZE, PROTECTED_SHA, 0o600),
        "completed": identity(COMPLETED, COMPLETED_SIZE, COMPLETED_SHA),
        "m2_result": identity(M2_RESULT, M2_RESULT_SIZE, M2_RESULT_SHA, 0o600),
        "m2_index": identity(M2_INDEX, M2_INDEX_SIZE, M2_INDEX_SHA, 0o600),
    }
    result["blocked"] = {
        name: identity(BLOCKED / name, size, digest)
        for name, (size, digest) in BLOCKED_IDENTITIES.items()
    }
    return result


def inspect_call_policy(source: bytes, filename: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=filename)
    imports: set[str] = set()
    popen_count = 0
    violations: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            continue
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            direct_name = node.func.id
            if direct_name in {"eval", "exec", "compile", "input"}:
                violations.append("direct_builtin:" + direct_name)
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
            continue
        name = node.func.attr
        owner = node.func.value.id if isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name) else ""
        if owner == "os" and name in {"system", "popen"}:
            violations.append("os_command:" + name)
        if owner == "subprocess" and name in {"run", "call", "check_call", "check_output"}:
            violations.append("subprocess_helper:" + name)
        if owner == "subprocess" and name == "Popen":
            popen_count += 1
            keywords = {item.arg: item.value for item in node.keywords}
            shell_value = keywords.get("shell")
            if not (
                isinstance(shell_value, ast.Constant)
                and shell_value.value is False
            ):
                violations.append("subprocess_Popen:shell_not_false")
    return {
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "popen_count": popen_count,
        "violations": violations,
    }


def validate_source_policy(source: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy = inspect_call_policy(source, "<m3s-v5-orchestration-v3>")
    require(policy["violations"] == [], "forbidden dynamic or command call")
    require(
        not set(policy["imports"]).intersection(
            {"socket", "urllib", "http", "requests", "aiohttp"}
        ),
        "network import forbidden",
    )
    require(policy["popen_count"] == 1, "unexpected Popen surface")

    safe_qualified = inspect_call_policy(
        b"import re\npattern = re.compile(r'x')\n",
        "<qualified-re-compile-positive-fixture>",
    )
    require(
        safe_qualified["violations"] == []
        and safe_qualified["popen_count"] == 0,
        "qualified re.compile fixture rejected",
    )
    negative_fixtures = {
        "direct_eval": (
            b"eval('x')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:eval"],
        ),
        "direct_exec": (
            b"exec('x')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:exec"],
        ),
        "direct_compile": (
            b"compile('x', '<x>', 'exec')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:compile"],
        ),
        "direct_input": (
            b"input()\n",
            ["direct_builtin:input"],
        ),
        "os_system": (
            b"import os\nos.system('x')\n",
            ["os_command:system"],
        ),
        "os_popen": (
            b"import os\nos.popen('x')\n",
            ["os_command:popen"],
        ),
        "subprocess_run": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.run(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:run"],
        ),
        "subprocess_call": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.call(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:call"],
        ),
        "subprocess_check_call": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.check_call(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:check_call"],
        ),
        "subprocess_check_output": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.check_output(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:check_output"],
        ),
        "subprocess_popen_shell_true": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.Popen(['x'], shell=True)\n",
            ["subprocess_Popen:shell_not_false"],
        ),
    }
    negative_results: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for fixture_name, (fixture_source, expected) in negative_fixtures.items():
        observed = inspect_call_policy(
            fixture_source,
            "<negative-" + fixture_name + ">",
        )
        require(observed["violations"] == expected, fixture_name + " fixture mismatch")
        negative_results[fixture_name] = observed["violations"]

    forbidden = (
        b"Text" + b"Encoder",
        b"Java" + b"Script",
        b"$" + b"(",
        b"<" + b"<",
        b"sys." + b"stdin",
    )
    require(all(token not in source for token in forbidden), "prohibited orchestration token")
    require(b"/usr/bin/" + b"python3" not in source, "host python forbidden")
    require(b"python" + b" -" not in source, "python dash forbidden")
    return {
        "canonical_json": "json.dumps ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False separators comma-colon",
        "direct_argv_only": True,
        "imports": policy["imports"],
        "negative_fixtures": negative_results
        | {
            "command_substitution_absent": True,
            "heredoc_absent": True,
            "host_python_absent": True,
            "js_runtime_absent": True,
            "python_dash_absent": True,
            "shell_true_absent": True,
            "stdin_source_absent": True,
            "text_encoder_absent": True,
            "unfrozen_source_absent": True,
        },
        "popen_shell_false_count": policy["popen_count"],
        "qualified_re_compile_positive_fixture": "PASS",
        "self_policy_violations": policy["violations"],
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c", "orchestrator must use literal -c source")
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "orchestrator argv separator missing")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-wrapper-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-finalize-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(tokens[1:])


def construct_commands(args: argparse.Namespace, plan_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    writer = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    driver = extract_once(plan_bytes, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    orchestrator = extract_once(plan_bytes, ORCHESTRATOR_BEGIN, ORCHESTRATOR_END)
    require((len(writer), sha(writer)) == (args.expected_writer_size, args.expected_writer_sha256), "writer identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    require(
        (len(orchestrator), sha(orchestrator))
        == (args.expected_orchestrator_size, args.expected_orchestrator_sha256),
        "orchestrator identity mismatch",
    )
    source_policy = validate_source_policy(orchestrator)
    transport = [
        str(PYTHON),
        "-c",
        writer.decode("utf-8"),
        "--",
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--begin-marker",
        DRIVER_BEGIN[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--end-marker",
        DRIVER_END[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--destination",
        str(DRIVER),
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-driver-size",
        str(args.expected_driver_size),
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
    ]
    transport_json = canonical_argv(transport)
    require(sha(transport_json) == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256, "transport argv hash mismatch")
    self_check = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "self-check",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--wrapper",
        str(WRAPPER),
        "--expected-wrapper-sha",
        args.expected_wrapper_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
    ]
    self_check_json = canonical_argv(self_check)
    require(sha(self_check_json) == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256, "self-check argv hash mismatch")
    finalize = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "finalize",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
        "--writer-self-test",
        str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
        "--self-check-result",
        str(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json"),
    ]
    finalize_json = canonical_argv(finalize)
    require(sha(finalize_json) == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256, "finalize argv hash mismatch")
    require((len(transport), len(self_check), len(finalize)) == (26, 25, 23), "root argv count mismatch")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "finalize": finalize,
        "finalize_json": finalize_json,
        "orchestrator": orchestrator,
        "self_check": self_check,
        "self_check_json": self_check_json,
        "source_policy": source_policy,
        "transport": transport,
        "transport_json": transport_json,
        "writer": writer,
    }


def preflight(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    environment = preflight_environment()
    require(str(PYTHON) == "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12", "pinned Python path mismatch")
    resolved_python = PYTHON.resolve(strict=True)
    require(resolved_python.is_file() and not resolved_python.is_symlink(), "resolved pinned Python unsafe")
    python_identity = identity(resolved_python, None, PYTHON_SHA)
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V5 root already exists")
    require(ROOT.parent.is_dir() and not ROOT.parent.is_symlink(), "trusted-tools parent unsafe")
    plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_bytes = read_regular(STATUS)
    require(sha(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(sha(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")
    commands = construct_commands(args, plan_bytes)
    wrapper = identity(WRAPPER, WRAPPER_SIZE, args.expected_wrapper_sha256, 0o600)
    require(args.expected_wrapper_sha256 == WRAPPER_SHA, "wrapper authority mismatch")
    retained = validate_retained_roots()
    protected = validate_protected()
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V5 root appeared during preflight")
    return {
        "commands": commands,
        "documents": {
            "plan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": len(plan_bytes)},
            "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": len(status_bytes)},
        },
        "environment": environment,
        "inventory": inventory,
        "protected": protected,
        "retained": retained,
        "python": python_identity,
        "wrapper": wrapper,
    }


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def create_root() -> dict[str, Any]:
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    created = ["root"]
    try:
        for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
            os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
            fsync_directory(ROOT)
            created.append(name)
    finally:
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    return {
        "created": created,
        "home": private_directory(ROOT / "home", set()),
        "receipts": private_directory(ROOT / "receipts", set()),
        "root": private_directory(ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"}),
        "tmp": private_directory(ROOT / "tmp", set()),
    }


def receipt_result(path: Path, phase: str, argv_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = read_regular(path)
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "wrapper receipt is not object")
    require(
        value["phase"] == phase
        and value["returncode"] == 0
        and value["timed_out"] is False
        and value["output_truncated"] is False
        and value["session_id"] is None
        and value["credential_variables"] == []
        and value["wrapper_error"] is None,
        phase + " wrapper result mismatch",
    )
    require(sha(canonical_argv(value["argv"])) == argv_hash, phase + " receipt argv mismatch")
    st = lstat_regular(path, 0o600)
    return {
        "elapsed_seconds": value["elapsed_seconds"],
        "mode": "0600",
        "path": str(path),
        "phase": phase,
        "sha256": sha(payload),
        "size": len(payload),
        "stdout_summary": value["output"],
        "inode": st.st_ino,
    }


def invoke_root_phases(pre: dict[str, Any], args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    commands = pre["commands"]
    transport_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE",
            commands["transport_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(transport_outer, "transport outer")
    transport_summary = json.loads(transport_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        transport_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE"
        and transport_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and transport_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and transport_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and transport_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "transport outer summary mismatch",
    )
    driver = identity(DRIVER, args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256, 0o600)
    source_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK",
            commands["self_check_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(self_outer, "self-check outer")
    self_summary = json.loads(self_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        self_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK"
        and self_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and self_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and self_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and self_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "self-check outer summary mismatch",
    )
    self_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_output = json.loads(self_receipt["stdout_summary"])
    require(self_output["result"] == "PASS", "self-check did not PASS")
    writer_test_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json")
    writer_test = json.loads(writer_test_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        writer_test["phase"] == "M3S_V5_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
        and writer_test["error"] is None
        and writer_test["no_replace_existing_source_receipt"] is True,
        "writer self-test mismatch",
    )
    finalize_outer = capture(
        commands["finalize"],
        SEED,
        phase_environment("M3S_V5_FINALIZE", commands["finalize_json"], None),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(finalize_outer, "finalize outer")
    finalize_summary = json.loads(finalize_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        finalize_summary
        == {
            "phase": "M3S_V5_FINAL_INDEX",
            "result": "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        },
        "finalize summary mismatch",
    )
    final_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json")
    final_index = json.loads(final_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        final_index["phase"] == "M3S_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and final_index["verdict"] == "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"
        and final_index["transport_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["self_check_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["finalize_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
        "final index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "final root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS))
        == {"source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"},
        "final receipt set mismatch",
    )
    require(not (RECEIPTS / "successor-preparation-v5-result.json").exists(), "reserved result appeared")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "final_index": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'final-index.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json"),
            "sha256": sha(final_payload),
            "size": len(final_payload),
            "verdict": final_index["verdict"],
        },
        "finalize_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": finalize_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": self_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(self_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(self_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_receipt": self_receipt,
        "source_receipt": source_receipt,
        "transport_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": transport_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "writer_self_test": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'writer-self-test.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
            "sha256": sha(writer_test_payload),
            "size": len(writer_test_payload),
        },
    }


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    started_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.monotonic()
    root_created = False
    try:
        pre = preflight(args)
        root_state = create_root()
        root_created = True
        phases = invoke_root_phases(pre, args)
        output = {
            "argv_hashes": {
                "finalize": args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
                "self_check": args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
                "transport": args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
            },
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "orchestration": {
                "sha256": args.expected_orchestrator_sha256,
                "size": args.expected_orchestrator_size,
                "source_policy": pre["commands"]["source_policy"],
            },
            "phases": phases,
            "root": root_state,
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        }
        os.write(1, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 0
    except BaseException as exc:
        output = {
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "error": type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "root_created": root_created or ROOT.exists() or ROOT.is_symlink(),
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V5_ORCHESTRATION_V3_STOPPED",
        }
        os.write(2, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_PREROOT_ORCHESTRATOR_V5_3_END
```

V3 keeps the same ordered 32-string outer schema and canonical JSON algorithm
as v2, with `ORCHESTRATOR`, `OSIZE`, and `OSHA` bound to this v3 range.
The nested transport/self-check/finalize arrays remain the exact 26/25/23
schemas frozen above. All four arrays are constructed and hash-checked in the
same live pinned-Python process before `mkdir`, retained in memory, and never

```python
    tokens = [b"/usr/bin/env", b"-i", *ENVIRONMENT_TOKENS, *outer_bytes]

        if index != SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX:
            require(b"\n" not in token, "LF outside source token")

    command = render_tokens(tokens)
    require(command.startswith(PREFIX) and command.endswith(SUFFIX), "envelope boundary mismatch")
    require(b"\r" not in command and b"\x00" not in command, "envelope forbidden control")
    require(command.count(b"\n") == SOURCE_LF_COUNT, "envelope LF count mismatch")
    return command


def parse_envelope(command: bytes) -> list[bytes]:
    require(isinstance(command, bytes), "command must be bytes")
    require(command.startswith(PREFIX), "missing literal exec prefix")
    require(command.endswith(SUFFIX), "missing fixed stdin redirection")
    require(command.count(SUFFIX) == 1, "stdin redirection count mismatch")
    require(b"\r" not in command and b"\x00" not in command, "forbidden command control")
    body_end = len(command) - len(SUFFIX)
    index = len(PREFIX)
    tokens: list[bytes] = []
    while index < body_end:
        require(command[index:index + 1] == b"'", "token must start single-quoted")
        index += 1
        value = bytearray()
        while True:
            require(index < body_end, "unterminated single quote")
            byte = command[index]

                    value.append(39)
                    index += len(QUOTE_ESCAPE)
                    continue
                index += 1
                break
            if byte == 10:
                require(len(tokens) == SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX, "LF outside source token")
            elif byte < 32 or byte == 127:
                raise RuntimeError("forbidden control byte")
            value.append(byte)
            index += 1
        tokens.append(bytes(value))
        if index == body_end:
            break
        require(command[index:index + 1] == b" ", "token separator mismatch")
        index += 1
        require(index < body_end, "missing token after separator")
    require(index == body_end, "unexpected shell syntax")
    return tokens

    tokens = parse_envelope(command)

    require(render_tokens(tokens) == command, "noncanonical quote encoding")
    require(len(tokens) == TOKEN_COUNT, "parsed token count mismatch")
    return {

        "source_sha256": sha(tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX]),
        "source_single_quote_count": tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX].count(b"'"),
        "token_count": len(tokens),
    }

        "base64_decoder": b"exec '/usr/bin/base64' '-D' </dev/null",
        "alternate_shell": b"exec '/bin/bash' '-c' 'true' </dev/null",
        "altered_source_byte": render_tokens(altered_tokens),
    }


def validate_fixture_matrix(outer_argv: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    good = build_envelope(outer_argv)
    require(parse_envelope(good) == expected_token_vector(outer_argv), "positive parse mismatch")
    require(render_tokens(parse_envelope(good)) == good, "positive round-trip mismatch")
    results: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, command in negative_fixture_commands(good, outer_argv).items():
        try:

        except RuntimeError:

        else:

def validate_source_security(source: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename="<m3s-v5-envelope-v1>")
    imports: set[str] = set()
    forbidden_calls: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            if node.func.id in {"eval", "exec", "compile", "input"}:
                forbidden_calls.append(node.func.id)
    require(not imports.intersection({"subprocess", "socket", "urllib", "http", "requests"}), "unsafe import")
    require(forbidden_calls == [], "forbidden dynamic call")
    return {
        "forbidden_calls": forbidden_calls,
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def validate_contract(
    plan_bytes: bytes,
    plan_sha256: str,
    status_sha256: str,
    transport_argv_json_sha256: str,
    self_check_argv_json_sha256: str,
    finalize_argv_json_sha256: str,

        plan_bytes,
        plan_sha256,
        status_sha256,
        transport_argv_json_sha256,
        self_check_argv_json_sha256,
        finalize_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    envelope = build_envelope(outer_argv)
    validation = validate_envelope(envelope, outer_argv)
    fixtures = validate_fixture_matrix(outer_argv)
    return {
        "cwd": str(SEED),

        "fixtures": fixtures,
        "outer_argv_json_sha256": sha(outer_json),
        "outer_argv_json_size": len(outer_json),
        "outer_argv_count": len(outer_argv),
        "shell": "/bin/zsh",
        "shell_login": False,
        "stdin": "/dev/null",
    }
```

```python
def read_regular(path: Path) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), f"not a regular file: {path}")
    require(not path.is_symlink(), f"symlink forbidden: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
            f"identity changed while opening: {path}",
        )
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while reading: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    data = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(data) == final.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while reading: {path}",
    )
    return data, final


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1, "begin marker count is not one")
    require(payload.count(end) == 1, "end marker count is not one")
    begin_at = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    end_at = payload.index(end)
    require(begin_at <= end_at, "source markers are out of order")
    return payload[begin_at:end_at]


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False)
    result.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--begin-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--end-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--destination", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    return result


def main() -> int:
    expected_names = [
        "--plan",
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        "--status",
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        "--begin-marker",
        "--end-marker",
        "--destination",
        "--expected-writer-size",
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        "--expected-driver-size",
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
    ]
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "missing argv separator")
    options = tokens[1:]
    require(len(options) == len(expected_names) * 2, "unexpected argv length")
    require(options[::2] == expected_names, "unexpected argv option order")
    args = parser().parse_args(options)

    plan = Path(args.plan)
    status_path = Path(args.status)
    destination = Path(args.destination)
    require(destination == BOOTSTRAP_ROOT / "candidate-driver.py", "destination mismatch")
    require(destination.parent == BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, "destination parent mismatch")
    root_stat = BOOTSTRAP_ROOT.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(root_stat.st_mode), "bootstrap root is not a directory")
    require(not BOOTSTRAP_ROOT.is_symlink(), "bootstrap root is a symlink")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(root_stat.st_mode) == 0o700, "bootstrap root mode mismatch")
    require(root_stat.st_uid == os.getuid(), "bootstrap root owner mismatch")

    plan_bytes, plan_stat = read_regular(plan)
    status_bytes, status_stat = read_regular(status_path)
    require(digest(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(digest(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")

    writer_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    require(len(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_size, "writer size mismatch")
    require(digest(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_sha256, "writer hash mismatch")
    actual_argv = [
        "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12",
        "-c",
        writer_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
        "--",
        *options,
    ]
    require(
        os.environ.get("BOUND_ARGV_JSON")
        == json.dumps(
            actual_argv,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            allow_nan=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ),
        "transport BOUND_ARGV_JSON mismatch",
    )
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_PHASE") == "M3S_V6_SOURCE_WRITE", "transport phase mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_TIMEOUT") == "60", "transport timeout mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("CANDIDATE_REPO") == str(SEED), "transport seed mismatch")
    require(
        os.environ.get("RESULT_PATH")
        == str(BOOTSTRAP_ROOT / "receipts/source-receipt.json"),
        "transport receipt mismatch",
    )

    begin = args.begin_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    end = args.end_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    driver_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, begin, end)
    require(len(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_size, "driver size mismatch")
    require(digest(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "driver hash mismatch")

    fd = os.open(
        destination,
        os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
        0o600,
    )
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        view = memoryview(driver_bytes)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            require(written == len(view), "short write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

    written_bytes, verified = read_regular(destination)
    require(
        (verified.st_dev, verified.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
        "destination identity changed",
    )
    require(stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode) == 0o600, "destination mode mismatch")
    require(written_bytes == driver_bytes, "destination bytes mismatch")
    require(digest(written_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "destination hash mismatch")
    directory_fd = os.open(BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        directory_opened = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino)
            == (root_stat.st_dev, root_stat.st_ino),
            "bootstrap root identity changed while opening",
        )
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
        directory_final = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_final.st_dev, directory_final.st_ino)
            == (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino),
            "bootstrap root identity changed while fsyncing",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)

    summary = {
        "destination": {
            "device": verified.st_dev,
            "inode": verified.st_ino,
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(destination),
            "sha256": digest(written_bytes),
            "size": len(written_bytes),
            "type": "regular",
        },
        "directory_fsync": True,
        "driver_marker_counts": [plan_bytes.count(begin), plan_bytes.count(end)],
        "extracted_bytes": len(driver_bytes),
        "file_fsync": True,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V6_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "plan": {
            "device": plan_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": plan_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(plan),
            "sha256": digest(plan_bytes),
            "size": len(plan_bytes),
        },
        "status": {
            "device": status_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": status_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(status_path),
            "sha256": digest(status_bytes),
            "size": len(status_bytes),
        },
        "writer_marker_counts": [
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_BEGIN),
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_END),
        ],
        "written_bytes": len(written_bytes),
    }
    os.write(1, compact(summary) + b"\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_WRITER_V6_END
```
