def pre_finalize_validator_contract_self_test() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, _ = read_regular(DRIVER)
    tree = ast.parse(payload, filename=str(DRIVER))
    self_check_node = next(
        node
        for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "self_check"
    )
    discovered: set[str] = set()
    for node in ast.walk(self_check_node):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            continue
        name: str | None = None
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            name = node.func.id
        elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
            name = node.func.attr
        if name is not None and (
            name.startswith("validate_") or name.endswith("_self_test")
        ):
            discovered.add(name)
    require(
        discovered == set(SELF_CHECK_PREFINALIZE_VALIDATORS),
        "self-check pre-finalize validator traversal mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "discovered": sorted(discovered),
        "expected": sorted(SELF_CHECK_PREFINALIZE_VALIDATORS),
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def validate_v5_m2b() -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected = {
        "source-receipt.json": (12666, "dc205075bd8d2390d5f31ad2ae036031843968bca416d958720b1c657c0b6ae9"),
        "writer-self-test.json": (19244, "c9ff289716121d30fdd6f0e47b9a4a471d43fecb84096615fded7bd219f46f4e"),
        "self-check-result.json": (2066, "3fd414adb993e06b3f9ef5beb2415af688852eff45a72f690e16044f56bf713a"),
        "final-index.json": (V5_FINAL_INDEX_SIZE, V5_FINAL_INDEX_SHA),
        "candidate12-recovery-v5-execution-result.json": (
            V5_EXECUTION_RESULT_SIZE,
            V5_EXECUTION_RESULT_SHA,
        ),
    }
    root = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V5_M2B)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "V5 M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(V5_M2B / "home"), "V5 M2B home changed")
    require(not os.listdir(V5_M2B / "tmp"), "V5 M2B tmp changed")
    require(set(os.listdir(V5_M2B / "receipts")) == set(expected), "V5 M2B receipt set mismatch")
    files = {
        name: require_identity(V5_M2B / "receipts" / name, expected_sha, 0o600, size)
        for name, (size, expected_sha) in expected.items()
    }
    driver = require_identity(V5_M2B_DRIVER, V5_DRIVER_SHA, 0o600, V5_DRIVER_SIZE)
    index, _ = load_json(V5_M2B / "receipts/final-index.json")
    require(
        index["phase"] == "M2B_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and index["verdict"] == "M2B_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "V5 M2B final index verdict mismatch",
    )
    execution, _ = load_json(V5_EXECUTION_RESULT)
    require(execution["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5", "V5 execution phase mismatch")
    require(execution["returncode"] == 1, "V5 execution return code mismatch")
    require(execution["elapsed_seconds"] == 209.426602, "V5 execution elapsed mismatch")
    require(
        execution["timed_out"] is False
        and execution["output_truncated"] is False
        and execution["session_id"] is None
        and execution["credential_variables"] == []
        and execution["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "V5 execution wrapper boundary mismatch",
    )
    require(
        len(execution["argv"]) == 29
        and sha(argv_json(execution["argv"])) == V5_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA,
        "V5 execution argv identity mismatch",
    )
    output = json.loads(execution["output"])
    require(output["candidate"] == str(V5_CANDIDATE), "V5 execution candidate mismatch")
    require(output["error"] == "RuntimeError: conflicting process detected", "V5 execution error mismatch")
    require(output["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5", "V5 output phase mismatch")
    result = output["result"]
    require(
        result["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and result["sealing_complete"] is True
        and result["sealing_errors"] == [],
        "V5 execution sealing mismatch",
    )
    require(
        result["path_count"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_COUNT
        and result["regular_file_bytes"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_BYTES
        and result["sha256"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_SHA,
        "V5 completed attempt identity mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "files": files,
        "home": home,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "result": "IMMUTABLE_M2_STOPPED",
        "root": root,
        "tmp": tmp,
    }


def validate_v5_candidate() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = private_directory_identity(V5_CANDIDATE)
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts")) == set(HISTORICAL_STOPPED_CANDIDATE_RECEIPTS),
        "V5 candidate receipt set mismatch",
    )
    index_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-receipt-index.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SIZE,
    )
    stop_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/m2-stop-receipt.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_STOP_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_STOP_SIZE,
    )
    preservation_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/preservation-receipt.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_SIZE,
    )
    index, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("final-receipt-index.json")
    require_exact_keys(index["repository"], V5_SUMMARY_KEYS, "V5 repository summary")
    require_exact_keys(index["attempt_pre_index"], V5_SUMMARY_KEYS, "V5 pre-index summary")
    require_exact_keys(
        index["doctor_termination_evidence"],
        V5_DOCTOR_TERMINATION_KEYS,
        "V5 doctor termination evidence",
    )
    require(
        set(index["files"]) == set(HISTORICAL_STOPPED_CANDIDATE_RECEIPTS) - {"final-receipt-index.json"},
        "V5 indexed receipt set mismatch",
    )
    for name, identity in index["files"].items():
        require_exact_keys(identity, V5_FILE_IDENTITY_KEYS, f"V5 file identity {name}")
    require(
        index["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and index["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and index["sealing_errors_before_index"] == [],
        "V5 candidate final index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["repository"]
        == {
            "path_count": 27404,
            "regular_file_bytes": 573790192,
            "sha256": "8c8f1968ae67c045822c056e57ba4b2c00bd31088b728b8721e60de9912e7d83",
        },
        "V5 candidate repository identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["attempt_pre_index"]
        == {
            "path_count": 27443,
            "regular_file_bytes": 581532035,
            "sha256": "04272b56019ed3605f22b89328b13611f258e41eb5596768236d2603e8dd2f38",
        },
        "V5 candidate pre-index identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["status"] == "TERMINATED"
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["returncode"] == 0
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["termination_proven"] is True
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["safe_to_seal"] is True,
        "V5 doctor termination evidence mismatch",
    )
    for name, identity in index["files"].items():
        require_identity(
            V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts" / name,
            identity["sha256"],
            0o600,
            identity["size"],
        )
    stop, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("m2-stop-receipt.json")
    require(
        stop["phase"] == "M2_STOP"
        and stop["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and stop["error"] == "RuntimeError: conflicting process detected",
        "V5 stop receipt mismatch",
    )
    preservation, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("preservation-receipt.json")
    require(
        preservation["phase"] == "M2_PRESERVATION"
        and preservation["result"] == "FROZEN_PREALLOCATION_EVIDENCE",
        "V5 preservation fallback mismatch",
    )
    preflight, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("preflight-receipt.json")
    require(
        preflight["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_PREFLIGHT"
        and preflight["result"] == "PASS"
        and preflight["execute_argv_json_sha256"] == V5_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA,
        "V5 preflight receipt mismatch",
    )
    dry_run, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("candidate-dry-run-validation.json")
    require(
        dry_run["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_V5_VALIDATION"
        and dry_run["verdict"] == "PASS"
        and dry_run["normalized_size"] == 1390
        and dry_run["normalized_sha256"] == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA,
        "V5 candidate dry-run evidence mismatch",
    )
    setup, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("setup-result.json")
    require(
        setup["phase"] == "M2_SETUP"
        and setup["returncode"] == 0
        and setup["timed_out"] is False
        and setup["stdout_truncated"] is False
        and setup["stderr_truncated"] is False
        and setup["aggregate_truncated"] is False
        and setup["capture_errors"] == []
        and setup["session_id"] is None
        and setup["credential_variables"] == []
        and setup["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "V5 setup result mismatch",
    )
    post_setup, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("post-setup-receipt.json")
    readiness, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("readiness-result.json")
    require(
        post_setup["phase"] == "M2_POST_SETUP"
        and post_setup["result"] == "PASS"
        and readiness["phase"] == "M2_READINESS"
        and readiness["result"] == "PASS"
        and readiness["issues"] == [],
        "V5 post-setup/readiness mismatch",
    )
    staging, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("doctor-profile-staging.json")
    validation, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("doctor-validation.json")
    require(
        staging["phase"] == "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_STAGING"
        and staging["result"] == "PASS"
        and staging["config_staged"] is False
        and staging["credential_content_read"] is False
        and staging["unrelated_operator_codex_content_read"] is False,
        "V5 profile staging mismatch",
    )
    require(
        validation["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION"
        and validation["result"] == "PASS"
        and validation["returncode"] == 0
        and validation["failures"] == [],
        "V5 doctor validation mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "final_index": index_identity,
        "preservation": preservation_identity,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "root": root,
        "stop": stop_identity,
        "verdict": "M2_STOPPED",
    }



def validate_processes() -> None:
    result_path = M2B / "receipts" / EXECUTION_RESULT_NAME
    require(not result_path.exists(), "reserved successor result already exists")
    require(not result_path.is_symlink(), "reserved successor result is a symlink")


def read_only_gates(
    values: dict[str, str],
    home: Path,
    tmp: Path,
    *,
    include_process_gate: bool,
    current_candidate: Path | None = None,
    expected_current_identity: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(values["base"]) == BASE, "base path mismatch")
    require(Path(values["seed"]) == SEED, "seed path mismatch")
    base_info = BASE.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(base_info.st_mode) and not BASE.is_symlink(), "unsafe candidate base")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(base_info.st_mode) == 0o700, "candidate base mode mismatch")
    require(shutil.disk_usage(BASE).free >= 5 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, "insufficient disk")
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in os.environ), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in os.environ, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    if include_process_gate:
        validate_processes()
    return {
        "active_monitoring_policy": ACTIVE_MONITORING_POLICY,
        "documents": validate_documents(values["plan"], values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["status"], values["expected_status_sha256"]),
        "original": validate_original(values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["expected_status_sha256"]),
        "protected": validate_protected(),
        "predecessors": validate_predecessors(
            current_candidate,
            expected_current_identity,
        ),
        "identity_shape_contract": identity_shape_contract_self_test(),
        "m3s_v1_stopped": validate_m3s_v1_stopped(),
        "m3s_v2_stopped": validate_m3s_v2_stopped(),
        "m3s_v3_stopped": validate_m3s_v3_stopped(),
        "old_m2b": validate_old_m2b(),
        "v2_m2b": validate_v2_m2b(),
        "v3_m2b": validate_v3_m2b(),
        "v4_m2b": validate_v4_m2b(),
        "v5_m2b": validate_v5_m2b(),
        "v5_candidate": validate_v5_candidate(),
        "v6_m2b": validate_v6_m2b(),
        "v7_m2b": validate_v7_m2b(),
        "v7_candidate": validate_v7_candidate(),
        "v8_and_m2": validate_v8_and_m2_evidence(),
        "profiles": validate_profiles(),
        "process_gate": "PASS" if include_process_gate else "NOT_REPEATED_POST_DOCTOR",
        "python": validate_python(),
        "uv": validate_uv(home, tmp),
        "seed": validate_seed(),
    }

def validate_wrapper_result(
    path: Path,
    expected_phase: str,
    expected_argv_sha: str,
    expected_cwd: Path,
    expected_timeout: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    payload, identity = load_json(path)
    require(identity["mode"] == "0600", "wrapper result mode mismatch")
    require(payload["format_version"] == 1 and payload["phase"] == expected_phase, "wrapper result phase mismatch")
    require(payload["cwd"] == str(expected_cwd), "wrapper result CWD mismatch")
    require(payload["timeout_seconds"] == expected_timeout, "wrapper timeout mismatch")
    require(payload["output_limit_bytes"] == 1048576, "wrapper output limit mismatch")
    require(payload["returncode"] == 0, "wrapper result nonzero")
    require(payload["timed_out"] is False, "wrapper result timed out")
    require(payload["output_truncated"] is False, "wrapper result truncated")
    require(payload["session_id"] is None, "wrapper result session present")
    require(payload["credential_variables"] == [], "wrapper result credentials present")
    require(payload["wrapper_error"] is None, "wrapper result error present")
    require(sha(argv_json(payload["argv"])) == expected_argv_sha, "wrapper argv JSON hash mismatch")
    return payload, identity


def self_check(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    started_at_utc = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    driver_identity = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])
    active_phase_check = validate_active_phase_names()
    identity_shape_contract = identity_shape_contract_self_test()
    m3s_v1_stopped = validate_m3s_v1_stopped()
    m3s_v2_stopped = validate_m3s_v2_stopped()
    m3s_v3_stopped = validate_m3s_v3_stopped()
    m3s_v4_stopped = validate_m3s_v4_stopped()
    m3s_v5_stopped = validate_m3s_v5_stopped()
    historical_receipt_contract = historical_receipt_contract_self_test()
    pre_finalize_validator_contract = pre_finalize_validator_contract_self_test()
    current_argv = [str(PYTHON), str(DRIVER), *sys.argv[1:]]
    environment = validate_phase_environment(
        "M3S_V6_SELF_CHECK",
        60,
        current_argv,
        M2B / "receipts/self-check-result.json",
    )
    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("self-check", values["expected_self_sha"])
    documents = validate_documents(values["plan"], values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["status"], values["expected_status_sha256"])
    wrapper_identity = validate_wrapper(values["wrapper"], values["expected_wrapper_sha"])
    process_identity = require_identity(SEED / "tools/loop_engineering/process.py", PROCESS_SHA, 0o644)
    toolchain_identity = require_identity(SEED / "tools/loop_engineering/toolchain.py", TOOLCHAIN_SHA, 0o644)
    source_receipt = Path(values["source_receipt"])
    require(source_receipt == M2B / "receipts/source-receipt.json", "source receipt path mismatch")
    receipt, receipt_identity = validate_wrapper_result(
        source_receipt,
        "M3S_V6_SOURCE_WRITE",
        values["expected_transport_argv_json_sha256"],
        SEED,
        60,
    )
    transport = receipt["argv"]
    expected_names = [
        "--plan", "--expected-plan-sha256", "--status", "--expected-status-sha256",
        "--begin-marker", "--end-marker", "--destination", "--expected-writer-size",
        "--expected-writer-sha256", "--expected-driver-size", "--expected-driver-sha256",
    ]
    require(transport[:4] == [str(PYTHON), "-c", transport[2], "--"], "transport prefix mismatch")
    require(len(transport) == 4 + len(expected_names) * 2, "transport argv length mismatch")
    require(transport[4::2] == expected_names, "transport option order mismatch")
    transport_values = dict(zip((name[2:] for name in expected_names), transport[5::2], strict=True))
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    writer_source = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    driver_source = extract_once(plan_bytes, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    require(transport[2].encode("utf-8") == writer_source, "executed writer bytes mismatch")
    require(len(writer_source) == int(values["expected_writer_size"]), "writer size argument mismatch")
    require(sha(writer_source) == values["expected_writer_sha256"], "writer hash argument mismatch")
    require(transport_values["plan"] == str(PLAN), "transport plan mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-plan-sha256"] == values["expected_plan_sha256"], "transport plan hash mismatch")
    require(transport_values["status"] == str(STATUS), "transport status mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-status-sha256"] == values["expected_status_sha256"], "transport status hash mismatch")
    require(transport_values["begin-marker"] == DRIVER_BEGIN[:-1].decode("ascii"), "transport begin marker mismatch")
    require(transport_values["end-marker"] == DRIVER_END[:-1].decode("ascii"), "transport end marker mismatch")
    require(transport_values["destination"] == str(DRIVER), "transport destination mismatch")
    require(int(transport_values["expected-writer-size"]) == len(writer_source), "transport writer size mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-writer-sha256"] == sha(writer_source), "transport writer hash mismatch")
    require(int(transport_values["expected-driver-size"]) == len(driver_source), "transport driver size mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-driver-sha256"] == sha(driver_source), "transport driver hash mismatch")
    require(driver_identity["sha256"] == sha(driver_source), "installed driver differs from plan")
    writer_summary = json.loads(receipt["output"])
    require(writer_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V6_SOURCE_WRITE", "writer summary phase mismatch")
    require(writer_summary["file_fsync"] is True and writer_summary["directory_fsync"] is True, "writer durability mismatch")
    fsync_existing(source_receipt)
    fsync_directory(source_receipt.parent)
    test_path = M2B / "receipts/writer-self-test.json"
    try:
        probe_fd = os.open(source_receipt, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    except FileExistsError:
        no_replace = True
    else:
        os.close(probe_fd)
        raise RuntimeError("O_EXCL failed to reject existing source receipt")
    fixture = {"a": [1, "\u4e2d"], "z": False}
    fixture_bytes = compact(fixture)
    require(json.loads(fixture_bytes.decode("utf-8")) == fixture, "canonical JSON fixture mismatch")
    capture_test = bounded(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(SEED), "diff", "--binary", "HEAD"],
        SEED,
        child_environment(M2B / "home", M2B / "tmp"),
        60,
        1048576,
    )
    require_success(capture_test, "split capture self-test")
    require_channel(
        capture_test,
        "stdout",
        GIT_PATCH_STDOUT_SIZE,
        GIT_PATCH_STDOUT_SHA,
    )
    require_git_stderr_contract(capture_test)
    capture_test_summary = {
        key: value
        for key, value in capture_test.items()
        if key not in {"stdout", "stderr", "stdout_diagnostic", "stderr_diagnostic"}
    }
    old_m2b = validate_old_m2b()
    v2_m2b = validate_v2_m2b()
    v3_m2b = validate_v3_m2b()
    v4_m2b = validate_v4_m2b()
    v5_m2b = validate_v5_m2b()
    v5_candidate = validate_v5_candidate()
    v6_m2b = validate_v6_m2b()
    v7_m2b = validate_v7_m2b()
    v7_candidate = validate_v7_candidate()
    v8_and_m2 = validate_v8_and_m2_evidence()
    candidate_set_contract = candidate_set_contract_self_test()
    successor_contract = successor_contract_self_test()
    predecessors = validate_predecessors()
    report = {
        "documents": documents,
        "active_phase_check": active_phase_check,
        "identity_shape_contract": identity_shape_contract,
        "m3s_v1_stopped": m3s_v1_stopped,
        "m3s_v2_stopped": m3s_v2_stopped,
        "m3s_v3_stopped": m3s_v3_stopped,
        "m3s_v4_stopped": m3s_v4_stopped,
        "m3s_v5_stopped": m3s_v5_stopped,
        "historical_receipt_contract": historical_receipt_contract,
        "pre_finalize_validator_contract": pre_finalize_validator_contract,
        "driver": driver_identity,
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "environment": environment,
        "error": None,
        "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "fixture": {"bytes": len(fixture_bytes), "sha256": sha(fixture_bytes)},
        "format_version": 1,
        "no_replace_existing_source_receipt": no_replace,
        "old_m2b": old_m2b,
        "v2_m2b": v2_m2b,
        "v3_m2b": v3_m2b,
        "v4_m2b": v4_m2b,
        "v5_m2b": v5_m2b,
        "v5_candidate": v5_candidate,
        "v6_m2b": v6_m2b,
        "v7_m2b": v7_m2b,
        "v7_candidate": v7_candidate,
        "v8_and_m2": v8_and_m2,
        "candidate_set_contract": candidate_set_contract,
        "successor_contract": successor_contract,
        "predecessors": predecessors,
        "phase": "M3S_V6_WRITER_SELF_TEST",
        "process_api": process_identity,
        "root_state": m2b_state,
        "split_capture_test": capture_test_summary,
        "source_receipt": receipt_identity,
        "toolchain_api": toolchain_identity,
        "transport_writer": {"sha256": sha(writer_source), "size": len(writer_source)},
        "wrapper": wrapper_identity,
        "self_check_argv_json_sha256": sha(argv_json(current_argv)),
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
    }
    write_exclusive(test_path, pretty(report))
    os.write(1, compact({"phase": report["phase"], "result": "PASS"}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def finalize(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    self_id = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])
    validate_active_phase_names()
    identity_shape_contract = identity_shape_contract_self_test()
    m3s_v1_stopped = validate_m3s_v1_stopped()
    m3s_v2_stopped = validate_m3s_v2_stopped()
    m3s_v3_stopped = validate_m3s_v3_stopped()
    m3s_v4_stopped = validate_m3s_v4_stopped()
    m3s_v5_stopped = validate_m3s_v5_stopped()
    current_argv = [str(PYTHON), str(DRIVER), *sys.argv[1:]]
    environment = validate_phase_environment("M3S_V6_FINALIZE", 60, current_argv, None)
    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("finalize", values["expected_self_sha"])
    documents = validate_documents(values["plan"], values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["status"], values["expected_status_sha256"])
    source = Path(values["source_receipt"])
    writer_test = Path(values["writer_self_test"])
    self_result = Path(values["self_check_result"])
    require(source == M2B / "receipts/source-receipt.json", "source receipt path mismatch")
    require(writer_test == M2B / "receipts/writer-self-test.json", "writer self-test path mismatch")
    require(self_result == M2B / "receipts/self-check-result.json", "self-check result path mismatch")
    source_payload, source_id = validate_wrapper_result(
        source,
        "M3S_V6_SOURCE_WRITE",
        values["expected_transport_argv_json_sha256"],
        SEED,
        60,
    )
    writer_payload, writer_id = load_json(writer_test)
    require(writer_payload["phase"] == "M3S_V6_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "writer self-test phase mismatch")
    require(writer_payload["error"] is None and writer_payload["no_replace_existing_source_receipt"] is True, "writer self-test failed")
    self_payload, self_result_id = validate_wrapper_result(
        self_result,
        "M3S_V6_SELF_CHECK",
        values["expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256"],
        SEED,
        60,
    )
    require(json.loads(self_payload["output"])["result"] == "PASS", "self-check output mismatch")
    for path in (source, writer_test, self_result):
        fsync_existing(path)
    fsync_directory(source.parent)
    transport_writer = source_payload["argv"][2].encode("utf-8")
    index = {
        "documents": documents,
        "identity_shape_contract": identity_shape_contract,
        "m3s_v1_stopped": m3s_v1_stopped,
        "m3s_v2_stopped": m3s_v2_stopped,
        "m3s_v3_stopped": m3s_v3_stopped,
        "m3s_v4_stopped": m3s_v4_stopped,
        "m3s_v5_stopped": m3s_v5_stopped,
        "driver": self_id,
        "environment": environment,
        "files": {
            "source-receipt.json": source_id,
            "writer-self-test.json": writer_id,
            "self-check-result.json": self_result_id,
        },
        "finalize_argv_json_sha256": sha(argv_json(current_argv)),
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V6_FINAL_INDEX",
        "paths": {
            "candidate-driver.py": self_id,
            "home": directory_identity(M2B / "home"),
            "receipts": directory_identity(M2B / "receipts"),
            "tmp": directory_identity(M2B / "tmp"),
        },
        "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "root_state": m2b_state,
        "reserved_candidate_execution_result": str(M2B / "receipts" / EXECUTION_RESULT_NAME),
        "source_result_phase": source_payload["phase"],
        "transport_argv_json_sha256": values["expected_transport_argv_json_sha256"],
        "transport_writer": {"sha256": sha(transport_writer), "size": len(transport_writer)},
        "self_check_argv_json_sha256": values["expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256"],
        "verdict": "M3S_V6_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
    }
    path = M2B / "receipts/final-index.json"
    write_exclusive(path, pretty(index))
    validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])
    os.write(1, compact({"phase": index["phase"], "result": index["verdict"]}) + b"\n")
    return 0


def candidate_dry_run(
    repo: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    receipts: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    _, seed_normalized, seed_evidence = frozen_seed_dry_run()
    python_dir = repo / ".python"
    quoted = shlex.quote(str(python_dir))
    argv = [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "--no-print-directory",
        "-n",
        "UV=../../trusted-tools/uv-0.12.17/extracted/uv-aarch64-apple-darwin/uv",
        "UV_CACHE_DIR_LOCAL=.cache/uv",
        f"UV_ENV=UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR={quoted}",
        "setup",
    ]
    result, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes = bounded_bytes(
        argv,
        repo,
        env,
        60,
        65536,
    )
    stdout_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "candidate-dry-run-stdout.bin",
        stdout_bytes,
    )
    stderr_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "candidate-dry-run-stderr.bin",
        stderr_bytes,
    )
    capture_record = {
        "capture": result,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_V6_CAPTURE",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stderr_base64": base64.b64encode(stderr_bytes).decode("ascii"),
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "raw_stdout_base64": base64.b64encode(stdout_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    }
    capture_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "candidate-dry-run-capture.json",
        pretty(capture_record),
    )
    candidate_path = os.fsencode(str(repo))
    seed_path = os.fsencode(str(SEED))
    validation: dict[str, Any] = {
        "candidate_path": str(repo),
        "candidate_path_occurrences": stdout_bytes.count(candidate_path),
        "capture": capture_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "line_feeds": stdout_bytes.count(b"\n"),
        "normalization_token": NORMALIZATION_TOKEN.decode("ascii"),
        "normalization_token_occurrences_before": stdout_bytes.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN),
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_V6_VALIDATION",
        "raw_stderr_sha256": sha(stderr_bytes),
        "raw_stderr_size": len(stderr_bytes),
        "raw_stdout_sha256": sha(stdout_bytes),
        "raw_stdout_size": len(stdout_bytes),
        "seed": seed_evidence,
        "seed_path_occurrences": stdout_bytes.count(seed_path),
        "verdict": "STOPPED",
    }
    try:
        require_success(result, "candidate make dry-run")
        stderr_contract = require_make_stderr_contract(result)
        validation["stderr_contract"] = stderr_contract
        require(stdout_bytes.count(b"\n") == 9, "candidate dry-run line count mismatch")
        require(candidate_path != seed_path, "candidate path equals seed path")
        require(
            stdout_bytes.count(candidate_path) == 8,
            "candidate path occurrence mismatch",
        )
        require(stdout_bytes.count(seed_path) == 0, "seed path present in candidate output")
        require(
            stdout_bytes.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 0,
            "candidate output contains normalization token",
        )
        normalized = stdout_bytes.replace(candidate_path, NORMALIZATION_TOKEN)
        require(
            normalized.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 8,
            "candidate normalized token count mismatch",
        )
        require(
            len(normalized) == 1390
            and sha(normalized) == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA
            and normalized == seed_normalized,
            "candidate canonical dry-run mismatch",
        )
        reconstructed = seed_normalized.replace(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN, candidate_path)
        require(
            reconstructed == stdout_bytes,
            "candidate raw dry-run reconstruction mismatch",
        )
        validation.update(
            {
                "normalized_sha256": sha(normalized),
                "normalized_size": len(normalized),
                "reconstructed_raw_sha256": sha(reconstructed),
                "reconstructed_raw_size": len(reconstructed),
                "verdict": "PASS",
            }
        )
        validation_identity = write_exclusive(
            receipts / "candidate-dry-run-validation.json",
            pretty(validation),
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        validation["error"] = (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048]
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "candidate-dry-run-validation.json",
            pretty(validation),
        )
        raise
    result["evidence"] = {
        "capture": capture_identity,
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "validation": validation_identity,
    }
    result["normalized_bytes"] = validation["normalized_size"]
    result["normalized_sha256"] = validation["normalized_sha256"]
    result["reconstructed_raw_sha256"] = validation["reconstructed_raw_sha256"]
    result["reconstructed_raw_size"] = validation["reconstructed_raw_size"]
    return result

def unsafe_links(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    unsafe: list[str] = []
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_symlink():
            continue
        try:
            resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
        except OSError:
            unsafe.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix() + ":broken")
            continue
        if not resolved.is_relative_to(root):
            unsafe.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix() + ":external")
    return unsafe


def pre_setup_validate(repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    manifest, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    require(sha(manifest) == MANIFEST_SHA and counts["records"] == 2322, "candidate manifest mismatch")
    validate_data_input(repo)
    require(status_counts(repo) == {"staged": 0, "modified_tracked": 15, "ordinary_untracked": 71}, "candidate status mismatch")
    require(git_bytes(["remote"], repo) == b"", "candidate remote present")
    ignored = git_paths_ignored(repo)
    require(not ignored, "ignored paths present before setup")
    for relative in (".python", ".venv", "apps/web/node_modules", ".cache/tiktoken", ".cache/playwright", ".loop"):
        require(not (repo / relative).exists(), f"pre-setup root exists: {relative}")
    require(not unsafe_links(repo), "unsafe pre-setup links")
    return {"counts": counts, "manifest_sha256": sha(manifest)}


def git_paths_ignored(root: Path) -> list[bytes]:
    payload = git_bytes(["-c", "core.quotePath=false", "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard"], root, 4 * 1024 * 1024)
    return [] if not payload else payload[:-1].split(b"\0")


def materialize(parent: Path, receipts: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
    materialization_started = time.monotonic()
    repo = parent / "repo"
    source_manifest, patch, included, source_patch_capture = validate_source(SEED)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "source-tracked.patch", patch)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "included-untracked.zlist", included)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "source-manifest.jsonl", source_manifest)
    commands: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    old_umask = os.umask(0o022)
    try:
        specs = [
            (["/usr/bin/git", "clone", "--quiet", "--no-local", "--no-hardlinks", str(SEED), str(repo)], BASE, None),
            (["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), "remote", "remove", "origin"], BASE, None),
            (["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), "apply", "--binary", "--whitespace=nowarn", "-"], BASE, patch),
            (["/usr/bin/rsync", "--archive", "--from0", f"--files-from={receipts / 'included-untracked.zlist'}", str(SEED) + "/", str(repo) + "/"], BASE, None),
        ]
        for argv, cwd, input_bytes in specs:
            remaining = 300 - int(time.monotonic() - materialization_started)
            require(remaining > 0, "materialization exceeded 300 seconds")
            result = bounded(argv, cwd, child_environment(parent / "home", parent / "tmp"), remaining, 1048576, input_bytes=input_bytes)
            commands.append(result)
            require_success(result, "materialization")
            if argv[0] == "/usr/bin/git":
                require_empty_channel(result, "stdout")
                require_git_stderr_contract(result)
            else:
                require_empty_channel(result, "stdout")
                require_empty_channel(result, "stderr")
    finally:
        os.umask(old_umask)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "materialization-results.jsonl", b"".join(compact(item) + b"\n" for item in commands))
    candidate_manifest, _ = canonical_manifest(repo)
    require(candidate_manifest == source_manifest, "source/candidate manifest bytes differ")
    write_exclusive(receipts / "candidate-manifest.jsonl", candidate_manifest)
    pre_setup = pre_setup_validate(repo)
    pre_setup["candidate_dry_run"] = candidate_dry_run(
        repo,
        child_environment(parent / "home", parent / "tmp"),
        receipts,
    )
    pre_setup["source_patch_capture"] = source_patch_capture
    pre_setup["source_candidate_byte_identical"] = True
    write_exclusive(receipts / "pre-setup-receipt.json", pretty({"format_version": 1, "phase": "M2_PRE_SETUP", "result": "PASS", **pre_setup}))
    require(time.monotonic() - materialization_started <= 300, "materialization exceeded 300 seconds")
    return repo, candidate_manifest



def stage_doctor_profiles(
    repo: Path,
    parent: Path,
    receipts: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_root = repo / "config/loop-engineering/profiles"
    private_home = parent / "home"
    codex_home = private_home / ".codex"
    require(
        private_home.is_dir()
        and not private_home.is_symlink()
        and stat.S_IMODE(private_home.lstat().st_mode) == 0o700,
        "unsafe candidate-private HOME",
    )
    require(not codex_home.exists() and not codex_home.is_symlink(), "candidate-private Codex home already exists")
    operator_profiles = validate_profiles()
    source_records: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
        source_identity = require_identity(source_root / name, expected_sha, 0o644, expected_size)
        require(
            operator_profiles[name]["sha256"] == expected_sha
            and operator_profiles[name]["size"] == expected_size,
            f"operator profile identity mismatch: {name}",
        )
        source_records[name] = {
            "operator_profile": operator_profiles[name],
            "reviewed_template": source_identity,
        }
    command = {
        "config_staged": False,
        "credential_content_read": False,
        "destination": str(codex_home),
        "files": source_records,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_COMMAND",
        "unrelated_operator_codex_content_read": False,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-command.json", pretty(command))
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "config_staged": False,
        "credential_content_read": False,
        "destination": str(codex_home),
        "files": {},
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_STAGING",
        "result": "FAIL",
        "unrelated_operator_codex_content_read": False,
    }
    try:
        codex_home.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
        fsync_directory(private_home)
        codex_info = codex_home.lstat()
        require(
            stat.S_ISDIR(codex_info.st_mode)
            and not codex_home.is_symlink()
            and codex_info.st_uid == os.getuid()
            and stat.S_IMODE(codex_info.st_mode) == 0o700,
            "unsafe staged Codex home",
        )
        for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
            payload, source_identity = read_regular(source_root / name)
            require(
                source_identity["mode"] == "0644"
                and source_identity["size"] == expected_size
                and source_identity["sha256"] == expected_sha,
                f"reviewed profile changed before copy: {name}",
            )
            destination_identity = write_exclusive(codex_home / name, payload)
            require(
                destination_identity["mode"] == "0600"
                and destination_identity["size"] == expected_size
                and destination_identity["sha256"] == expected_sha,
                f"staged profile identity mismatch: {name}",
            )
            result["files"][name] = {"destination": destination_identity, "source": source_identity}
        fsync_directory(codex_home)
        require(set(os.listdir(codex_home)) == set(PROFILES), "unexpected candidate-private Codex-home entry")
        for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
            require_identity(codex_home / name, expected_sha, 0o600, expected_size)
        result["directory"] = private_directory_identity(codex_home)
        result["result"] = "PASS"
    except BaseException as exc:
        result["error"] = bounded_error(exc)
        write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-staging.json", pretty(result))
        raise
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-staging.json", pretty(result))
    return result


def doctor_capture_total(
    argv: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int,
    stdout_limit: int,
    stderr_limit: int,
    aggregate_limit: int,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    heartbeat: bool = False,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes]:
    started_at_utc = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    buffers = {"stdout": bytearray(), "stderr": bytearray()}
    digests = {"stdout": hashlib.sha256(), "stderr": hashlib.sha256()}
    totals = {"stdout": 0, "stderr": 0}
    truncated = {"stdout": False, "stderr": False, "aggregate": False}
    lock = threading.Lock()
    stopped = threading.Event()
    process: Any | None = None
    threads: list[threading.Thread] = []
    heartbeat_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
    lifecycle_history = ["not-started"]
    lifecycle_state = "not-started"
    returncode: int | None = None
    timed_out = False
    termination_attempted = False
    termination_signals: list[str] = []
    spawn_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    stdin_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    wait_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    drain_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    heartbeat_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    termination_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    unexpected_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    def record_error(
        bucket: list[dict[str, str]],
        stage: str,
        exc: BaseException,
    ) -> None:
        bucket.append(
            {
                "error": (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048],
                "stage": stage,
            }
        )

    def emit_heartbeat() -> None:
        try:
            while not stopped.wait(240):
                os.write(
                    1,
                    compact({"phase": "M2_PROGRESS", "utc": utc_now()}) + b"\n",
                )
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(heartbeat_errors, "heartbeat", exc)

    def drain(name: str, pipe: Any, limit: int) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                chunk = pipe.read(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digests[name].update(chunk)
                with lock:
                    previous = totals[name]
                    aggregate_previous = totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"]
                    totals[name] += len(chunk)
                    allowed = min(
                        len(chunk),
                        max(0, limit - previous),
                        max(0, aggregate_limit - aggregate_previous),
                    )
                    if allowed:
                        buffers[name].extend(chunk[:allowed])
                    if totals[name] > limit:
                        truncated[name] = True
                    if totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"] > aggregate_limit:
                        truncated["aggregate"] = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(drain_errors, "drain-" + name, exc)
        finally:
            try:
                pipe.close()
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(drain_errors, "close-" + name, exc)

    def terminate_started(reason: str) -> None:
        nonlocal lifecycle_state, returncode, termination_attempted
        if process is None:
            return
        try:
            observed = process.poll()
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-initial-poll", exc)
            observed = None
            lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
        if observed is not None:
            returncode = observed
            lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            return
        termination_attempted = True
        for label, signal_value, wait_seconds in (
            ("TERM", signal.SIGTERM, 2),
            ("KILL", signal.SIGKILL, 5),
        ):
            termination_signals.append(label)
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal_value)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-" + label, exc)
            try:
                observed = process.wait(timeout=wait_seconds)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                continue
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(wait_errors, reason + "-wait-" + label, exc)
                continue
            returncode = observed
            lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            return
        try:
            observed = process.poll()
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-final-poll", exc)
            lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
        else:
            if observed is None:
                lifecycle_state = "still-live"
            else:
                returncode = observed
                lifecycle_state = "terminated"
        if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
            lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)

    try:
        try:
            process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 -- fixed doctor argv only
                argv,
                cwd=cwd,
                env=env,
                stdin=(
                    subprocess.PIPE
                    if input_bytes is not None
                    else subprocess.DEVNULL
                ),
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                start_new_session=True,
                shell=False,
            )
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(spawn_errors, "spawn", exc)
        else:
            lifecycle_state = "started"
            lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            if process.stdout is None or process.stderr is None:
                record_error(
                    drain_errors,
                    "capture-pipes",
                    RuntimeError("capture pipes missing"),
                )
            else:
                for name, pipe, limit in (
                    ("stdout", process.stdout, stdout_limit),
                    ("stderr", process.stderr, stderr_limit),
                ):
                    thread = threading.Thread(
                        target=drain,
                        args=(name, pipe, limit),
                        name="m3s-v1-doctor-" + name,
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    threads.append(thread)
                    try:
                        thread.start()
                    except BaseException as exc:
                        record_error(drain_errors, "start-drain-" + name, exc)
            if heartbeat:
                heartbeat_thread = threading.Thread(
                    target=emit_heartbeat,
                    name="m3s-v1-doctor-heartbeat",
                    daemon=True,
                )
                try:
                    heartbeat_thread.start()
                except BaseException as exc:
                    record_error(heartbeat_errors, "start-heartbeat", exc)
            if input_bytes is not None:
                if process.stdin is None:
                    record_error(
                        stdin_errors,
                        "stdin-pipe",
                        RuntimeError("stdin pipe missing"),
                    )
                else:
                    try:
                        view = memoryview(input_bytes)
                        while view:
                            written = process.stdin.write(view)
                            if written is None or written <= 0:
                                raise RuntimeError("short child stdin write")
                            view = view[written:]
                        process.stdin.flush()
                    except BaseException as exc:
                        record_error(stdin_errors, "stdin-write", exc)
                    finally:
                        try:
                            process.stdin.close()
                        except BaseException as exc:
                            record_error(stdin_errors, "stdin-close", exc)
            try:
                returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed_out = True
                terminate_started("timeout")
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(wait_errors, "wait", exc)
                terminate_started("wait-error")
            else:
                lifecycle_state = "terminated"
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
    except BaseException as exc:
        record_error(unexpected_errors, "capture", exc)
    finally:
        if process is not None and lifecycle_state != "terminated":
            terminate_started("finally")
        for thread in threads:
            try:
                thread.join(timeout=5)
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(drain_errors, "join-drain", exc)
            if thread.is_alive():
                record_error(
                    drain_errors,
                    "join-drain",
                    RuntimeError("capture thread failed to stop"),
                )
        stopped.set()
        if heartbeat_thread is not None:
            try:
                heartbeat_thread.join(timeout=2)
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(heartbeat_errors, "join-heartbeat", exc)
            if heartbeat_thread.is_alive():
                record_error(
                    heartbeat_errors,
                    "join-heartbeat",
                    RuntimeError("heartbeat thread failed to stop"),
                )
        if process is not None and returncode is None:
            try:
                observed = process.poll()
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(termination_errors, "receipt-poll", exc)
                lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
            else:
                if observed is None:
                    lifecycle_state = "still-live"
                else:
                    returncode = observed
                    lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)

    stdout_bytes = bytes(buffers["stdout"])
    stderr_bytes = bytes(buffers["stderr"])
    capture_errors = (
        spawn_errors
        + stdin_errors
        + wait_errors
        + drain_errors
        + heartbeat_errors
        + unexpected_errors
    )
    credential_names = sorted(name for name in env if SECRET_NAME.search(name))
    capture_complete = (
        lifecycle_state == "terminated"
        and returncode is not None
        and not timed_out
        and not any(truncated.values())
        and capture_errors == []
        and termination_errors == []
    )
    result = {
        "aggregate_limit_bytes": aggregate_limit,
        "aggregate_truncated": truncated["aggregate"],
        "argv": argv,
        "capture_complete": capture_complete,
        "capture_errors": capture_errors,
        "child_started": process is not None,
        "credential_environment_variables": credential_names,
        "cwd": str(cwd),
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "environment_names": sorted(env),
        "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "format_version": 3,
        "heartbeat_errors": heartbeat_errors,
        "lifecycle_history": lifecycle_history,
        "lifecycle_state": lifecycle_state,
        "returncode": returncode,
        "session_observation": "not-collected",
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
        "stderr": stderr_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr_captured_sha256": sha(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_captured_size": len(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_limit_bytes": stderr_limit,
        "stderr_sha256": digests["stderr"].hexdigest(),
        "stderr_size": totals["stderr"],
        "stderr_truncated": truncated["stderr"],
        "stdin": "FIXED_BYTES" if input_bytes is not None else "DEVNULL",
        "stdin_errors": stdin_errors,
        "stdout": stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stdout_captured_sha256": sha(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_captured_size": len(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_limit_bytes": stdout_limit,
        "stdout_sha256": digests["stdout"].hexdigest(),
        "stdout_size": totals["stdout"],
        "stdout_truncated": truncated["stdout"],
        "termination": {
            "attempted": termination_attempted,
            "errors": termination_errors,
            "signals": termination_signals,
        },
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "wait_errors": wait_errors,
    }
    return result, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes


def capture_and_validate_doctor(
    repo: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    receipts: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    argv = ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-doctor"]
    command = {
        "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
        "argv": argv,
        "cwd": str(repo),
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_COMMAND",
        "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "timeout_seconds": 300,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-command.json", pretty(command))
    capture_started_at_utc = utc_now()
    capture_started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        capture, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes = doctor_capture_total(
            argv,
            repo,
            env,
            300,
            65536,
            65536,
            131072,
            heartbeat=True,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        stdout_bytes = b""
        stderr_bytes = b""
        escape_error = {
            "error": bounded_error(exc),
            "stage": "doctor-capture-total-escape",
        }
        capture = {
            "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
            "aggregate_truncated": False,
            "argv": argv,
            "capture_complete": False,
            "capture_errors": [escape_error],
            "capture_function_escaped": True,
            "child_started": None,
            "credential_environment_variables": sorted(
                name for name in env if SECRET_NAME.search(name)
            ),
            "cwd": str(repo),
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - capture_started, 6),
            "environment_names": sorted(env),
            "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
            "format_version": 3,
            "heartbeat_errors": [],
            "lifecycle_history": ["not-started", "indeterminate"],
            "lifecycle_state": "indeterminate",
            "returncode": None,
            "session_observation": "not-collected",
            "started_at_utc": capture_started_at_utc,
            "stderr": "",
            "stderr_captured_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stderr_captured_size": 0,
            "stderr_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(b""),
            "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stderr_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stderr_size": 0,
            "stderr_truncated": False,
            "stdin": "DEVNULL",
            "stdin_errors": [],
            "stdout": "",
            "stdout_captured_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stdout_captured_size": 0,
            "stdout_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(b""),
            "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stdout_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stdout_size": 0,
            "stdout_truncated": False,
            "termination": {
                "attempted": False,
                "errors": [
                    {
                        "error": "capture function escaped; child state unavailable",
                        "stage": "doctor-capture-total-escape",
                    }
                ],
                "signals": [],
            },
            "timed_out": False,
            "timeout_seconds": 300,
            "wait_errors": [],
        }
    capture.update({"phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE"})
    stdout_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-stdout.bin", stdout_bytes)
    stderr_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-stderr.bin", stderr_bytes)
    environment_record = dict(sorted(env.items()))
    capture_receipt = {
        "capture": capture,
        "environment": {
            "names": sorted(env),
            "non_secret_values": environment_record,
            "sha256": sha(compact(environment_record)),
        },
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
    }
    capture_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "doctor-capture.json",
        pretty(capture_receipt),
    )
    failures: list[str] = []
    if capture["returncode"] is None:
        failures.append("returncode_unavailable")
    elif capture["returncode"] != 0:
        failures.append("returncode")
    if capture["lifecycle_state"] != "terminated":
        failures.append("child_" + capture["lifecycle_state"])
    if capture["timed_out"]:
        failures.append("timeout")
    if (
        capture["stdout_truncated"]
        or capture["stderr_truncated"]
        or capture["aggregate_truncated"]
    ):
        failures.append("truncation")
    if capture["capture_errors"]:
        failures.append("capture_error")
    if capture["termination"]["errors"]:
        failures.append("termination_error")
    if not capture["capture_complete"]:
        failures.append("capture_incomplete")
    if capture["credential_environment_variables"]:
        failures.append("credential_environment_variable")
    stderr_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    try:
        stderr_contract = require_make_stderr_contract(capture)
    except BaseException as exc:
        failures.append("stderr:" + bounded_error(exc))
    expected_stdout = (
        f"READY root={repo} codex=/opt/homebrew/bin/codex commands=4\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    if stdout_bytes != expected_stdout:
        failures.append("stdout")
    if (
        capture["stdout_size"] != len(expected_stdout)
        or capture["stdout_sha256"] != sha(expected_stdout)
    ):
        failures.append("stdout_identity")
    try:
        require_no_prompt_or_secret(capture, "loop-doctor")
    except BaseException as exc:
        failures.append("prompt_or_secret:" + bounded_error(exc))
    validation = {
        "capture_complete": capture["capture_complete"],
        "capture_errors": capture["capture_errors"],
        "capture_receipt": capture_identity,
        "child_started": capture["child_started"],
        "expected_stdout": {
            "sha256": sha(expected_stdout),
            "size": len(expected_stdout),
        },
        "failures": failures,
        "format_version": 1,
        "lifecycle_history": capture["lifecycle_history"],
        "lifecycle_state": capture["lifecycle_state"],
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "result": "PASS" if not failures else "FAIL",
        "returncode": capture["returncode"],
        "session_observation": capture["session_observation"],
        "stderr_contract": stderr_contract,
        "termination": capture["termination"],
        "timed_out": capture["timed_out"],
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-validation.json", pretty(validation))
    require(not failures, "loop-doctor validation failed: " + ",".join(failures))
    return validation


def validate_v8_and_m2_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    identities = {
        "v8_final_index": require_identity(
            V8_M2B / "receipts/final-index.json",
            V8_FINAL_INDEX_SHA,
            0o600,
            8138,
        ),
        "v8_result": require_identity(
            V8_EXECUTION_RESULT,
            V8_EXECUTION_RESULT_SHA,
            0o600,
            18103,
        ),
        "m2_index": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-receipt-index.json",
            M2_FINAL_INDEX_SHA,
            0o600,
            12784,
        ),
        "m2_repository": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-repository-manifest.jsonl",
            M2_REPOSITORY_SHA,
            0o600,
        ),
        "m2_attempt": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-attempt-manifest.jsonl",
            M2_ATTEMPT_SHA,
            0o600,
        ),
        "blocked_state": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "state.json",
            BLOCKED_STATE_SHA,
            0o644,
            17815,
        ),
        "blocked_events": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "events.jsonl",
            BLOCKED_EVENTS_SHA,
            0o644,
            2278,
        ),
        "planner": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "artifacts/planner/001.json",
            BLOCKED_PLANNER_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
        "coder": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "artifacts/coder/001.json",
            BLOCKED_CODER_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
        "coder_events": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "agents/coder/001-events.jsonl",
            BLOCKED_CODER_EVENTS_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
    }
    state, _ = load_json(BLOCKED_RUN / "state.json")
    require(
        state["run_id"] == BLOCKED_RUN_ID
        and state["state"] == "blocked"
        and state["coder_session_id"] == BLOCKED_CODER_SESSION
        and state["cycle"] == 1
        and state["code_cycle"] == 0,
        "blocked run state mismatch",
    )
    require(
        len(state["artifacts"].get("planner", [])) == 1
        and len(state["artifacts"].get("coder", [])) == 1,
        "blocked artifacts mismatch",
    )
    pyc_identities: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for relative, size, expected_sha in (
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/__init__.cpython-312.pyc",
            5943,
            "e48232d881acb62c67e8af6365d4145bfdcc8958c0dc46658846fb8c9c3a6b64",
        ),
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/aliases.cpython-312.pyc",
            12576,
            "21dac7a7fd74ec2b979b0bba348cf4b96f8be7fc87e412ae571b48851e1f0d92",
        ),
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/utf_8.cpython-312.pyc",
            2315,
            "0739ac120c090d359232d37253404998c4ca5cc8db89e3bbc7b8f4b24dfc0e97",
        ),
    ):
        pyc_identities[relative] = require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "repo" / relative,
            expected_sha,
            0o644,
            size,
        )
    identities["successor_requirement"] = require_identity(
        SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT,
        SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        0o644,
        8771,
    )
    identities["schema_seed"] = require_identity(
        SCHEMA_SEED,
        SCHEMA_SEED_SHA,
        0o644,
        6328,
    )
    identities["loop_config"] = require_identity(
        ORIGINAL / "loop-engineering.yaml",
        LOOP_CONFIG_SHA,
        0o644,
    )
    current_manifest, totals = tree_manifest(M2_CANDIDATE)
    require(
        totals == {"path_count": 27593, "regular_file_bytes": 590971877}
        and sha(current_manifest)
        == "db21b412395986a770e02f510201a861774fe116ffee42268154b7c6145142f1",
        "retained M2 candidate drift",
    )
    return {
        "identities": identities,
        "m2_current_tree": {**totals, "sha256": sha(current_manifest)},
        "retained_ignored_cache_path_count": 132,
        "retained_pyc": pyc_identities,
        "schema_seed_authority": False,
    }


def write_candidate_file(
    path: Path,
    payload: bytes,
    *,
    replace: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(
        path.parent.is_dir() and not path.parent.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe candidate file parent",
    )
    destination = path
    if replace:
        before = path.lstat()
        require(
            stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
            "overlay target unsafe",
        )
        destination = path.with_name("." + path.name + ".m3s-v1-overlay")
    require(
        not destination.exists() and not destination.is_symlink(),
        "candidate file collision",
    )
    fd = os.open(
        destination,
        os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
        0o644,
    )
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero candidate file write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        require(os.fstat(fd).st_size == len(payload), "candidate file short write")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if replace:
        os.replace(destination, path)
    fsync_directory(path.parent)
    return require_identity(path, sha(payload), 0o644, len(payload))


def manifest_rows(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for raw in payload.splitlines():
        value = json.loads(raw)
        require(
            isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("path"), str),
            "manifest row invalid",
        )
        require(value["path"] not in rows, "duplicate manifest path")
        rows[value["path"]] = value
    return rows


def validate_successor_source(
    repo: Path,
    *,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
    context_expected: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reference_bytes, _ = read_regular(
        BASE
        / "candidate.OlsWg1/receipts/candidate-pre-setup-manifest.jsonl"
    )
    require(sha(reference_bytes) == MANIFEST_SHA, "B2 reference manifest mismatch")
    payload, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    rows = manifest_rows(payload)
    reference = manifest_rows(reference_bytes)
    requirement_path = (
        "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
    )
    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()
    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}
    if context_expected:
        expected_paths.add(context_path)
    require(set(rows) == expected_paths, "successor repository path set mismatch")
    for path, value in reference.items():
        if path not in {
            "STATUS.md",
            "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
        }:
            require(rows[path] == value, "non-overlay B2 record changed: " + path)
    expected_overlay = {
        "STATUS.md": ("tracked", status_sha),
        "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md": (
            "ordinary-untracked",
            plan_sha,
        ),
        requirement_path: (
            "ordinary-untracked",
            SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        ),
    }
    for path, (path_class, expected_sha) in expected_overlay.items():
        row = rows[path]
        require(
            row["class"] == path_class
            and row["type"] == "regular"
            and row["mode"] == "0644"
            and row["sha256"] == expected_sha,
            "successor overlay identity mismatch: " + path,
        )
    if context_expected:
        row = rows[context_path]
        require(
            row["class"] == "ordinary-untracked"
            and row["type"] == "regular"
            and row["mode"] == "0600",
            "trusted-context record identity mismatch",
        )
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 73,
            "records": 2324,
        }
    else:
        require(context_path not in rows, "trusted-context exists before init")
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 72,
            "records": 2323,
        }
    require(counts == expected_counts, "successor manifest counts mismatch")
    current_status = status_counts(repo)
    require(
        current_status
        == {
            "staged": 0,
            "modified_tracked": 15,
            "ordinary_untracked": expected_counts["ordinary_untracked"],
        },
        "successor Git status mismatch",
    )
    require(git_bytes(["remote"], repo) == b"", "successor remote exists")
    return {
        "counts": counts,
        "manifest_sha256": sha(payload),
        "status": current_status,
    }


def overlay_successor_documents(
    repo: Path,
    receipts: Path,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    context = repo / TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL
    requirement_target = (
        repo / "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
    )
    require(
        not context.exists() and not context.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context path not reserved",
    )
    require(
        not context.parent.exists() and not context.parent.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context parent path not reserved",
    )
    require(
        not requirement_target.exists() and not requirement_target.is_symlink(),
        "v2 requirement collision",
    )
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    requirement_bytes, _ = read_regular(SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT)
    require(sha(plan_bytes) == plan_sha, "overlay plan drift")
    require(sha(status_bytes) == status_sha, "overlay status drift")
    require(
        sha(requirement_bytes) == SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        "overlay requirement drift",
    )
    identities = {
        "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md": write_candidate_file(
            repo / "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
            plan_bytes,
            replace=True,
        ),
        "STATUS.md": write_candidate_file(
            repo / "STATUS.md",
            status_bytes,
            replace=True,
        ),
        (
            "docs/requirements/"
            "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
        ): write_candidate_file(
            requirement_target,
            requirement_bytes,
            replace=False,
        ),
    }
    require(
        sha(read_regular(SCHEMA_SEED)[0]) == SCHEMA_SEED_SHA,
        "schema seed changed during overlay",
    )
    validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=False,
    )
    receipt = {
        "format_version": 1,
        "identities": identities,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_OVERLAY",
        "result": "PASS",
        "schema_seed_copied": False,
        "trusted_context_reserved_absent": True,
        "validation": validation,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v6-overlay.json", pretty(receipt))
    return receipt


def policy_file_identity(path: Path) -> str:
    info = path.lstat()
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        return "symlink:" + os.readlink(path)
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), "policy path is not regular")
    return (
        "regular:"
        + str(info.st_mode)
        + ":"
        + str(info.st_size)
        + ":"
        + hash_regular(path)["sha256"]
    )


def policy_snapshot(repo: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    paths = [repo / "AGENTS.md", repo / "loop-engineering.yaml"]
    for directory in (
        repo / "config/loop-engineering",
        repo / "tools/loop_engineering",
    ):
        paths.extend(
            path
            for path in directory.rglob("*")
            if (path.is_file() or path.is_symlink())
            and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
            and path.suffix != ".pyc"
        )
    return {
        path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(): policy_file_identity(path)
        for path in paths
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink()
    }


def final_context_record(
    repo: Path,
    run_id: str,

        "finalized_documents": {

                "docs/requirements/"

            ),

                    "docs/requirements/"

        "run": {

            "initial_state_sha256": state_identity["sha256"],
            "initial_state_size": state_identity["size"],
