        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_V8_CAPTURE",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stderr_base64": base64.b64encode(stderr_bytes).decode("ascii"),
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "raw_stdout_base64": base64.b64encode(stdout_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    }
    capture_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "candidate-dry-run-capture.json",
        pretty(capture_record),
    )
    candidate_path = os.fsencode(str(repo))
    seed_path = os.fsencode(str(SEED))
    validation: dict[str, Any] = {
        "candidate_path": str(repo),
        "candidate_path_occurrences": stdout_bytes.count(candidate_path),
        "capture": capture_identity,
        "format_version": 1,
        "line_feeds": stdout_bytes.count(b"\n"),
        "normalization_token": NORMALIZATION_TOKEN.decode("ascii"),
        "normalization_token_occurrences_before": stdout_bytes.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN),
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_V8_VALIDATION",
        "raw_stderr_sha256": sha(stderr_bytes),
        "raw_stderr_size": len(stderr_bytes),
        "raw_stdout_sha256": sha(stdout_bytes),
        "raw_stdout_size": len(stdout_bytes),
        "seed": seed_evidence,
        "seed_path_occurrences": stdout_bytes.count(seed_path),
        "verdict": "STOPPED",
    }
    try:
        require_success(result, "candidate make dry-run")
        stderr_contract = require_make_stderr_contract(result)
        validation["stderr_contract"] = stderr_contract
        require(stdout_bytes.count(b"\n") == 9, "candidate dry-run line count mismatch")
        require(candidate_path != seed_path, "candidate path equals seed path")
        require(
            stdout_bytes.count(candidate_path) == 8,
            "candidate path occurrence mismatch",
        )
        require(stdout_bytes.count(seed_path) == 0, "seed path present in candidate output")
        require(
            stdout_bytes.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 0,
            "candidate output contains normalization token",
        )
        normalized = stdout_bytes.replace(candidate_path, NORMALIZATION_TOKEN)
        require(
            normalized.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 8,
            "candidate normalized token count mismatch",
        )
        require(
            len(normalized) == 1390
            and sha(normalized) == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA
            and normalized == seed_normalized,
            "candidate canonical dry-run mismatch",
        )
        reconstructed = seed_normalized.replace(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN, candidate_path)
        require(
            reconstructed == stdout_bytes,
            "candidate raw dry-run reconstruction mismatch",
        )
        validation.update(
            {
                "normalized_sha256": sha(normalized),
                "normalized_size": len(normalized),
                "reconstructed_raw_sha256": sha(reconstructed),
                "reconstructed_raw_size": len(reconstructed),
                "verdict": "PASS",
            }
        )
        validation_identity = write_exclusive(
            receipts / "candidate-dry-run-validation.json",
            pretty(validation),
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        validation["error"] = (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048]
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "candidate-dry-run-validation.json",
            pretty(validation),
        )
        raise
    result["evidence"] = {
        "capture": capture_identity,
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "validation": validation_identity,
    }
    result["normalized_bytes"] = validation["normalized_size"]
    result["normalized_sha256"] = validation["normalized_sha256"]
    result["reconstructed_raw_sha256"] = validation["reconstructed_raw_sha256"]
    result["reconstructed_raw_size"] = validation["reconstructed_raw_size"]
    return result

def unsafe_links(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    unsafe: list[str] = []
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_symlink():
            continue
        try:
            resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
        except OSError:
            unsafe.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix() + ":broken")
            continue
        if not resolved.is_relative_to(root):
            unsafe.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix() + ":external")
    return unsafe


def pre_setup_validate(repo: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    manifest, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    require(sha(manifest) == MANIFEST_SHA and counts["records"] == 2322, "candidate manifest mismatch")
    validate_data_input(repo)
    require(status_counts(repo) == {"staged": 0, "modified_tracked": 15, "ordinary_untracked": 71}, "candidate status mismatch")
    require(git_bytes(["remote"], repo) == b"", "candidate remote present")
    ignored = git_paths_ignored(repo)
    require(not ignored, "ignored paths present before setup")
    for relative in (".python", ".venv", "apps/web/node_modules", ".cache/tiktoken", ".cache/playwright", ".loop"):
        require(not (repo / relative).exists(), f"pre-setup root exists: {relative}")
    require(not unsafe_links(repo), "unsafe pre-setup links")
    return {"counts": counts, "manifest_sha256": sha(manifest)}


def git_paths_ignored(root: Path) -> list[bytes]:
    payload = git_bytes(["-c", "core.quotePath=false", "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard"], root, 4 * 1024 * 1024)
    return [] if not payload else payload[:-1].split(b"\0")


def materialize(parent: Path, receipts: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
    materialization_started = time.monotonic()
    repo = parent / "repo"
    source_manifest, patch, included, source_patch_capture = validate_source(SEED)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "source-tracked.patch", patch)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "included-untracked.zlist", included)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "source-manifest.jsonl", source_manifest)
    commands: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    old_umask = os.umask(0o022)
    try:
        specs = [
            (["/usr/bin/git", "clone", "--quiet", "--no-local", "--no-hardlinks", str(SEED), str(repo)], BASE, None),
            (["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), "remote", "remove", "origin"], BASE, None),
            (["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(repo), "apply", "--binary", "--whitespace=nowarn", "-"], BASE, patch),
            (["/usr/bin/rsync", "--archive", "--from0", f"--files-from={receipts / 'included-untracked.zlist'}", str(SEED) + "/", str(repo) + "/"], BASE, None),
        ]
        for argv, cwd, input_bytes in specs:
            remaining = 300 - int(time.monotonic() - materialization_started)
            require(remaining > 0, "materialization exceeded 300 seconds")
            result = bounded(argv, cwd, child_environment(parent / "home", parent / "tmp"), remaining, 1048576, input_bytes=input_bytes)
            commands.append(result)
            require_success(result, "materialization")
            if argv[0] == "/usr/bin/git":
                require_empty_channel(result, "stdout")
                require_git_stderr_contract(result)
            else:
                require_empty_channel(result, "stdout")
                require_empty_channel(result, "stderr")
    finally:
        os.umask(old_umask)
    write_exclusive(receipts / "materialization-results.jsonl", b"".join(compact(item) + b"\n" for item in commands))
    candidate_manifest, _ = canonical_manifest(repo)
    require(candidate_manifest == source_manifest, "source/candidate manifest bytes differ")
    write_exclusive(receipts / "candidate-manifest.jsonl", candidate_manifest)
    pre_setup = pre_setup_validate(repo)
    pre_setup["candidate_dry_run"] = candidate_dry_run(
        repo,
        child_environment(parent / "home", parent / "tmp"),
        receipts,
    )
    pre_setup["source_patch_capture"] = source_patch_capture
    pre_setup["source_candidate_byte_identical"] = True
    write_exclusive(receipts / "pre-setup-receipt.json", pretty({"format_version": 1, "phase": "M2_PRE_SETUP", "result": "PASS", **pre_setup}))
    require(time.monotonic() - materialization_started <= 300, "materialization exceeded 300 seconds")
    return repo, candidate_manifest



def stage_doctor_profiles(
    repo: Path,
    parent: Path,
    receipts: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_root = repo / "config/loop-engineering/profiles"
    private_home = parent / "home"
    codex_home = private_home / ".codex"
    require(
        private_home.is_dir()
        and not private_home.is_symlink()
        and stat.S_IMODE(private_home.lstat().st_mode) == 0o700,
        "unsafe candidate-private HOME",
    )
    require(not codex_home.exists() and not codex_home.is_symlink(), "candidate-private Codex home already exists")
    operator_profiles = validate_profiles()
    source_records: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
        source_identity = require_identity(source_root / name, expected_sha, 0o644, expected_size)
        require(
            operator_profiles[name]["sha256"] == expected_sha
            and operator_profiles[name]["size"] == expected_size,
            f"operator profile identity mismatch: {name}",
        )
        source_records[name] = {
            "operator_profile": operator_profiles[name],
            "reviewed_template": source_identity,
        }
    command = {
        "config_staged": False,
        "credential_content_read": False,
        "destination": str(codex_home),
        "files": source_records,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_COMMAND",
        "unrelated_operator_codex_content_read": False,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-command.json", pretty(command))
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "config_staged": False,
        "credential_content_read": False,
        "destination": str(codex_home),
        "files": {},
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_STAGING",
        "result": "FAIL",
        "unrelated_operator_codex_content_read": False,
    }
    try:
        codex_home.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
        fsync_directory(private_home)
        codex_info = codex_home.lstat()
        require(
            stat.S_ISDIR(codex_info.st_mode)
            and not codex_home.is_symlink()
            and codex_info.st_uid == os.getuid()
            and stat.S_IMODE(codex_info.st_mode) == 0o700,
            "unsafe staged Codex home",
        )
        for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
            payload, source_identity = read_regular(source_root / name)
            require(
                source_identity["mode"] == "0644"
                and source_identity["size"] == expected_size
                and source_identity["sha256"] == expected_sha,
                f"reviewed profile changed before copy: {name}",
            )
            destination_identity = write_exclusive(codex_home / name, payload)
            require(
                destination_identity["mode"] == "0600"
                and destination_identity["size"] == expected_size
                and destination_identity["sha256"] == expected_sha,
                f"staged profile identity mismatch: {name}",
            )
            result["files"][name] = {"destination": destination_identity, "source": source_identity}
        fsync_directory(codex_home)
        require(set(os.listdir(codex_home)) == set(PROFILES), "unexpected candidate-private Codex-home entry")
        for name, (expected_size, expected_sha) in sorted(PROFILES.items()):
            require_identity(codex_home / name, expected_sha, 0o600, expected_size)
        result["directory"] = private_directory_identity(codex_home)
        result["result"] = "PASS"
    except BaseException as exc:
        result["error"] = bounded_error(exc)
        write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-staging.json", pretty(result))
        raise
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-profile-staging.json", pretty(result))
    return result


def doctor_capture_total(
    argv: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int,
    stdout_limit: int,
    stderr_limit: int,
    aggregate_limit: int,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    heartbeat: bool = False,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes]:
    started_at_utc = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    buffers = {"stdout": bytearray(), "stderr": bytearray()}
    digests = {"stdout": hashlib.sha256(), "stderr": hashlib.sha256()}
    totals = {"stdout": 0, "stderr": 0}
    truncated = {"stdout": False, "stderr": False, "aggregate": False}
    lock = threading.Lock()
    stopped = threading.Event()
    process: Any | None = None
    threads: list[threading.Thread] = []
    heartbeat_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
    lifecycle_history = ["not-started"]
    lifecycle_state = "not-started"
    returncode: int | None = None
    timed_out = False
    termination_attempted = False
    termination_signals: list[str] = []
    spawn_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    stdin_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    wait_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    drain_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    heartbeat_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    termination_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    unexpected_errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    def record_error(
        bucket: list[dict[str, str]],
        stage: str,
        exc: BaseException,
    ) -> None:
        bucket.append(
            {
                "error": (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048],
                "stage": stage,
            }
        )

    def emit_heartbeat() -> None:
        try:
            while not stopped.wait(240):
                os.write(
                    1,
                    compact({"phase": "M2_PROGRESS", "utc": utc_now()}) + b"\n",
                )
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(heartbeat_errors, "heartbeat", exc)

    def drain(name: str, pipe: Any, limit: int) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                chunk = pipe.read(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digests[name].update(chunk)
                with lock:
                    previous = totals[name]
                    aggregate_previous = totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"]
                    totals[name] += len(chunk)
                    allowed = min(
                        len(chunk),
                        max(0, limit - previous),
                        max(0, aggregate_limit - aggregate_previous),
                    )
                    if allowed:
                        buffers[name].extend(chunk[:allowed])
                    if totals[name] > limit:
                        truncated[name] = True
                    if totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"] > aggregate_limit:
                        truncated["aggregate"] = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(drain_errors, "drain-" + name, exc)
        finally:
            try:
                pipe.close()
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(drain_errors, "close-" + name, exc)

    def terminate_started(reason: str) -> None:
        nonlocal lifecycle_state, returncode, termination_attempted
        if process is None:
            return
        try:
            observed = process.poll()
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-initial-poll", exc)
            observed = None
            lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
        if observed is not None:
            returncode = observed
            lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            return
        termination_attempted = True
        for label, signal_value, wait_seconds in (
            ("TERM", signal.SIGTERM, 2),
            ("KILL", signal.SIGKILL, 5),
        ):
            termination_signals.append(label)
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal_value)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-" + label, exc)
            try:
                observed = process.wait(timeout=wait_seconds)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                continue
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(wait_errors, reason + "-wait-" + label, exc)
                continue
            returncode = observed
            lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            return
        try:
            observed = process.poll()
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(termination_errors, reason + "-final-poll", exc)
            lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
        else:
            if observed is None:
                lifecycle_state = "still-live"
            else:
                returncode = observed
                lifecycle_state = "terminated"
        if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
            lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)

    try:
        try:
            process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 -- fixed doctor argv only
                argv,
                cwd=cwd,
                env=env,
                stdin=(
                    subprocess.PIPE
                    if input_bytes is not None
                    else subprocess.DEVNULL
                ),
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                start_new_session=True,
                shell=False,
            )
        except BaseException as exc:
            record_error(spawn_errors, "spawn", exc)
        else:
            lifecycle_state = "started"
            lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
            if process.stdout is None or process.stderr is None:
                record_error(
                    drain_errors,
                    "capture-pipes",
                    RuntimeError("capture pipes missing"),
                )
            else:
                for name, pipe, limit in (
                    ("stdout", process.stdout, stdout_limit),
                    ("stderr", process.stderr, stderr_limit),
                ):
                    thread = threading.Thread(
                        target=drain,
                        args=(name, pipe, limit),
                        name="m3s-v1-doctor-" + name,
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    threads.append(thread)
                    try:
                        thread.start()
                    except BaseException as exc:
                        record_error(drain_errors, "start-drain-" + name, exc)
            if heartbeat:
                heartbeat_thread = threading.Thread(
                    target=emit_heartbeat,
                    name="m3s-v1-doctor-heartbeat",
                    daemon=True,
                )
                try:
                    heartbeat_thread.start()
                except BaseException as exc:
                    record_error(heartbeat_errors, "start-heartbeat", exc)
            if input_bytes is not None:
                if process.stdin is None:
                    record_error(
                        stdin_errors,
                        "stdin-pipe",
                        RuntimeError("stdin pipe missing"),
                    )
                else:
                    try:
                        view = memoryview(input_bytes)
                        while view:
                            written = process.stdin.write(view)
                            if written is None or written <= 0:
                                raise RuntimeError("short child stdin write")
                            view = view[written:]
                        process.stdin.flush()
                    except BaseException as exc:
                        record_error(stdin_errors, "stdin-write", exc)
                    finally:
                        try:
                            process.stdin.close()
                        except BaseException as exc:
                            record_error(stdin_errors, "stdin-close", exc)
            try:
                returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed_out = True
                terminate_started("timeout")
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(wait_errors, "wait", exc)
                terminate_started("wait-error")
            else:
                lifecycle_state = "terminated"
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)
    except BaseException as exc:
        record_error(unexpected_errors, "capture", exc)
    finally:
        if process is not None and lifecycle_state != "terminated":
            terminate_started("finally")
        for thread in threads:
            try:
                thread.join(timeout=5)
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(drain_errors, "join-drain", exc)
            if thread.is_alive():
                record_error(
                    drain_errors,
                    "join-drain",
                    RuntimeError("capture thread failed to stop"),
                )
        stopped.set()
        if heartbeat_thread is not None:
            try:
                heartbeat_thread.join(timeout=2)
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(heartbeat_errors, "join-heartbeat", exc)
            if heartbeat_thread.is_alive():
                record_error(
                    heartbeat_errors,
                    "join-heartbeat",
                    RuntimeError("heartbeat thread failed to stop"),
                )
        if process is not None and returncode is None:
            try:
                observed = process.poll()
            except BaseException as exc:
                record_error(termination_errors, "receipt-poll", exc)
                lifecycle_state = "indeterminate"
            else:
                if observed is None:
                    lifecycle_state = "still-live"
                else:
                    returncode = observed
                    lifecycle_state = "terminated"
            if lifecycle_history[-1] != lifecycle_state:
                lifecycle_history.append(lifecycle_state)

    stdout_bytes = bytes(buffers["stdout"])
    stderr_bytes = bytes(buffers["stderr"])
    capture_errors = (
        spawn_errors
        + stdin_errors
        + wait_errors
        + drain_errors
        + heartbeat_errors
        + unexpected_errors
    )
    credential_names = sorted(name for name in env if SECRET_NAME.search(name))
    capture_complete = (
        lifecycle_state == "terminated"
        and returncode is not None
        and not timed_out
        and not any(truncated.values())
        and capture_errors == []
        and termination_errors == []
    )
    result = {
        "aggregate_limit_bytes": aggregate_limit,
        "aggregate_truncated": truncated["aggregate"],
        "argv": argv,
        "capture_complete": capture_complete,
        "capture_errors": capture_errors,
        "child_started": process is not None,
        "credential_environment_variables": credential_names,
        "cwd": str(cwd),
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "environment_names": sorted(env),
        "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "format_version": 3,
        "heartbeat_errors": heartbeat_errors,
        "lifecycle_history": lifecycle_history,
        "lifecycle_state": lifecycle_state,
        "returncode": returncode,
        "session_observation": "not-collected",
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
        "stderr": stderr_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr_captured_sha256": sha(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_captured_size": len(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_limit_bytes": stderr_limit,
        "stderr_sha256": digests["stderr"].hexdigest(),
        "stderr_size": totals["stderr"],
        "stderr_truncated": truncated["stderr"],
        "stdin": "FIXED_BYTES" if input_bytes is not None else "DEVNULL",
        "stdin_errors": stdin_errors,
        "stdout": stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stdout_captured_sha256": sha(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_captured_size": len(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_limit_bytes": stdout_limit,
        "stdout_sha256": digests["stdout"].hexdigest(),
        "stdout_size": totals["stdout"],
        "stdout_truncated": truncated["stdout"],
        "termination": {
            "attempted": termination_attempted,
            "errors": termination_errors,
            "signals": termination_signals,
        },
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "wait_errors": wait_errors,
    }
    return result, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes


def capture_and_validate_doctor(
    repo: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    receipts: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    argv = ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-doctor"]
    command = {
        "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
        "argv": argv,
        "cwd": str(repo),
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_COMMAND",
        "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "timeout_seconds": 300,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-command.json", pretty(command))
    capture_started_at_utc = utc_now()
    capture_started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        capture, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes = doctor_capture_total(
            argv,
            repo,
            env,
            300,
            65536,
            65536,
            131072,
            heartbeat=True,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        stdout_bytes = b""
        stderr_bytes = b""
        escape_error = {
            "error": bounded_error(exc),
            "stage": "doctor-capture-total-escape",
        }
        capture = {
            "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
            "aggregate_truncated": False,
            "argv": argv,
            "capture_complete": False,
            "capture_errors": [escape_error],
            "capture_function_escaped": True,
            "child_started": None,
            "credential_environment_variables": sorted(
                name for name in env if SECRET_NAME.search(name)
            ),
            "cwd": str(repo),
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - capture_started, 6),
            "environment_names": sorted(env),
            "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
            "format_version": 3,
            "heartbeat_errors": [],
            "lifecycle_history": ["not-started", "indeterminate"],
            "lifecycle_state": "indeterminate",
            "returncode": None,
            "session_observation": "not-collected",
            "started_at_utc": capture_started_at_utc,
            "stderr": "",
            "stderr_captured_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stderr_captured_size": 0,
            "stderr_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(b""),
            "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stderr_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stderr_size": 0,
            "stderr_truncated": False,
            "stdin": "DEVNULL",
            "stdin_errors": [],
            "stdout": "",
            "stdout_captured_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stdout_captured_size": 0,
            "stdout_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(b""),
            "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stdout_sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
            "stdout_size": 0,
            "stdout_truncated": False,
            "termination": {
                "attempted": False,
                "errors": [
                    {
                        "error": "capture function escaped; child state unavailable",
                        "stage": "doctor-capture-total-escape",
                    }
                ],
                "signals": [],
            },
            "timed_out": False,
            "timeout_seconds": 300,
            "wait_errors": [],
        }
    capture.update({"phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE"})
    stdout_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-stdout.bin", stdout_bytes)
    stderr_identity = write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-stderr.bin", stderr_bytes)
    environment_record = dict(sorted(env.items()))
    capture_receipt = {
        "capture": capture,
        "environment": {
            "names": sorted(env),
            "non_secret_values": environment_record,
            "sha256": sha(compact(environment_record)),
        },
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
    }
    capture_identity = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "doctor-capture.json",
        pretty(capture_receipt),
    )
    failures: list[str] = []
    if capture["returncode"] is None:
        failures.append("returncode_unavailable")
    elif capture["returncode"] != 0:
        failures.append("returncode")
    if capture["lifecycle_state"] != "terminated":
        failures.append("child_" + capture["lifecycle_state"])
    if capture["timed_out"]:
        failures.append("timeout")
    if (
        capture["stdout_truncated"]
        or capture["stderr_truncated"]
        or capture["aggregate_truncated"]
    ):
        failures.append("truncation")
    if capture["capture_errors"]:
        failures.append("capture_error")
    if capture["termination"]["errors"]:
        failures.append("termination_error")
    if not capture["capture_complete"]:
        failures.append("capture_incomplete")
    if capture["credential_environment_variables"]:
        failures.append("credential_environment_variable")
    stderr_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    try:
        stderr_contract = require_make_stderr_contract(capture)
    except BaseException as exc:
        failures.append("stderr:" + bounded_error(exc))
    expected_stdout = (
        f"READY root={repo} codex=/opt/homebrew/bin/codex commands=4\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    if stdout_bytes != expected_stdout:
        failures.append("stdout")
    if (
        capture["stdout_size"] != len(expected_stdout)
        or capture["stdout_sha256"] != sha(expected_stdout)
    ):
        failures.append("stdout_identity")
    try:
        require_no_prompt_or_secret(capture, "loop-doctor")
    except BaseException as exc:
        failures.append("prompt_or_secret:" + bounded_error(exc))
    validation = {
        "capture_complete": capture["capture_complete"],
        "capture_errors": capture["capture_errors"],
        "capture_receipt": capture_identity,
        "child_started": capture["child_started"],
        "expected_stdout": {
            "sha256": sha(expected_stdout),
            "size": len(expected_stdout),
        },
        "failures": failures,
        "format_version": 1,
        "lifecycle_history": capture["lifecycle_history"],
        "lifecycle_state": capture["lifecycle_state"],
        "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION",
        "raw_stderr": stderr_identity,
        "raw_stdout": stdout_identity,
        "result": "PASS" if not failures else "FAIL",
        "returncode": capture["returncode"],
        "session_observation": capture["session_observation"],
        "stderr_contract": stderr_contract,
        "termination": capture["termination"],
        "timed_out": capture["timed_out"],
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "doctor-validation.json", pretty(validation))
    require(not failures, "loop-doctor validation failed: " + ",".join(failures))
    return validation


def validate_v8_and_m2_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    identities = {
        "v8_final_index": require_identity(
            V8_M2B / "receipts/final-index.json",
            V8_FINAL_INDEX_SHA,
            0o600,
            8138,
        ),
        "v8_result": require_identity(
            V8_EXECUTION_RESULT,
            V8_EXECUTION_RESULT_SHA,
            0o600,
            18103,
        ),
        "m2_index": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-receipt-index.json",
            M2_FINAL_INDEX_SHA,
            0o600,
            12784,
        ),
        "m2_repository": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-repository-manifest.jsonl",
            M2_REPOSITORY_SHA,
            0o600,
        ),
        "m2_final_attempt_manifest": require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-attempt-manifest.jsonl",
            M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA,
            0o600,
            M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE,
        ),
        "blocked_state": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "state.json",
            BLOCKED_STATE_SHA,
            0o644,
            17815,
        ),
        "blocked_events": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "events.jsonl",
            BLOCKED_EVENTS_SHA,
            0o644,
            2278,
        ),
        "planner": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "artifacts/planner/001.json",
            BLOCKED_PLANNER_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
        "coder": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "artifacts/coder/001.json",
            BLOCKED_CODER_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
        "coder_events": require_identity(
            BLOCKED_RUN / "agents/coder/001-events.jsonl",
            BLOCKED_CODER_EVENTS_SHA,
            0o644,
        ),
    }
    m2_index, _ = load_json(M2_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-receipt-index.json")
    m2_outer, _ = load_json(V8_EXECUTION_RESULT)
    m2_outer_result = json.loads(m2_outer["output"])["result"]
    index_manifest = m2_index["files"]["final-attempt-manifest.jsonl"]
    index_summary = m2_index["attempt_pre_index"]
    outer_manifest = m2_outer_result["sealing_outcomes"]["final-attempt-manifest"]
    outer_completed = m2_outer_result["sealing_outcomes"]["completed-attempt-tree"]
    require(
        m2_index["verdict"] == "M2_PASS"
        and m2_outer["returncode"] == 0
        and m2_outer["timed_out"] is False
        and m2_outer["output_truncated"] is False
        and m2_outer["session_id"] is None
        and m2_outer["credential_variables"] == []
        and m2_outer["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "accepted M2 wrapper/index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index_manifest["size"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE
        and index_manifest["sha256"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA
        and index_summary == {
            "path_count": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_PATH_COUNT,
            "regular_file_bytes": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_REGULAR_BYTES,
            "sha256": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA,
        }
        and outer_manifest["identity"]["size"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE
        and outer_manifest["identity"]["sha256"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA
        and {
            "path_count": outer_manifest["path_count"],
            "regular_file_bytes": outer_manifest["regular_file_bytes"],
            "sha256": outer_manifest["sha256"],
        } == index_summary,
        "M2 final-attempt manifest semantic identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        outer_completed == {
            "path_count": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_PATH_COUNT,
            "regular_file_bytes": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_REGULAR_BYTES,
            "sha256": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_SHA,
        }
        and {
            "path_count": m2_outer_result["path_count"],
            "regular_file_bytes": m2_outer_result["regular_file_bytes"],
            "sha256": m2_outer_result["sha256"],
        } == outer_completed,
        "M2 completed-attempt tree semantic identity mismatch",
    )
    state, _ = load_json(BLOCKED_RUN / "state.json")
    require(
        state["run_id"] == BLOCKED_RUN_ID
        and state["state"] == "blocked"
        and state["coder_session_id"] == BLOCKED_CODER_SESSION
        and state["cycle"] == 1
        and state["code_cycle"] == 1,
        "blocked run state mismatch",
    )
    expected_blocked_artifacts = {
        "coder": [
            ".loop/runs/20261009T124056Z-37111cbc/artifacts/coder/001.json"
        ],
        "planner": [
            ".loop/runs/20261009T124056Z-37111cbc/artifacts/planner/001.json"
        ],
    }
    require(
        state["artifacts"] == expected_blocked_artifacts,
        "blocked artifacts mismatch",
    )
    pyc_identities: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for relative, size, expected_sha in (
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/__init__.cpython-312.pyc",
            5943,
            "e48232d881acb62c67e8af6365d4145bfdcc8958c0dc46658846fb8c9c3a6b64",
        ),
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/aliases.cpython-312.pyc",
            12576,
            "21dac7a7fd74ec2b979b0bba348cf4b96f8be7fc87e412ae571b48851e1f0d92",
        ),
        (
            ".python/cpython-3.12.14-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/"
            "encodings/__pycache__/utf_8.cpython-312.pyc",
            2315,
            "0739ac120c090d359232d37253404998c4ca5cc8db89e3bbc7b8f4b24dfc0e97",
        ),
    ):
        pyc_identities[relative] = require_identity(
            M2_CANDIDATE / "repo" / relative,
            expected_sha,
            0o644,
            size,
        )
    identities["successor_requirement"] = require_identity(
        SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT,
        SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        0o644,
        8771,
    )
    identities["schema_seed"] = require_identity(
        SCHEMA_SEED,
        SCHEMA_SEED_SHA,
        0o644,
        6328,
    )
    identities["loop_config"] = require_identity(
        ORIGINAL / "loop-engineering.yaml",
        LOOP_CONFIG_SHA,
        0o644,
    )
    current_manifest, totals = tree_manifest(M2_CANDIDATE)
    require(
        totals == {"path_count": 27593, "regular_file_bytes": 590971877}
        and sha(current_manifest)
        == "db21b412395986a770e02f510201a861774fe116ffee42268154b7c6145142f1",
        "retained M2 candidate drift",
    )
    return {
        "identities": identities,
        "m2_completed_attempt_tree": outer_completed,
        "m2_current_tree": {**totals, "sha256": sha(current_manifest)},
        "m2_final_attempt_manifest": index_summary,
        "retained_ignored_cache_path_count": 132,
        "retained_pyc": pyc_identities,
        "schema_seed_authority": False,
    }


def write_candidate_file(
    path: Path,
    payload: bytes,
    *,
    replace: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(
        path.parent.is_dir() and not path.parent.is_symlink(),
        "unsafe candidate file parent",
    )
    destination = path
    if replace:
        before = path.lstat()
        require(
            stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),
            "overlay target unsafe",
        )
        destination = path.with_name("." + path.name + ".m3s-v1-overlay")
    require(
        not destination.exists() and not destination.is_symlink(),
        "candidate file collision",
    )
    fd = os.open(
        destination,
        os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
        0o644,
    )
    try:
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero candidate file write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        require(os.fstat(fd).st_size == len(payload), "candidate file short write")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if replace:
        os.replace(destination, path)
    fsync_directory(path.parent)
    return require_identity(path, sha(payload), 0o644, len(payload))


def manifest_rows(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for raw in payload.splitlines():
        value = json.loads(raw)
        require(
            isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("path"), str),
            "manifest row invalid",
        )
        require(value["path"] not in rows, "duplicate manifest path")
        rows[value["path"]] = value
    return rows


def validate_successor_source(
    repo: Path,
    *,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
    context_expected: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reference_bytes, _ = read_regular(
        BASE
        / "candidate.OlsWg1/receipts/candidate-pre-setup-manifest.jsonl"
    )
    require(sha(reference_bytes) == MANIFEST_SHA, "B2 reference manifest mismatch")
    payload, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    rows = manifest_rows(payload)
    reference = manifest_rows(reference_bytes)
    requirement_path = (
        "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
    )
    context_path = TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix()
    expected_paths = set(reference) | {requirement_path}
    if context_expected:
        expected_paths.add(context_path)
    require(set(rows) == expected_paths, "successor repository path set mismatch")
    for path, value in reference.items():
        if path not in {
            "STATUS.md",
            "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
        }:
            require(rows[path] == value, "non-overlay B2 record changed: " + path)
    expected_overlay = {
        "STATUS.md": ("tracked", status_sha),
        "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md": (
            "ordinary-untracked",
            plan_sha,
        ),
        requirement_path: (
            "ordinary-untracked",
            SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        ),
    }
    for path, (path_class, expected_sha) in expected_overlay.items():
        row = rows[path]
        require(
            row["class"] == path_class
            and row["type"] == "regular"
            and row["mode"] == "0644"
            and row["sha256"] == expected_sha,
            "successor overlay identity mismatch: " + path,
        )
    if context_expected:
        row = rows[context_path]
        require(
            row["class"] == "ordinary-untracked"
            and row["type"] == "regular"
            and row["mode"] == "0600",
            "trusted-context record identity mismatch",
        )
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 73,
            "records": 2324,
        }
    else:
        require(context_path not in rows, "trusted-context exists before init")
        expected_counts = {
            "tracked": 2251,
            "ordinary_untracked": 72,
            "records": 2323,
        }
    require(counts == expected_counts, "successor manifest counts mismatch")
    current_status = status_counts(repo)
    require(
        current_status
        == {
            "staged": 0,
            "modified_tracked": 15,
            "ordinary_untracked": expected_counts["ordinary_untracked"],
        },
        "successor Git status mismatch",
    )
    require(git_bytes(["remote"], repo) == b"", "successor remote exists")
    return {
        "counts": counts,
        "manifest_sha256": sha(payload),
        "status": current_status,
    }


def overlay_successor_documents(
    repo: Path,
    receipts: Path,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    context = repo / TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL
    requirement_target = (
        repo / "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
    )
    require(
        not context.exists() and not context.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context path not reserved",
    )
    require(
        not context.parent.exists() and not context.parent.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context parent path not reserved",
    )
    require(
        not requirement_target.exists() and not requirement_target.is_symlink(),
        "v2 requirement collision",
    )
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    status_bytes, _ = read_regular(STATUS)
    requirement_bytes, _ = read_regular(SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT)
    require(sha(plan_bytes) == plan_sha, "overlay plan drift")
    require(sha(status_bytes) == status_sha, "overlay status drift")
    require(
        sha(requirement_bytes) == SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
        "overlay requirement drift",
    )
    identities = {
        "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md": write_candidate_file(
            repo / "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
            plan_bytes,
            replace=True,
        ),
        "STATUS.md": write_candidate_file(
            repo / "STATUS.md",
            status_bytes,
            replace=True,
        ),
        (
            "docs/requirements/"
            "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
        ): write_candidate_file(
            requirement_target,
            requirement_bytes,
            replace=False,
        ),
    }
    require(
        sha(read_regular(SCHEMA_SEED)[0]) == SCHEMA_SEED_SHA,
        "schema seed changed during overlay",
    )
    validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=False,
    )
    receipt = {
        "format_version": 1,
        "identities": identities,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_OVERLAY",
        "result": "PASS",
        "schema_seed_copied": False,
        "trusted_context_reserved_absent": True,
        "validation": validation,
    }
    write_exclusive(receipts / "successor-v8-overlay.json", pretty(receipt))
    return receipt


def policy_file_identity(path: Path) -> str:
    info = path.lstat()
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        return "symlink:" + os.readlink(path)
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), "policy path is not regular")
    return (
        "regular:"
        + str(info.st_mode)
        + ":"
        + str(info.st_size)
        + ":"
        + hash_regular(path)["sha256"]
    )


def policy_snapshot(repo: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    paths = [repo / "AGENTS.md", repo / "loop-engineering.yaml"]
    for directory in (
        repo / "config/loop-engineering",
        repo / "tools/loop_engineering",
    ):
        paths.extend(
            path
            for path in directory.rglob("*")
            if (path.is_file() or path.is_symlink())
            and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
            and path.suffix != ".pyc"
        )
    return {
        path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(): policy_file_identity(path)
        for path in paths
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink()
    }


def final_context_record(
    repo: Path,
    run_id: str,
    state_identity: dict[str, Any],
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "authority_state": "CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL",
        "blocked_predecessor": {
            "coder_artifact_sha256": BLOCKED_CODER_SHA,
            "coder_event_log_sha256": BLOCKED_CODER_EVENTS_SHA,
            "coder_session_id": BLOCKED_CODER_SESSION,
            "events_sha256": BLOCKED_EVENTS_SHA,
            "planner_artifact_sha256": BLOCKED_PLANNER_SHA,
            "planner_session_id": BLOCKED_PLANNER_SESSION,
            "run_id": BLOCKED_RUN_ID,
            "state_sha256": BLOCKED_STATE_SHA,
        },
        "candidate": {
            "base_head": HEAD,
            "root": str(repo),
            "source_kind": "FROZEN_B2_RECONSTRUCTION_NOT_DYG_COPY",
        },
        "evidence": {
            "b2_manifest_sha256": MANIFEST_SHA,
            "b2_patch_sha256": PATCH_SHA,
            "b2_path_list_sha256": LIST_SHA,
            "m2_completed_attempt_tree_sha256": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_SHA,
            "m2_final_attempt_manifest_sha256": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA,
            "m2_final_index_sha256": M2_FINAL_INDEX_SHA,
            "m2_outer_result_sha256": M2_OUTER_RESULT_SHA,
            "m2_repository_sha256": M2_REPOSITORY_SHA,
            "protected_manifest_sha256": PROTECTED_SHA,
            "protected_result_sha256": RESULT_SHA,
        },
        "finalized_documents": {
            "execplan_sha256": plan_sha,
            "requirement_path": (
                "docs/requirements/"
                "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
            ),
            "requirement_sha256": SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT_SHA,
            "status_sha256": status_sha,
        },
        "format_version": 1,
        "overlay": {
            "paths": [
                "STATUS.md",
                TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix(),
                "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
                (
                    "docs/requirements/"
                    "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
                ),
            ],
        },
        "record_kind": "liveclip_m3_successor_trusted_context_v1",
        "run": {
            "initial_state_mode": "0644",
            "initial_state_path": ".loop/runs/" + run_id + "/state.json",
            "initial_state_sha256": state_identity["sha256"],
            "initial_state_size": state_identity["size"],
            "run_id": run_id,
            "state": "received",
        },
        "serialization": {
            "algorithm": (
                "json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, "
                "sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8') "
                "+ b'\\n'"
            ),
            "encoding": "UTF-8",
            "terminal_lf": True,
        },
    }


def validate_final_context_shape(
    value: dict[str, Any],
    repo: Path,
    run_id: str,
    state_identity: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    require_exact_keys(
        value,
        frozenset({
            "authority_state",
            "blocked_predecessor",
            "candidate",
            "evidence",
            "finalized_documents",
            "format_version",
            "overlay",
            "record_kind",
            "run",
            "serialization",
        }),
        "trusted-context",
    )
    require(
        value["authority_state"] == "CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL",
        "context authority state mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["record_kind"] == "liveclip_m3_successor_trusted_context_v1",
        "context kind mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["candidate"]["root"] == str(repo),
        "context candidate root mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["candidate"]["source_kind"]
        == "FROZEN_B2_RECONSTRUCTION_NOT_DYG_COPY",
        "context source kind mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["run"]["run_id"] == run_id and run_id != BLOCKED_RUN_ID,
        "context run ID mismatch",
    )
    require(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", run_id)
        is not None,
        "context run ID shape mismatch",
    )
    require(value["run"]["state"] == "received", "context initial state mismatch")
    require(
        value["run"]["initial_state_sha256"] == state_identity["sha256"],
        "context state hash mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["overlay"]["paths"]
        == [
            "STATUS.md",
            TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix(),
            "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
            "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md",
        ],
        "context overlay paths mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["evidence"]["b2_manifest_sha256"] == MANIFEST_SHA,
        "context B2 mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["blocked_predecessor"]["state_sha256"] == BLOCKED_STATE_SHA,
        "context blocked state mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["serialization"]["terminal_lf"] is True,
        "context serialization mismatch",
    )


def successor_contract_self_test() -> dict[str, bool]:
    repo = BASE / "candidate.M3SSELFTEST/repo"
    run_id = "20990101T010203Z-1a2b3c4d"
    state_identity = {"sha256": "a" * 64, "size": 123}
    valid = final_context_record(
        repo,
        run_id,
        state_identity,
        "b" * 64,
        "c" * 64,
    )
    validate_final_context_shape(valid, repo, run_id, state_identity)

    def rejected(mutate: Any) -> bool:
        candidate = json.loads(json.dumps(valid))
        mutate(candidate)
        try:
            validate_final_context_shape(
                candidate,
                repo,
                run_id,
                state_identity,
            )
        except RuntimeError:
            return True
        return False

    cases = {
        "valid_final_record_accept": True,
        "extra_top_key_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item.__setitem__("extra", True)
        ),
        "blocked_run_id_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["run"].__setitem__(
                "run_id",
                BLOCKED_RUN_ID,
            )
        ),
        "wrong_candidate_root_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["candidate"].__setitem__(
                "root",
                str(M2_CANDIDATE / "repo"),
            )
        ),
        "schema_seed_authority_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item.__setitem__(
                "authority_state",
                "SCHEMA_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORITY",
            )
        ),
        "wrong_state_hash_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["run"].__setitem__(
                "initial_state_sha256",
                "d" * 64,
            )
        ),
    }
    require(all(cases.values()), "successor context self-test failed")
    return cases


def initialize_and_bind_successor(
    repo: Path,
    parent: Path,
    receipts: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    loop_root = repo / ".loop"
    require(
        not loop_root.exists() and not loop_root.is_symlink(),
        "pre-existing loop root",
    )
    context_path = repo / TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL
    context_directory = context_path.parent
    require(
        not context_path.exists() and not context_path.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context collision before init",
    )
    require(
        not context_directory.exists()
        and not context_directory.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context directory collision before init",
    )
    argv = [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "loop-init",
        (
            "REQUIREMENT=docs/requirements/"
            "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
        ),
    ]
    command = {
        "argv": argv,
        "cwd": str(repo),
        "format_version": 1,
        "output_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_LOOP_INIT_COMMAND",
        "timeout_seconds": 60,
    }
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-loop-init-command.json",
        pretty(command),
    )
    result = bounded(argv, repo, env, 60, 65536)
    result.update({"phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_LOOP_INIT"})
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-loop-init-result.json",
        pretty(result),
    )
    require_success(result, "loop-init")
    require_no_prompt_or_secret(result, "loop-init")
    runs_root = loop_root / "runs"
    require(
        runs_root.is_dir() and not runs_root.is_symlink(),
        "run root missing or unsafe",
    )
    run_dirs = sorted(
        (
            path
            for path in runs_root.iterdir()
            if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()
        ),
        key=lambda path: os.fsencode(path.name),
    )
    require(len(run_dirs) == 1, "loop-init did not create exactly one run")
    run_id = run_dirs[0].name
    require(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", run_id)
        is not None,
        "run ID mismatch",
    )
    require(run_id != BLOCKED_RUN_ID, "blocked run ID reused")
    state_path = run_dirs[0] / "state.json"
    events_path = run_dirs[0] / "events.jsonl"
    state, state_identity = load_json(state_path)
    require(state_identity["mode"] == "0644", "initial state mode mismatch")
    require_exact_keys(
        state,
        frozenset({
            "run_id",
            "requirement",
            "base_sha",
            "state",
            "cycle",
            "code_cycle",
            "coder_session_id",
            "artifacts",
            "command_results",
            "last_error",
        }),
        "initial state",
    )
    requirement_bytes, _ = read_regular(SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT)
    require(
        state
        == {
            "artifacts": {},
            "base_sha": HEAD,
            "code_cycle": 0,
            "coder_session_id": None,
            "command_results": [],
            "cycle": 0,
            "last_error": None,
            "requirement": requirement_bytes.decode("utf-8").strip(),
            "run_id": run_id,
            "state": "received",
        },
        "initial state content mismatch",
    )
    events_bytes, events_identity = read_regular(events_path)
    require(events_identity["mode"] == "0644", "initial events mode mismatch")
    event_lines = events_bytes.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    require(len(event_lines) == 1, "initial events count mismatch")
    event = json.loads(event_lines[0])
    require_exact_keys(
        event,
        frozenset({"kind", "payload", "state", "ts"}),
        "initial event",
    )
    require(
        event["kind"] == "run.created"
        and event["state"] == "received"
        and event["payload"] == {"base_sha": HEAD}
        and re.fullmatch(
            r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z",
            event["ts"],
        )
        is not None,
        "initial event mismatch",
    )
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-initial-state.json",
        pretty({
            "file": state_identity,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_INITIAL_STATE",
            "state": state,
        }),
    )
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-initial-events.jsonl",
        events_bytes,
    )
    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    context_directory_info = context_directory.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISDIR(context_directory_info.st_mode)
        and not context_directory.is_symlink()
        and stat.S_IMODE(context_directory_info.st_mode) == 0o755,
        "trusted-context directory creation mismatch",
    )
    fsync_directory(context_directory.parent)
    fsync_directory(context_directory)
    context = final_context_record(
        repo,
        run_id,
        state_identity,
        plan_sha,
        status_sha,
    )
    validate_final_context_shape(context, repo, run_id, state_identity)
    context_identity = write_exclusive(context_path, pretty(context))
    require(context_identity["mode"] == "0600", "trusted-context mode mismatch")
    context_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-trusted-context.json",
        pretty({
            "file": context_identity,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_TRUSTED_CONTEXT",
            "record": context,
            "result": "PENDING_EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER_BINDING",
            "schema_seed_authority": False,
        }),
    )
    snapshot = policy_snapshot(repo)
    require(
        TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix() in snapshot,
        "trusted context absent from policy snapshot",
    )
    policy_payload = compact(snapshot)
    policy_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-policy-snapshot.json",
        pretty({
            "files": snapshot,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_POLICY_SNAPSHOT",
            "sha256": sha(policy_payload),
        }),
    )
    probe = (
        "import json;from pathlib import Path;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.store import fingerprint_worktree;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.toolchain import ToolchainManager;"
        "root=Path.cwd();trusted=ToolchainManager(root).prepare();"
        "print(json.dumps({'candidate_worktree':fingerprint_worktree(root),"
        "'snapshot_fingerprint':trusted.fingerprint,"
        "'snapshot_path':str(trusted.path),"
        "'source_fingerprint':trusted.source_fingerprint},"
        "ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,"
        "separators=(',',':'),sort_keys=True))"
    )
    toolchain_result = bounded(
        [str(repo / ".venv/bin/python"), "-c", probe],
        repo,
        env,
        300,
        65536,
        heartbeat=True,
    )
    require_success(toolchain_result, "trusted toolchain prepare")
    require_empty_channel(toolchain_result, "stderr")
    require(
        toolchain_result["stdout"].count("\n") == 1,
        "toolchain probe stdout mismatch",
    )
    toolchain = json.loads(toolchain_result["stdout"])
    require(
        toolchain_result["stdout"].encode("utf-8")
        == compact(toolchain) + b"\n",
        "toolchain probe output is not canonical",
    )
    snapshot_path = Path(toolchain["snapshot_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    require(
        snapshot_path.is_relative_to(parent / "home"),
        "toolchain snapshot is not candidate-private",
    )
    for key in (
        "candidate_worktree",
        "snapshot_fingerprint",
        "source_fingerprint",
    ):
        require(
            re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", toolchain[key]) is not None,
            "toolchain identity invalid",
        )
    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-toolchain-snapshot.json",
        pretty({
            "capture": toolchain_result,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V8_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
            "result": "PASS",
            "toolchain": toolchain,
        }),
    )
    source_validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=True,
    )
    loop_run_argv = ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-run", "RUN_ID=" + run_id]
    bindings = {
        "candidate_root": str(repo),
        "candidate_worktree_sha256": toolchain["candidate_worktree"],
        "context": context_identity,
        "context_receipt": context_receipt,
        "format_version": 1,
        "future_loop_run_argv": loop_run_argv,
        "future_loop_run_argv_json_sha256": sha(argv_json(loop_run_argv)),
        "initial_events": events_identity,
        "initial_state": state_identity,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_FINAL_BINDINGS",
        "policy_receipt": policy_receipt,
        "policy_snapshot_sha256": sha(policy_payload),
        "run_id": run_id,
        "source_validation": source_validation,
        "toolchain_receipt": toolchain_receipt,
        "toolchain_snapshot_fingerprint": toolchain[
            "snapshot_fingerprint"
        ],
        "toolchain_source_fingerprint": toolchain["source_fingerprint"],
        "verdict": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V8_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
    }
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v8-final-bindings.json",
        pretty(bindings),
    )
    return bindings


def setup_argv(repo: Path) -> list[str]:
    quoted = shlex.quote(str(repo / ".python"))
    return [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "UV=../../trusted-tools/uv-0.12.17/extracted/uv-aarch64-apple-darwin/uv",
        "UV_CACHE_DIR_LOCAL=.cache/uv",
        f"UV_ENV=UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR={quoted}",
        "setup",
    ]


def post_setup(
    repo: Path,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=False,
    )
    manifest, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    roots: dict[str, str] = {}
    for relative in (".python", ".venv", "apps/web/node_modules", ".cache/tiktoken", ".cache/playwright"):
        path = repo / relative
        require(path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe dependency root: {relative}")
        resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
        require(resolved.is_relative_to(repo), f"external dependency root: {relative}")
        roots[relative] = str(resolved)
    alias = repo / ".python/cpython-3.12-macos-aarch64-none"
    alias_info = alias.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISLNK(alias_info.st_mode), "managed Python alias is not a symlink")
    target = os.readlink(alias)
    require(os.path.isabs(target), "managed Python alias is relative")
    resolved_alias = alias.resolve(strict=True)
    require(resolved_alias.is_relative_to(repo / ".python"), "managed Python alias is external")
    links = [path for path in repo.rglob("*") if path.is_symlink()]
    unsafe = unsafe_links(repo)
    require(not unsafe and len(links) == 102, "post-setup link safety mismatch")
    readiness_probe = (
        "import json;from pathlib import Path;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.toolchain import ToolchainManager,toolchain_fingerprint;"
        "root=Path.cwd();issues=ToolchainManager(root).readiness_issues();"
        "print(json.dumps({'fingerprint':toolchain_fingerprint(root),'issues':issues},"
        "ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'),sort_keys=True))"
    )
    started = time.monotonic()
    readiness = bounded(
        [str(repo / ".venv/bin/python"), "-c", readiness_probe],
        repo,
        child_environment(Path(os.environ["HOME"]), Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])),
        120,
        65536,
    )
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    require_success(readiness, "readiness")
    require_empty_channel(readiness, "stderr")
    require(readiness["stdout"].count("\n") == 1, "readiness stdout shape mismatch")
    readiness_payload = json.loads(readiness["stdout"])
    require(
        readiness["stdout"].encode("utf-8") == compact(readiness_payload) + b"\n",
        "readiness stdout is not canonical",
    )
    issues = readiness_payload["issues"]
    fingerprint = readiness_payload["fingerprint"]
    require(issues == [], f"readiness issues: {issues}")
    require(isinstance(fingerprint, str) and len(fingerprint) == 64, "invalid toolchain fingerprint")
    require((repo / ".cache/playwright/ffmpeg-1011/ffmpeg-mac").is_file(), "Playwright ffmpeg missing")
    return {
        "alias": {"path": str(alias), "resolved": str(resolved_alias), "target": target},
        "canonical_manifest_sha256": sha(manifest),
        "source_validation": source_validation,
        "readiness_capture": readiness,
        "readiness_elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed, 6),
        "readiness_issues": issues,
        "roots": roots,
        "safe_links": len(links),
        "toolchain_fingerprint": fingerprint,
    }


def bounded_error(exc: BaseException) -> str:
    return (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048]


def seal_attempt(
    parent: Path,
    repo: Path | None,
    receipts: Path,
    verdict: str,
    error: str | None,
    frozen_preflight: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    outcomes: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def best_effort(label: str, operation: Any) -> Any:
        try:
            value = operation()
            outcomes[label] = value
            return value
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append({"error": bounded_error(exc), "step": label})
            return None

    def retain_or_write(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
            identity = hash_regular(path)
            require(identity["mode"] == "0600", f"existing receipt mode mismatch: {path}")
            require(identity["sha256"] == sha(payload), f"existing receipt bytes mismatch: {path}")
            return identity
        return write_exclusive(path, payload)

    preflight_payload = pretty(frozen_preflight)
    best_effort(
        "preflight-receipt",
        lambda: retain_or_write(receipts / "preflight-receipt.json", preflight_payload),
    )
    if error is not None:
        stop_payload = pretty(
            {
                "error": error,
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V8_STOP",
                "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
                "verdict": verdict,
            }
        )
        best_effort(
            "successor-v8-stop",
            lambda: retain_or_write(receipts / "successor-v8-stop.json", stop_payload),
        )

    def preserve_snapshot() -> dict[str, Any]:
        path = receipts / "preservation-receipt.json"
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
            identity = hash_regular(path)
            require(identity["mode"] == "0600", "existing preservation receipt mode mismatch")
            return identity
        payload = pretty(
            {
                "accepted_preallocation_snapshot": frozen_preflight,
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V8_PRESERVATION",
                "result": "FROZEN_PREALLOCATION_EVIDENCE",
            }
        )
        return write_exclusive(path, payload)

    best_effort("preservation-receipt", preserve_snapshot)
    repository_state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "manifest": b"",
        "totals": {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0},
    }

    def seal_repository() -> dict[str, Any]:
        if repo is not None and (repo.exists() or repo.is_symlink()):
            manifest, totals = tree_manifest(repo)
        else:
            manifest, totals = b"", {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0}
        repository_state["manifest"] = manifest
        repository_state["totals"] = totals
        identity = retain_or_write(receipts / "final-repository-manifest.jsonl", manifest)
        return {"identity": identity, **totals, "sha256": sha(manifest)}

    best_effort("final-repository-manifest", seal_repository)
    attempt_state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "manifest": b"",
        "totals": {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0},
    }

    def seal_attempt_tree() -> dict[str, Any]:
        manifest, totals = tree_manifest(parent)
        attempt_state["manifest"] = manifest
        attempt_state["totals"] = totals
        identity = retain_or_write(receipts / "final-attempt-manifest.jsonl", manifest)
        return {"identity": identity, **totals, "sha256": sha(manifest)}

    best_effort("final-attempt-manifest", seal_attempt_tree)
    files: dict[str, Any] = {}
    receipt_names = best_effort(
        "receipt-directory-list",
        lambda: sorted((path.name for path in receipts.iterdir()), key=os.fsencode),
    )
    if receipt_names is not None:
        for name in receipt_names:
            if name == "final-receipt-index.json":
                continue
            path = receipts / name
            identity = best_effort("receipt-identity:" + name, lambda path=path: hash_regular(path))
            if identity is not None:
                files[name] = identity
    required_before_index = {
        "preflight-receipt.json",
        "preservation-receipt.json",
        "final-repository-manifest.jsonl",
        "final-attempt-manifest.jsonl",
    }
    if error is not None:
        required_before_index.add("successor-v8-stop.json")
        dry_run_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_RECEIPTS
        )
        if dry_run_started:
            required_before_index.update(CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_RECEIPTS)
        profile_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in DOCTOR_PROFILE_RECEIPTS
        )
        if profile_started:
            required_before_index.update(DOCTOR_PROFILE_RECEIPTS)
        doctor_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in DOCTOR_CAPTURE_RECEIPTS
        )
        if doctor_started:
            required_before_index.update(DOCTOR_CAPTURE_RECEIPTS)
        successor_groups = (
            ("successor-v8-overlay.json",),
            (
                "successor-v8-loop-init-command.json",
                "successor-v8-loop-init-result.json",
                "successor-v8-initial-state.json",
                "successor-v8-initial-events.jsonl",
            ),
            (
                "successor-v8-trusted-context.json",
                "successor-v8-policy-snapshot.json",
                "successor-v8-toolchain-snapshot.json",
                "successor-v8-final-bindings.json",
            ),
        )
        for group in successor_groups:
            if any(
                (receipts / name).exists()
                or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
                for name in group
            ):
                required_before_index.update(group)
    else:
        required_before_index.update(
            set(SUCCESSOR_V8_RECEIPTS) - {"successor-v8-stop.json", "final-receipt-index.json"}
        )
    doctor_termination_evidence: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "NOT_STARTED"}

    def validate_doctor_termination_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
        command_path = receipts / "doctor-command.json"
        capture_path = receipts / "doctor-capture.json"
        validation_path = receipts / "doctor-validation.json"
        command_exists = command_path.exists() or command_path.is_symlink()
        capture_exists = capture_path.exists() or capture_path.is_symlink()
        validation_exists = validation_path.exists() or validation_path.is_symlink()
        if not command_exists and not capture_exists and not validation_exists:
            return {
                "capture_receipt": None,
                "child_started": None,
                "command_receipt": None,
                "lifecycle_state": "not-applicable",
                "returncode": None,
                "safe_to_seal": True,
                "status": "DOCTOR_PHASE_NOT_STARTED",
                "termination_proven": False,
                "validation_receipt": None,
            }
        require(
            command_exists and capture_exists and validation_exists,
            "doctor command/capture/validation receipt core incomplete",
        )
        require(repo is not None, "doctor receipt core exists without repository")
        command, command_identity = load_json(command_path)
        capture_receipt, capture_identity = load_json(capture_path)
        validation, validation_identity = load_json(validation_path)
        require(
            command_identity["mode"] == "0600"
            and capture_identity["mode"] == "0600"
            and validation_identity["mode"] == "0600",
            "doctor command/capture/validation receipt mode mismatch",
        )
        expected_command = {
            "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
            "argv": ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-doctor"],
            "cwd": str(repo),
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_COMMAND",
            "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "timeout_seconds": 300,
        }
        require(
            command == expected_command,
            "doctor command receipt contract mismatch",
        )
        require(
            capture_receipt["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE",
            "doctor capture receipt phase mismatch",
        )
        require(
            validation["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION",
            "doctor validation receipt phase mismatch",
        )
        require(
            validation["capture_receipt"] == capture_identity,
            "doctor validation does not bind capture receipt",
        )
        capture = capture_receipt["capture"]
        require(
            {
                "aggregate_limit_bytes": capture["aggregate_limit_bytes"],
                "argv": capture["argv"],
                "cwd": capture["cwd"],
                "stderr_limit_bytes": capture["stderr_limit_bytes"],
                "stdout_limit_bytes": capture["stdout_limit_bytes"],
                "timeout_seconds": capture["timeout_seconds"],
            }
            == {
                key: expected_command[key]
                for key in (
                    "aggregate_limit_bytes",
                    "argv",
                    "cwd",
                    "stderr_limit_bytes",
                    "stdout_limit_bytes",
                    "timeout_seconds",
                )
            },
            "doctor command/capture contract mismatch",
        )
        for field in (
            "child_started",
            "lifecycle_history",
            "lifecycle_state",
            "returncode",
            "session_observation",
            "termination",
            "timed_out",
        ):
            require(
                validation[field] == capture[field],
                "doctor capture/validation mismatch: " + field,
            )
        require(
            validation["raw_stdout"] == capture_receipt["raw_stdout"]
            and validation["raw_stderr"] == capture_receipt["raw_stderr"],
            "doctor raw-channel identity mismatch",
        )
        child_started = validation["child_started"]
        lifecycle_state = validation["lifecycle_state"]
        returncode = validation["returncode"]
        require(
            child_started is True or child_started is False or child_started is None,
            "invalid doctor child_started value",
        )
        require(
            lifecycle_state
            in ("not-started", "started", "terminated", "still-live", "indeterminate"),
            "invalid doctor lifecycle state",
        )
        if child_started is False:
            require(
                lifecycle_state == "not-started" and returncode is None,
                "spawn-failure doctor lifecycle mismatch",
            )
            status = "SPAWN_FAILED_NOT_STARTED"
            safe_to_seal = True
            termination_proven = False
        else:
            termination_proven = (
                lifecycle_state == "terminated" and returncode is not None
            )
            status = "TERMINATED" if termination_proven else "UNPROVEN"
            safe_to_seal = termination_proven
        return {
            "capture_receipt": capture_identity,
            "child_started": child_started,
            "command_receipt": command_identity,
            "lifecycle_state": lifecycle_state,
            "returncode": returncode,
            "safe_to_seal": safe_to_seal,
            "status": status,
            "termination_proven": termination_proven,
            "validation_receipt": validation_identity,
        }

    validated_doctor_termination = best_effort(
        "doctor-termination-evidence",
        validate_doctor_termination_evidence,
    )
    if validated_doctor_termination is None:
        doctor_termination_evidence = {"status": "INVALID_OR_UNAVAILABLE"}
    else:
        doctor_termination_evidence = validated_doctor_termination
        if not doctor_termination_evidence["safe_to_seal"]:
            errors.append(
                {
                    "error": (
                        "persisted doctor evidence does not prove child termination: "
                        + str(doctor_termination_evidence["child_started"])
                        + "/"
                        + doctor_termination_evidence["lifecycle_state"]
                    ),
                    "step": "doctor-child-termination-unproven",
                }
            )

    missing_before_index = sorted(required_before_index - set(files))
    if missing_before_index:
        errors.append({"error": ",".join(missing_before_index), "step": "required-receipts"})
    index = {
