def validate_final_context_shape(
    value: dict[str, Any],
    repo: Path,
    run_id: str,
    state_identity: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    require_exact_keys(
        value,
        frozenset({
            "authority_state",
            "blocked_predecessor",
            "candidate",
            "evidence",
            "finalized_documents",
            "format_version",
            "overlay",
            "record_kind",
            "run",
            "serialization",
        }),
        "trusted-context",
    )
    require(
        value["authority_state"] == "CONTROLLER_BOUND_FINAL",
        "context authority state mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["record_kind"] == "liveclip_m3_successor_trusted_context_v1",
        "context kind mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["candidate"]["root"] == str(repo),
        "context candidate root mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["candidate"]["source_kind"]
        == "FROZEN_B2_RECONSTRUCTION_NOT_DYG_COPY",
        "context source kind mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["run"]["run_id"] == run_id and run_id != BLOCKED_RUN_ID,
        "context run ID mismatch",
    )
    require(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", run_id)
        is not None,
        "context run ID shape mismatch",
    )
    require(value["run"]["state"] == "received", "context initial state mismatch")
    require(
        value["run"]["initial_state_sha256"] == state_identity["sha256"],
        "context state hash mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["overlay"]["paths"]
        == [
            "STATUS.md",
            TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix(),
            "docs/exec-plans/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2.md",
            "docs/requirements/liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md",
        ],
        "context overlay paths mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["evidence"]["b2_manifest_sha256"] == MANIFEST_SHA,
        "context B2 mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["blocked_predecessor"]["state_sha256"] == BLOCKED_STATE_SHA,
        "context blocked state mismatch",
    )
    require(
        value["serialization"]["terminal_lf"] is True,
        "context serialization mismatch",
    )


def successor_contract_self_test() -> dict[str, bool]:
    repo = BASE / "candidate.M3SSELFTEST/repo"
    run_id = "20990101T010203Z-1a2b3c4d"
    state_identity = {"sha256": "a" * 64, "size": 123}
    valid = final_context_record(
        repo,
        run_id,
        state_identity,
        "b" * 64,
        "c" * 64,
    )
    validate_final_context_shape(valid, repo, run_id, state_identity)

    def rejected(mutate: Any) -> bool:
        candidate = json.loads(json.dumps(valid))
        mutate(candidate)
        try:
            validate_final_context_shape(
                candidate,
                repo,
                run_id,
                state_identity,
            )
        except RuntimeError:
            return True
        return False

    cases = {
        "valid_final_record_accept": True,
        "extra_top_key_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item.__setitem__("extra", True)
        ),
        "blocked_run_id_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["run"].__setitem__(
                "run_id",
                BLOCKED_RUN_ID,
            )
        ),
        "wrong_candidate_root_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["candidate"].__setitem__(
                "root",
                str(M2_CANDIDATE / "repo"),
            )
        ),
        "schema_seed_authority_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item.__setitem__(
                "authority_state",
                "SCHEMA_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORITY",
            )
        ),
        "wrong_state_hash_reject": rejected(
            lambda item: item["run"].__setitem__(
                "initial_state_sha256",
                "d" * 64,
            )
        ),
    }
    require(all(cases.values()), "successor context self-test failed")
    return cases


def initialize_and_bind_successor(
    repo: Path,
    parent: Path,
    receipts: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    loop_root = repo / ".loop"
    require(
        not loop_root.exists() and not loop_root.is_symlink(),
        "pre-existing loop root",
    )
    context_path = repo / TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL
    context_directory = context_path.parent
    require(
        not context_path.exists() and not context_path.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context collision before init",
    )
    require(
        not context_directory.exists()
        and not context_directory.is_symlink(),
        "trusted-context directory collision before init",
    )
    argv = [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "loop-init",
        (
            "REQUIREMENT=docs/requirements/"
            "liveclip-agent-runtime-v2-acceptance-v2.md"
        ),
    ]
    command = {
        "argv": argv,
        "cwd": str(repo),
        "format_version": 1,
        "output_limit_bytes": 65536,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_LOOP_INIT_COMMAND",
        "timeout_seconds": 60,
    }
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-loop-init-command.json",
        pretty(command),
    )
    result = bounded(argv, repo, env, 60, 65536)
    result.update({"phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_LOOP_INIT"})
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-loop-init-result.json",
        pretty(result),
    )
    require_success(result, "loop-init")
    require_no_prompt_or_secret(result, "loop-init")
    runs_root = loop_root / "runs"
    require(
        runs_root.is_dir() and not runs_root.is_symlink(),
        "run root missing or unsafe",
    )
    run_dirs = sorted(
        (
            path
            for path in runs_root.iterdir()
            if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()
        ),
        key=lambda path: os.fsencode(path.name),
    )
    require(len(run_dirs) == 1, "loop-init did not create exactly one run")
    run_id = run_dirs[0].name
    require(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8}", run_id)
        is not None,
        "run ID mismatch",
    )
    require(run_id != BLOCKED_RUN_ID, "blocked run ID reused")
    state_path = run_dirs[0] / "state.json"
    events_path = run_dirs[0] / "events.jsonl"
    state, state_identity = load_json(state_path)
    require(state_identity["mode"] == "0644", "initial state mode mismatch")
    require_exact_keys(
        state,
        frozenset({
            "run_id",
            "requirement",
            "base_sha",
            "state",
            "cycle",
            "code_cycle",
            "coder_session_id",
            "artifacts",
            "command_results",
            "last_error",
        }),
        "initial state",
    )
    requirement_bytes, _ = read_regular(SUCCESSOR_REQUIREMENT)
    require(
        state
        == {
            "artifacts": {},
            "base_sha": HEAD,
            "code_cycle": 0,
            "coder_session_id": None,
            "command_results": [],
            "cycle": 0,
            "last_error": None,
            "requirement": requirement_bytes.decode("utf-8").strip(),
            "run_id": run_id,
            "state": "received",
        },
        "initial state content mismatch",
    )
    events_bytes, events_identity = read_regular(events_path)
    require(events_identity["mode"] == "0644", "initial events mode mismatch")
    event_lines = events_bytes.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    require(len(event_lines) == 1, "initial events count mismatch")
    event = json.loads(event_lines[0])
    require_exact_keys(
        event,
        frozenset({"kind", "payload", "state", "ts"}),
        "initial event",
    )
    require(
        event["kind"] == "run.created"
        and event["state"] == "received"
        and event["payload"] == {"base_sha": HEAD}
        and re.fullmatch(
            r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z",
            event["ts"],
        )
        is not None,
        "initial event mismatch",
    )
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-initial-state.json",
        pretty({
            "file": state_identity,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_INITIAL_STATE",
            "state": state,
        }),
    )
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-initial-events.jsonl",
        events_bytes,
    )
    context_directory.mkdir(mode=0o755, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    context_directory_info = context_directory.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISDIR(context_directory_info.st_mode)
        and not context_directory.is_symlink()
        and stat.S_IMODE(context_directory_info.st_mode) == 0o755,
        "trusted-context directory creation mismatch",
    )
    fsync_directory(context_directory.parent)
    fsync_directory(context_directory)
    context = final_context_record(
        repo,
        run_id,
        state_identity,
        plan_sha,
        status_sha,
    )
    validate_final_context_shape(context, repo, run_id, state_identity)
    context_identity = write_exclusive(context_path, pretty(context))
    require(context_identity["mode"] == "0600", "trusted-context mode mismatch")
    context_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-trusted-context.json",
        pretty({
            "file": context_identity,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_TRUSTED_CONTEXT",
            "record": context,
            "result": "PENDING_EXTERNAL_CONTROLLER_BINDING",
            "schema_seed_authority": False,
        }),
    )
    snapshot = policy_snapshot(repo)
    require(
        TRUSTED_CONTEXT_REL.as_posix() in snapshot,
        "trusted context absent from policy snapshot",
    )
    policy_payload = compact(snapshot)
    policy_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-policy-snapshot.json",
        pretty({
            "files": snapshot,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_POLICY_SNAPSHOT",
            "sha256": sha(policy_payload),
        }),
    )
    probe = (
        "import json;from pathlib import Path;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.store import fingerprint_worktree;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.toolchain import ToolchainManager;"
        "root=Path.cwd();trusted=ToolchainManager(root).prepare();"
        "print(json.dumps({'candidate_worktree':fingerprint_worktree(root),"
        "'snapshot_fingerprint':trusted.fingerprint,"
        "'snapshot_path':str(trusted.path),"
        "'source_fingerprint':trusted.source_fingerprint},"
        "ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,"
        "separators=(',',':'),sort_keys=True))"
    )
    toolchain_result = bounded(
        [str(repo / ".venv/bin/python"), "-c", probe],
        repo,
        env,
        300,
        65536,
        heartbeat=True,
    )
    require_success(toolchain_result, "trusted toolchain prepare")
    require_empty_channel(toolchain_result, "stderr")
    require(
        toolchain_result["stdout"].count("\n") == 1,
        "toolchain probe stdout mismatch",
    )
    toolchain = json.loads(toolchain_result["stdout"])
    require(
        toolchain_result["stdout"].encode("utf-8")
        == compact(toolchain) + b"\n",
        "toolchain probe output is not canonical",
    )
    snapshot_path = Path(toolchain["snapshot_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    require(
        snapshot_path.is_relative_to(parent / "home"),
        "toolchain snapshot is not candidate-private",
    )
    for key in (
        "candidate_worktree",
        "snapshot_fingerprint",
        "source_fingerprint",
    ):
        require(
            re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", toolchain[key]) is not None,
            "toolchain identity invalid",
        )
    toolchain_receipt = write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-toolchain-snapshot.json",
        pretty({
            "capture": toolchain_result,
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT",
            "result": "PASS",
            "toolchain": toolchain,
        }),
    )
    source_validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=True,
    )
    loop_run_argv = ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-run", "RUN_ID=" + run_id]
    bindings = {
        "candidate_root": str(repo),
        "candidate_worktree_sha256": toolchain["candidate_worktree"],
        "context": context_identity,
        "context_receipt": context_receipt,
        "format_version": 1,
        "future_loop_run_argv": loop_run_argv,
        "future_loop_run_argv_json_sha256": sha(argv_json(loop_run_argv)),
        "initial_events": events_identity,
        "initial_state": state_identity,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_FINAL_BINDINGS",
        "policy_receipt": policy_receipt,
        "policy_snapshot_sha256": sha(policy_payload),
        "run_id": run_id,
        "source_validation": source_validation,
        "toolchain_receipt": toolchain_receipt,
        "toolchain_snapshot_fingerprint": toolchain[
            "snapshot_fingerprint"
        ],
        "toolchain_source_fingerprint": toolchain["source_fingerprint"],
        "verdict": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
    }
    write_exclusive(
        receipts / "successor-v9-final-bindings.json",
        pretty(bindings),
    )
    return bindings


def setup_argv(repo: Path) -> list[str]:
    quoted = shlex.quote(str(repo / ".python"))
    return [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "UV=../../trusted-tools/uv-0.12.17/extracted/uv-aarch64-apple-darwin/uv",
        "UV_CACHE_DIR_LOCAL=.cache/uv",
        f"UV_ENV=UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR={quoted}",
        "setup",
    ]


def post_setup(
    repo: Path,
    plan_sha: str,
    status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_validation = validate_successor_source(
        repo,
        plan_sha=plan_sha,
        status_sha=status_sha,
        context_expected=False,
    )
    manifest, counts = canonical_manifest(repo)
    roots: dict[str, str] = {}
    for relative in (".python", ".venv", "apps/web/node_modules", ".cache/tiktoken", ".cache/playwright"):
        path = repo / relative
        require(path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe dependency root: {relative}")
        resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
        require(resolved.is_relative_to(repo), f"external dependency root: {relative}")
        roots[relative] = str(resolved)
    alias = repo / ".python/cpython-3.12-macos-aarch64-none"
    alias_info = alias.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISLNK(alias_info.st_mode), "managed Python alias is not a symlink")
    target = os.readlink(alias)
    require(os.path.isabs(target), "managed Python alias is relative")
    resolved_alias = alias.resolve(strict=True)
    require(resolved_alias.is_relative_to(repo / ".python"), "managed Python alias is external")
    links = [path for path in repo.rglob("*") if path.is_symlink()]
    unsafe = unsafe_links(repo)
    require(not unsafe and len(links) == 102, "post-setup link safety mismatch")
    readiness_probe = (
        "import json;from pathlib import Path;"
        "from tools.loop_engineering.toolchain import ToolchainManager,toolchain_fingerprint;"
        "root=Path.cwd();issues=ToolchainManager(root).readiness_issues();"
        "print(json.dumps({'fingerprint':toolchain_fingerprint(root),'issues':issues},"
        "ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'),sort_keys=True))"
    )
    started = time.monotonic()
    readiness = bounded(
        [str(repo / ".venv/bin/python"), "-c", readiness_probe],
        repo,
        child_environment(Path(os.environ["HOME"]), Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])),
        120,
        65536,
    )
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    require_success(readiness, "readiness")
    require_empty_channel(readiness, "stderr")
    require(readiness["stdout"].count("\n") == 1, "readiness stdout shape mismatch")
    readiness_payload = json.loads(readiness["stdout"])
    require(
        readiness["stdout"].encode("utf-8") == compact(readiness_payload) + b"\n",
        "readiness stdout is not canonical",
    )
    issues = readiness_payload["issues"]
    fingerprint = readiness_payload["fingerprint"]
    require(issues == [], f"readiness issues: {issues}")
    require(isinstance(fingerprint, str) and len(fingerprint) == 64, "invalid toolchain fingerprint")
    require((repo / ".cache/playwright/ffmpeg-1011/ffmpeg-mac").is_file(), "Playwright ffmpeg missing")
    return {
        "alias": {"path": str(alias), "resolved": str(resolved_alias), "target": target},
        "canonical_manifest_sha256": sha(manifest),
        "source_validation": source_validation,
        "readiness_capture": readiness,
        "readiness_elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed, 6),
        "readiness_issues": issues,
        "roots": roots,
        "safe_links": len(links),
        "toolchain_fingerprint": fingerprint,
    }


def bounded_error(exc: BaseException) -> str:
    return (type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))[:2048]


def seal_attempt(
    parent: Path,
    repo: Path | None,
    receipts: Path,
    verdict: str,
    error: str | None,
    frozen_preflight: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    outcomes: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def best_effort(label: str, operation: Any) -> Any:
        try:
            value = operation()
            outcomes[label] = value
            return value
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append({"error": bounded_error(exc), "step": label})
            return None

    def retain_or_write(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
            identity = hash_regular(path)
            require(identity["mode"] == "0600", f"existing receipt mode mismatch: {path}")
            require(identity["sha256"] == sha(payload), f"existing receipt bytes mismatch: {path}")
            return identity
        return write_exclusive(path, payload)

    preflight_payload = pretty(frozen_preflight)
    best_effort(
        "preflight-receipt",
        lambda: retain_or_write(receipts / "preflight-receipt.json", preflight_payload),
    )
    if error is not None:
        stop_payload = pretty(
            {
                "error": error,
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_STOP",
                "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
                "verdict": verdict,
            }
        )
        best_effort(
            "successor-v9-stop",
            lambda: retain_or_write(receipts / "successor-v9-stop.json", stop_payload),
        )

    def preserve_snapshot() -> dict[str, Any]:
        path = receipts / "preservation-receipt.json"
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
            identity = hash_regular(path)
            require(identity["mode"] == "0600", "existing preservation receipt mode mismatch")
            return identity
        payload = pretty(
            {
                "accepted_preallocation_snapshot": frozen_preflight,
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_PRESERVATION",
                "result": "FROZEN_PREALLOCATION_EVIDENCE",
            }
        )
        return write_exclusive(path, payload)

    best_effort("preservation-receipt", preserve_snapshot)
    repository_state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "manifest": b"",
        "totals": {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0},
    }

    def seal_repository() -> dict[str, Any]:
        if repo is not None and (repo.exists() or repo.is_symlink()):
            manifest, totals = tree_manifest(repo)
        else:
            manifest, totals = b"", {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0}
        repository_state["manifest"] = manifest
        repository_state["totals"] = totals
        identity = retain_or_write(receipts / "final-repository-manifest.jsonl", manifest)
        return {"identity": identity, **totals, "sha256": sha(manifest)}

    best_effort("final-repository-manifest", seal_repository)
    attempt_state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "manifest": b"",
        "totals": {"path_count": 0, "regular_file_bytes": 0},
    }

    def seal_attempt_tree() -> dict[str, Any]:
        manifest, totals = tree_manifest(parent)
        attempt_state["manifest"] = manifest
        attempt_state["totals"] = totals
        identity = retain_or_write(receipts / "final-attempt-manifest.jsonl", manifest)
        return {"identity": identity, **totals, "sha256": sha(manifest)}

    best_effort("final-attempt-manifest", seal_attempt_tree)
    files: dict[str, Any] = {}
    receipt_names = best_effort(
        "receipt-directory-list",
        lambda: sorted((path.name for path in receipts.iterdir()), key=os.fsencode),
    )
    if receipt_names is not None:
        for name in receipt_names:
            if name == "final-receipt-index.json":
                continue
            path = receipts / name
            identity = best_effort("receipt-identity:" + name, lambda path=path: hash_regular(path))
            if identity is not None:
                files[name] = identity
    required_before_index = {
        "preflight-receipt.json",
        "preservation-receipt.json",
        "final-repository-manifest.jsonl",
        "final-attempt-manifest.jsonl",
    }
    if error is not None:
        required_before_index.add("successor-v9-stop.json")
        dry_run_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_RECEIPTS
        )
        if dry_run_started:
            required_before_index.update(CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_RECEIPTS)
        profile_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in DOCTOR_PROFILE_RECEIPTS
        )
        if profile_started:
            required_before_index.update(DOCTOR_PROFILE_RECEIPTS)
        doctor_started = any(
            (receipts / name).exists() or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
            for name in DOCTOR_CAPTURE_RECEIPTS
        )
        if doctor_started:
            required_before_index.update(DOCTOR_CAPTURE_RECEIPTS)
        successor_groups = (
            ("successor-v9-overlay.json",),
            (
                "successor-v9-loop-init-command.json",
                "successor-v9-loop-init-result.json",
                "successor-v9-initial-state.json",
                "successor-v9-initial-events.jsonl",
            ),
            (
                "successor-v9-trusted-context.json",
                "successor-v9-policy-snapshot.json",
                "successor-v9-toolchain-snapshot.json",
                "successor-v9-final-bindings.json",
            ),
        )
        for group in successor_groups:
            if any(
                (receipts / name).exists()
                or (receipts / name).is_symlink()
                for name in group
            ):
                required_before_index.update(group)
    else:
        required_before_index.update(
            set(SUCCESSOR_V9_RECEIPTS) - {"successor-v9-stop.json", "final-receipt-index.json"}
        )
    doctor_termination_evidence: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "NOT_STARTED"}

    def validate_doctor_termination_evidence() -> dict[str, Any]:
        command_path = receipts / "doctor-command.json"
        capture_path = receipts / "doctor-capture.json"
        validation_path = receipts / "doctor-validation.json"
        command_exists = command_path.exists() or command_path.is_symlink()
        capture_exists = capture_path.exists() or capture_path.is_symlink()
        validation_exists = validation_path.exists() or validation_path.is_symlink()
        if not command_exists and not capture_exists and not validation_exists:
            return {
                "capture_receipt": None,
                "child_started": None,
                "command_receipt": None,
                "lifecycle_state": "not-applicable",
                "returncode": None,
                "safe_to_seal": True,
                "status": "DOCTOR_PHASE_NOT_STARTED",
                "termination_proven": False,
                "validation_receipt": None,
            }
        require(
            command_exists and capture_exists and validation_exists,
            "doctor command/capture/validation receipt core incomplete",
        )
        require(repo is not None, "doctor receipt core exists without repository")
        command, command_identity = load_json(command_path)
        capture_receipt, capture_identity = load_json(capture_path)
        validation, validation_identity = load_json(validation_path)
        require(
            command_identity["mode"] == "0600"
            and capture_identity["mode"] == "0600"
            and validation_identity["mode"] == "0600",
            "doctor command/capture/validation receipt mode mismatch",
        )
        expected_command = {
            "aggregate_limit_bytes": 131072,
            "argv": ["/usr/bin/make", "loop-doctor"],
            "cwd": str(repo),
            "format_version": 1,
            "phase": "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_COMMAND",
            "stderr_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "stdout_limit_bytes": 65536,
            "timeout_seconds": 300,
        }
        require(
            command == expected_command,
            "doctor command receipt contract mismatch",
        )
        require(
            capture_receipt["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_CAPTURE",
            "doctor capture receipt phase mismatch",
        )
        require(
            validation["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION",
            "doctor validation receipt phase mismatch",
        )
        require(
            validation["capture_receipt"] == capture_identity,
            "doctor validation does not bind capture receipt",
        )
        capture = capture_receipt["capture"]
        require(
            {
                "aggregate_limit_bytes": capture["aggregate_limit_bytes"],
                "argv": capture["argv"],
                "cwd": capture["cwd"],
                "stderr_limit_bytes": capture["stderr_limit_bytes"],
                "stdout_limit_bytes": capture["stdout_limit_bytes"],
                "timeout_seconds": capture["timeout_seconds"],
            }
            == {
                key: expected_command[key]
                for key in (
                    "aggregate_limit_bytes",
                    "argv",
                    "cwd",
                    "stderr_limit_bytes",
                    "stdout_limit_bytes",
                    "timeout_seconds",
                )
            },
            "doctor command/capture contract mismatch",
        )
        for field in (
            "child_started",
            "lifecycle_history",
            "lifecycle_state",
            "returncode",
            "session_observation",
            "termination",
            "timed_out",
        ):
            require(
                validation[field] == capture[field],
                "doctor capture/validation mismatch: " + field,
            )
        require(
            validation["raw_stdout"] == capture_receipt["raw_stdout"]
            and validation["raw_stderr"] == capture_receipt["raw_stderr"],
            "doctor raw-channel identity mismatch",
        )
        child_started = validation["child_started"]
        lifecycle_state = validation["lifecycle_state"]
        returncode = validation["returncode"]
        require(
            child_started is True or child_started is False or child_started is None,
            "invalid doctor child_started value",
        )
        require(
            lifecycle_state
            in ("not-started", "started", "terminated", "still-live", "indeterminate"),
            "invalid doctor lifecycle state",
        )
        if child_started is False:
            require(
                lifecycle_state == "not-started" and returncode is None,
                "spawn-failure doctor lifecycle mismatch",
            )
            status = "SPAWN_FAILED_NOT_STARTED"
            safe_to_seal = True
            termination_proven = False
        else:
            termination_proven = (
                lifecycle_state == "terminated" and returncode is not None
            )
            status = "TERMINATED" if termination_proven else "UNPROVEN"
            safe_to_seal = termination_proven
        return {
            "capture_receipt": capture_identity,
            "child_started": child_started,
            "command_receipt": command_identity,
            "lifecycle_state": lifecycle_state,
            "returncode": returncode,
            "safe_to_seal": safe_to_seal,
            "status": status,
            "termination_proven": termination_proven,
            "validation_receipt": validation_identity,
        }

    validated_doctor_termination = best_effort(
        "doctor-termination-evidence",
        validate_doctor_termination_evidence,
    )
    if validated_doctor_termination is None:
        doctor_termination_evidence = {"status": "INVALID_OR_UNAVAILABLE"}
    else:
        doctor_termination_evidence = validated_doctor_termination
        if not doctor_termination_evidence["safe_to_seal"]:
            errors.append(
                {
                    "error": (
                        "persisted doctor evidence does not prove child termination: "
                        + str(doctor_termination_evidence["child_started"])
                        + "/"
                        + doctor_termination_evidence["lifecycle_state"]
                    ),
                    "step": "doctor-child-termination-unproven",
                }
            )

    missing_before_index = sorted(required_before_index - set(files))
    if missing_before_index:
        errors.append({"error": ",".join(missing_before_index), "step": "required-receipts"})
    index = {
        "attempt_pre_index": {
            **attempt_state["totals"],
            "sha256": sha(attempt_state["manifest"]),
        },
        "doctor_termination_evidence": doctor_termination_evidence,
        "files": files,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_FINAL_INDEX",
        "repository": {
            **repository_state["totals"],
            "sha256": sha(repository_state["manifest"]),
        },
        "sealing_errors_before_index": list(errors),
        "verdict": verdict if not errors else verdict + "_SEALING_INCOMPLETE",
    }
    best_effort(
        "final-receipt-index",
        lambda: retain_or_write(receipts / "final-receipt-index.json", pretty(index)),
    )
    completed: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def complete_tree() -> dict[str, Any]:
        manifest, totals = tree_manifest(parent)
        completed.update({**totals, "sha256": sha(manifest)})
        return completed

    best_effort("completed-attempt-tree", complete_tree)
    required_final = required_before_index | {"final-receipt-index.json"}
    present_final = set()
    final_names = best_effort(
        "final-receipt-directory-list",
        lambda: sorted((path.name for path in receipts.iterdir()), key=os.fsencode),
    )
    if final_names is not None:
        present_final = set(final_names)
    missing_final = sorted(required_final - present_final)
    if missing_final:
        errors.append({"error": ",".join(missing_final), "step": "required-final-receipts"})
    sealing_complete = not errors
    return {
        **completed,
        "sealing_complete": sealing_complete,
        "sealing_errors": errors,
        "sealing_outcomes": outcomes,
        "verdict": verdict if sealing_complete else verdict + "_SEALING_INCOMPLETE",
    }


def execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    started = time.monotonic()
    initial_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])
    active_phase_check = validate_active_phase_names()
    execution_result = M2B / "receipts" / EXECUTION_RESULT_NAME
    current_argv = [str(PYTHON), str(DRIVER), *sys.argv[1:]]
    environment = validate_phase_environment(
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9",
        2730,
        current_argv,
        execution_result,
    )
    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("execute", values["expected_self_sha"])
    validate_wrapper(values["wrapper"], values["expected_wrapper_sha"])
    final_index = M2B / "receipts/final-index.json"
    require_identity(
        final_index,
        values["expected_bootstrap_final_index_sha256"],
        0o600,
    )
    index, _ = load_json(final_index)
    require(
        index["verdict"] == "M3S_V9_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3S final index verdict mismatch",
    )
    for key in (
        "transport_argv_json_sha256",
        "self_check_argv_json_sha256",
        "finalize_argv_json_sha256",
    ):
        require(index[key] == values["expected_" + key], key + " mismatch")
    os.environ["M3S_PLAN_SHA256"] = values["expected_plan_sha256"]
    os.environ["M3S_STATUS_SHA256"] = values["expected_status_sha256"]
    gates = read_only_gates(
        values,
        M2B / "home",
        M2B / "tmp",
        include_process_gate=True,
    )
    gates["active_phase_check"] = active_phase_check
    gates["driver_environment"] = environment
    gates["m2b_state"] = m2b_state
    require(
        time.monotonic() - started < 2700,
        "total deadline exhausted before allocation",
    )
    allocation = bounded(
        ["/usr/bin/mktemp", "-d", str(BASE / "candidate.XXXXXXXX")],
        BASE,
        child_environment(M2B / "home", M2B / "tmp"),
        10,
        65536,
    )
    require_success(allocation, "mktemp")
    require_empty_channel(allocation, "stderr")
    candidate_text = allocation["stdout"].strip()
    require(
        re.fullmatch(
            re.escape(str(BASE)) + r"/candidate\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+",
            candidate_text,
        )
        is not None,
        "mktemp path mismatch",
    )
    parent = Path(candidate_text)
    receipts = parent / "successor-receipts"
    repo: Path | None = parent / "repo"
    frozen_preflight = {
        "allocation": allocation,
        "driver_preallocation": initial_driver,
        "execute_argv_json_sha256": sha(argv_json(current_argv)),
        "format_version": 1,
        "gates": gates,
        "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_PREFLIGHT",
        "result": "STOPPED_BEFORE_POSTALLOCATION_IDENTITY",
    }
    try:
        require(
            parent.parent == BASE
            and parent.is_dir()
            and not parent.is_symlink(),
            "unsafe successor parent",
        )
        require(
            stat.S_IMODE(parent.lstat().st_mode) == 0o700,
            "successor parent mode mismatch",
        )
        current_identity = private_directory_identity(parent)
        frozen_preflight["authorized_current_candidate"] = current_identity
        for name in ("home", "tmp", "successor-receipts"):
            (parent / name).mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
        fsync_directory(parent)
        second_driver = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])
        frozen_preflight["driver_postallocation"] = second_driver
        require(
            (
                initial_driver["device"],
                initial_driver["inode"],
                initial_driver["size"],
                initial_driver["sha256"],
            )
            == (
                second_driver["device"],
                second_driver["inode"],
                second_driver["size"],
                second_driver["sha256"],
            ),
            "driver identity changed after allocation",
        )
        frozen_preflight["result"] = "PASS"
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "preflight-receipt.json",
            pretty(frozen_preflight),
        )
        repo, source_manifest = materialize(parent, receipts)
        require(
            sha(source_manifest) == MANIFEST_SHA,
            "materialized manifest mismatch",
        )
        overlay_successor_documents(
            repo,
            receipts,
            values["expected_plan_sha256"],
            values["expected_status_sha256"],
        )
        dry_env = child_environment(parent / "home", parent / "tmp")
        require_identity(UV, UV_SHA, 0o700, 37062400)
        validate_uv(parent / "home", parent / "tmp")
        require(
            2700 - (time.monotonic() - started) > 2310,
            "insufficient budget before setup",
        )
        setup = setup_argv(repo)
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "setup-command.json",
            pretty({
                "argv": setup,
                "cwd": str(repo),
                "format_version": 1,
                "output_limit_bytes": 1048576,
                "phase": "M2_SETUP_COMMAND",
                "timeout_seconds": 1800,
            }),
        )
        setup_result = bounded(
            setup,
            repo,
            dry_env,
            1800,
            1048576,
            heartbeat=True,
        )
        setup_result.update({"phase": "M2_SETUP"})
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "setup-result.json",
            pretty(setup_result),
        )
        require_success(setup_result, "setup")
        require_no_prompt_or_secret(setup_result, "setup")
        require(
            2700 - (time.monotonic() - started) > 720,
            "insufficient budget after setup",
        )
        post = post_setup(
            repo,
            values["expected_plan_sha256"],
            values["expected_status_sha256"],
        )
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "post-setup-receipt.json",
            pretty({
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M2_POST_SETUP",
                "result": "PASS",
                **post,
            }),
        )
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "readiness-result.json",
            pretty({
                "elapsed_seconds": post["readiness_elapsed_seconds"],
                "format_version": 1,
                "issues": post["readiness_issues"],
                "phase": "M2_READINESS",
                "result": "PASS",
            }),
        )
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "toolchain-fingerprint.json",
            pretty({
                "fingerprint": post["toolchain_fingerprint"],
                "format_version": 1,
                "phase": "M2_TOOLCHAIN_FINGERPRINT",
            }),
        )
        profiles = stage_doctor_profiles(repo, parent, receipts)
        require(profiles["result"] == "PASS", "doctor profile staging failed")
        doctor = capture_and_validate_doctor(repo, dry_env, receipts)
        require(doctor["result"] == "PASS", "loop-doctor validation failed")
        require(
            2700 - (time.monotonic() - started) > 360,
            "insufficient budget before init",
        )
        bindings = initialize_and_bind_successor(
            repo,
            parent,
            receipts,
            dry_env,
            values["expected_plan_sha256"],
            values["expected_status_sha256"],
        )
        require(
            bindings["verdict"]
            == "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
            "successor bindings verdict mismatch",
        )
        preserved = read_only_gates(
            values,
            parent / "home",
            parent / "tmp",
            include_process_gate=False,
            current_candidate=parent,
            expected_current_identity=current_identity,
        )
        write_exclusive(
            receipts / "preservation-receipt.json",
            pretty({
                "format_version": 1,
                "gates": preserved,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_PRESERVATION",
                "result": "PASS",
            }),
        )
        require(
            2700 - (time.monotonic() - started) > 30,
            "insufficient budget for sealing",
        )
        final = seal_attempt(
            parent,
            repo,
            receipts,
            "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
            None,
            frozen_preflight,
        )
        os.write(
            1,
            compact({
                "candidate": str(parent),
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9",
                "result": final,
            })
            + b"\n",
        )
        return 0 if final["sealing_complete"] else 1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = bounded_error(exc)
        if frozen_preflight["result"] != "PASS":
            frozen_preflight["postallocation_error"] = error
        final = seal_attempt(
            parent,
            repo,
            receipts,
            "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9_STOPPED",
            error,
            frozen_preflight,
        )
        os.write(
            1,
            compact({
                "candidate": str(parent),
                "error": error,
                "phase": "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_V9",
                "result": final,
            })
            + b"\n",
        )
        return 1


def main() -> int:
    command, values = parse_shape(sys.argv[1:])
    if command == "self-check":
        return self_check(values)
    if command == "finalize":
        return finalize(values)
    return execute(values)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def canonical_argv(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    return json.dumps(
        argv,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def lstat_regular(path: Path, expected_mode: int | None = None) -> os.stat_result:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"not regular: {path}")
    if expected_mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) == expected_mode, f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    return before


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 8_000_000) -> bytes:
    before = lstat_regular(path)
    require(before.st_size <= maximum, f"file too large: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size)
            == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
            f"opened identity mismatch: {path}",
        )
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1_048_576)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"read identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == before.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size),
        f"path identity changed: {path}",
    )
    return payload


def identity(path: Path, size: int | None, expected_sha: str, mode: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = read_regular(path)
    if size is not None:
        require(len(payload) == size, f"size mismatch: {path}")
    require(sha(payload) == expected_sha, f"hash mismatch: {path}")
    st = path.lstat()
    if mode is not None:
        require(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) == mode, f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    return {
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": expected_sha,
        "size": len(payload),
    }


def private_directory(path: Path, entries: set[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    st = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"not directory: {path}")
    require(st.st_uid == CURRENT_UID and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) == 0o700, f"private directory mismatch: {path}")
    actual = set(os.listdir(path))
    if entries is not None:
        require(actual == entries, f"directory entries mismatch: {path}")
    return {
        "device": st.st_dev,
        "entries": sorted(actual),
        "inode": st.st_ino,
        "mode": "0700",
        "owner_uid": st.st_uid,
        "path": str(path),
    }


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def phase_environment(
    phase: str,
    argv_bytes: bytes,
    result_path: Path | None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    env = {
        "BOUND_ARGV_JSON": argv_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
        "BOUND_PHASE": phase,
        "BOUND_TIMEOUT": str(PHASE_TIMEOUT),
        "CANDIDATE_REPO": str(SEED),
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
        "HOME": str(ROOT / "home"),
        "LANG": "C",
        "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE,
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "TMPDIR": str(ROOT / "tmp"),
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    if result_path is not None:
        env["RESULT_PATH"] = str(result_path)
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in env), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in env, "CODEX_HOME forbidden")

def drain(pipe: Any, target: bytearray, state: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> None:
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = pipe.read(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            with state["lock"]:
                state[name + "_observed"] += len(chunk)
                state["aggregate_observed"] += len(chunk)
                channel_remaining = CHANNEL_LIMIT - len(target)
                aggregate_remaining = AGGREGATE_LIMIT - state["retained_total"]
                retained = max(0, min(len(chunk), channel_remaining, aggregate_remaining))
                if retained:
                    target.extend(chunk[:retained])
                    state["retained_total"] += retained
                if retained < len(chunk):
                    state[name + "_truncated"] = True
                if state["aggregate_observed"] > AGGREGATE_LIMIT:
                    state["aggregate_truncated"] = True
    except BaseException as exc:
        with state["lock"]:
            state["capture_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    finally:
        try:
            pipe.close()
        except BaseException as exc:
            with state["lock"]:
                state["capture_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))


def terminate_group(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes], errors: list[str]) -> None:
    try:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("TERM " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        return
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        pass
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("TERM wait " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
    try:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return
    except BaseException as exc:
        errors.append("KILL " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))


def capture(argv: list[str], cwd: Path, env: dict[str, str], timeout: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "capture argv invalid")
    require(cwd.is_dir() and not cwd.is_symlink(), "capture cwd unsafe")
    stdout = bytearray()
    stderr = bytearray()
    state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "aggregate_observed": 0,
        "aggregate_truncated": False,
        "capture_errors": [],
        "lock": threading.Lock(),
        "retained_total": 0,
        "stderr_observed": 0,
        "stderr_truncated": False,
        "stdout_observed": 0,
        "stdout_truncated": False,
        "termination_errors": [],
    }
    started_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - argv and environment are fixed and validated
        argv,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=env,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True,
        shell=False,
    )
    require(process.stdout is not None and process.stderr is not None, "capture pipe unavailable")
    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=(process.stdout, stdout, state, "stdout"), daemon=True),
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=(process.stderr, stderr, state, "stderr"), daemon=True),
    ]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    timed_out = False
    try:
        returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        terminate_group(process, state["termination_errors"])
        try:
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=5)
        except BaseException as exc:
            state["termination_errors"].append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
            returncode = None
    finally:
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join(timeout=5)
        if any(thread.is_alive() for thread in threads):
            state["capture_errors"].append("drain thread still alive")
            terminate_group(process, state["termination_errors"])
    finished_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return {
        "aggregate_limit": AGGREGATE_LIMIT,
        "aggregate_observed": state["aggregate_observed"],
        "aggregate_truncated": state["aggregate_truncated"],
        "argv": argv,
        "capture_errors": state["capture_errors"],
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "finished_at_utc": finished_at_utc,
        "returncode": returncode,
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
        "stderr": bytes(stderr),
        "stderr_limit": CHANNEL_LIMIT,
        "stderr_observed": state["stderr_observed"],
        "stderr_truncated": state["stderr_truncated"],
        "stdout": bytes(stdout),
        "stdout_limit": CHANNEL_LIMIT,
        "stdout_observed": state["stdout_observed"],
        "stdout_truncated": state["stdout_truncated"],
        "termination_errors": state["termination_errors"],
        "timed_out": timed_out,
    }


def require_capture_pass(result: dict[str, Any], label: str) -> None:
    require(result["returncode"] == 0, label + " return code")
    require(result["timed_out"] is False, label + " timeout")
    require(result["stdout_truncated"] is False, label + " stdout truncation")
    require(result["stderr_truncated"] is False, label + " stderr truncation")
    require(result["aggregate_truncated"] is False, label + " aggregate truncation")
    require(result["capture_errors"] == [], label + " capture error")
    require(result["termination_errors"] == [], label + " termination error")
    require(result["stderr"] == b"", label + " stderr nonempty")


def require_git_capture_pass(result: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    require(result["returncode"] == 0, "git preflight return code")
    require(result["timed_out"] is False, "git preflight timeout")
    require(result["stdout_truncated"] is False, "git preflight stdout truncation")
    require(result["stderr_truncated"] is False, "git preflight stderr truncation")
    require(result["aggregate_truncated"] is False, "git preflight aggregate truncation")
    require(result["capture_errors"] == [], "git preflight capture error")
    require(result["termination_errors"] == [], "git preflight termination error")
    stderr = result["stderr"]
    if stderr == b"":
        return "EMPTY"
    require(
        len(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SIZE and sha(stderr) == GIT_WARNING_SHA,
        "git preflight stderr mismatch",
    )
    return "DARWIN_CONFSTR_WARNING"


def read_only_git(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    result = capture(
        argv,
        DELIVERY,
        {
            "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
            "HOME": "/Users/junhuaxu",
            "LANG": "C",
            "LC_ALL": "C",
            "PATH": PATH_VALUE,
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
            "TMPDIR": "/tmp",  # noqa: S108 - fixed zero-write pre-root environment
            "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
        },
        30,
    )
    variant = require_git_capture_pass(result)
    return result["stdout"], variant


def validate_inventory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    branch, branch_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "branch", "--show-current"]
    )
    head, head_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]
    )
    status, status_stderr = read_only_git(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(DELIVERY), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"]
    )
    require(branch == (EXPECTED_BRANCH + "\n").encode(), "branch mismatch")
    require(head == (EXPECTED_HEAD + "\n").encode(), "HEAD mismatch")
    lines = status.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    staged = sum(1 for line in lines if line[:1] not in {" ", "?"})
    modified = sum(1 for line in lines if len(line) > 1 and line[1] not in {" ", "?"})
    untracked = sum(1 for line in lines if line.startswith("??"))
    require((staged, modified, untracked) == (EXPECTED_STAGED, EXPECTED_MODIFIED, EXPECTED_UNTRACKED), "inventory mismatch")
    candidates = sorted(
        path.name
        for path in BASE.iterdir()
        if path.name.startswith("candidate.") and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink()
    )
    require(len(candidates) == EXPECTED_CANDIDATES, "candidate count mismatch")
    return {
        "branch": EXPECTED_BRANCH,
        "candidates": len(candidates),
        "head": EXPECTED_HEAD,
        "modified": modified,
        "staged": staged,
        "untracked": untracked,
        "stderr_contracts": {
            "branch": branch_stderr,
            "head": head_stderr,
            "status": status_stderr,
        },
    }


def validate_retained_roots() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for version, identities in (("v1", V1_IDENTITIES), ("v2", V2_IDENTITIES), ("v3", V3_IDENTITIES)):
        root = BASE / ("trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-" + version)
        private_directory(root, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
        private_directory(root / "home", set())
        private_directory(root / "tmp", set())
        private_directory(root / "receipts", {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"})
        result[version] = {
            name: identity(root / name, size, digest, 0o600)
            for name, (size, digest) in identities.items()
        }
    private_directory(V4_ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V4_ROOT / "receipts", set())
    for relative in V4_ABSENT:
        path = V4_ROOT / relative
        require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "V4 absent artifact appeared")
    result["v4"] = {
        "absent": list(V4_ABSENT),
        "failure": "ReferenceError: " + "Text" + "Encoder is not defined",
        "root_budget": "CONSUMED",
        "wrapper_or_subprocess_ran": False,
    }
    result["v5"] = validate_v5_stopped()
    result["v6"] = validate_v6_stopped()
    result["v7"] = validate_v7_stopped()
    result["v8"] = validate_v8_procedural_stop()
    return result


def validate_v5_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    private_directory(V5_ROOT, {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"})
    private_directory(V5_ROOT / "home", set())
    private_directory(V5_ROOT / "tmp", set())
    private_directory(V5_ROOT / "receipts", {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"})
    files = {name: identity(V5_ROOT / name, size, digest_value, 0o600) for name, (size, digest_value) in V5_IDENTITIES.items()}
    source = json.loads(read_regular(V5_ROOT / "receipts/source-receipt.json").decode("utf-8"))
    stopped = json.loads(read_regular(V5_ROOT / "receipts/self-check-result.json").decode("utf-8"))
    require(source["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE" and source["returncode"] == 0 and source["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.086361 and source["timed_out"] is False and source["output_truncated"] is False and source["session_id"] is None and source["credential_variables"] == [] and source["wrapper_error"] is None, "V5 source receipt mismatch")
    require(sha(canonical_argv(source["argv"])) == V5_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA, "V5 transport argv mismatch")
    summary = json.loads(source["output"])
    require(summary["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SOURCE_WRITE" and summary["file_fsync"] is True and summary["directory_fsync"] is True, "V5 source output mismatch")
    require(stopped["phase"] == "M3S_V5_SELF_CHECK" and stopped["returncode"] == 1 and stopped["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.08542 and stopped["timed_out"] is False and stopped["output_truncated"] is False and stopped["session_id"] is None and stopped["credential_variables"] == [] and stopped["wrapper_error"] is None, "V5 self-check receipt mismatch")
    require(sha(canonical_argv(stopped["argv"])) == V5_SELF_ARGV_SHA, "V5 self-check argv mismatch")
    require(stopped["output"].endswith(V5_FAILURE + "\n"), "V5 failure mismatch")
    for relative in V5_ABSENT:
        path = V5_ROOT / relative
        require(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), "V5 absent artifact appeared")
    v3_bytes = read_regular(BASE / "trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v3/candidate-driver.py")
    require(v3_bytes.count(b"set(CANDIDATE_" + b"RECEIPTS)") == 5, "V3 five-use shared receipt evidence mismatch")
    return {"budget": "CONSUMED_NO_REUSE", "failure": V5_FAILURE, "files": files, "v3_shared_receipt_tuple_uses": 5}
