```python
def validate_protected() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = {
        "protected": identity(PROTECTED, PROTECTED_SIZE, PROTECTED_SHA, 0o600),
        "completed": identity(COMPLETED, COMPLETED_SIZE, COMPLETED_SHA),
        "m2_result": identity(M2_RESULT, M2_RESULT_SIZE, M2_RESULT_SHA, 0o600),
        "m2_index": identity(M2_INDEX, M2_INDEX_SIZE, M2_INDEX_SHA, 0o600),
    }
    result["blocked"] = {
        name: identity(BLOCKED / name, size, digest)
        for name, (size, digest) in BLOCKED_IDENTITIES.items()
    }
    result["m2_final_attempt_manifest"] = identity(
        BASE / "candidate.dygENR4n/receipts/final-attempt-manifest.jsonl",
        M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE,
        M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA,
        0o600,
    )
    m2_index = json.loads(read_regular(M2_INDEX).decode("utf-8"))
    m2_outer = json.loads(read_regular(M2_RESULT).decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        m2_index["verdict"] == "M2_PASS"
        and m2_outer["returncode"] == 0
        and m2_outer["timed_out"] is False
        and m2_outer["output_truncated"] is False
        and m2_outer["session_id"] is None
        and m2_outer["credential_variables"] == []
        and m2_outer["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "M2 final wrapper/index mismatch",
    )
    outer_result = json.loads(m2_outer["output"])["result"]
    index_manifest = m2_index["files"]["final-attempt-manifest.jsonl"]
    index_summary = m2_index["attempt_pre_index"]
    outer_manifest = outer_result["sealing_outcomes"]["final-attempt-manifest"]
    outer_completed = outer_result["sealing_outcomes"]["completed-attempt-tree"]
    require(
        index_manifest["size"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE
        and index_manifest["sha256"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA
        and index_summary == {
            "path_count": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_PATH_COUNT,
            "regular_file_bytes": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_REGULAR_BYTES,
            "sha256": M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA,
        }
        and outer_manifest["identity"]["size"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SIZE
        and outer_manifest["identity"]["sha256"] == M2_FINAL_ATTEMPT_MANIFEST_SHA
        and {
            "path_count": outer_manifest["path_count"],
            "regular_file_bytes": outer_manifest["regular_file_bytes"],
            "sha256": outer_manifest["sha256"],
        } == index_summary,
        "M2 final-attempt manifest binding mismatch",
    )
    require(
        outer_completed == {
            "path_count": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_PATH_COUNT,
            "regular_file_bytes": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_REGULAR_BYTES,
            "sha256": M2_COMPLETED_ATTEMPT_TREE_SHA,
        }
        and {
            "path_count": outer_result["path_count"],
            "regular_file_bytes": outer_result["regular_file_bytes"],
            "sha256": outer_result["sha256"],
        } == outer_completed,
        "M2 completed-attempt tree binding mismatch",
    )
    result["m2_semantic_split"] = {
        "completed_attempt_tree": outer_completed,
        "final_attempt_manifest": index_summary,
    }
    return result


def inspect_call_policy(source: bytes, filename: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=filename)
    imports: set[str] = set()
    popen_count = 0
    violations: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            continue
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            direct_name = node.func.id
            if direct_name in {"eval", "exec", "compile", "input"}:
                violations.append("direct_builtin:" + direct_name)
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
            continue
        name = node.func.attr
        owner = node.func.value.id if isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name) else ""
        if owner == "os" and name in {"system", "popen"}:
            violations.append("os_command:" + name)
        if owner == "subprocess" and name in {"run", "call", "check_call", "check_output"}:
            violations.append("subprocess_helper:" + name)
        if owner == "subprocess" and name == "Popen":
            popen_count += 1
            keywords = {item.arg: item.value for item in node.keywords}
            shell_value = keywords.get("shell")
            if not (
                isinstance(shell_value, ast.Constant)
                and shell_value.value is False
            ):
                violations.append("subprocess_Popen:shell_not_false")
    return {
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "popen_count": popen_count,
        "violations": violations,
    }


def validate_source_policy(source: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy = inspect_call_policy(source, "<m3s-v11-orchestration-v1>")
    require(policy["violations"] == [], "forbidden dynamic or command call")
    require(
        not set(policy["imports"]).intersection(
            {"socket", "urllib", "http", "requests", "aiohttp"}
        ),
        "network import forbidden",
    )
    require(policy["popen_count"] == 1, "unexpected Popen surface")

    safe_qualified = inspect_call_policy(
        b"import re\npattern = re.compile(r'x')\n",
        "<qualified-re-compile-positive-fixture>",
    )
    require(
        safe_qualified["violations"] == []
        and safe_qualified["popen_count"] == 0,
        "qualified re.compile fixture rejected",
    )
    negative_fixtures = {
        "direct_eval": (
            b"eval('x')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:eval"],
        ),
        "direct_exec": (
            b"exec('x')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:exec"],
        ),
        "direct_compile": (
            b"compile('x', '<x>', 'exec')\n",
            ["direct_builtin:compile"],
        ),
        "direct_input": (
            b"input()\n",
            ["direct_builtin:input"],
        ),
        "os_system": (
            b"import os\nos.system('x')\n",
            ["os_command:system"],
        ),
        "os_popen": (
            b"import os\nos.popen('x')\n",
            ["os_command:popen"],
        ),
        "subprocess_run": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.run(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:run"],
        ),
        "subprocess_call": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.call(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:call"],
        ),
        "subprocess_check_call": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.check_call(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:check_call"],
        ),
        "subprocess_check_output": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.check_output(['x'])\n",
            ["subprocess_helper:check_output"],
        ),
        "subprocess_popen_shell_true": (
            b"import subprocess\nsubprocess.Popen(['x'], shell=True)\n",
            ["subprocess_Popen:shell_not_false"],
        ),
    }
    negative_results: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for fixture_name, (fixture_source, expected) in negative_fixtures.items():
        observed = inspect_call_policy(
            fixture_source,
            "<negative-" + fixture_name + ">",
        )
        require(observed["violations"] == expected, fixture_name + " fixture mismatch")
        negative_results[fixture_name] = observed["violations"]

    forbidden = (
        b"Text" + b"Encoder",
        b"Java" + b"Script",
        b"$" + b"(",
        b"<" + b"<",
        b"sys." + b"stdin",
    )
    require(all(token not in source for token in forbidden), "prohibited orchestration token")
    require(b"/usr/bin/" + b"python3" not in source, "host python forbidden")
    require(b"python" + b" -" not in source, "python dash forbidden")
    return {
        "canonical_json": "json.dumps ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False separators comma-colon",
        "direct_argv_only": True,
        "imports": policy["imports"],
        "negative_fixtures": negative_results
        | {
            "command_substitution_absent": True,
            "heredoc_absent": True,
            "host_python_absent": True,
            "js_runtime_absent": True,
            "python_dash_absent": True,
            "shell_true_absent": True,
            "stdin_source_absent": True,
            "text_encoder_absent": True,
            "unfrozen_source_absent": True,
        },
        "popen_shell_false_count": policy["popen_count"],
        "qualified_re_compile_positive_fixture": "PASS",
        "self_policy_violations": policy["violations"],
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    require(sys.argv[0] == "-c", "orchestrator must use literal -c source")
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "orchestrator argv separator missing")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-orchestrator-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-wrapper-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-finalize-argv-json-sha256", required=True)
    return parser.parse_args(tokens[1:])


def construct_commands(args: argparse.Namespace, plan_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(args.plan) == PLAN and Path(args.status) == STATUS, "document path mismatch")
    writer = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    driver = extract_once(plan_bytes, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    orchestrator = extract_once(plan_bytes, ORCHESTRATOR_BEGIN, ORCHESTRATOR_END)
    require((len(writer), sha(writer)) == (args.expected_writer_size, args.expected_writer_sha256), "writer identity mismatch")
    require((len(driver), sha(driver)) == (args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256), "driver identity mismatch")
    require(
        (len(orchestrator), sha(orchestrator))
        == (args.expected_orchestrator_size, args.expected_orchestrator_sha256),
        "orchestrator identity mismatch",
    )
    source_policy = validate_source_policy(orchestrator)
    transport = [
        str(PYTHON),
        "-c",
        writer.decode("utf-8"),
        "--",
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--begin-marker",
        DRIVER_BEGIN[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--end-marker",
        DRIVER_END[:-1].decode("ascii"),
        "--destination",
        str(DRIVER),
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-driver-size",
        str(args.expected_driver_size),
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
    ]
    transport_json = canonical_argv(transport)
    require(sha(transport_json) == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256, "transport argv hash mismatch")
    self_check = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "self-check",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--wrapper",
        str(WRAPPER),
        "--expected-wrapper-sha",
        args.expected_wrapper_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-writer-size",
        str(args.expected_writer_size),
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        args.expected_writer_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
    ]
    self_check_json = canonical_argv(self_check)
    require(sha(self_check_json) == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256, "self-check argv hash mismatch")
    finalize = [
        str(PYTHON),
        str(DRIVER),
        "finalize",
        "--expected-self-sha",
        args.expected_driver_sha256,
        "--plan",
        str(PLAN),
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        args.expected_plan_sha256,
        "--status",
        str(STATUS),
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        args.expected_status_sha256,
        "--expected-transport-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
        "--expected-self-check-argv-json-sha256",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
        "--source-receipt",
        str(RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json"),
        "--writer-self-test",
        str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
        "--self-check-result",
        str(RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json"),
    ]
    finalize_json = canonical_argv(finalize)
    require(sha(finalize_json) == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256, "finalize argv hash mismatch")
    require((len(transport), len(self_check), len(finalize)) == (26, 25, 23), "root argv count mismatch")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "finalize": finalize,
        "finalize_json": finalize_json,
        "orchestrator": orchestrator,
        "self_check": self_check,
        "self_check_json": self_check_json,
        "source_policy": source_policy,
        "transport": transport,
        "transport_json": transport_json,
        "writer": writer,
    }


def preflight(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    environment = preflight_environment()
    require(str(PYTHON) == "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12", "pinned Python path mismatch")
    resolved_python = PYTHON.resolve(strict=True)
    require(resolved_python.is_file() and not resolved_python.is_symlink(), "resolved pinned Python unsafe")
    python_identity = identity(resolved_python, None, PYTHON_SHA)
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V11 root already exists")
    require(ROOT.parent.is_dir() and not ROOT.parent.is_symlink(), "trusted-tools parent unsafe")
    plan_bytes = read_regular(PLAN, maximum=LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)
    status_bytes = read_regular(STATUS)
    require(sha(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(sha(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")
    require(len(plan_bytes) <= LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES, "closed V11 plan exceeds explicit bound")
    require(V9_PLAN_SIZE > V9_LEGACY_PLAN_LIMIT, "V9 legacy-bound fixture mismatch")
    commands = construct_commands(args, plan_bytes)
    wrapper = identity(WRAPPER, WRAPPER_SIZE, args.expected_wrapper_sha256, 0o600)
    require(args.expected_wrapper_sha256 == WRAPPER_SHA, "wrapper authority mismatch")
    retained = validate_retained_roots()
    protected = validate_protected()
    inventory = validate_inventory()
    require(not ROOT.exists() and not ROOT.is_symlink(), "V11 root appeared during preflight")
    return {
        "commands": commands,
        "documents": {
            "plan": {"path": str(PLAN), "sha256": args.expected_plan_sha256, "size": len(plan_bytes)},
            "status": {"path": str(STATUS), "sha256": args.expected_status_sha256, "size": len(status_bytes)},
        },
        "environment": environment,
        "inventory": inventory,
        "protected": protected,
        "retained": retained,
        "python": python_identity,
        "wrapper": wrapper,
    }


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def create_root() -> dict[str, Any]:
    os.mkdir(ROOT, 0o700)
    fsync_directory(ROOT.parent)
    created = ["root"]
    try:
        for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
            os.mkdir(ROOT / name, 0o700)
            fsync_directory(ROOT)
            created.append(name)
    finally:
        fsync_directory(ROOT)
    return {
        "created": created,
        "home": private_directory(ROOT / "home", set()),
        "receipts": private_directory(ROOT / "receipts", set()),
        "root": private_directory(ROOT, {"home", "tmp", "receipts"}),
        "tmp": private_directory(ROOT / "tmp", set()),
    }


def receipt_result(path: Path, phase: str, argv_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = read_regular(path)
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "wrapper receipt is not object")
    require(
        value["phase"] == phase
        and value["returncode"] == 0
        and value["timed_out"] is False
        and value["output_truncated"] is False
        and value["session_id"] is None
        and value["credential_variables"] == []
        and value["wrapper_error"] is None,
        phase + " wrapper result mismatch",
    )
    require(sha(canonical_argv(value["argv"])) == argv_hash, phase + " receipt argv mismatch")
    st = lstat_regular(path, 0o600)
    return {
        "elapsed_seconds": value["elapsed_seconds"],
        "mode": "0600",
        "path": str(path),
        "phase": phase,
        "sha256": sha(payload),
        "size": len(payload),
        "stdout_summary": value["output"],
        "inode": st.st_ino,
    }


def invoke_root_phases(pre: dict[str, Any], args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    commands = pre["commands"]
    transport_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V11_SOURCE_WRITE",
            commands["transport_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(transport_outer, "transport outer")
    transport_summary = json.loads(transport_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        transport_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V11_SOURCE_WRITE"
        and transport_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and transport_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and transport_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and transport_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "transport outer summary mismatch",
    )
    driver = identity(DRIVER, args.expected_driver_size, args.expected_driver_sha256, 0o600)
    source_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "source-receipt.json",
        "M3S_V11_SOURCE_WRITE",
        args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_outer = capture(
        [str(PYTHON), str(WRAPPER)],
        SEED,
        phase_environment(
            "M3S_V11_SELF_CHECK",
            commands["self_check_json"],
            RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        ),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(self_outer, "self-check outer")
    self_summary = json.loads(self_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        self_summary["phase"] == "M3S_V11_SELF_CHECK"
        and self_summary["returncode"] == 0
        and self_summary["timed_out"] is False
        and self_summary["output_truncated"] is False
        and self_summary["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "self-check outer summary mismatch",
    )
    self_receipt = receipt_result(
        RECEIPTS / "self-check-result.json",
        "M3S_V11_SELF_CHECK",
        args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    self_output = json.loads(self_receipt["stdout_summary"])
    require(self_output["result"] == "PASS", "self-check did not PASS")
    writer_test_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json")
    writer_test = json.loads(writer_test_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        writer_test["phase"] == "M3S_V11_WRITER_SELF_TEST"
        and writer_test["error"] is None
        and writer_test["no_replace_existing_source_receipt"] is True,
        "writer self-test mismatch",
    )
    finalize_outer = capture(
        commands["finalize"],
        SEED,
        phase_environment("M3S_V11_FINALIZE", commands["finalize_json"], None),
        OUTER_TIMEOUT,
    )
    require_capture_pass(finalize_outer, "finalize outer")
    finalize_summary = json.loads(finalize_outer["stdout"].decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        finalize_summary
        == {
            "phase": "M3S_V11_FINAL_INDEX",
            "result": "M3S_V11_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        },
        "finalize summary mismatch",
    )
    final_payload = read_regular(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json")
    final_index = json.loads(final_payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(
        final_index["phase"] == "M3S_V11_FINAL_INDEX"
        and final_index["verdict"] == "M3S_V11_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW"
        and final_index["transport_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["self_check_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256
        and final_index["finalize_argv_json_sha256"] == args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
        "final index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(ROOT)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "final root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(
        set(os.listdir(RECEIPTS))
        == {"source-receipt.json", "writer-self-test.json", "self-check-result.json", "final-index.json"},
        "final receipt set mismatch",
    )
    require(not (RECEIPTS / "successor-preparation-v11-result.json").exists(), "reserved result appeared")
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "final_index": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'final-index.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "final-index.json"),
            "sha256": sha(final_payload),
            "size": len(final_payload),
            "verdict": final_index["verdict"],
        },
        "finalize_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": finalize_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(finalize_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": self_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(self_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(self_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "self_check_receipt": self_receipt,
        "source_receipt": source_receipt,
        "transport_outer": {
            "elapsed_seconds": transport_outer["elapsed_seconds"],
            "stderr_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stderr"]),
            "stdout_sha256": sha(transport_outer["stdout"]),
        },
        "writer_self_test": {
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE((RECEIPTS / 'writer-self-test.json').lstat().st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(RECEIPTS / "writer-self-test.json"),
            "sha256": sha(writer_test_payload),
            "size": len(writer_test_payload),
        },
    }


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    started_at_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = time.monotonic()
    root_created = False
    try:
        pre = preflight(args)
        root_state = create_root()
        root_created = True
        phases = invoke_root_phases(pre, args)
        output = {
            "argv_hashes": {
                "finalize": args.expected_finalize_argv_json_sha256,
                "self_check": args.expected_self_check_argv_json_sha256,
                "transport": args.expected_transport_argv_json_sha256,
            },
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "orchestration": {
                "sha256": args.expected_orchestrator_sha256,
                "size": args.expected_orchestrator_size,
                "source_policy": pre["commands"]["source_policy"],
            },
            "phases": phases,
            "root": root_state,
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V11_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        }
        os.write(1, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 0
    except BaseException as exc:
        output = {
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
            "error": type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc),
            "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "root_created": root_created or ROOT.exists() or ROOT.is_symlink(),
            "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
            "verdict": "M3S_V11_ORCHESTRATION_V1_STOPPED",
        }
        os.write(2, compact(output) + b"\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:

def canonical_argv(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:

    return json.dumps(

        allow_nan=False,

def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1 and payload.count(end) == 1, "marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end, start)
    require(start <= finish, "marker order mismatch")
    return payload[start:finish]


def build_outer_argv(

def expected_token_vector(outer_argv: list[str]) -> list[bytes]:

def validate_control_bytes(value: bytes, token_index: int) -> None:

        elif byte < 32 or byte == 127:
            raise RuntimeError("forbidden control byte")


def quote_token(value: bytes, token_index: int) -> bytes:

    validate_control_bytes(value, token_index)
    return b"'" + value.replace(b"'", QUOTE_ESCAPE) + b"'"


def render_tokens(tokens: list[bytes]) -> bytes:
    return PREFIX + b" ".join(
        quote_token(value, index) for index, value in enumerate(tokens)
    ) + SUFFIX

    source = tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX]
    require((len(source), sha(source)) == (ORCHESTRATOR_SIZE, ORCHESTRATOR_SHA), "source identity mismatch")
    require(source.count(b"\n") == SOURCE_LF_COUNT, "source LF count mismatch")
    require(source.count(b"'") == SOURCE_SINGLE_QUOTE_COUNT, "source quote count mismatch")
    for index, token in enumerate(tokens):
        validate_control_bytes(token, index)
        if index != SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX:
            require(b"\n" not in token, "LF outside source token")


def build_envelope(outer_argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    tokens = expected_token_vector(outer_argv)
    validate_token_vector(tokens, outer_argv)
    command = render_tokens(tokens)
    require(command.startswith(PREFIX) and command.endswith(SUFFIX), "envelope boundary mismatch")
    require(b"\r" not in command and b"\x00" not in command, "envelope forbidden control")
    require(command.count(b"\n") == SOURCE_LF_COUNT, "envelope LF count mismatch")
    return command


def parse_envelope(command: bytes) -> list[bytes]:
    require(isinstance(command, bytes), "command must be bytes")
    require(command.startswith(PREFIX), "missing literal exec prefix")
    require(command.endswith(SUFFIX), "missing fixed stdin redirection")
    require(command.count(SUFFIX) == 1, "stdin redirection count mismatch")
    require(b"\r" not in command and b"\x00" not in command, "forbidden command control")
    body_end = len(command) - len(SUFFIX)
    index = len(PREFIX)
    tokens: list[bytes] = []
    while index < body_end:
        require(command[index:index + 1] == b"'", "token must start single-quoted")
        index += 1
        value = bytearray()
        while True:
            require(index < body_end, "unterminated single quote")
            byte = command[index]
            if byte == 39:
                if command[index:index + len(QUOTE_ESCAPE)] == QUOTE_ESCAPE:
                    value.append(39)
                    index += len(QUOTE_ESCAPE)
                    continue
                index += 1
                break
            if byte == 10:
                require(len(tokens) == SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX, "LF outside source token")
            elif byte < 32 or byte == 127:
                raise RuntimeError("forbidden control byte")
            value.append(byte)
            index += 1
        tokens.append(bytes(value))
        if index == body_end:
            break
        require(command[index:index + 1] == b" ", "token separator mismatch")
        index += 1
        require(index < body_end, "missing token after separator")
    require(index == body_end, "unexpected shell syntax")
    return tokens


def validate_envelope(command: bytes, outer_argv: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tokens = parse_envelope(command)
    validate_token_vector(tokens, outer_argv)
    require(render_tokens(tokens) == command, "noncanonical quote encoding")
    require(len(tokens) == TOKEN_COUNT, "parsed token count mismatch")
    return {
        "command_sha256": sha(command),
        "command_size": len(command),
        "environment_token_order": [item.decode("ascii") for item in ENVIRONMENT_TOKENS],
        "lf_count": command.count(b"\n"),
        "parser": "quote-state-v2",
        "result": "PASS",
        "source_sha256": sha(tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX]),
        "source_single_quote_count": tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX].count(b"'"),
        "token_count": len(tokens),
    }


def negative_fixture_commands(
    good: bytes,
    outer_argv: list[str],
) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    tokens = expected_token_vector(outer_argv)
    altered_tokens = list(tokens)
    altered_source = bytearray(altered_tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX])
    altered_source[0] ^= 1
    altered_tokens[SOURCE_TOKEN_INDEX] = bytes(altered_source)
    return {
        "lf_outside_source": b"exec '/usr/bin/env\n' </dev/null",
        "carriage_return": b"exec '/usr/bin/env\r' </dev/null",
        "nul": b"exec '/usr/bin/env\x00' </dev/null",
        "other_control": b"exec '/usr/bin/env\x01' </dev/null",
        "malformed_quote_escape": b"exec 'bad'\\' 'token' </dev/null",
        "variable_expansion": b"exec $HOME </dev/null",
        "command_substitution": b"exec $(id) </dev/null",
        "process_substitution": b"exec <(id) </dev/null",
        "heredoc": b"exec '/usr/bin/env' <<EOF",
        "here_string": b"exec '/usr/bin/env' <<< 'x'",
        "pipeline": good + b" | 'cat'",
        "list_operator": good + b" && 'true'",
        "separator": good + b"; 'true'",
        "glob": b"exec '*' </dev/null",
        "function": b"f() { 'true'; }; " + good,
        "alias": b"alias x='true'; " + good,
        "eval": b"eval " + good,
        "extra_redirection": good + b" 2>'/tmp/x'",
        "extra_command": good + b"; '/usr/bin/true'",
        "source_file": b"source '/tmp/envelope'",
        "temp_file": b"exec '/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12' '/tmp/source.py' </dev/null",
        "base64_decoder": b"exec '/usr/bin/base64' '-D' </dev/null",
        "alternate_shell": b"exec '/bin/bash' '-c' 'true' </dev/null",
        "altered_source_byte": render_tokens(altered_tokens),
    }


def validate_fixture_matrix(outer_argv: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    good = build_envelope(outer_argv)
    require(parse_envelope(good) == expected_token_vector(outer_argv), "positive parse mismatch")
    require(render_tokens(parse_envelope(good)) == good, "positive round-trip mismatch")
    results: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, command in negative_fixture_commands(good, outer_argv).items():
        try:
            validate_envelope(command, outer_argv)
        except RuntimeError:
            results[name] = "REJECTED"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(name + " negative fixture accepted")
    require(len(results) == 24, "negative fixture count mismatch")
    return results


def validate_source_security(source: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename="<m3s-v11-envelope-v7>")
    imports: set[str] = set()
    forbidden_calls: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            imports.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports.add(node.module.split(".")[0])
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
            if node.func.id in {"eval", "exec", "compile", "input"}:
                forbidden_calls.append(node.func.id)
    require(not imports.intersection({"subprocess", "socket", "urllib", "http", "requests"}), "unsafe import")
    require(forbidden_calls == [], "forbidden dynamic call")
    return {
        "forbidden_calls": forbidden_calls,
        "imports": sorted(imports),
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def validate_contract(
    plan_bytes: bytes,
    plan_sha256: str,
    status_sha256: str,
    transport_argv_json_sha256: str,
    self_check_argv_json_sha256: str,
    finalize_argv_json_sha256: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    outer_argv, outer_json = build_outer_argv(
        plan_bytes,
        plan_sha256,
        status_sha256,
        transport_argv_json_sha256,
        self_check_argv_json_sha256,
        finalize_argv_json_sha256,
    )
    envelope = build_envelope(outer_argv)
    validation = validate_envelope(envelope, outer_argv)
    fixtures = validate_fixture_matrix(outer_argv)
    return {
        "cwd": str(SEED),
        "envelope": validation,
        "fixtures": fixtures,
        "outer_argv_json_sha256": sha(outer_json),
        "outer_argv_json_size": len(outer_json),
        "outer_argv_count": len(outer_argv),
        "shell": "/bin/zsh",
        "shell_login": False,
        "stdin": "/dev/null",
    }
# LIVECLIP_M3S_EXECUTION_ENVELOPE_V7_END
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


WRITER_BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_WRITER_V12_" + b"BEGIN\n"
WRITER_END = b"# LIVECLIP_M3S_WRITER_V12_" + b"END\n"
BOOTSTRAP_ROOT = Path(
    "/Users/junhuaxu/Library/Application Support/LiveClip/engineering-candidates/"
    "agent-runtime-v2/a822890ace12/trusted-tools/m3-successor-preparation-v12"
)
SEED = Path(
    "/Users/junhuaxu/Library/Application Support/LiveClip/engineering-candidates/"
    "agent-runtime-v2/a822890ace12/candidate.OlsWg1/repo"
)


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), f"not a regular file: {path}")
    require(not path.is_symlink(), f"symlink forbidden: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
            f"identity changed while opening: {path}",
        )
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while reading: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    data = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(data) == final.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while reading: {path}",
    )
    return data, final


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1, "begin marker count is not one")
    require(payload.count(end) == 1, "end marker count is not one")
    begin_at = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    end_at = payload.index(end)
    require(begin_at <= end_at, "source markers are out of order")
    return payload[begin_at:end_at]


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False)
    result.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--begin-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--end-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--destination", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    return result


def main() -> int:
    expected_names = [
        "--plan",
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        "--status",
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        "--begin-marker",
        "--end-marker",
        "--destination",
        "--expected-writer-size",
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        "--expected-driver-size",
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
    ]
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "missing argv separator")
    options = tokens[1:]
    require(len(options) == len(expected_names) * 2, "unexpected argv length")
    require(options[::2] == expected_names, "unexpected argv option order")
    args = parser().parse_args(options)

    plan = Path(args.plan)
    status_path = Path(args.status)
    destination = Path(args.destination)
    require(destination == BOOTSTRAP_ROOT / "candidate-driver.py", "destination mismatch")
    require(destination.parent == BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, "destination parent mismatch")
    root_stat = BOOTSTRAP_ROOT.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(root_stat.st_mode), "bootstrap root is not a directory")
    require(not BOOTSTRAP_ROOT.is_symlink(), "bootstrap root is a symlink")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(root_stat.st_mode) == 0o700, "bootstrap root mode mismatch")
    require(root_stat.st_uid == os.getuid(), "bootstrap root owner mismatch")

    plan_bytes, plan_stat = read_regular(plan)
    status_bytes, status_stat = read_regular(status_path)
    require(digest(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(digest(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")

    writer_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    require(len(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_size, "writer size mismatch")
    require(digest(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_sha256, "writer hash mismatch")
    actual_argv = [
        "/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12",
        "-c",
        writer_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
        "--",
        *options,
    ]
    require(
        os.environ.get("BOUND_ARGV_JSON")
        == json.dumps(
            actual_argv,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            allow_nan=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ),
        "transport BOUND_ARGV_JSON mismatch",
    )
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_PHASE") == "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE", "transport phase mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_TIMEOUT") == "60", "transport timeout mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("CANDIDATE_REPO") == str(SEED), "transport seed mismatch")
    require(
        os.environ.get("RESULT_PATH")
        == str(BOOTSTRAP_ROOT / "receipts/source-receipt.json"),
        "transport receipt mismatch",
    )

    begin = args.begin_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    end = args.end_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    driver_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, begin, end)
    require(len(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_size, "driver size mismatch")
    require(digest(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "driver hash mismatch")

    fd = os.open(
        destination,
        os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
        0o600,
    )
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        view = memoryview(driver_bytes)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            require(written == len(view), "short write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

    written_bytes, verified = read_regular(destination)
    require(
        (verified.st_dev, verified.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
        "destination identity changed",
    )
    require(stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode) == 0o600, "destination mode mismatch")
    require(written_bytes == driver_bytes, "destination bytes mismatch")
    require(digest(written_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "destination hash mismatch")
    directory_fd = os.open(BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        directory_opened = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino)
            == (root_stat.st_dev, root_stat.st_ino),
            "bootstrap root identity changed while opening",
        )
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
        directory_final = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_final.st_dev, directory_final.st_ino)
            == (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino),
            "bootstrap root identity changed while fsyncing",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)

    summary = {
        "destination": {
            "device": verified.st_dev,
            "inode": verified.st_ino,
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(destination),
            "sha256": digest(written_bytes),
            "size": len(written_bytes),
            "type": "regular",
        },
        "directory_fsync": True,
        "driver_marker_counts": [plan_bytes.count(begin), plan_bytes.count(end)],
        "extracted_bytes": len(driver_bytes),
        "file_fsync": True,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M3S_V12_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "plan": {
            "device": plan_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": plan_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(plan),
            "sha256": digest(plan_bytes),
            "size": len(plan_bytes),
        },
        "status": {
            "device": status_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": status_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(status_path),
            "sha256": digest(status_bytes),
            "size": len(status_bytes),
        },
        "writer_marker_counts": [
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_BEGIN),
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_END),
        ],
        "written_bytes": len(written_bytes),
    }
    os.write(1, compact(summary) + b"\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
# LIVECLIP_M3S_WRITER_V12_END
```

```python
def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def require_exact_keys(
    value: object,
    expected: frozenset[str],
    label: str,
) -> None:
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"{label} is not an object")
    require(set(value) == set(expected), f"{label} schema mismatch")


def load_v5_candidate_receipt(name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    require(name in V5_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_KEYS, f"unknown V5 receipt schema: {name}")
    payload, identity = load_json(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts" / name)
    require_exact_keys(payload, V5_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_KEYS[name], f"V5 {name}")
    return payload, identity


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(all(isinstance(item, str) for item in argv), "argv must contain strings")
    return json.dumps(
        argv,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def parse_shape(tokens: list[str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    require(tokens and tokens[0] in SHAPES, "unknown subcommand")
    shape = SHAPES[tokens[0]]
    require(len(tokens) == len(shape), "unexpected argv length")
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    active = ""
    for expected, actual in zip(shape, tokens, strict=True):
        if expected is None:
            require(active.startswith("--") and actual != "", "missing option value")
            values[active[2:].replace("-", "_")] = actual
        else:
            require(actual == expected, f"unexpected argv token: {actual}")
            active = expected
    return tokens[0], values


def open_identity(path: Path) -> tuple[int, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), f"not regular: {path}")
    require(not path.is_symlink(), f"symlink forbidden: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    opened = os.fstat(fd)
    require(
        (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
        f"identity changed: {path}",
    )
    return fd, opened


def hash_regular(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    size = 0
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while hashing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    require(size == final.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while hashing: {path}",
    )
    return {
        "device": final.st_dev,
        "inode": final.st_ino,
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(final.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
        "size": size,
        "type": "regular",
    }


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 4 * 1024 * 1024) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    identity = hash_regular(path)
    require(identity["size"] <= maximum, f"file exceeds read bound: {path}")
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    require(
        (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (identity["device"], identity["inode"]),
        f"identity changed between bounded reads: {path}",
    )
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed during bounded read: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == final.st_size, f"short bounded read: {path}")
    require(sha(payload) == identity["sha256"], f"read changed: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed during bounded read: {path}",
    )
    return payload, identity


def living_plan_size_allowed(size: int) -> bool:
    return isinstance(size, int) and 0 <= size <= LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES


def read_living_plan() -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    return read_regular(PLAN, maximum=LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES)


def living_plan_bound_contract_self_test() -> dict[str, Any]:
    identity = hash_regular(PLAN)
    require(
        identity["size"] == PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_SIZE
        or (
            identity["size"] > PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_SIZE
            and living_plan_size_allowed(identity["size"])
        ),
        "closed V12 Living ExecPlan size contract mismatch",
    )
    require(
        PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_SIZE
        == PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_LEGACY_PLAN_LIMIT + PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_EXCESS,
        "retained V9 plan-bound arithmetic mismatch",
    )
    require(
        PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_SIZE > LEGACY_LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES,
        "retained V9 plan unexpectedly fits legacy bound",
    )
    require(
        living_plan_size_allowed(LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES),
        "Living ExecPlan upper boundary rejected",
    )
    require(
        not living_plan_size_allowed(LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES + 1),
        "Living ExecPlan over-boundary fixture accepted",
    )
    driver_bytes, _ = read_regular(DRIVER)
    tree = ast.parse(driver_bytes, filename=str(DRIVER))
    plan_reads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    forbidden_plan_reads: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call) or not node.args:
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Name) or node.args[0].id != "PLAN":
            continue
        name = node.func.id if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) else ""
        if name == "read_regular":
            keywords = {item.arg: item.value for item in node.keywords}
            maximum = keywords.get("maximum")
            explicit = (
                isinstance(maximum, ast.Name)
                and maximum.id == "LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES"
            )
            plan_reads.append({
                "explicit_living_plan_maximum": explicit,
                "line": node.lineno,
            })
            if not explicit:
                forbidden_plan_reads.append("read_regular:" + str(node.lineno))
    require(len(plan_reads) == 1, "Living ExecPlan read surface mismatch")
    require(forbidden_plan_reads == [], "implicit Living ExecPlan read bound")
    return {
        "active_limit_bytes": LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES,
        "closed_plan_size_bytes": identity["size"],
        "legacy_limit_bytes": PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_LEGACY_PLAN_LIMIT,
        "legacy_v9_excess_bytes": PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_PLAN_EXCESS,
        "legacy_v9_rejected": True,
        "plan_read_calls": plan_reads,
        "result": "PASS",
        "upper_boundary_accepts": LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES,
        "upper_boundary_plus_one_rejected": LIVING_PLAN_MAX_BYTES + 1,
    }


def require_identity(
    path: Path,
    expected_sha: str,
    expected_mode: int | None = None,
    expected_size: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    identity = hash_regular(path)
    require(identity["sha256"] == expected_sha, f"hash mismatch: {path}")
    if expected_mode is not None:
        require(identity["mode"] == f"{expected_mode:04o}", f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    if expected_size is not None:
        require(identity["size"] == expected_size, f"size mismatch: {path}")
    return identity


def fsync_existing(path: Path) -> None:
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
    )


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe directory: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
            f"directory identity changed while opening: {path}",
        )
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
            f"directory identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISDIR(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino) == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino),
        f"directory path identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
    )


def directory_identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe directory: {path}")
    return {
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
        "size": 0,
        "type": "directory",
    }


def private_directory_identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe private directory: {path}")
    require(info.st_uid == os.getuid(), f"private directory owner mismatch: {path}")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, f"private directory mode mismatch: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode))
            == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_uid, 0o700),
            f"private directory identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return {
        "device": opened.st_dev,
        "inode": opened.st_ino,
        "mode": "0700",
        "owner_uid": opened.st_uid,
        "path": str(path),
        "type": "directory",
    }


def validate_m2b_state(phase: str, expected_self_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected_receipts = {
        "self-check": {"source-receipt.json"},
        "finalize": {
            "source-receipt.json",
            "writer-self-test.json",
            "self-check-result.json",
        },
        "execute": {
            "source-receipt.json",
            "writer-self-test.json",
            "self-check-result.json",
            "final-index.json",
        },
    }
    require(phase in expected_receipts, "unknown M2B state phase")
    root = private_directory_identity(M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(M2B)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(M2B / "home"), "M2B home is not empty")
    require(not os.listdir(M2B / "tmp"), "M2B tmp is not empty")
    receipt_names = set(os.listdir(M2B / "receipts"))
    require(receipt_names == expected_receipts[phase], "M2B receipt entries mismatch")
    receipt_identities: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in sorted(receipt_names):
        identity = hash_regular(M2B / "receipts" / name)
        require(identity["mode"] == "0600", f"M2B receipt mode mismatch: {name}")
        receipt_identities[name] = identity
    execution_result = M2B / "receipts" / EXECUTION_RESULT_NAME
    require(not execution_result.exists() and not execution_result.is_symlink(), "candidate execution result already exists")
    return {
        "driver": require_identity(DRIVER, expected_self_sha, 0o600),
        "home": home,
        "phase": phase,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "receipt_files": receipt_identities,
        "reserved_execution_result_absent": True,
        "root": root,
        "tmp": tmp,
    }


def validate_phase_environment(
    phase: str,
    timeout: int,
    current_argv: list[str],
    result_path: Path | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID, "runtime uid mismatch")
    require(
        CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING == f"0x{CURRENT_UID:X}:0x0:0x0",
        "CoreFoundation uid binding mismatch",
    )
    expected = {
        "BOUND_ARGV_JSON": argv_json(current_argv).decode("utf-8"),
        "BOUND_PHASE": phase,
        "BOUND_TIMEOUT": str(timeout),
        "CANDIDATE_REPO": str(SEED),
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
        "HOME": str(M2B / "home"),
        "LANG": "C",
        "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE,
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "TMPDIR": str(M2B / "tmp"),
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    if result_path is not None:
        expected["RESULT_PATH"] = str(result_path)
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected, f"{phase} environment mismatch")
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in expected), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in expected, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    return {"environment_names": sorted(expected), "stdin": "DEVNULL"}


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(path.parent.is_dir() and not path.parent.is_symlink(), "unsafe receipt parent")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode), f"new receipt is not regular: {path}")
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, f"zero write: {path}")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, len(payload)),
            f"new receipt identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    identity = require_identity(path, sha(payload), 0o600, len(payload))
    require(
        (identity["device"], identity["inode"]) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
        f"new receipt path identity changed: {path}",
    )
    fsync_directory(path.parent)
    return identity


def load_json(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    payload, identity = read_regular(path)
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"JSON root is not object: {path}")
    return value, identity


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1, "begin marker count mismatch")
    require(payload.count(end) == 1, "end marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end)
    require(start <= finish, "source markers out of order")
    return payload[start:finish]


def self_identity(expected_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(__file__) == DRIVER, "driver absolute path mismatch")
    identity = require_identity(DRIVER, expected_sha, 0o600)
    require(identity["size"] > 0, "empty driver")
    return identity


def predecessor_phase(version: str, suffix: str) -> str:
    require(version in {"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11"}, "unknown predecessor phase version")
    return "M3S_" + version + "_" + suffix



def predecessor_successor_phase(version: str, suffix: str = "") -> str:
    require(version in {"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11"}, "unknown predecessor successor version")
    return "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + suffix


def predecessor_dry_run_phase(version: str, suffix: str) -> str:
    require(version in {"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11"}, "unknown predecessor dry-run version")
    return "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_" + suffix


def versioned_phase_tokens(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    require(version in {"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13"}, "unknown phase version")
    return (
        "M3S_" + version + "_SOURCE_WRITE", "M3S_" + version + "_SELF_CHECK", "M3S_" + version + "_FINALIZE",
        "M3S_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX", "M3S_" + version + "_WRITER_SELF_TEST", "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version,
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PREFLIGHT", "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_TOOLCHAIN_SNAPSHOT", "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOP", "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_PRESERVATION",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + version + "_STOPPED", "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_CAPTURE",
        "M3_SUCCESSOR_DRY_RUN_" + version + "_VALIDATION",
    )


def active_v12_phases() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return versioned_phase_tokens("V12")



def predecessor_active_phases(version: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    require(version in {"V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11"}, "unknown predecessor phase version")
    return versioned_phase_tokens(version)



GENERIC_DIRECTORY_KEYS = frozenset({"mode", "path", "sha256", "size", "type"})
PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_KEYS = frozenset(
    {"device", "inode", "mode", "owner_uid", "path", "type"}
)


def require_directory_shape(
    identity: dict[str, Any],
    expected_path: Path,
    *,
    private: bool,
) -> None:
    expected_keys = PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_KEYS if private else GENERIC_DIRECTORY_KEYS
    require(set(identity) == expected_keys, "directory identity field set mismatch")
    require(identity["path"] == str(expected_path), "directory identity path mismatch")
    require(identity["type"] == "directory", "directory identity type mismatch")
    if private:
        require("uid" not in identity, "legacy uid key is forbidden")
        require(identity["owner_uid"] == CURRENT_UID, "private directory owner mismatch")
        require(identity["mode"] == "0700", "private directory mode mismatch")
        require(
            isinstance(identity["device"], int) and isinstance(identity["inode"], int),
            "private directory device/inode shape mismatch",
        )
    else:
        require(identity["mode"] == "0700", "generic fixture mode mismatch")
        require(identity["size"] == 0 and identity["sha256"] == EMPTY_SHA, "generic fixture payload mismatch")


def validated_private_directory(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    identity = private_directory_identity(path)
    require_directory_shape(identity, path, private=True)
    return identity


def identity_shape_contract_self_test() -> dict[str, Any]:
    fixture_path = Path("/shape-fixture")
    generic = {
        "mode": "0700",
        "path": str(fixture_path),
        "sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
        "size": 0,
        "type": "directory",
    }
    private = {
        "device": 1,
        "inode": 2,
        "mode": "0700",
        "owner_uid": CURRENT_UID,
        "path": str(fixture_path),
        "type": "directory",
    }
    require_directory_shape(generic, fixture_path, private=False)
    require_directory_shape(private, fixture_path, private=True)
    malformed = dict(private)
    malformed["uid"] = malformed.pop("owner_uid")
    rejected = False
    try:
        require_directory_shape(malformed, fixture_path, private=True)
    except RuntimeError:
        rejected = True
    require(rejected, "legacy uid-only identity fixture was accepted")
    return {
        "generic_keys": sorted(GENERIC_DIRECTORY_KEYS),
        "legacy_uid_only_rejected": True,
        "private_keys": sorted(PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_KEYS),
        "result": "PASS",
    }


def exact_python_string_tokens(payload: bytes) -> frozenset[str]:
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(payload, filename="<phase-source-policy>")
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("phase source is not valid Python") from exc
    return frozenset(node.value for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str))


def phase_source_violations(payload: bytes, require_active: bool) -> list[str]:
    active = active_v12_phases()
    stale = tuple(phase for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11") for phase in predecessor_active_phases(version))
    future = versioned_phase_tokens("V13")
    tokens = exact_python_string_tokens(payload)
    violations: list[str] = []
    if require_active:
        violations.extend("missing_active:" + phase for phase in active if phase not in tokens)
    violations.extend("stale_predecessor:" + phase for phase in stale if phase in tokens)
    violations.extend("future_v13:" + phase for phase in future if phase in tokens)
    forbidden = (b"candidate.dygENR4n" + b"/repo", b"--" + b"last", b"resume_liveclip" + b".sh")
    violations.extend("forbidden:" + token.decode("ascii") for token in forbidden if token in payload)
    return violations



def validate_active_phase_names() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, identity = read_regular(DRIVER)
    violations = phase_source_violations(payload, True)
    require(violations == [], "successor phase policy violation: " + ",".join(violations))
    active_fixture = b"\n".join(json.dumps(phase).encode("ascii") for phase in active_v12_phases())
    require(phase_source_violations(active_fixture, True) == [], "positive active-phase fixture failed")
    prefix = "M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_"
    collision_values = (prefix + "V1", prefix + "V10", prefix + "V11", prefix + "V12")
    collision_fixture = b"\n".join(json.dumps(phase).encode("ascii") for phase in collision_values)
    require(exact_python_string_tokens(collision_fixture) == frozenset(collision_values), "V1/V10/V11/V12 exact-token collision fixture failed")
    fixture_results: dict[str, str] = {"active_v12_exact_tokens": "PASS", "v1_v10_v11_v12_prefix_collision": "PASS"}
    for version in ("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11"):
        stale = predecessor_phase(version, "SELF_CHECK")
        stale_violations = phase_source_violations(active_fixture + b"\n" + json.dumps(stale).encode("ascii"), True)
        require(stale_violations == ["stale_predecessor:" + stale], "stale predecessor phase fixture failed: " + version)
        fixture_results["standalone_" + version.lower() + "_rejected"] = "PASS"
    standalone_v1 = prefix + "V1"
    require(phase_source_violations(active_fixture + b"\n" + json.dumps(standalone_v1).encode("ascii"), True) == ["stale_predecessor:" + standalone_v1], "standalone exact V1 successor phase was not rejected")
    future_phase = "M3S_" + "V13_SELF_CHECK"
    require(phase_source_violations(active_fixture + b"\n" + json.dumps(future_phase).encode("ascii"), True) == ["future_v13:" + future_phase], "future V13 exact phase fixture failed")
    fixture_results["future_v13_exact_phase_rejected"] = "PASS"
    return {"active_phases": list(active_v12_phases()), "comparison": "AST_EXACT_STRING_TOKENS", "driver": identity,
        "fixtures": fixture_results, "identity_shape_fixture": identity_shape_contract_self_test(),
        "immutable_predecessor_validation": {"roots": [str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V3_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V5_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V6_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V7_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V8_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V9_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V10_ROOT), str(PREVIOUS_M3S_V11_ROOT)], "runtime_phase_construction": True}, "violations": violations}



def validate_stopped_root(
    *,
    version: str,
    root: Path,
    driver: Path,
    driver_size: int,
    driver_sha: str,
    source_size: int,
    source_sha: str,
    self_size: int,
    self_sha: str,
    transport_argv_sha: str,
    self_argv_sha: str,
    source_elapsed: float,
    self_elapsed: float,
    failure: str,
    reserved_result_name: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes]:
    root_identity = validated_private_directory(root)
    expected_root = {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"}
    require(set(os.listdir(root)) == expected_root, "retained M3S-" + version + " root entries mismatch")
    directories: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts"):
        directories[name] = validated_private_directory(root / name)
    require(os.listdir(root / "home") == [], "retained M3S-" + version + " home not empty")
    require(os.listdir(root / "tmp") == [], "retained M3S-" + version + " tmp not empty")
    receipts = root / "receipts"
    require(
        set(os.listdir(receipts)) == {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"},
        "retained M3S-" + version + " receipt set mismatch",
    )
    driver_identity = require_identity(driver, driver_sha, 0o600, driver_size)
    source, source_identity = load_json(receipts / "source-receipt.json")
    require(
        source_identity["mode"] == "0600"
        and source_identity["size"] == source_size
        and source_identity["sha256"] == source_sha,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " source receipt identity mismatch",
    )
    source_phase = predecessor_phase(version, "SOURCE_WRITE")
    require(
        source["phase"] == source_phase
        and source["returncode"] == 0
        and source["elapsed_seconds"] == source_elapsed
        and source["timed_out"] is False
        and source["output_truncated"] is False
        and source["session_id"] is None
        and source["credential_variables"] == []
        and source["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " source wrapper result mismatch",
    )
    require(
        sha(argv_json(source["argv"])) == transport_argv_sha,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " transport argv mismatch",
    )
    writer_summary = json.loads(source["output"])
    require(
        writer_summary["phase"] == source_phase
        and writer_summary["file_fsync"] is True
        and writer_summary["directory_fsync"] is True,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " writer summary mismatch",
    )
    stopped, stopped_identity = load_json(receipts / "self-check-result.json")
    require(
        stopped_identity["mode"] == "0600"
        and stopped_identity["size"] == self_size
        and stopped_identity["sha256"] == self_sha,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " self-check receipt identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        stopped["phase"] == predecessor_phase(version, "SELF_CHECK")
        and stopped["returncode"] == 1
        and stopped["elapsed_seconds"] == self_elapsed
        and stopped["timed_out"] is False
        and stopped["output_truncated"] is False
        and stopped["session_id"] is None
        and stopped["credential_variables"] == []
        and stopped["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " self-check wrapper result mismatch",
    )
    require(
        sha(argv_json(stopped["argv"])) == self_argv_sha,
        "retained M3S-" + version + " self-check argv mismatch",
    )
    require(stopped["output"].endswith(failure + "\n"), "retained M3S-" + version + " failure mismatch")
    for absent in ("writer-self-test.json", "final-index.json", reserved_result_name):
        require(
            not (receipts / absent).exists() and not (receipts / absent).is_symlink(),
            "retained M3S-" + version + " absent artifact appeared: " + absent,
        )
    previous_bytes, _ = read_regular(driver)
    return {
        "budget": "CONSUMED_NO_REUSE",
        "directories": directories,
        "driver": driver_identity,
        "failure": failure,
        "root": root_identity,
        "self_check_result": stopped_identity,
        "source_receipt": source_identity,
        "verdict": "M3S_" + version + "_STOPPED_SELF_CHECK",
    }, previous_bytes


def validate_m3s_v1_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result, previous_bytes = validate_stopped_root(
        version="V1",
        root=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_ROOT,
        driver=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_DRIVER,
        driver_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_DRIVER_SIZE,
        driver_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_DRIVER_SHA,
        source_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_SOURCE_SIZE,
        source_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_SOURCE_SHA,
        self_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_SELF_SIZE,
        self_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_SELF_SHA,
        transport_argv_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA,
        self_argv_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_SELF_ARGV_SHA,
        source_elapsed=0.048821,
        self_elapsed=0.082811,
        failure=PREVIOUS_M3S_V1_FAILURE,
        reserved_result_name="successor-preparation-result.json",
    )
    future_root_token = ("M3S_" + "V2_").encode("ascii")
    future_successor_token = ("M3_SUCCESSOR_PREPARATION_" + "V2").encode("ascii")
    require(
        previous_bytes.count(future_root_token) == 1
        and previous_bytes.count(future_successor_token) == 1,
        "retained M3S-v1 self-token defect evidence mismatch",
    )
    result["future_token_occurrences"] = {
        "root": previous_bytes.count(future_root_token),
        "successor": previous_bytes.count(future_successor_token),
    }
    return result


def validate_m3s_v2_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result, previous_bytes = validate_stopped_root(
        version="V2",
        root=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_ROOT,
        driver=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_DRIVER,
        driver_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_DRIVER_SIZE,
        driver_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_DRIVER_SHA,
        source_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_SOURCE_SIZE,
        source_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_SOURCE_SHA,
        self_size=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_SELF_SIZE,
        self_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_SELF_SHA,
        transport_argv_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA,
        self_argv_sha=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_SELF_ARGV_SHA,
        source_elapsed=0.084058,
        self_elapsed=0.091287,
        failure=PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_FAILURE,
        reserved_result_name="successor-preparation-v2-result.json",
    )
    generic_start = previous_bytes.index(b"def directory_identity(")
    generic_end = previous_bytes.index(b"def private_directory_identity(", generic_start)
    generic_source = previous_bytes[generic_start:generic_end]
    uid_accesses = previous_bytes.count(b'["uid"]')
    require(uid_accesses == 2, "retained M3S-v2 uid-access evidence mismatch")
    require(b'"uid"' not in generic_source, "retained M3S-v2 generic directory unexpectedly includes uid")
    result["identity_contract_defect"] = {
        "directory_identity_uid_field_present": False,
        "failure": PREVIOUS_M3S_V2_FAILURE,
        "uid_subscript_accesses": uid_accesses,
    }
    return result

        "successor_only_count": 10,
        "wrong_shared_tuple_uses": wrong_shared_tuple_uses,
    }
    return result


def m3s_v4_empty_root_shape_accepts(
    root_entries: set[str],
    home_entries: set[str],
    tmp_entries: set[str],
    receipt_entries: set[str],
    absent_artifacts: set[str],
) -> bool:
    return (
        root_entries == {"home", "tmp", "receipts"}
        and home_entries == set()
        and tmp_entries == set()
        and receipt_entries == set()
        and absent_artifacts == set(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ABSENT)
    )


def validate_m3s_v4_stopped() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = validated_private_directory(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT)
    directories = {
        name: validated_private_directory(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT / name)
        for name in ("home", "tmp", "receipts")
    }
    root_entries = set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT))
    home_entries = set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT / "home"))
    tmp_entries = set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT / "tmp"))
    receipt_entries = set(os.listdir(PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT / "receipts"))
    absent_artifacts: set[str] = set()
    for relative in PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ABSENT:
        path = PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_ROOT / relative
        require(
            not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(),
            "retained M3S-v4 absent artifact appeared: " + relative,
        )
        absent_artifacts.add(relative)
    require(
        m3s_v4_empty_root_shape_accepts(
            root_entries,
            home_entries,
            tmp_entries,
            receipt_entries,
            absent_artifacts,
        ),
        "retained M3S-v4 empty-root shape mismatch",
    )
    negative_fixtures = {
        "driver_present": (
            root_entries | {"candidate-driver.py"},
            home_entries,
            tmp_entries,
            receipt_entries,
            absent_artifacts - {"candidate-driver.py"},
        ),
        "home_not_empty": (
            root_entries,
            {"unexpected"},
            tmp_entries,
            receipt_entries,
            absent_artifacts,
        ),
        "receipt_present": (
            root_entries,
            home_entries,
            tmp_entries,
            {"source-receipt.json"},
            absent_artifacts - {"receipts/source-receipt.json"},
        ),
        "root_entry_missing": (
            root_entries - {"tmp"},
            home_entries,
            tmp_entries,
            receipt_entries,
            absent_artifacts,
        ),
    }
    for label, fixture in negative_fixtures.items():
        require(
            not m3s_v4_empty_root_shape_accepts(*fixture),
            "retained M3S-v4 negative fixture accepted: " + label,
        )
    return {
        "absent_artifacts": sorted(absent_artifacts),
        "budget": "CONSUMED_NO_REUSE",
        "directories": directories,
        "failure": PREVIOUS_M3S_V4_FAILURE,
        "fixtures": {
            "driver_present_rejected": True,
            "home_not_empty_rejected": True,
            "receipt_present_rejected": True,
            "root_entry_missing_rejected": True,
        },
        "root": root,
        "verdict": "M3S_" + "V4_STOPPED_PRE_TRANSPORT",
        "wrapper_or_subprocess_ran": False,
    }

        driver=PREVIOUS_M3S_V5_DRIVER,

        "immutable_v5_stale_assertion_occurrences": stale_assertions,
```
