# LIVECLIP_M2B_WRITER_V7_BEGIN
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path


WRITER_BEGIN = b"# LIVECLIP_M2B_WRITER_V7_" + b"BEGIN\n"
WRITER_END = b"# LIVECLIP_M2B_WRITER_V7_" + b"END\n"
M2B_ROOT = Path(
    "/Users/junhuaxu/Library/Application Support/LiveClip/engineering-candidates/"
    "agent-runtime-v2/a822890ace12/trusted-tools/m2-candidate-bootstrap-v7"
)


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def read_regular(path: Path) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), f"not a regular file: {path}")
    require(not path.is_symlink(), f"symlink forbidden: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
            f"identity changed while opening: {path}",
        )
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while reading: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    data = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(data) == final.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while reading: {path}",
    )
    return data, final


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1, "begin marker count is not one")
    require(payload.count(end) == 1, "end marker count is not one")
    begin_at = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    end_at = payload.index(end)
    require(begin_at <= end_at, "source markers are out of order")
    return payload[begin_at:end_at]


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False)
    result.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-plan-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--status", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-status-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--begin-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--end-marker", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--destination", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-writer-sha256", required=True)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-size", required=True, type=int)
    result.add_argument("--expected-driver-sha256", required=True)
    return result


def main() -> int:
    expected_names = [
        "--plan",
        "--expected-plan-sha256",
        "--status",
        "--expected-status-sha256",
        "--begin-marker",
        "--end-marker",
        "--destination",
        "--expected-writer-size",
        "--expected-writer-sha256",
        "--expected-driver-size",
        "--expected-driver-sha256",
    ]
    tokens = sys.argv[1:]
    require(tokens[:1] == ["--"], "missing argv separator")
    options = tokens[1:]
    require(len(options) == len(expected_names) * 2, "unexpected argv length")
    require(options[::2] == expected_names, "unexpected argv option order")
    args = parser().parse_args(options)

    plan = Path(args.plan)
    status_path = Path(args.status)
    destination = Path(args.destination)
    require(destination == M2B_ROOT / "candidate-driver.py", "destination mismatch")
    require(destination.parent == M2B_ROOT, "destination parent mismatch")
    root_stat = M2B_ROOT.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(root_stat.st_mode), "M2B root is not a directory")
    require(not M2B_ROOT.is_symlink(), "M2B root is a symlink")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(root_stat.st_mode) == 0o700, "M2B root mode mismatch")
    require(root_stat.st_uid == os.getuid(), "M2B root owner mismatch")

    plan_bytes, plan_stat = read_regular(plan)
    status_bytes, status_stat = read_regular(status_path)
    require(digest(plan_bytes) == args.expected_plan_sha256, "plan hash mismatch")
    require(digest(status_bytes) == args.expected_status_sha256, "status hash mismatch")

    writer_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    require(len(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_size, "writer size mismatch")
    require(digest(writer_bytes) == args.expected_writer_sha256, "writer hash mismatch")
    actual_argv = ["/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12", "-c", writer_bytes.decode("utf-8"), "--", *options]
    require(
        os.environ.get("BOUND_ARGV_JSON")
        == json.dumps(actual_argv, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")),
        "transport BOUND_ARGV_JSON mismatch",
    )
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_PHASE") == "M2B_V7_SOURCE_WRITE", "transport phase mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("BOUND_TIMEOUT") == "60", "transport timeout mismatch")
    require(
        os.environ.get("CANDIDATE_REPO")
        == str(M2B_ROOT.parent.parent / "candidate.OlsWg1/repo"),
        "transport seed mismatch",
    )
    require(
        os.environ.get("RESULT_PATH") == str(M2B_ROOT / "receipts/source-receipt.json"),
        "transport receipt mismatch",
    )

    begin = args.begin_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    end = args.end_marker.encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    driver_bytes = extract_once(plan_bytes, begin, end)
    require(len(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_size, "driver size mismatch")
    require(digest(driver_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "driver hash mismatch")

    fd = os.open(
        destination,
        os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
        0o600,
    )
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        view = memoryview(driver_bytes)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, "zero write")
            require(written == len(view), "short write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

    written_bytes, verified = read_regular(destination)
    require(
        (verified.st_dev, verified.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
        "destination identity changed",
    )
    require(stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode) == 0o600, "destination mode mismatch")
    require(written_bytes == driver_bytes, "destination bytes mismatch")
    require(digest(written_bytes) == args.expected_driver_sha256, "destination hash mismatch")
    directory_fd = os.open(M2B_ROOT, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        directory_opened = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino)
            == (root_stat.st_dev, root_stat.st_ino),
            "M2B root identity changed while opening",
        )
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
        directory_final = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        require(
            (directory_final.st_dev, directory_final.st_ino)
            == (directory_opened.st_dev, directory_opened.st_ino),
            "M2B root identity changed while fsyncing",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)
    directory_after = M2B_ROOT.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISDIR(directory_after.st_mode)
        and not M2B_ROOT.is_symlink()
        and (directory_after.st_dev, directory_after.st_ino)
        == (directory_final.st_dev, directory_final.st_ino),
        "M2B root path identity changed while fsyncing",
    )

    summary = {
        "destination": {
            "device": verified.st_dev,
            "inode": verified.st_ino,
            "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(verified.st_mode):04o}",
            "path": str(destination),
            "sha256": digest(written_bytes),
            "size": len(written_bytes),
            "type": "regular",
        },
        "directory_fsync": True,
        "driver_marker_counts": [plan_bytes.count(begin), plan_bytes.count(end)],
        "extracted_bytes": len(driver_bytes),
        "file_fsync": True,
        "format_version": 1,
        "phase": "M2B_V7_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "plan": {
            "device": plan_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": plan_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(plan),
            "sha256": digest(plan_bytes),
            "size": len(plan_bytes),
        },
        "status": {
            "device": status_stat.st_dev,
            "inode": status_stat.st_ino,
            "path": str(status_path),
            "sha256": digest(status_bytes),
            "size": len(status_bytes),
        },
        "writer_marker_counts": [
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_BEGIN),
            plan_bytes.count(WRITER_END),
        ],
        "written_bytes": len(written_bytes),
    }
    os.write(1, compact(summary) + b"\n")
    return 0

        "readiness_capture", "readiness_elapsed_seconds", "readiness_issues",
        "result", "roots", "safe_links", "toolchain_fingerprint",
    }),
    "readiness-result.json": frozenset({
        "elapsed_seconds", "format_version", "issues", "phase", "result",
    }),
    "doctor-profile-staging.json": frozenset({
        "config_staged", "credential_content_read", "destination", "directory",
        "files", "format_version", "phase", "result",
        "unrelated_operator_codex_content_read",
    }),
    "doctor-validation.json": frozenset({
        "capture_complete", "capture_errors", "capture_receipt",
        "child_started", "expected_stdout", "failures", "format_version",
        "lifecycle_history", "lifecycle_state", "phase", "raw_stderr",
        "raw_stdout", "result", "returncode", "session_observation",
        "stderr_contract", "termination", "timed_out",
    }),
}
V5_SUMMARY_KEYS = frozenset({"path_count", "regular_file_bytes", "sha256"})
V5_DOCTOR_TERMINATION_KEYS = frozenset({
    "capture_receipt", "child_started", "command_receipt", "lifecycle_state",
    "returncode", "safe_to_seal", "status", "termination_proven",
    "validation_receipt",
})
V5_FILE_IDENTITY_KEYS = frozenset({
    "device", "inode", "mode", "path", "sha256", "size", "type",
})
V6_WRAPPER_RESULT_KEYS = frozenset({
    "argv", "credential_variables", "cwd", "elapsed_seconds",
    "finished_at_utc", "format_version", "output", "output_limit_bytes",
    "output_truncated", "phase", "returncode", "session_id",
    "started_at_utc", "timed_out", "timeout_seconds", "wrapper_error",
})

ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES = (
    "M2B_V7_SOURCE_WRITE",
    "M2B_V7_SELF_CHECK",
    "M2B_V7_FINALIZE",
    "M2B_V7_FINAL_INDEX",
    "M2_CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_V7_CAPTURE",
    "M2_CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_V7_VALIDATION",
    "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V7",
    "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V7_PREFLIGHT",
    "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V7_FINAL_INDEX",
)


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def require_exact_keys(
    value: object,
    expected: frozenset[str],
    label: str,
) -> None:
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"{label} is not an object")
    require(set(value) == set(expected), f"{label} schema mismatch")


def load_v5_candidate_receipt(name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    require(name in V5_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_KEYS, f"unknown V5 receipt schema: {name}")
    payload, identity = load_json(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts" / name)
    require_exact_keys(payload, V5_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_KEYS[name], f"V5 {name}")
    return payload, identity


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compact(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    ).encode("utf-8")


def pretty(value: object) -> bytes:
    return (
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def argv_json(argv: list[str]) -> bytes:
    require(all(isinstance(item, str) for item in argv), "argv must contain strings")
    return json.dumps(
        argv,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def parse_shape(tokens: list[str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    require(tokens and tokens[0] in SHAPES, "unknown subcommand")
    shape = SHAPES[tokens[0]]
    require(len(tokens) == len(shape), "unexpected argv length")
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    active = ""
    for expected, actual in zip(shape, tokens, strict=True):
        if expected is None:
            require(active.startswith("--") and actual != "", "missing option value")
            values[active[2:].replace("-", "_")] = actual
        else:
            require(actual == expected, f"unexpected argv token: {actual}")
            active = expected
    return tokens[0], values


def open_identity(path: Path) -> tuple[int, os.stat_result]:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), f"not regular: {path}")
    require(not path.is_symlink(), f"symlink forbidden: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    opened = os.fstat(fd)
    require(
        (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
        f"identity changed: {path}",
    )
    return fd, opened


def hash_regular(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    size = 0
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while hashing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    require(size == final.st_size, f"short read: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while hashing: {path}",
    )
    return {
        "device": final.st_dev,
        "inode": final.st_ino,
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(final.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
        "size": size,
        "type": "regular",
    }


def read_regular(path: Path, maximum: int = 4 * 1024 * 1024) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    identity = hash_regular(path)
    require(identity["size"] <= maximum, f"file exceeds read bound: {path}")
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    require(
        (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (identity["device"], identity["inode"]),
        f"identity changed between bounded reads: {path}",
    )
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed during bounded read: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    payload = b"".join(chunks)
    require(len(payload) == final.st_size, f"short bounded read: {path}")
    require(sha(payload) == identity["sha256"], f"read changed: {path}")
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed during bounded read: {path}",
    )
    return payload, identity


def require_identity(
    path: Path,
    expected_sha: str,
    expected_mode: int | None = None,
    expected_size: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    identity = hash_regular(path)
    require(identity["sha256"] == expected_sha, f"hash mismatch: {path}")
    if expected_mode is not None:
        require(identity["mode"] == f"{expected_mode:04o}", f"mode mismatch: {path}")
    if expected_size is not None:
        require(identity["size"] == expected_size, f"size mismatch: {path}")
    return identity


def fsync_existing(path: Path) -> None:
    fd, opened = open_identity(path)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_size),
            f"identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size)
        == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size),
        f"path identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
    )


def fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
    before = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe directory: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) == (before.st_dev, before.st_ino),
            f"directory identity changed while opening: {path}",
        )
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
            f"directory identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    after = path.lstat()
    require(
        stat.S_ISDIR(after.st_mode)
        and not path.is_symlink()
        and (after.st_dev, after.st_ino) == (final.st_dev, final.st_ino),
        f"directory path identity changed while fsyncing: {path}",
    )


def directory_identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe directory: {path}")
    return {
        "mode": f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}",
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": EMPTY_SHA,
        "size": 0,
        "type": "directory",
    }


def private_directory_identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe private directory: {path}")
    require(info.st_uid == os.getuid(), f"private directory owner mismatch: {path}")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700, f"private directory mode mismatch: {path}")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, opened.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(opened.st_mode))
            == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_uid, 0o700),
            f"private directory identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return {
        "device": opened.st_dev,
        "inode": opened.st_ino,
        "mode": "0700",
        "owner_uid": opened.st_uid,
        "path": str(path),
        "type": "directory",
    }


def validate_m2b_state(phase: str, expected_self_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected_receipts = {
        "self-check": {"source-receipt.json"},
        "finalize": {
            "source-receipt.json",
            "writer-self-test.json",
            "self-check-result.json",
        },
        "execute": {
            "source-receipt.json",
            "writer-self-test.json",
            "self-check-result.json",
            "final-index.json",
        },
    }
    require(phase in expected_receipts, "unknown M2B state phase")
    root = private_directory_identity(M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(M2B)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(M2B / "home"), "M2B home is not empty")
    require(not os.listdir(M2B / "tmp"), "M2B tmp is not empty")
    receipt_names = set(os.listdir(M2B / "receipts"))
    require(receipt_names == expected_receipts[phase], "M2B receipt entries mismatch")
    receipt_identities: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in sorted(receipt_names):
        identity = hash_regular(M2B / "receipts" / name)
        require(identity["mode"] == "0600", f"M2B receipt mode mismatch: {name}")
        receipt_identities[name] = identity
    execution_result = M2B / "receipts" / EXECUTION_RESULT_NAME
    require(not execution_result.exists() and not execution_result.is_symlink(), "candidate execution result already exists")
    return {
        "driver": require_identity(DRIVER, expected_self_sha, 0o600),
        "home": home,
        "phase": phase,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "receipt_files": receipt_identities,
        "reserved_execution_result_absent": True,
        "root": root,
        "tmp": tmp,
    }


def validate_phase_environment(
    phase: str,
    timeout: int,
    current_argv: list[str],
    result_path: Path | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(os.getuid() == CURRENT_UID, "runtime uid mismatch")
    require(
        CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING == f"0x{CURRENT_UID:X}:0x0:0x0",
        "CoreFoundation uid binding mismatch",
    )
    expected = {
        "BOUND_ARGV_JSON": argv_json(current_argv).decode("utf-8"),
        "BOUND_PHASE": phase,
        "BOUND_TIMEOUT": str(timeout),
        "CANDIDATE_REPO": str(SEED),
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
        "HOME": str(M2B / "home"),
        "LANG": "C",
        "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE,
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "TMPDIR": str(M2B / "tmp"),
        "__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING": CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING,
    }
    if result_path is not None:
        expected["RESULT_PATH"] = str(result_path)
    require(dict(os.environ) == expected, f"{phase} environment mismatch")
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in expected), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in expected, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    return {"environment_names": sorted(expected), "stdin": "DEVNULL"}


def write_exclusive(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(path.parent.is_dir() and not path.parent.is_symlink(), "unsafe receipt parent")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode), f"new receipt is not regular: {path}")
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            require(written > 0, f"zero write: {path}")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        require(
            (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size)
            == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino, len(payload)),
            f"new receipt identity changed: {path}",
        )
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    identity = require_identity(path, sha(payload), 0o600, len(payload))
    require(
        (identity["device"], identity["inode"]) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
        f"new receipt path identity changed: {path}",
    )
    fsync_directory(path.parent)
    return identity


def load_json(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    payload, identity = read_regular(path)
    value = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"JSON root is not object: {path}")
    return value, identity


def extract_once(payload: bytes, begin: bytes, end: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(payload.count(begin) == 1, "begin marker count mismatch")
    require(payload.count(end) == 1, "end marker count mismatch")
    start = payload.index(begin) + len(begin)
    finish = payload.index(end)
    require(start <= finish, "source markers out of order")
    return payload[start:finish]


def self_identity(expected_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(__file__) == DRIVER, "driver absolute path mismatch")
    identity = require_identity(DRIVER, expected_sha, 0o600)
    require(identity["size"] > 0, "empty driver")
    return identity


def validate_active_phase_names() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, identity = read_regular(DRIVER)
    found_predecessor_phases = {
        value.decode("ascii")
        for value in re.findall(
            rb"""["'](M2(?:B)?_(?:[A-Z0-9_]*_)?V[123456](?:_[A-Z0-9_]+)?)["']""",
            payload,
        )
    }
    allowed_predecessor_phases = {
        "M2B_V4_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "M2B_V5_FINAL_INDEX",
        "M2B_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "M2B_V6_SOURCE_WRITE",
        "M2B_V6_SELF_CHECK",
        "M2_CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_V5_VALIDATION",
        "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5",
        "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_PREFLIGHT",
        "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_FINAL_INDEX",
    }
    stale = sorted(found_predecessor_phases - allowed_predecessor_phases)
    require(
        stale == [],
        "stale active V1/V2/V3/V4/V5/V6 phase literal in V7 driver: "
        + ",".join(stale),
    )
    require(
        found_predecessor_phases == allowed_predecessor_phases,
        "immutable V4/V5/V6 predecessor phase literal mismatch",
    )
    missing = [
        phase
        for phase in ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES
        if payload.count(('"'+ phase + '"').encode("ascii")) == 0
    ]
    require(missing == [], "missing active V7 phase literal: " + ",".join(missing))
    v5_result_token = b"candidate12-recovery-" + b"v5-execution-result.json"
    v6_result_token = b"candidate12-recovery-" + b"v6-execution-result.json"
    v7_result_token = b"candidate12-recovery-" + b"v7-execution-result.json"
    v5_heartbeat_token = b"m2-" + b"v5-heartbeat"
    v5_doctor_token = b"m2-" + b"v5-doctor-"
    v6_heartbeat_token = b"m2-" + b"v6-heartbeat"
    v6_doctor_token = b"m2-" + b"v6-doctor-"
    v7_heartbeat_token = b"m2-" + b"v7-heartbeat"
    v7_doctor_token = b"m2-" + b"v7-doctor-"
    metadata_counts = {
        "v5_predecessor_result": payload.count(v5_result_token),
        "v6_predecessor_result": payload.count(v6_result_token),
        "v7_execution_result": payload.count(v7_result_token),
        "v7_heartbeat": payload.count(v7_heartbeat_token),
        "v7_doctor_threads": payload.count(v7_doctor_token),
    }
    require(
        metadata_counts
        == {
            "v5_predecessor_result": 2,
            "v6_predecessor_result": 1,
            "v7_execution_result": 1,
            "v7_heartbeat": 1,
            "v7_doctor_threads": 2,
        },
        "V7 active/predecessor metadata literal mismatch",
    )
    require(
        v5_heartbeat_token not in payload
        and v5_doctor_token not in payload
        and v6_heartbeat_token not in payload
        and v6_doctor_token not in payload,
        "stale active predecessor thread metadata in V7 driver",
    )
    return {
        "active_phases": list(ACTIVE_VERSIONED_PHASES),
        "metadata_counts": metadata_counts,
        "allowed_immutable_predecessor_phases": sorted(allowed_predecessor_phases),
        "driver": identity,
        "stale_active_phases": stale,
    }

def validate_documents(
    plan: str,
    expected_plan_sha: str,
    status_path: str,
    expected_status_sha: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(plan) == PLAN, "plan path mismatch")
    require(Path(status_path) == STATUS, "status path mismatch")
    return {
        "plan": require_identity(PLAN, expected_plan_sha, 0o644),
        "status": require_identity(STATUS, expected_status_sha, 0o644),
    }


def child_environment(home: Path, tmp: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    env = {
        "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
        "HOME": str(home),
        "LANG": "C",
        "LC_ALL": "C",
        "PATH": PATH_VALUE,
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "TMPDIR": str(tmp),
    }
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in env), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in env, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    return env
def redacted_diagnostic(payload: bytes, maximum: int = 8192) -> dict[str, Any]:
    text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(
        r"(?i)((?:api_?key|authorization|cookie|credential|password|private_?key|secret|token)\\s*[=:]\\s*)\\S+",
        r"\\1<redacted>",
        text,
    )
    encoded = text.encode("utf-8")
    truncated = len(encoded) > maximum
    if truncated:
        encoded = (
            encoded[: maximum // 2]
            + b"\n<diagnostic-truncated>\n"
            + encoded[-maximum // 2 :]
        )
    return {"text": encoded.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), "truncated": truncated}


def split_capture(
    argv: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int,
    stdout_limit: int,
    stderr_limit: int,
    aggregate_limit: int,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    heartbeat: bool = False,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes]:
    require(argv and all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in argv), "invalid argv")
    require(cwd.is_dir() and not cwd.is_symlink(), "unsafe child CWD")
    require(timeout > 0, "invalid timeout")
    require(0 < stdout_limit <= aggregate_limit, "invalid stdout limit")
    require(0 < stderr_limit <= aggregate_limit, "invalid stderr limit")
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in env), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in env, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    stopped = threading.Event()

    def emit_heartbeat() -> None:
        while not stopped.wait(240):
            os.write(1, compact({"phase": "M2_PROGRESS", "utc": utc_now()}) + b"\n")

    heartbeat_thread = threading.Thread(
        target=emit_heartbeat,
        name="m2-v7-heartbeat",
        daemon=True,
    )
    if heartbeat:
        heartbeat_thread.start()
    started_at_utc = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 -- fixed, validated argv only
        argv,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=env,
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if input_bytes is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True,
        shell=False,
    )
    require(process.stdout is not None and process.stderr is not None, "capture pipes missing")
    buffers = {"stdout": bytearray(), "stderr": bytearray()}
    digests = {"stdout": hashlib.sha256(), "stderr": hashlib.sha256()}
    totals = {"stdout": 0, "stderr": 0}
    truncated = {"stdout": False, "stderr": False, "aggregate": False}
    capture_errors: list[str] = []
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def drain(name: str, pipe: Any, limit: int) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                chunk = pipe.read(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digests[name].update(chunk)
                with lock:
                    previous = totals[name]
                    aggregate_previous = totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"]
                    totals[name] += len(chunk)
                    allowed = min(
                        len(chunk),
                        max(0, limit - previous),
                        max(0, aggregate_limit - aggregate_previous),
                    )
                    if allowed:
                        buffers[name].extend(chunk[:allowed])
                    if totals[name] > limit:
                        truncated[name] = True
                    if totals["stdout"] + totals["stderr"] > aggregate_limit:
                        truncated["aggregate"] = True
        except BaseException as exc:
            capture_errors.append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
        finally:
            try:
                pipe.close()
            except OSError as exc:
                capture_errors.append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=("stdout", process.stdout, stdout_limit), daemon=True),
        threading.Thread(target=drain, args=("stderr", process.stderr, stderr_limit), daemon=True),
    ]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    if input_bytes is not None:
        require(process.stdin is not None, "stdin pipe missing")
        try:
            view = memoryview(input_bytes)
            while view:
                written = process.stdin.write(view)
                require(written is not None and written > 0, "short child stdin write")
                view = view[written:]
            process.stdin.flush()
        except BrokenPipeError as exc:
            capture_errors.append(type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
        finally:
            process.stdin.close()
    timed_out = False
    try:
        returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        try:
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=5)
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=5)
        if thread.is_alive():
            capture_errors.append("capture thread failed to stop")
    stopped.set()
    if heartbeat:
        heartbeat_thread.join(timeout=2)
    stdout_bytes = bytes(buffers["stdout"])
    stderr_bytes = bytes(buffers["stderr"])
    record = {
        "aggregate_limit_bytes": aggregate_limit,
        "aggregate_truncated": truncated["aggregate"],
        "argv": argv,
        "capture_errors": capture_errors,
        "credential_variables": [],
        "cwd": str(cwd),
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 6),
        "environment_names": sorted(env),
        "finished_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "format_version": 2,
        "session_id": None,
        "started_at_utc": started_at_utc,
        "stderr": stderr_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stderr_bytes),
        "stderr_limit_bytes": stderr_limit,
        "stderr_sha256": digests["stderr"].hexdigest(),
        "stderr_size": totals["stderr"],
        "stderr_truncated": truncated["stderr"],
        "stdin": "DEVNULL" if input_bytes is None else "FIXED_BYTES",
        "stdout": stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stdout_diagnostic": redacted_diagnostic(stdout_bytes),
        "stdout_limit_bytes": stdout_limit,
        "stdout_sha256": digests["stdout"].hexdigest(),
        "stdout_size": totals["stdout"],
        "stdout_truncated": truncated["stdout"],
        "returncode": returncode,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "wrapper_error": None if not capture_errors else "; ".join(capture_errors)[:2048],
    }
    return record, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes


def bounded_bytes(
    argv: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int,
    limit: int,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    heartbeat: bool = False,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes]:
    stderr_limit = min(65536, limit)
    return split_capture(
        argv,
        cwd,
        env,
        timeout,
        limit,
        stderr_limit,
        limit,
        input_bytes=input_bytes,
        heartbeat=heartbeat,
    )


def bounded(
    argv: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    env: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int,
    limit: int,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    heartbeat: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record, _, _ = bounded_bytes(
        argv, cwd, env, timeout, limit, input_bytes=input_bytes, heartbeat=heartbeat
    )
    return record


def require_success(result: dict[str, Any], phase: str) -> None:
    require(result["returncode"] == 0, f"{phase} returned nonzero")
    require(not result["timed_out"], f"{phase} timed out")
    require(not result["stdout_truncated"], f"{phase} stdout truncated")
    require(not result["stderr_truncated"], f"{phase} stderr truncated")
    require(not result["aggregate_truncated"], f"{phase} aggregate output truncated")
    require(result["session_id"] is None, f"{phase} produced a session")
    require(result["credential_variables"] == [], f"{phase} saw credentials")
    require(result["capture_errors"] == [], f"{phase} capture error")
    require(result["wrapper_error"] is None, f"{phase} wrapper error")


def require_channel(
    result: dict[str, Any], name: str, expected_size: int, expected_sha: str
) -> None:
    require(result[f"{name}_size"] == expected_size, f"{name} size mismatch")
    require(result[f"{name}_sha256"] == expected_sha, f"{name} hash mismatch")
    require(not result[f"{name}_truncated"], f"{name} truncated")


def require_empty_channel(result: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> None:
    require_channel(result, name, 0, EMPTY_SHA)


def require_stderr_contract(
    result: dict[str, Any], warning: bytes, warning_sha: str, tool: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    observed_size = result["stderr_size"]
    observed_sha = result["stderr_sha256"]
    if (observed_size, observed_sha) == (0, EMPTY_SHA):
        variant = "EMPTY"
        expected_size = 0
        expected_sha = EMPTY_SHA
        expected_bytes = b""
    elif (observed_size, observed_sha) == (len(warning), warning_sha):
        variant = "DARWIN_CONFSTR_WARNING"
        expected_size = len(warning)
        expected_sha = warning_sha
        expected_bytes = warning
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{tool} stderr violates {STDERR_POLICY}")
    require_channel(result, "stderr", expected_size, expected_sha)
    require(
        result["stderr"].encode("utf-8") == expected_bytes,
        f"{tool} stderr bytes mismatch",
    )
    contract = {
        "observed_sha256": observed_sha,
        "observed_size": observed_size,
        "policy": STDERR_POLICY,
        "variant": variant,
    }
    result["stderr_contract"] = contract
    return contract


def require_git_stderr_contract(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return require_stderr_contract(result, GIT_WARNING, GIT_WARNING_SHA, "Git")


def require_make_stderr_contract(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return require_stderr_contract(result, MAKE_WARNING, MAKE_WARNING_SHA, "Make")


def require_no_prompt_or_secret(result: dict[str, Any], phase: str) -> None:
    diagnostic = result["stdout_diagnostic"]["text"] + "\n" + result["stderr_diagnostic"]["text"]
    require(
        re.search(
            r"(?i)(?:enter|provide|prompt).{0,80}(?:password|token|credential|api.?key)",
            diagnostic,
        )
        is None,
        f"{phase} requested a credential",
    )


def git_bytes(
    argv: list[str],
    root: Path,
    limit: int = 1048576,
    evidence: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> bytes:
    home = Path(os.environ["HOME"])
    tmp = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])
    result, stdout_bytes, _ = bounded_bytes(
        ["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(root), *argv],
        root,
        child_environment(home, tmp),
        60,
        limit,
    )
    require_success(result, "git " + " ".join(argv))
    require_git_stderr_contract(result)
    if argv == ["diff", "--binary", "HEAD"]:
        require_channel(result, "stdout", GIT_PATCH_STDOUT_SIZE, GIT_PATCH_STDOUT_SHA)
    if evidence is not None:
        evidence.update(
            {
                "argv": result["argv"],
                "stderr_contract": result["stderr_contract"],
                "stdout_sha256": result["stdout_sha256"],
                "stdout_size": result["stdout_size"],
            }
        )
    return stdout_bytes


def git_paths(root: Path, untracked: bool = False) -> list[bytes]:
    args = ["-c", "core.quotePath=false", "ls-files", "-z"]
    if untracked:
        args.extend(["--others", "--exclude-standard"])
    payload = git_bytes(args, root)
    require(payload.endswith(b"\0") or payload == b"", "Git path list terminator missing")
    return [] if not payload else payload[:-1].split(b"\0")


def file_record(root: Path, raw_path: bytes, path_class: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    relative = os.fsdecode(raw_path)
    path = root / relative
    info = path.lstat()
    mode = f"{stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode):04o}"
    if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        identity = hash_regular(path)
        kind = "regular"
        size = identity["size"]
        content_sha = identity["sha256"]
        target = None
    elif stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        target = os.readlink(path)
        encoded = os.fsencode(target)
        kind = "symlink"
        size = len(encoded)
        content_sha = sha(encoded)
    elif stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
        target = None
        kind = "directory"
        size = 0
        content_sha = EMPTY_SHA
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unsupported path type: {relative}")
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "mode": mode,
        "path": relative,
        "sha256": content_sha,
        "size": size,
        "symlink_target": target,
        "type": kind,
    }
    if path_class is not None:
        record["class"] = path_class
    return record


def canonical_manifest(root: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, int]]:
    tracked = git_paths(root)
    ordinary = [
        item
        for item in git_paths(root, True)
        if not item.startswith(b"data/") and not item.startswith(b"input/")
    ]
    classes = {item: "tracked" for item in tracked}
    for item in ordinary:
        require(item not in classes, "path belongs to two manifest classes")
        classes[item] = "ordinary-untracked"
    rows = [file_record(root, item, classes[item]) for item in sorted(classes)]
    payload = b"".join(compact(row) + b"\n" for row in rows)
    return payload, {
        "ordinary_untracked": len(ordinary),
        "records": len(rows),
        "tracked": len(tracked),
    }


def tree_manifest(root: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, int]]:
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), f"unsafe tree root: {root}")
    paths = sorted(
        root.rglob("*"),
        key=lambda item: os.fsencode(item.relative_to(root).as_posix()),
    )
    payload_parts: list[bytes] = []
    regular_bytes = 0
    for path in paths:
        raw = os.fsencode(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
        record = file_record(root, raw, None)
        if record["type"] == "regular":
            regular_bytes += int(record["size"])
        payload_parts.append(compact(record) + b"\n")
    return b"".join(payload_parts), {
        "path_count": len(paths),
        "regular_file_bytes": regular_bytes,
    }


def validate_source(root: Path) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    manifest, counts = canonical_manifest(root)
    require(counts == {"tracked": 2251, "ordinary_untracked": 71, "records": 2322}, "source counts mismatch")
    require(sha(manifest) == MANIFEST_SHA, "source manifest mismatch")
    patch_capture: dict[str, Any] = {}
    patch = git_bytes(["diff", "--binary", "HEAD"], root, evidence=patch_capture)
    require(sha(patch) == PATCH_SHA, "source patch mismatch")
    included = b"\0".join(
        item
        for item in git_paths(root, True)
        if not item.startswith(b"data/") and not item.startswith(b"input/")
    ) + b"\0"
    require(sha(included) == LIST_SHA, "included path list mismatch")
    excluded_manifest = require_identity(
        BASE / "candidate.OlsWg1/receipts/excluded-ordinary-untracked-manifest.jsonl",
        EXCLUDED_SHA,
        0o600,
    )
    require(excluded_manifest["size"] > 0, "excluded manifest is empty")
    return manifest, patch, included, patch_capture


def validate_data_input(root: Path) -> None:
    manifest, _ = canonical_manifest(root)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in manifest.decode("utf-8").splitlines()]
    selected = [row for row in rows if row["path"].startswith(("data/", "input/"))]
    require(
        [row["path"] for row in selected] == ["data/demo/.gitkeep", "data/projects/.gitkeep"],
        "data/input scaffold paths mismatch",
    )
    for row in selected:
        require(row["class"] == "tracked", "data scaffold is not tracked")
        require(row["type"] == "regular", "data scaffold is not regular")
        require(row["mode"] == "0644", "data scaffold mode mismatch")
        require(row["size"] == 1 and row["sha256"] == SCAFFOLD_SHA, "data scaffold bytes mismatch")
    excluded_bytes, _ = read_regular(BASE / "candidate.OlsWg1/receipts/excluded-data-input-untracked.zlist")
    excluded = [] if not excluded_bytes else excluded_bytes[:-1].split(b"\0")
    require(len(excluded) == 83, "excluded path count mismatch")
    for raw in excluded:
        require(not (root / os.fsdecode(raw)).exists(), f"excluded path present: {os.fsdecode(raw)}")


def validate_protected() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, identity = read_regular(PROTECTED_MANIFEST)
    require(identity["sha256"] == PROTECTED_SHA, "protected manifest hash mismatch")
    lines = payload.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
    require(len(lines) == 102, "protected manifest record count mismatch")
    source_media = 0
    for line in lines:
        record = json.loads(line)
        path = ORIGINAL / record["path"]
        info = path.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe protected path: {path}")
        require(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == int(record["mode"], 8), f"protected mode mismatch: {path}")
        require(info.st_size == record["size"], f"protected size mismatch: {path}")
        if record["category"] == "source-media":
            source_media += 1
            require(record["sha256"] == "818b669972b4e3f75f5358685ec231cd7daaaaa250c6525188291151c1109943", "source-media receipt mismatch")
        else:
            require(hash_regular(path)["sha256"] == record["sha256"], f"protected hash mismatch: {path}")
    require(source_media == 1, "source-media receipt count mismatch")
    require_identity(
        ORIGINAL / "data/evaluations/agent-v2-oauth-full-v4-20260928/agent-run-result.json",
        RESULT_SHA,
        0o600,
    )
    return {"records": 102, "manifest_sha256": PROTECTED_SHA, "source_media_content_read": False}


def status_counts(root: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    payload = git_bytes(["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"], root)
    records = [] if not payload else payload[:-1].split(b"\0")
    staged = 0
    modified = 0
    untracked = 0
    for record in records:
        code = record[:2]
        if code == b"??":
            untracked += 1
        else:
            modified += 1
            if code[:1] not in (b" ", b"?"):
                staged += 1
    return {"staged": staged, "modified_tracked": modified, "ordinary_untracked": untracked}


def validate_original(plan_sha: str, status_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    branch = git_bytes(["branch", "--show-current"], ORIGINAL).decode("utf-8").strip()
    head = git_bytes(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], ORIGINAL).decode("utf-8").strip()
    require(branch == "main" and head == HEAD, "original branch or HEAD mismatch")
    counts = status_counts(ORIGINAL)
    require(counts == {"staged": 0, "modified_tracked": 15, "ordinary_untracked": 154}, "original status counts mismatch")
    require_identity(REQUIREMENT, REQUIREMENT_SHA, 0o644, 16335)
    validate_documents(str(PLAN), plan_sha, str(STATUS), status_sha)
    return {"branch": branch, "head": head, **counts}


def validate_predecessors() -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    candidate_paths = sorted(
        (path for path in BASE.iterdir() if path.name.startswith("candidate.")),
        key=lambda path: os.fsencode(path.name),
    )
    require(
        [path.name for path in candidate_paths] == sorted(PREDECESSORS, key=os.fsencode),
        "predecessor candidate set mismatch",
    )
    for path in candidate_paths:
        require(path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), f"unsafe predecessor path: {path}")
    for name, (count, regular_bytes, current_sha, historical_sha) in PREDECESSORS.items():
        payload, totals = tree_manifest(BASE / name)
        require(totals["path_count"] == count, f"predecessor path count mismatch: {name}")
        require(totals["regular_file_bytes"] == regular_bytes, f"predecessor byte count mismatch: {name}")
        require(sha(payload) == current_sha, f"predecessor tree mismatch: {name}")
        result[name] = {
            **totals,
            "canonical_current_sha256": current_sha,
            "historical_receipt_sha256": historical_sha,
        }
    return result

def validate_profiles() -> dict[str, Any]:
    codex_home = Path("/Users/junhuaxu/.codex")
    info = codex_home.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not codex_home.is_symlink(), "unsafe Codex home")
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, (size, expected_sha) in PROFILES.items():
        result[name] = require_identity(codex_home / name, expected_sha, 0o600, size)
    config_path = codex_home / "config.toml"
    config_identity = require_identity(
        config_path,
        CURRENT_CONFIG_SHA,
        0o600,
        CURRENT_CONFIG_SIZE,
    )
    config_info = config_path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(config_info.st_mode) and not config_path.is_symlink(), "unsafe config path")
    require(
        (config_info.st_dev, config_info.st_ino, config_info.st_size)
        == (config_identity["device"], config_identity["inode"], CURRENT_CONFIG_SIZE),
        "config path identity mismatch",
    )
    require(config_identity["inode"] == CURRENT_CONFIG_INODE, "config inode mismatch")
    require(int(config_info.st_mtime) == CURRENT_CONFIG_TIMESTAMP, "config mtime mismatch")
    require(int(config_info.st_birthtime) == CURRENT_CONFIG_TIMESTAMP, "config birth time mismatch")
    require(int(config_info.st_ctime) == CURRENT_CONFIG_TIMESTAMP, "config ctime mismatch")
    result["config.toml"] = {
        **config_identity,
        "birth_ctime_mtime_epoch": CURRENT_CONFIG_TIMESTAMP,
    }
    for name, expected_sha in M2P_RECEIPTS.items():
        require_identity(M2P / name, expected_sha, 0o600)
    return result


def validate_python() -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = PYTHON.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode), "pinned Python launcher is not a symlink")
    require(os.readlink(PYTHON) == PYTHON_LINK_TARGET, "pinned Python link target mismatch")
    resolved = PYTHON.resolve(strict=True)
    identity = require_identity(resolved, PYTHON_SHA, 0o755, 34640)
    require(platform.python_version() == "3.12.14", "running Python version mismatch")
    require(platform.machine() == "arm64", "running Python architecture mismatch")
    require(hasattr(enum, "StrEnum"), "StrEnum unavailable")
    return {"launcher": str(PYTHON), "resolved": str(resolved), **identity}


def validate_uv(home: Path, tmp: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    executable = require_identity(UV, UV_SHA, 0o700, 37062400)
    require_identity(UV_ARCHIVE, UV_ARCHIVE_SHA)
    for name, expected_sha in UV_RECEIPTS.items():
        require_identity(UV_ROOT / "receipts" / name, expected_sha, 0o600)
    result = bounded(
        ["/usr/bin/codesign", "--verify", "--deep", "--strict", str(UV)],
        ORIGINAL,
        child_environment(home, tmp),
        30,
        65536,
    )
    require_success(result, "codesign")
    return {"executable": executable, "codesign": result}


def frozen_seed_dry_run() -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    payload, identity = load_json(FROZEN_SEED_PREFLIGHT)
    require_identity(
        FROZEN_SEED_PREFLIGHT,
        FROZEN_SEED_PREFLIGHT_SHA,
        0o600,
        FROZEN_SEED_PREFLIGHT_SIZE,
    )
    require(
        payload["format_version"] == 1
        and payload["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_PREFLIGHT"
        and payload["result"] == "PASS",
        "frozen seed preflight boundary mismatch",
    )
    result = payload["gates"]["seed"]["dry_run"]
    require_success(result, "frozen seed make dry-run")
    require_channel(result, "stdout", MAKE_DRY_STDOUT_SIZE, MAKE_DRY_STDOUT_SHA)
    require_make_stderr_contract(result)
    raw = result["stdout"].encode("utf-8")
    seed_path = os.fsencode(str(SEED))
    require(raw.count(b"\n") == 9, "frozen seed dry-run line count mismatch")
    require(raw.count(seed_path) == 8, "frozen seed path occurrence mismatch")
    require(raw.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 0, "frozen seed contains normalization token")
    normalized = raw.replace(seed_path, NORMALIZATION_TOKEN)
    require(normalized.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 8, "frozen normalized token count mismatch")
    require(
        len(normalized) == 1390 and sha(normalized) == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA,
        "frozen seed normalized identity mismatch",
    )
    return raw, normalized, {
        "identity": identity,
        "line_feeds": 9,
        "normalized_sha256": sha(normalized),
        "normalized_size": len(normalized),
        "seed_path_occurrences": 8,
        "stderr_contract": result["stderr_contract"],
    }


def validate_seed() -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(SEED.is_dir() and not SEED.is_symlink(), "unsafe seed")
    manifest, patch, included, patch_capture = validate_source(SEED)
    validate_data_input(SEED)
    remotes = git_bytes(["remote"], SEED)
    require(remotes == b"", "seed has a remote")
    for relative in (".python", ".venv", "apps/web/node_modules", ".cache/tiktoken", ".cache/playwright", ".loop"):
        require(not (SEED / relative).exists(), f"seed dependency/control root exists: {relative}")
    frozen_raw, frozen_normalized, frozen_evidence = frozen_seed_dry_run()
    quoted = shlex.quote(str(SEED / ".python"))
    dry_argv = [
        "/usr/bin/make",
        "--no-print-directory",
        "-n",
        "UV=../../trusted-tools/uv-0.12.17/extracted/uv-aarch64-apple-darwin/uv",
        "UV_CACHE_DIR_LOCAL=.cache/uv",
        f"UV_ENV=UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR={quoted}",
        "setup",
    ]
    dry_result, dry_bytes, _ = bounded_bytes(
        dry_argv,
        SEED,
        child_environment(Path(os.environ["HOME"]), Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])),
        60,
        65536,
    )
    require_success(dry_result, "seed make dry-run")
    require_channel(dry_result, "stdout", MAKE_DRY_STDOUT_SIZE, MAKE_DRY_STDOUT_SHA)
    require_make_stderr_contract(dry_result)
    require(dry_bytes == frozen_raw, "live seed dry-run differs from frozen raw bytes")
    seed_path = os.fsencode(str(SEED))
    require(dry_bytes.count(b"\n") == 9, "seed dry-run line count mismatch")
    require(dry_bytes.count(seed_path) == 8, "seed path occurrence mismatch")
    require(dry_bytes.count(NORMALIZATION_TOKEN) == 0, "seed contains normalization token")
    normalized = dry_bytes.replace(seed_path, NORMALIZATION_TOKEN)
    require(normalized == frozen_normalized, "seed normalized bytes differ from frozen evidence")
    require(len(normalized) == 1390 and sha(normalized) == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA, "seed normalized dry-run mismatch")
    post_manifest, post_counts = canonical_manifest(SEED)
    require(post_manifest == manifest and post_counts["records"] == 2322, "seed dry-run changed source")
    return {
        "dry_run": dry_result,
        "dry_run_sha256": sha(dry_bytes),
        "frozen_dry_run": frozen_evidence,
        "manifest_sha256": sha(manifest),
        "normalized_sha256": sha(normalized),
        "normalized_size": len(normalized),
        "patch_capture": patch_capture,
        "patch_sha256": sha(patch),
        "list_sha256": sha(included),
    }

def validate_wrapper(path: str, expected_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(path) == WRAPPER, "wrapper path mismatch")
    require(expected_sha == WRAPPER_SHA, "wrapper argument hash mismatch")
    return require_identity(WRAPPER, WRAPPER_SHA, 0o600, 2345)


def validate_v4_m2b() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = private_directory_identity(V4_M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(V4_M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(V4_M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V4_M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V4_M2B)) == {"home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "V4 stopped M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(V4_M2B / "home"), "V4 stopped M2B home changed")
    require(not os.listdir(V4_M2B / "tmp"), "V4 stopped M2B tmp changed")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V4_M2B / "receipts")) == {"source-receipt.json"},
        "V4 stopped M2B receipt set mismatch",
    )
    require(
        not (V4_M2B / "candidate-driver.py").exists()
        and not (V4_M2B / "candidate-driver.py").is_symlink(),
        "V4 stopped M2B driver unexpectedly exists",
    )
    source_identity = require_identity(
        V4_SOURCE_RECEIPT,
        V4_SOURCE_RECEIPT_SHA,
        0o600,
        V4_SOURCE_RECEIPT_SIZE,
    )
    payload, _ = load_json(V4_SOURCE_RECEIPT)
    require(payload["phase"] == "M2B_V4_SOURCE_WRITE", "V4 source phase mismatch")
    require(payload["returncode"] == 1, "V4 source return code mismatch")
    require(payload["timed_out"] is False, "V4 source timeout mismatch")
    require(payload["output_truncated"] is False, "V4 source truncation mismatch")
    require(payload["session_id"] is None, "V4 source session mismatch")
    require(payload["credential_variables"] == [], "V4 source credential evidence mismatch")
    require(payload["wrapper_error"] is None, "V4 source wrapper error mismatch")
    require(
        sha(argv_json(payload["argv"])) == V4_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA,
        "V4 transport argv identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        payload["output"].endswith("RuntimeError: transport phase mismatch\n"),
        "V4 source stop output mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "home": home,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "root": root,
        "source_receipt": source_identity,
        "stop": "V4_TRANSPORT_PHASE_MISMATCH",
        "tmp": tmp,
        "transport_argv_json_sha256": V4_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA,
    }


def validate_v6_m2b() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = private_directory_identity(V6_M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(V6_M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(V6_M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V6_M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V6_M2B)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "V6 M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(V6_M2B / "home"), "V6 M2B home changed")
    require(not os.listdir(V6_M2B / "tmp"), "V6 M2B tmp changed")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V6_M2B / "receipts"))
        == {"source-receipt.json", "self-check-result.json"},
        "V6 stopped receipt set mismatch",
    )
    driver = require_identity(V6_M2B_DRIVER, V6_DRIVER_SHA, 0o600, V6_DRIVER_SIZE)
    source_identity = require_identity(
        V6_SOURCE_RECEIPT,
        V6_SOURCE_RECEIPT_SHA,
        0o600,
        V6_SOURCE_RECEIPT_SIZE,
    )
    self_identity_record = require_identity(
        V6_SELF_CHECK_RESULT,
        V6_SELF_CHECK_RESULT_SHA,
        0o600,
        V6_SELF_CHECK_RESULT_SIZE,
    )
    source, _ = load_json(V6_SOURCE_RECEIPT)
    self_result, _ = load_json(V6_SELF_CHECK_RESULT)
    require_exact_keys(source, V6_WRAPPER_RESULT_KEYS, "V6 source receipt")
    require_exact_keys(self_result, V6_WRAPPER_RESULT_KEYS, "V6 self-check receipt")
    require(
        source["phase"] == "M2B_V6_SOURCE_WRITE"
        and source["returncode"] == 0
        and source["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.072293,
        "V6 source result mismatch",
    )
    require(
        self_result["phase"] == "M2B_V6_SELF_CHECK"
        and self_result["returncode"] == 1
        and self_result["elapsed_seconds"] == 0.291967,
        "V6 self-check result mismatch",
    )
    for label, record in (("source", source), ("self-check", self_result)):
        require(
            record["timed_out"] is False
            and record["output_truncated"] is False
            and record["session_id"] is None
            and record["credential_variables"] == []
            and record["wrapper_error"] is None,
            f"V6 {label} wrapper boundary mismatch",
        )
    require(
        len(source["argv"]) == 26
        and sha(argv_json(source["argv"])) == V6_TRANSPORT_ARGV_SHA,
        "V6 source argv identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        len(self_result["argv"]) == 25
        and sha(argv_json(self_result["argv"])) == V6_SELF_CHECK_ARGV_SHA,
        "V6 self-check argv identity mismatch",
    )
    traceback = self_result["output"]
    require(
        "in validate_v5_candidate" in traceback
        and "setup[\"output_truncated\"]" in traceback
        and traceback.endswith("KeyError: 'output_truncated'\n"),
        "V6 retained failure mismatch",
    )
    require(
        not (V6_M2B / "receipts/writer-self-test.json").exists()
        and not (V6_M2B / "receipts/final-index.json").exists()
        and not V6_RESERVED_EXECUTION_RESULT.exists(),
        "V6 forbidden downstream evidence exists",
    )
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "home": home,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "result": "STOPPED_SELF_CHECK_V5_SETUP_SCHEMA",
        "root": root,
        "self_check_result": self_identity_record,
        "source_receipt": source_identity,
        "tmp": tmp,
    }


def validate_v5_m2b() -> dict[str, Any]:
    expected = {
        "source-receipt.json": (12666, "dc205075bd8d2390d5f31ad2ae036031843968bca416d958720b1c657c0b6ae9"),
        "writer-self-test.json": (19244, "c9ff289716121d30fdd6f0e47b9a4a471d43fecb84096615fded7bd219f46f4e"),
        "self-check-result.json": (2066, "3fd414adb993e06b3f9ef5beb2415af688852eff45a72f690e16044f56bf713a"),
        "final-index.json": (V5_FINAL_INDEX_SIZE, V5_FINAL_INDEX_SHA),
        "candidate12-recovery-v5-execution-result.json": (
            V5_EXECUTION_RESULT_SIZE,
            V5_EXECUTION_RESULT_SHA,
        ),
    }
    root = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B)
    home = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "home")
    tmp = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "tmp")
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V5_M2B / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V5_M2B)) == {"candidate-driver.py", "home", "tmp", "receipts"},
        "V5 M2B root entries mismatch",
    )
    require(not os.listdir(V5_M2B / "home"), "V5 M2B home changed")
    require(not os.listdir(V5_M2B / "tmp"), "V5 M2B tmp changed")
    require(set(os.listdir(V5_M2B / "receipts")) == set(expected), "V5 M2B receipt set mismatch")
    files = {
        name: require_identity(V5_M2B / "receipts" / name, expected_sha, 0o600, size)
        for name, (size, expected_sha) in expected.items()
    }
    driver = require_identity(V5_M2B_DRIVER, V5_DRIVER_SHA, 0o600, V5_DRIVER_SIZE)
    index, _ = load_json(V5_M2B / "receipts/final-index.json")
    require(
        index["phase"] == "M2B_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and index["verdict"] == "M2B_V5_READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_REVIEW",
        "V5 M2B final index verdict mismatch",
    )
    execution, _ = load_json(V5_EXECUTION_RESULT)
    require(execution["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5", "V5 execution phase mismatch")
    require(execution["returncode"] == 1, "V5 execution return code mismatch")
    require(execution["elapsed_seconds"] == 209.426602, "V5 execution elapsed mismatch")
    require(
        execution["timed_out"] is False
        and execution["output_truncated"] is False
        and execution["session_id"] is None
        and execution["credential_variables"] == []
        and execution["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "V5 execution wrapper boundary mismatch",
    )
    require(
        len(execution["argv"]) == 29
        and sha(argv_json(execution["argv"])) == V5_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA,
        "V5 execution argv identity mismatch",
    )
    output = json.loads(execution["output"])
    require(output["candidate"] == str(V5_CANDIDATE), "V5 execution candidate mismatch")
    require(output["error"] == "RuntimeError: conflicting process detected", "V5 execution error mismatch")
    require(output["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5", "V5 output phase mismatch")
    result = output["result"]
    require(
        result["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and result["sealing_complete"] is True
        and result["sealing_errors"] == [],
        "V5 execution sealing mismatch",
    )
    require(
        result["path_count"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_COUNT
        and result["regular_file_bytes"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_BYTES
        and result["sha256"] == V5_CANDIDATE_TREE_SHA,
        "V5 completed attempt identity mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "driver": driver,
        "files": files,
        "home": home,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "result": "IMMUTABLE_M2_STOPPED",
        "root": root,
        "tmp": tmp,
    }


def validate_v5_candidate() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = private_directory_identity(V5_CANDIDATE)
    receipts = private_directory_identity(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts")
    require(
        set(os.listdir(V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts")) == set(CANDIDATE_RECEIPTS),
        "V5 candidate receipt set mismatch",
    )
    index_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/final-receipt-index.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SIZE,
    )
    stop_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/m2-stop-receipt.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_STOP_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_STOP_SIZE,
    )
    preservation_identity = require_identity(
        V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts/preservation-receipt.json",
        V5_CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_SHA,
        0o600,
        V5_CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_SIZE,
    )
    index, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("final-receipt-index.json")
    require_exact_keys(index["repository"], V5_SUMMARY_KEYS, "V5 repository summary")
    require_exact_keys(index["attempt_pre_index"], V5_SUMMARY_KEYS, "V5 pre-index summary")
    require_exact_keys(
        index["doctor_termination_evidence"],
        V5_DOCTOR_TERMINATION_KEYS,
        "V5 doctor termination evidence",
    )
    require(
        set(index["files"]) == set(CANDIDATE_RECEIPTS) - {"final-receipt-index.json"},
        "V5 indexed receipt set mismatch",
    )
    for name, identity in index["files"].items():
        require_exact_keys(identity, V5_FILE_IDENTITY_KEYS, f"V5 file identity {name}")
    require(
        index["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_FINAL_INDEX"
        and index["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and index["sealing_errors_before_index"] == [],
        "V5 candidate final index mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["repository"]
        == {
            "path_count": 27404,
            "regular_file_bytes": 573790192,
            "sha256": "8c8f1968ae67c045822c056e57ba4b2c00bd31088b728b8721e60de9912e7d83",
        },
        "V5 candidate repository identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["attempt_pre_index"]
        == {
            "path_count": 27443,
            "regular_file_bytes": 581532035,
            "sha256": "04272b56019ed3605f22b89328b13611f258e41eb5596768236d2603e8dd2f38",
        },
        "V5 candidate pre-index identity mismatch",
    )
    require(
        index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["status"] == "TERMINATED"
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["returncode"] == 0
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["termination_proven"] is True
        and index["doctor_termination_evidence"]["safe_to_seal"] is True,
        "V5 doctor termination evidence mismatch",
    )
    for name, identity in index["files"].items():
        require_identity(
            V5_CANDIDATE / "receipts" / name,
            identity["sha256"],
            0o600,
            identity["size"],
        )
    stop, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("m2-stop-receipt.json")
    require(
        stop["phase"] == "M2_STOP"
        and stop["verdict"] == "M2_STOPPED"
        and stop["error"] == "RuntimeError: conflicting process detected",
        "V5 stop receipt mismatch",
    )
    preservation, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("preservation-receipt.json")
    require(
        preservation["phase"] == "M2_PRESERVATION"
        and preservation["result"] == "FROZEN_PREALLOCATION_EVIDENCE",
        "V5 preservation fallback mismatch",
    )
    preflight, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("preflight-receipt.json")
    require(
        preflight["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE12_RECOVERY_V5_PREFLIGHT"
        and preflight["result"] == "PASS"
        and preflight["execute_argv_json_sha256"] == V5_EXECUTE_ARGV_SHA,
        "V5 preflight receipt mismatch",
    )
    dry_run, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("candidate-dry-run-validation.json")
    require(
        dry_run["phase"] == "M2_CANDIDATE_DRY_RUN_V5_VALIDATION"
        and dry_run["verdict"] == "PASS"
        and dry_run["normalized_size"] == 1390
        and dry_run["normalized_sha256"] == DRY_RUN_NORMAL_SHA,
        "V5 candidate dry-run evidence mismatch",
    )
    setup, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("setup-result.json")
    require(
        setup["phase"] == "M2_SETUP"
        and setup["returncode"] == 0
        and setup["timed_out"] is False
        and setup["stdout_truncated"] is False
        and setup["stderr_truncated"] is False
        and setup["aggregate_truncated"] is False
        and setup["capture_errors"] == []
        and setup["session_id"] is None
        and setup["credential_variables"] == []
        and setup["wrapper_error"] is None,
        "V5 setup result mismatch",
    )
    post_setup, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("post-setup-receipt.json")
    readiness, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("readiness-result.json")
    require(
        post_setup["phase"] == "M2_POST_SETUP"
        and post_setup["result"] == "PASS"
        and readiness["phase"] == "M2_READINESS"
        and readiness["result"] == "PASS"
        and readiness["issues"] == [],
        "V5 post-setup/readiness mismatch",
    )
    staging, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("doctor-profile-staging.json")
    validation, _ = load_v5_candidate_receipt("doctor-validation.json")
    require(
        staging["phase"] == "M2_DOCTOR_PROFILE_STAGING"
        and staging["result"] == "PASS"
        and staging["config_staged"] is False
        and staging["credential_content_read"] is False
        and staging["unrelated_operator_codex_content_read"] is False,
        "V5 profile staging mismatch",
    )
    require(
        validation["phase"] == "M2_LOOP_DOCTOR_VALIDATION"
        and validation["result"] == "PASS"
        and validation["returncode"] == 0
        and validation["failures"] == [],
        "V5 doctor validation mismatch",
    )
    return {
        "final_index": index_identity,
        "preservation": preservation_identity,
        "receipts": receipts,
        "root": root,
        "stop": stop_identity,
        "verdict": "M2_STOPPED",
    }



def validate_processes() -> None:
    result = bounded(
        ["/usr/bin/pgrep", "-fal", "make setup|loop-doctor|loop-init|loop-run"],
        ORIGINAL,
        child_environment(Path(os.environ["HOME"]), Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])),
        10,
        65536,
    )
    require(result["returncode"] == 1 and not result["timed_out"], "conflicting process detected")


def read_only_gates(
    values: dict[str, str],
    home: Path,
    tmp: Path,
    *,
    include_process_gate: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(Path(values["base"]) == BASE, "base path mismatch")
    require(Path(values["seed"]) == SEED, "seed path mismatch")
    base_info = BASE.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(base_info.st_mode) and not BASE.is_symlink(), "unsafe candidate base")
    require(stat.S_IMODE(base_info.st_mode) == 0o700, "candidate base mode mismatch")
    require(shutil.disk_usage(BASE).free >= 5 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, "insufficient disk")
    require(not any(SECRET_NAME.search(name) for name in os.environ), "credential variable present")
    require("CODEX_HOME" not in os.environ, "CODEX_HOME is forbidden")
    if include_process_gate:
        validate_processes()
    return {
        "active_monitoring_policy": ACTIVE_MONITORING_POLICY,
        "documents": validate_documents(values["plan"], values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["status"], values["expected_status_sha256"]),
        "original": validate_original(values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["expected_status_sha256"]),
        "protected": validate_protected(),
        "predecessors": validate_predecessors(),
        "old_m2b": validate_old_m2b(),
        "v2_m2b": validate_v2_m2b(),
        "v3_m2b": validate_v3_m2b(),
        "v4_m2b": validate_v4_m2b(),
        "v5_m2b": validate_v5_m2b(),
        "v5_candidate": validate_v5_candidate(),
        "v6_m2b": validate_v6_m2b(),
        "profiles": validate_profiles(),
        "process_gate": "PASS" if include_process_gate else "NOT_REPEATED_POST_DOCTOR",
        "python": validate_python(),
        "uv": validate_uv(home, tmp),
        "seed": validate_seed(),
    }

def validate_wrapper_result(
    path: Path,
    expected_phase: str,
    expected_argv_sha: str,
    expected_cwd: Path,
    expected_timeout: int,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    payload, identity = load_json(path)
    require(identity["mode"] == "0600", "wrapper result mode mismatch")
    require(payload["format_version"] == 1 and payload["phase"] == expected_phase, "wrapper result phase mismatch")
    require(payload["cwd"] == str(expected_cwd), "wrapper result CWD mismatch")
    require(payload["timeout_seconds"] == expected_timeout, "wrapper timeout mismatch")
    require(payload["output_limit_bytes"] == 1048576, "wrapper output limit mismatch")
    require(payload["returncode"] == 0, "wrapper result nonzero")
    require(payload["timed_out"] is False, "wrapper result timed out")
    require(payload["output_truncated"] is False, "wrapper result truncated")
    require(payload["session_id"] is None, "wrapper result session present")
    require(payload["credential_variables"] == [], "wrapper result credentials present")
    require(payload["wrapper_error"] is None, "wrapper result error present")
    require(sha(argv_json(payload["argv"])) == expected_argv_sha, "wrapper argv JSON hash mismatch")
    return payload, identity


def self_check(values: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    started_at_utc = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    driver_identity = self_identity(values["expected_self_sha"])
    active_phase_check = validate_active_phase_names()
    current_argv = [str(PYTHON), str(DRIVER), *sys.argv[1:]]
    environment = validate_phase_environment(
        "M2B_V7_SELF_CHECK",
        60,
        current_argv,
        M2B / "receipts/self-check-result.json",
    )
    m2b_state = validate_m2b_state("self-check", values["expected_self_sha"])
    documents = validate_documents(values["plan"], values["expected_plan_sha256"], values["status"], values["expected_status_sha256"])
    wrapper_identity = validate_wrapper(values["wrapper"], values["expected_wrapper_sha"])
    process_identity = require_identity(SEED / "tools/loop_engineering/process.py", PROCESS_SHA, 0o644)
    toolchain_identity = require_identity(SEED / "tools/loop_engineering/toolchain.py", TOOLCHAIN_SHA, 0o644)
    source_receipt = Path(values["source_receipt"])
    require(source_receipt == M2B / "receipts/source-receipt.json", "source receipt path mismatch")
    receipt, receipt_identity = validate_wrapper_result(
        source_receipt,
        "M2B_V7_SOURCE_WRITE",
        values["expected_transport_argv_json_sha256"],
        SEED,
        60,
    )
    transport = receipt["argv"]
    expected_names = [
        "--plan", "--expected-plan-sha256", "--status", "--expected-status-sha256",
        "--begin-marker", "--end-marker", "--destination", "--expected-writer-size",
        "--expected-writer-sha256", "--expected-driver-size", "--expected-driver-sha256",
    ]
    require(transport[:4] == [str(PYTHON), "-c", transport[2], "--"], "transport prefix mismatch")
    require(len(transport) == 4 + len(expected_names) * 2, "transport argv length mismatch")
    require(transport[4::2] == expected_names, "transport option order mismatch")
    transport_values = dict(zip((name[2:] for name in expected_names), transport[5::2], strict=True))
    plan_bytes, _ = read_regular(PLAN)
    writer_source = extract_once(plan_bytes, WRITER_BEGIN, WRITER_END)
    driver_source = extract_once(plan_bytes, DRIVER_BEGIN, DRIVER_END)
    require(transport[2].encode("utf-8") == writer_source, "executed writer bytes mismatch")
    require(len(writer_source) == int(values["expected_writer_size"]), "writer size argument mismatch")
    require(sha(writer_source) == values["expected_writer_sha256"], "writer hash argument mismatch")
    require(transport_values["plan"] == str(PLAN), "transport plan mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-plan-sha256"] == values["expected_plan_sha256"], "transport plan hash mismatch")
    require(transport_values["status"] == str(STATUS), "transport status mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-status-sha256"] == values["expected_status_sha256"], "transport status hash mismatch")
    require(transport_values["begin-marker"] == DRIVER_BEGIN[:-1].decode("ascii"), "transport begin marker mismatch")
    require(transport_values["end-marker"] == DRIVER_END[:-1].decode("ascii"), "transport end marker mismatch")
    require(transport_values["destination"] == str(DRIVER), "transport destination mismatch")
    require(int(transport_values["expected-writer-size"]) == len(writer_source), "transport writer size mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-writer-sha256"] == sha(writer_source), "transport writer hash mismatch")
    require(int(transport_values["expected-driver-size"]) == len(driver_source), "transport driver size mismatch")
    require(transport_values["expected-driver-sha256"] == sha(driver_source), "transport driver hash mismatch")
    require(driver_identity["sha256"] == sha(driver_source), "installed driver differs from plan")
    writer_summary = json.loads(receipt["output"])
    require(writer_summary["phase"] == "M2B_V7_SOURCE_WRITE", "writer summary phase mismatch")
    require(writer_summary["file_fsync"] is True and writer_summary["directory_fsync"] is True, "writer durability mismatch")
    fsync_existing(source_receipt)
    fsync_directory(source_receipt.parent)
    test_path = M2B / "receipts/writer-self-test.json"
    try:
        probe_fd = os.open(source_receipt, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    except FileExistsError:
        no_replace = True
    else:
        os.close(probe_fd)
        raise RuntimeError("O_EXCL failed to reject existing source receipt")
    fixture = {"a": [1, "\u4e2d"], "z": False}
    fixture_bytes = compact(fixture)
    require(json.loads(fixture_bytes.decode("utf-8")) == fixture, "canonical JSON fixture mismatch")
    capture_test = bounded(
